jobs.title: Director, Private Client and Corporate Business
jobs.description:
PRIVATE CLIENT

Guerlain has a unique strength: 2% of its VIC and VVIC clients account for 27% of SO Retail, an exceptional benchmark in the world of perfumes and cosmetics.

Guerlain wants to accelerate this key differentiator and unique competitive advantage in the US, while continuously enriching this client base with new recruitment pools.

Client & business Development

• You will develop and nurture a high-value portfolio of private clients by identifying new recruitment opportunities and leveraging existing and new networks.
• In close partnership with Marketing, you will design and activate high-profile, exclusive brand experiences and events that strengthen desirability, deepen client relationships, and generate incremental sales.
• In close partnership with HQ Private client team, you will identify local levers and use tools and assets developed at HQ level – virtual bridges, product & experience offer, client tools – to elevate client experiences. You will follow global client guidelines to ensure global consistency in TOP clients treatment.

PEX and high end sales

• In collaboration with locale sales and retail team as well as HQ Private team, we will develop a PEX and bespoke fragrance dedicated action plan from client identification, events and experiences, training, sales and follow up.

P&L & Strategic Objectives

• You will define and execute short-, medium-, and long-term strategies to deliver ambitious sales and P&L objectives. You will lead Private Sales in the US, fostering strong commitment and accountability, while optimizing sales activities to maximize profitability, market share, turnover, and sales volume.
• You will ensure close alignment and collaboration with key internal stakeholders to drive sustainable business performance.

CORPORATE SALES

In a context focused on identifying new growth opportunities and highly value-accretive business, while further enhancing brand desirability and awareness, the Maison Guerlain aims to create a new business unit alongside its existing business model: the corporate sales.

This corporate unit would complement the current Direct Retail business — including Boutiques and Department Stores — as well as the selective, high-quality Wholesale business.

It would be dedicated to developing new, out-of-store business opportunities, operated directly by the Maison and without intermediaries or third-party distributors.

Sales & Business development

• You will be responsible for developing and driving Corporate Sales in the US, from identifying and prospecting potential clients through to crafting tailored proposals and overseeing final delivery.
• The role will focus on building an entirely new network of business opportunities across multiple segments, including B2B, weddings, events, and other high-value occasions.
• You will be expected to identify new revenue streams, establish long-term relationships with key partners and clients, and build a sustainable Corporate & Events business for the Maison in the US.

Strategic objectives

• You will define clear tools, objectives, KPIs, and targets for this new business unit, establishing the framework required to build and scale the business successfully.
• Leveraging the tools and resources developed by HQ, you will define the commercial offer, pricing strategy, legal terms, and financial conditions, ensuring that all activities are conducted in full compliance with Guerlain’s rules, standards, and ethical principles.
• You will establish a robust and sustainable commercial model that balances business growth, profitability, brand equity, and long-term value creation.

BRAND PARTNERSHIPS

• Through these new strategic initiatives, you will also contribute to elevating the Maison by fostering meaningful synergies and strategic partnerships.
• You will be the key contact for any co-eventing or co-partnership initiative, playing a critical role in leveraging synergies with spas and hotel partners, across LVMH brands, as well as with other key strategic partners, in keeping with the Maison’s image and brand positioning.”
• You will guide and develop partnerships strategies, through to their orchestration while also engaging with other potential key stakeholders.
• These initiatives will also contribute to and support the two aforementioned missions, while ensuring that both private and corporate relationships are fully leveraged.

Key Interactions

• Directly reporting to GM, you will work closely with all US teams as well as HQ teams.
• On a day-to-day basis, you will work closely with the following teams: Retail, Training, Digital & Omnichannel, Finance, Press Relations and Marketing. You will also collaborate extensively with all Guerlain international teams especially, working very close with the New business & Private Client director and team at HQ.
• You will have interactions and bridges with your counterparts at a global level.
• You will also build and develop a strong network with VIC teams across other LVMH & external Maisons, with the aim of creating synergies and sharing best practices as well as developing a corporate network.

• More than 10–15 years of experience in customer marketing within the luxury sector (retail, hospitality, concierge services, etc.).
• Strong entrepreneurial mindset, with the drive and ability to explore new areas, define their scope, bring stakeholders together and engage them around key topics, while ensuring these initiatives gain visibility and traction across the organization.
• Recognized expertise in high-end clientele, with a proven ability to develop effective action plans and transform sales.
• Your own network of (U)HNWIs contacts and possess great social and networking skills deeply rooted in the local community.
• Excellent ability to operate in a demanding environment.
• Natural leadership, excellent interpersonal skills, and the ability to bring together and engage a wide range of internal and external stakeholders.
• Strong team spirit is essential, along with agility, responsiveness, and a solution-oriented mindset.
• Ability to prioritize and manage complexity, with a high degree of autonomy.
• Fluent/bilingual in English – Full proficiency in Microsoft Office.

jobs.title: English as a New Language Specialist
jobs.description:
Uncommon English as a New Language Specialists are passionate, fierce advocates for their students, who manage both teaching our diverse population of English Language Learners and supporting their General Education colleagues.. They also provide crucial academic interventions to students who are developing their English language skills and believe they are capable of high academic achievement.

• You will review intake assessments to ensure that all students receive the educational services and instructional methods that they need to succeed aligned with their English proficiency.

• You will serve as push-in support for English Language Learners across grade and content areas.

jobs.title: Lead Product Quality Chemist
jobs.description:
The North America Product Quality team safeguards the integrity of Veolia’s chemical portfolio through rigorous quality assurance, continuous process improvement, and proactive incident resolution. We serve as a critical technical resource for the Supply Chain, leading initiatives in supplier assessment, manufacturing optimization, and product scale-up. Furthermore, our team drives innovation and operational excellence by providing deep analytical expertise, validating QC specifications, and conducting comprehensive manufacturing capability assessments.

The Lead Product Quality Chemist serves as a strategic technical leader within the North America Product Quality team, responsible for optimizing laboratory operations and driving continuous quality improvement. This role integrates advanced analytical chemistry expertise with operational oversight to ensure adherence to rigorous quality standards, mentor laboratory personnel, and execute cross-functional initiatives that support Supply Chain goals and long-term business objectives.

Key Characteristics:

Technical Proficiency & Analytical Expertise

• This role requires strong hands-on laboratory skills with sophisticated instrumentation (ICP, spectrophotometers, viscometers, auto-titrators) and the ability to perform calibration, maintenance, and troubleshooting. The candidate must develop deep technical knowledge in analytical methods, quality control procedures, and process chemistry to support manufacturing and product development

Problem-Solving & Continuous Improvement Mindset

• The position demands proactive identification and resolution of manufacturing issues through root cause analysis (RCA), process troubleshooting, and quality incident investigations. Success requires driving manufacturing improvements, managing off-spec inventory rework, and supporting cost-savings initiatives—all requiring analytical thinking and innovation.

Cross-Functional Collaboration & Communication

• This role serves as a critical bridge between multiple departments (Manufacturing, Technology, Supply Chain, Regulatory, EHS, etc.) and requires frequent travel to North American plants for training, support, and scale-up activities. Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to communicate complex technical information to diverse audiences are essential for success.

Essential Functions

• Technical Leadership & Laboratory Operations: Oversee laboratory operations and advanced analytical testing (e.g., ICP, spectrophotometers, titrations), ensuring equipment maintenance, calibration, and troubleshooting align with rigorous quality standards.
• Manufacturing Support & Process Optimization: Provide direct technical and chemical process support to North American production plants, including batch troubleshooting, product scale-up, and guidance on manufacturing standards.
• Quality Assurance & Compliance: Manage and update QC procedures and material specifications, ensuring continuous compliance with ISO quality initiatives, regulatory requirements, and safety protocols.
• Quality Incident Management & Problem Solving: Lead quality incident investigations and conduct formal Root Cause Analysis (RCA) exercises to resolve manufacturing issues, manage off-spec inventory, and drive corrective actions.
• Strategic Initiatives & Digital Integration: Leverage digital tools (e.g., SAP, data analytics) to monitor production trends, enhance process visibility, and lead manufacturing initiatives focused on cost-savings and operational excellence.
• Cross-Functional Collaboration: Build and maintain collaborative relationships with Supply Chain, Technology, Manufacturing, EHS, and Commercial teams to align technical quality goals with long-term business objectives.
• Professional Development & Field Support: Travel to NORAM sites as needed for process scale-up, manufacturing support, and technical training of plant operators. (10% travel required)

• Bachelor’s Degree in Chemistry or related field with applicable laboratory or work experience.
• Minimum of 3-5 years of professional experience in process, analytical (lab), or quality chemistry.
• Experience with analytical instrumentation, wet chemistry, and sample preparation.
• Knowledge and experience in industrial chemical manufacturing processes.
• Strong organizational skills and ability to manage and drive multiple projects in a fast-paced and dynamic environment.

Desired Traits:

• Demonstrated ability to master specific chemical products/processes and analytical
• equipment methods.
• Experience with instrumental techniques including sample/standard preparation and method development for ICP, spectroscopy, and titrations.
• Ability to interpret and understand analytical results from chromatography and NMR spectra.
• Experience with SAP data platform software.
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Strong technical written communication skills.
• Strong problem-solving skills, with a results-oriented mindset.
• Experience with quality control, quality assurance, and/or chemical manufacturing processes.
• Experience with making data-driven decisions that impact quality, cost, processes, etc.
• Strong project management skills and ability to proactively push projects forward to meet deadlines.

Under the direction of a supervisor and in compliance with all company safety protocols, the Irrigation Maintenance I role supports preventative maintenance and agricultural operations. This position involves hands-on work in the field and shop, assisting with irrigation systems and general farm maintenance.

Functions include but are not limited to the following. Must be able to move freely between tasks depending on workload, season, etc.

• Assist with assembling, inspecting, cleaning, and replacing irrigation pump and motor equipment.
• Perform basic troubleshooting and maintenance on pumps, valves, and fittings.
• Conduct preventive maintenance such as oiling motors and greasing pumps.
• Support setup for new water well development (excavation, PVC installation).
• Operate basic heavy equipment (e.g., forklifts, service trucks).
• Perform general farm maintenance: cleaning, painting, minor irrigation fixes.
• Maintain cleanliness and organization of the irrigation shop.
• Follow all safety protocols and wear appropriate PPE.
• Other duties as assigned.

Farm Maintenance

• Cleaning up of roadways, equipment yards, shops
• Painting
• Address minor irrigation fixes.
• Occasional welding (if no experience, training will be provided on the job)
• Other duties as assigned

Additional

• Keep equipment stocked.
• Maintain Safety protocols when performing different types of tasks. Wearing the appropriate PPE.
• Always maintain the Irrigation Maintenance shop clean.
• General maintenance, installations, repairs, or electrical work at the different Wonderful Orchards locations.
• Other duties as assigned.

Pay Range: $20-$21/hour. Final compensation will be dependent upon skills & experience

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily.  The requirements listed below are representative of the knowledge, shall, and/ or ability required.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

Critical Skills (Soft skills/ transferable)

• Consistently follow standard work and standard operating procedures.
• Satisfactory reading comprehension of manuals, directions, safety hazards
• Satisfactory communication skills including writing emails, texts, report outs
• Self-directed individual with troubleshooting and problem-solving skills
• Able to take and read various measurements – land depth, length, voltage

Functional Skills (Hard skills/ job-specific)

• Proven experience in electrical, construction, or commercial environments is required
• Basic to Advance knowledge of: Pumps, motors, filter stations, sulfur burners, gypsum machine, fertilizer and acid pumps
• Read, understand and apply Operating Manuals, plans and specifications and visualize two-dimensional drawings in three dimensions.
• The ability to drive a truck and trailer. The ability to properly secure a load.
• Experience using Global Positioning System (GPS)
• Comprehension and practice of farm safety, electrical safety, and trench safety

EDUCATION and/or EXPERIENCE:

• 1-2 years working with Agricultural Farm Equipment preferred and/or 1 year working experience with wonderful farming operations (Irrigation Department)Proven experience in electrical, construction, or commercial environments is required

CERTIFICATIONS AND LICENSES:

• Valid state driver’s license

jobs.title: Automation Technician
jobs.description:
The Automation Technician is responsible for installing, maintaining, troubleshooting, and optimizing robotic systems and automated manufacturing equipment. This role ensures equipment reliability, supports continuous improvement initiatives, and contributes to safe and efficient production operations.

Key Responsibilities

• Installation & Commissioning
• Install, configure, and calibrate industrial robots, PLCs, HMIs, sensors, and automation systems.
• Assist in commissioning new automated equipment and validating system performance.
• Interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and wiring diagrams.

Maintenance & Troubleshooting

• Perform preventive and corrective maintenance on robotic arms, conveyors, vision systems, actuators, and control systems.
• Diagnose mechanical, electrical, and programming faults using diagnostic tools, software, and test equipment.
• Restore systems to optimal performance with minimal downtime.
• Programming & Technical Support
• Modify robot pathways, PLC logic, and machine parameters as needed.
• Support continuous improvement and process optimization initiatives.
• Collaborate with engineering teams to implement automation upgrades.

Safety & Compliance

• Ensure all robotic cells and automation systems meet applicable safety standards (e.g., lockout/tagout, guarding, emergency stop circuits).
• Support safety audits and equipment validations.
• Maintain accurate documentation, maintenance logs, and technical reports.

Collaboration

• Work closely with maintenance, production, engineering, and quality teams to resolve equipment issues.
• Provide technical guidance to operators and maintenance personnel.
• Assist in training personnel on automated equipment use and basic troubleshooting.

Required Qualifications

• Experience with industrial robots such as ABB, FANUC, KUKA, Yaskawa, or similar.
• Knowledge of PLCs (Allen-Bradley, Siemens, Mitsubishi), HMIs, and industrial networks.
• Strong mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills.
• Ability to read blueprints, wiring diagrams, and control schematics.

Preferred Qualifications

• Associate degree in Robotics, Mechatronics, Industrial Automation, Electrical Technology, or related field — or equivalent experience.
• Certification in robotics or automation (e.g., FANUC HandlingTool, ABB IRC5, Allen‑Bradley PLC).
• Experience in manufacturing, automotive, aerospace, or food production environments.
• Understanding of pneumatics, hydraulics, vision systems, and servo control.
• Familiarity with safety standards such as ANSI/RIA, NFPA 70E, OSHA.

Key Competencies

• Strong problem‑solving and analytical thinking.
• Excellent communication and teamwork abilities.
• Adaptability and willingness to learn advanced automation technologies.
• Attention to detail and commitment to safety.

The salary range for this role is $35 to $38 (hourly) all salaries will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Jack Link’s Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Jack Link’s provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to be successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and talk or hear.  The employee is occasionally required to sit, and reach with hands and arms.  The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The work environment is a plant / office setting with varying degrees of temperatures and noise levels. Exposure to manufacturing equipment movement and wet / slippery floors. Travel may be required.

IMPORTANT: If the Government cannot confirm that you are authorized to work, we are required to provide you written instructions and an opportunity to contact SSA and/or DHS before taking adverse action against you, including terminating your employment. jobs.title: Service Software Developer
jobs.description:
Team Overview

Diagnostic App team is a small team that builds and maintains front end experiences that power critical diagnostic workflows across Robotic platforms used both by engineers and field service personnel.

We partner closely with Product Management, UX/UI Design, Mechanical and Electrical Engineering, Embedded Engineering, Product Support Engineers and QA teams to deliver cohesive, intuitive user experiences that scale across all of Intuitive platforms. Our primary product is a dashboard-like tool that provides data, log analysis and visualization platform used across Da Vinci 5 and expanding to additional product lines such as ION. This role offers the opportunity to contribute to shared design systems, shape front-end architecture decisions, and directly influence how users interact with our products across platforms.

Primary Function of the Position

As a Service Software Engineer on the Diagnostic App team, you will be designing, developing, and maintaining responsive and scalable user interfaces that help internal field service and engineering teams make sense of complex robotic system data. This role focuses on translating design requirements into high-quality code, contributing to reusable UI components, and ensuring seamless user experiences.

What you’ll do:

• Create new interfaces that help engineering users debug robotic systems, triage issues, and more easily understand complex system interactions.

• Understand robotic systems and electro-mechanical design and underlying software so as to debug software interfaces and translate engineering data to field service usable interfaces.

• Basic understanding of user research, wireframing, and user journeys.

• Strong intuition for designing user centered software, accessibility and a working knowledge of UX principles.

• Able to design backend interfaces that will feed data into the user interface.

• Develop Knowledge base articles that convey usage of the tool and build in instrumentation / interview usage of tool from the field.

• Translate UX/UI designs into clean, maintainable, and reusable code.

• Ensure consistent UI behavior across multiple platforms and applications

• Participate in code reviews to maintain code quality and enforce front-end standards

• Collaborate with Product Managers and Experienced Field Service Personnel to understand problem statements, clarify requirements and refine user interactions.

• Work closely with embedded teams to integrate APIs and ensure seamless data flow

• Troubleshoot UI defects and performance issues

• Support QA in identifying root causes of UI-related defects

• Contribute to improving UI architecture, standards, and documentation

• Maintain awareness of evolving technologies and recommend improvements when appropriate

What you’ll bring:

• Experience in robotics / hardware debugging with front-end development experience preferably in JavaScript/TypeScript and modern React.

• Must possess effective analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills on hardware and software.

• Must possess strong attention-to-detail, individual initiative, sense of ownership, and organizational skills.

• Must be a self-starter and capable of working effectively with little supervision and be capable of identifying and driving individual projects.

• Proven ability to design responsive UI/UX flows for complex technical users (e.g., engineers, dev tools, or internal productivity tools).

• Strong systems thinking with the ability to understand how backend data, logs, states, and robotic system events interconnect.

• Ability to operate autonomously in a small team with ambiguous or evolving requirements across teams.

• Familiarity with REST APIs and asynchronous data handling

• Experience with version control systems such as Git

• Understanding of UI performance optimization techniques

• Ability to debug UI issues effectively and independently

You'll impress us if you have:

• Experience contributing to software interfaces for hardware systems.

• Experience working across multiple applications or shared UI platforms

• Experience with 3D visualization, simulation, or interactive graphics (nice to have, not required).

• Familiarity with log analysis tools, developer tooling, or internal platform engineering.

• Exposure to Python, Linux, or cloud deployment environments (AWS).

• Exposure / experience in bringing in AI agentic solutions that could improve user experience.

What Success Looks Like

• You quickly gain a deep understanding of Diagnostic App users and propose UI solutions the end users haven’t thought of asking for.

• You design and deliver intuitive visualizations that make debugging and understanding robotic systems substantially easier.

• You collaborate closely with the Product team and existing Diagnostic App team to shape strategy, architecture, and roadmap direction.

• You demonstrate strong ownership by seeing problems end‑to‑end and driving improvements to both product and process.

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19.  Details can vary by role.

jobs.description:
The NM Internal Agency RN reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

A clinically competent, registered, professional nurse who prescribes, delegates and coordinates nursing care to the acutely ill patient through the nursing process of assessment, planning, intervention, implementation and evaluation.  Effectively interacts with patients, significant others, and other health team members, while maintaining ANA standards of professional nursing practice.  The NM Internal Agency RN will be prepared to perform these duties at all NM hospitals as required by the schedule.

As a member of the NM Internal Agency RN Team, the nurse in this role will have assignments that span across all NM hospital locations.  Generally, the minimum assignment at the same hospital location will be six (6) continuous weeks, with the maximum assignment not to exceed six (6) continuous months at the same hospital location.  This position offers the RN the opportunity to enhance their clinical skills, as well as sharpen communication and teamwork. The NM Internal Agency RN works with many diverse people and grows relationships with fellow staff members all over Northwestern Medicine’s system hospitals.

Responsibilities:

• Collects and analyzes data, identifies expected outcomes, develops and implements an individualized plan, coordinates care delivery and evaluates progress toward attainment of outcomes.
• Directs care and determines the appropriate utilization of any assistant involved in providing direct patient care.
• Collaborates with patient, family and/or significant others, physicians and ancillary staff. Creates a documented plan, focused on outcomes and decisions related to the care and delivery of services that indicates communications with patients, families, and others.
• Participates in shared decision making, committee work, and unit projects.
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings.
• Utilizes the best available evidence, including research findings to guide practice decisions.

Required:

• Minimum of two years of inpatient med/surg, stepdown or ICU experience.
• Current State of Illinois Registered Professional Nurse
• CPR – Basic Life Support
• Strong interpersonal skills
• Ability to collaborate with others
• Strong analytic abilities
• ADN - Associate Degree Nursing (ADN) with commitment to obtain a BSN from an accredited program within three years of first day of employment in clinical nurse role.
• ACLS
• PALS

Preferred:

• Previous RN experience in a float or coverage capacity in the inpatient hospital setting
• Bachelor of Science in Nursing, with expectation to obtain BSN after 2 years of employment

jobs.title: Internal Relief Veterinarian
jobs.description:
Three Hospitals. One Culture. One Standard of Care.

As our Internal Relief Veterinarian, you’ll travel between three sister hospitals in southeastern New Hampshire—covering for doctors on vacation or leave, stepping in seamlessly, and bringing your best every time you walk through the door.

• Canobie Lake Veterinary Hospital — Windham, NH | 2024 AAHA Practice of the Year
• All Pets Veterinary Hospital — Nashua, NH
• Greenland Veterinary Hospital — Greenland, NH

All three hospitals are AAHA-accredited, busy, and fully equipped. Each runs on the same culture—Conscious Care®—our owner’s trademarked program built around compassion for self, team, clients, patients, and community. You won’t feel like a stranger walking in. You’ll feel like you belong.

What Makes This Role Unique

Relief veterinarians at most practices still carry the full weight—the callbacks, the follow-up lists, the administrative details that were never really yours. That’s not how we do it.

Here, you are a doctor. Full stop.

• You see appointments, perform exams, make diagnostic and treatment plans, and do surgery and dentals (don’t like surgery and dentals, no problem)
• Client follow-up and administrative detail stay with the permanent team—not you
• Your task list is lean by design, so your headspace stays on medicine
• A personal assistant supports your appointments—checking in and checking out clients and monitoring your flow throughout the day
• We stay on schedule so you walk out on time, every shift

jobs.title: Technical Account Manager
jobs.description:
Extend is the all-in one document AI platform that provides models, APIs, and infra for developers and agents to make every document process programmatic. AI teams at companies like Square, Zillow, Brex, Flatiron Health, Checkr, and Mercury use Extend to parse, extract, and edit their most complex documents.

We're looking for a Technical Account Manager at Extend. You will own the technical and commercial health of a book of 40–50 of our mid-market and startup customers. We are looking for a technical seller: someone an engineering team trusts to debug their integration, and who can then turn that trust into renewals, expansions, and saved contractions.

Our customers are the most technical AI and engineering teams. When one of them starts asking internally whether they still need Extend or could just use a frontier model, no usage dashboard will tell you. You'll know because you're on their weekly call. 

We're looking for someone with sharp commercial instincts, the technical fluency to hold their own with developers, and the presence to run a room of customer stakeholders and control the narrative when things aren't going perfectly.




WHY YOU SHOULD CONSIDER JOINING

 - We've grown revenue 6x YoY with our growth continuing to accelerate (8 figures, 200%+ NRR)

 - We have a product loved by users and being used in mission-critical flows at enterprises (Square, Zillow, Chime) and startups (Brex, Mercury, Checkr), and many more

 - The market for document processing has expanded 1000x due to LLMs, and all existing solutions are low NPS

 - We're punching well above our weight, supporting customer and revenue metrics with half the team size of other startups — everyone joining at this stage will have outsized impact

 - We've raised our Series A, de-risked the business, and our sales team has exceeded quota every quarter, but there's still tremendous upside ahead; now's the perfect time to join

 - You'll be joining a talent dense team, operating in a high performance culture, in-person in NYC, with high equity ownership

 - You'll get a front row seat to how a successful startup is built, with plenty of leadership opportunities as we grow quickly
   
   


ROLE & IMPACT

 - Account management: Own our customers' post-sales journey from onboarding, to adoption, to renewal + expansion

 - Account monitoring: track usage trends across your book, both growth and contraction, so you spot expansion and churn signals before the customer raises them

 - Build the early-warning system: define which events and actions tell us an account is healthy, expanding, or at risk, and turn that into reporting and playbooks we can reuse across the long tail

 - Frontline technical support: answer customer questions, work through API issues (keys, JSON output, logs) far enough to scope the problem, and escalate cleanly to our support and document engineering teams

 - Own the relationships: run weekly-to-biweekly check-ins with the technical stakeholders at the ~20 accounts you're actively focused on each quarter, learn their business model and product roadmap, and know what's coming before it lands

 - Own the number: drive renewals, orchestrate expansions, and de-risk contractions across a book of 40–50 accounts — including commercial conversations to right-size contracts
   
   


IDEAL CANDIDATE CREDENTIALS

 - You've owned commercial outcomes: you've managed renewals, negotiated, handled objections, and de-risked a contraction yourself — not supported someone else who did

 - You're technical enough to build trust with engineers: you can talk fluently about APIs, debugging, and latency, you know how to scope an issue, and you know when to say "let me bring in an engineer" instead of guessing

 - You can command a room: run a meeting with a customer's engineers and leadership, control the narrative, and move a tense conversation forward

 - You're resourceful and self-directed: you've built your own onboarding and your own systems at a company where neither existed yet

 - 4–6 years of experience in customer success, account management, solutions, or technical support at a developer tools, data/analytics, or AI-native software company

 - Ideally 1-2 years at a growth stage startup





BENEFITS

Beyond the below, we care deeply about each of our candidates on a personal level. We take the time to understand your needs to craft a package designed for you:

 - Insurance — 100% health insurance premium coverage

 - Relocation — for candidates based outside of NYC

 - Unlimited PTO policy — we trust everyone like owners, take what you need

 - Daily lunch & snacks covered (plus dinner if you're in the office late) — you'll never go hungry and you help pick the snacks

 - Unlimited token / tooling access — no handicaps on your productivity

 - Learning and development investment — we invest heavily in our team and support your growth

jobs.title: Manager, SEO+ AEO
jobs.description:
ABOUT VAYNERMEDIA

VaynerMedia is a global integrated creative and media agency, built for today's consumers. As the Modern Agency of Record, it understands the nuances of today's attention landscape, empowering brands to win attention, drive relevance, and deliver business results. Founded in 2009, by Gary Vaynerchuk, the independently owned agency operates in 15 offices worldwide, including Amsterdam, Bangkok, Chicago, New Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Miami, New York, Tokyo, Toronto, Singapore, and Sydney. VaynerMedia is part of the VaynerX family of companies.

Overall Purpose: We are seeking an SEO Manager to execute day-to-day SEO tactics and drive continuous improvement in our clients’ organic search performance. Reporting to the SEO Director, this person will be hands-on in conducting keyword research, optimizing website content, fixing technical SEO issues, and monitoring results to ensure steady growth in rankings and traffic. The SEO Manager will translate the overall strategy into actionable tasks – working closely with content creators and developers – and will play a key role in delivering on client KPIs for organic visibility. This role is ideal for a detail-oriented SEO specialist who can balance multiple projects and stay ahead of search algorithm changes in a dynamic agency environment.

KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY:

• Execute comprehensive SEO tasks for client websites on a daily basis. This includes conducting in-depth keyword research, optimizing on-page elements (titles, meta descriptions, headings, content) for target keywords, and improving internal linking to boost relevance and rankings .

• Perform regular technical SEO audits to identify and resolve issues that could impact crawlability or rankings – such as broken links, sitemap errors, indexing problems, site speed/performance issues, or mobile usability concerns. Coordinate with developers to implement technical fixes and enhancements

• Implement and manage off-page SEO efforts like link building and content outreach campaigns under the guidance of the SEO Director. Identify backlink opportunities, manage relationships for guest posts or partnerships, and monitor backlink profiles for quality and compliance

• Monitor and analyze SEO performance metrics using tools like Google Analytics, Google Search Console, and other SEO software. Track keyword rankings, organic traffic trends, click-through rates, and conversion metrics. Prepare regular reports that detail progress, insights, and recommendations for each client

• Continuously refine SEO tactics based on data-driven insights: if certain keywords or pages are underperforming, adjust the strategy (update content, tweak keywords, improve page UX, etc.) to capitalize on opportunities. Use A/B testing or multivariate testing for SEO changes when applicable to measure impact

• Stay up-to-date with search engine algorithm changes (Google core updates, etc.) and industry trends. Quickly adapt optimization strategies in response to new SEO developments or ranking factor changes to maintain and improve client results

• Collaborate closely with the SEO Director to ensure alignment with the overarching SEO strategy and priorities. Provide input and feedback during strategy sessions based on on-the-ground findings and performance data

• Work with content writers to plan and produce SEO-friendly content (blog posts, landing page copy, etc.) that balances ranking objectives with quality and user intent. Similarly, liaise with web developers/designers to ensure site changes or new features are SEO-compliant (for example, proper use of heading tags, avoidance of content duplication, etc.)

• Educate or inform junior team members, account managers, or clients on SEO best practices as needed – helping others understand how SEO efforts contribute to broader marketing goals

EXPERIENCE/KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED:

• 5–8 years of hands-on SEO experience, preferably in an agency or multi-client environment. Proven track record of implementing SEO tactics that have led to improved rankings and organic traffic growth over time (case studies or examples will be a plus).

• Solid understanding of search engine algorithms and ranking factors. Expertise in both on-page SEO (content optimization, HTML tags, keyword usage) and technical SEO (site architecture, page speed optimization, structured data). Familiarity with off-page SEO and link-building strategies is also required .

• Proficiency with SEO and analytics tools: must be adept at using Google Search Console and Google Analytics for monitoring performance, as well as SEO-specific tools like Ahrefs, SEMrush, Moz, or similar for research and tracking. Ability to use these tools to diagnose issues and find opportunities is essential.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Comfortable digging into data to identify trends or anomalies, and translating those into actionable SEO improvements. Should be able to make data-driven decisions and measure the impact of optimizations (e.g., changes in rankings or traffic after a fix)

• Ability to translate keyword opportunities into actionable recommendations for

• relevant and engaging content to drive viewer engagement and page ranking

• Excellent time management and organizational abilities – capable of balancing priorities across several client projects and delivering results on schedule. Adaptable and resilient, with the ability to adjust strategies quickly in response to algorithm updates or shifts in client goals

• Good communication skills, both written and verbal. Able to clearly report on SEO performance and explain complex SEO concepts in simple terms to clients or account teams. Effective at collaborating with cross-functional colleagues, such as content writers, designers, and developers, to implement SEO recommendations .

• Keen attention to detail and a commitment to quality. Ensuring accuracy in reporting, avoiding mistakes in optimization (like broken links or incorrect redirects), and adhering to best practices that prevent penalties

• Passion for SEO and digital marketing – stays curious and continuously learns about new SEO tools, techniques, and trends. Maybe you experiment with new strategies on your own or follow industry experts to keep your knowledge fresh

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, computer science, or a related field is a plus. Relevant certifications (e.g., Google Analytics Individual Qualification) are welcome but not mandatory

Your Impact

As an HSE Specialist, you will play a key role in advancing Pearce’s health, safety, and environmental objectives across Solar, Energy Storage Systems (ESS), UPS, Battery, Wind, and EV operations. This highly field-focused position will partner closely with operational teams to strengthen safety performance, with particular emphasis on electrical safety and driver safety.

You will support the implementation and continuous improvement of HSE programs, conduct field audits, investigate incidents, identify safety risks, develop corrective actions, and provide training and coaching to employees and operational leaders. You will also help manage driver safety initiatives aimed at reducing vehicle-related incidents and improving safe-driving behaviors across the organization.

Success in this role requires a strong working knowledge of HSE regulations and electrical safety practices, the ability to influence employees and leaders at all levels, and a willingness to travel extensively to support field operations throughout the United States.

Core Responsibilities

• Conduct field safety audits, inspections, and observations to evaluate compliance with company policies, customer requirements, and applicable regulations.

• Support implementation and continuous improvement of HSE management systems and reporting processes.

• Maintain compliance with applicable federal, state, and local HSE requirements, including OSHA and EPA standards.

• Travel to project sites and operational locations throughout the United States to provide hands-on HSE support, training, audits, incident response, and coaching.

Core Qualifications

• Demonstrated knowledge of electrical safety practices and hazards associated with electrical and energy-related field operations.

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with the ability to coach, influence, and build credibility with employees and leaders at all levels.

• Strong organizational and problem-solving skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently in a remote and field-based environment.

jobs.title: Forward Deployed Engineer - MX
jobs.description:
FORWARD DEPLOYED ENGINEER - MEXICO



About the Company

We're partnering with an AI-native operating system for supply chains used by wholesalers, manufacturers, retailers, and traders. The platform integrates logistics and procurement data through connections with internal and external systems, enabling predictive analytics and automated workflows that improve fill rates, reduce inventory levels, and optimize cash-to-cash cycle time.

By leveraging predictive analytics and automation, the company helps large enterprises reduce costs, unlock additional revenue, and prevent under- or over-stocking across complex global supply chains.



Role Overview

The Forward Deployed Engineer (FDE) is the person who makes the platform work in the real world. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, client operations, and AI implementation — and owns the technical execution of how the platform gets built into each client's environment.

The FDE works directly with clients and the Implementation team, learns how each client's systems and operations actually run, and builds the integrations, automations, and AI solutions that make the platform mission-critical. This is a first-of-its-kind role at the company — the person who takes it will be defining what forward deployment looks like here.



Key Responsibilities

 - Build integrations between the platform and client systems — ERPs, WMS, TMS, data warehouses — writing real code to connect, extract, and transform data across environments

 - Deploy alongside clients in their environment — understand how their teams actually operate, where data breaks, and what needs to be built or configured to run reliably

 - Design, implement, and iterate on AI workflows using the company's platform — agentic flows, prompt engineering, context design, and output evaluation — tuned to each client's specific supply chain use cases

 - Own the reliability, performance, and continuous improvement of live deployments — monitor outputs, identify failure modes, and fix them without waiting to be asked

 - Translate what you build and learn in the field into structured product feedback, technical documentation, and reusable playbooks — so the next deployment starts smarter than the last



Profile We're Looking For

 - You build things: Min. 2-4 years of hands-on engineering experience — Python, REST APIs, SQL — and a portfolio of real integrations or systems you've shipped, not just designed

 - You operate in ambiguity: comfortable walking into a client environment without a complete spec, asking the right questions, and figuring out what needs to be built — without waiting for perfect requirements

 - You understand data end-to-end: how it flows across systems, where it breaks, and what it takes to make it clean and reliable enough for AI to use — SQL or equivalent is second nature

 - You have a working understanding of AI and LLMs: enough to design prompts, evaluate outputs critically, and know when a model result looks right but isn't

 - You communicate clearly across audiences: can explain a technical integration to a VP of Operations and write clean documentation for an engineer — in both Spanish and English

 - You own what you ship: high accountability, low ego — you track down the root cause, fix it, and make sure it doesn't happen again

 - Based in LATAM or the US, available to work across time zones and travel to client sites when needed



Nice to Have

 - Background in supply chain, logistics, or operations — you'll understand what stockouts, fill rates, and OTIF mean without needing a glossary

 - Experience integrating with enterprise systems like SAP, Oracle, or similar ERPs and WMS platforms

 - Previous experience in a forward-deployed, solutions engineering, or customer-facing technical role

jobs.title: Payroll Compliance Manager
jobs.description:
Payroll Compliance Manager is responsible for developing, maintaining, and monitoring payroll compliance programs and internal controls across the organization. This role ensures payroll practices comply with federal, state, and local wage-and-hour, tax, garnishment, recordkeeping, and reporting requirements.

The Payroll Compliance Manager will serve as the payroll subject-matter expert for audits, regulatory changes, system controls, policy development, and risk mitigation. The successful candidate must have strong hands-on experience with UKG Pro and UKG Workforce Management and demonstrated proficiency using artificial intelligence tools to improve payroll auditing, compliance monitoring, data analysis, documentation, and operational efficiency.

Responsibilities

Payroll Compliance and Governance

• Monitor compliance with federal, state, and local payroll laws, including wage-and-hour, overtime, minimum wage, final-pay, pay-frequency, meal and rest-period, paid-leave, tax, and record-retention requirements.

• Maintain a comprehensive payroll compliance calendar covering tax filings, regulatory deadlines, year-end activities, audits, reconciliations, and policy reviews.

• Research regulatory changes and translate requirements into payroll policies, procedures, system configurations, and operational controls.

• Partner with Legal, Human Resources, Finance, Tax, Benefits, Operations, and Internal Audit to address payroll compliance risks.

• Review payroll policies and procedures to ensure consistent application across locations, business units, and employee populations.

• Maintain documentation supporting payroll decisions, regulatory interpretations, and corrective actions.

UKG System Compliance

• Serve as a functional subject-matter expert for UKG Pro and UKG Workforce Management.

• Evaluate UKG configurations to ensure compliance with company policies, wage-and-hour requirements, and payroll tax rules.

• Review pay codes, deduction codes, accruals, work rules, overtime rules, rounding rules, holiday rules, security roles, workflows, and approval controls.

• Partner with Payroll Operations, HRIS, IT, and UKG support teams to test and implement system changes.

• Develop UKG queries, reports, dashboards, and exception reporting to identify payroll compliance issues.

• Validate system updates, configuration changes, interfaces, and patches through documented testing and approval processes.

• Maintain configuration documentation, test scripts, control matrices, and system-change records.

Artificial Intelligence and Payroll Analytics

• Use approved AI tools to enhance payroll compliance audits, exception analysis, trend identification, policy research, documentation, and process improvement.

• Develop and maintain AI-assisted payroll audit prompts, compliance checklists, risk models, and standardized review procedures.

• Use AI and data analytics to identify anomalies such as duplicate or unusual payments, excessive manual adjustments, repeated missed punches, unauthorized timecard edits, and overtime anomalies.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent professional experience.
• Minimum of 5 years of progressive payroll experience, including at least 3 years in payroll compliance, audit, controls, or payroll management.

• Strong hands-on experience with UKG Pro and UKG Workforce Management is required.

• Demonstrated experience supporting complex, high-volume, multi-state payroll operations.

• Strong knowledge of federal, state, and local wage-and-hour and payroll tax requirements.

• Experience performing payroll audits, developing internal controls, and resolving compliance findings.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including pivot tables, lookups, data validation, exception analysis, and large-data reconciliation.

• Demonstrated proficiency using generative AI and AI-enabled analytics tools in a professional payroll, compliance, finance, audit, or HR environment.

• Strong analytical, research, documentation, project-management, problem-solving, and communication skills.

• Ability to handle confidential employee and payroll information with discretion.

jobs.title: Medical Science Liaison
jobs.description:
At Veracyte, we offer exciting career opportunities for those interested in joining a pioneering team that is committed to transforming cancer care for patients across the globe. Working at Veracyte enables our employees to not only make a meaningful impact on the lives of patients, but to also learn and grow within a purpose driven environment. This is what we call the Veracyte way – it’s about how we work together, guided by our values, to give clinicians the insights they need to help patients make life-changing decisions.

Our Values:

• We Seek A Better Way: We pursue bold ideas, embrace complexity, and keep pushing forward.

• We Make It Happen: We act with urgency, deliver with excellence, and always find a way.

• We Are Stronger Together: We engage with empathy, align around what's best for Veracyte, and celebrate as one team.

• We Care Deeply: We show up with integrity, kindness, and respect for one another.

The Position:

Our Medical Science Liaisons (MSLs) is a critical part of Decipher Urologic Cancers business group. They are clinical/genomic experts who provide clinical product education to our customers and our field teams with the goal of driving understanding and adoption of our novel diagnostics. Our MSLs have strong communication skills and are energized by building rapport with our HCP customers as well as our sales team and addressing their educational and customer needs. They will be expected to partner closely across the organization to serve as a scientific and clinical resource for the company's products and associated disease states, providing both internal and external educational support. This also includes providing support for the development of multi-channel medical educational activities and tools across the product lifecycle such as speaker programs, educational materials, slide creation, and on-line educational events.

The MSL functions as a field-based member of the marketing department within the commercial team. This is a full-time position with approximately 70% of time devoted to client-facing activities mostly at the request of the sales team, in-person and remote, and 30% spent on internal collaborations and special projects.

• They are clinical/genomic experts who provide clinical product education to our customers and our field teams with the goal of driving understanding and adoption of our novel diagnostics.

• They will be expected to partner closely across the organization to serve as a scientific and clinical resource for the company's products and associated disease states, providing both internal and external educational support.

• This also includes providing support for the development of multi-channel medical educational activities and tools across the product lifecycle such as speaker programs, educational materials, slide creation, and on-line educational events.

• This role requires at least 60% travel and provides coverage of key customers and support of field teams over multiple states in the United States.

• The coverage geography will be primarily in the Northeast and Midwest, with trips to other parts of the country.

• This position is remote but we would prefer a candidate located in Boston, New York, Philadelphia, or Washington, DC.

Who You Are:

Required Qualifications

• Advanced scientific or clinical degree required- PhD, MD, NP, PA, CGC

• At least 5 years of clinical experience – preferably urology/radiation oncology-focused

• Advanced understanding of tumor biology and molecular testing and/or related working experience critical for success in this role

• Outstanding interpersonal skills and a team player, demonstrating customer centricity, passion for patients and desire to help the cross-functional teams succeed

• Outstanding oral and written presentation skills, to convey complex study findings and data to audiences with varying degrees of scientific/clinical/healthcare knowledge

• Outstanding interpersonal skills in building rapport, probing, situational awareness and adapting communication and content based on real time needs of audience

• Willingness and ability to travel within defined region with proximity to a major airport

• A detail-oriented, organized, self-starter approach, with strong ability to multitask yet prioritize workload

Preferred Qualifications

• Prior experience as an MSL in the introduction of a novel clinical assay preferred

#LI-Remote

For candidates working remote (US), the range is $162,000 - $196,000.

The final salary offered to a successful candidate will be dependent on several factors that may include but are not limited to years of experience, skillset, geographic location, industry, education, etc. Base pay is one part of the Total Package that is provided to compensate and recognize employees for their work, and this role may be eligible for additional discretionary bonuses/incentives, and restricted stock units.

Pay range

$162,000—$196,000 USD

What We Can Offer You

Veracyte is a growing company that offers significant career opportunities if you are curious, driven, patient-oriented and aspire to help us build a great company. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, and are committed to fostering an inclusive workforce, where diverse backgrounds are represented, engaged, and empowered to drive innovative ideas and decisions. We are thrilled to be recognized as a 2024 Certified™ Great Place to Work® in both the US and Israel - a testament to our dynamic, inclusive, and inspiring workplace where passion meets purpose.

About Veracyte

Veracyte (Nasdaq: VCYT) is a global diagnostics company whose vision is to transform cancer care for patients all over the world. We empower clinicians with the high-value insights they need to guide and assure patients at pivotal moments in the race to diagnose and treat cancer. Our Veracyte Diagnostics Platform delivers high-performing cancer tests that are fueled by broad genomic and clinical data, deep bioinformatic and AI capabilities, and a powerful evidence-generation engine, which ultimately drives durable reimbursement and guideline inclusion for our tests, along with new insights to support continued innovation and pipeline development. jobs.description:
About Us

Social Finance is a national nonprofit and registered investment adviser expanding economic opportunity in America. We bring government, philanthropy, and business leaders together to improve systems and put capital to work in new ways. Since our founding in 2011, we have mobilized more than $500 million to create measurable results in workforce and education, health, and housing.

We are driven by the belief that social and economic systems should enable all people to thrive, and the conviction that we can create the most meaningful and measurable change in our communities when governments and markets work together. Our organization is built upon five core values: people, performance, integrity, collaboration, and inclusion.

Our work spans four areas: Impact-first Investing, Workforce and Education Investments, Advisory & Public Sector Practice, and the Social Finance Institute. Our Impact-first Investment team designs, launches, and manages investments that provide solutions for effectively deploying impact capital across a range of social outcomes. Our Workforce and Education Investments team designs, launches and manages financial solutions focused on addressing workforce challenges, including skills acquisition and training access. Our Advisory team partners with government and philanthropy leaders to implement data-driven programs for advancing social impact. And through the Social Finance Institute, we aim to build the field and change systems through actionable research, communities of practice, and educational outreach.

The Public Sector Practice

Through our Public Sector practice, we work alongside impact-focused leaders to build innovative funding structures and implement data-driven practices that deliver better results for people and communities.

Role and Responsibilities

This Associate, Public Sector position is based in either our Boston, MA, Washington D.C, San Francisco, CA or Austin, TX office. Associates of the Public Sector are an integral part of the Social Finance team and are staffed to multiple Advisory projects that span our various service offerings. Working together with a team, key activities may include:

Public Sector Projects

• Conduct research, analyzing data, and reviewing evidence to support project design decisions, test hypotheses, and drive recommendations to optimize operations and help achieve project outcomes

• Exercise progressing project management skills to include scheduling meetings, aiding in the execution of work plans, overseeing project timelines, coordinating team tasks, and ensuring effective communication within the team.

• Create, deliver and present materials, analyses, key findings and recommendations for both internal team and external partners; Lead interviews and facilitate discussion groups

• Conduct economic cost-benefit and other forms of analyses

• Support the drafting and review of contract, governance and scope-of-work documents; Write summaries, reports and email correspondence, etc.

• Research potential project partners; analyzing their performance and ability to achieve future outcomes to identify promising programs and support project design

• Collaborate with evaluation firms, when needed, to identify and measure key performance outcomes

Field Building

• Write blog posts and support the creation of white papers and reports that publish key learnings and findings from our work

• Contribute to and support research efforts in social issue areas and interventions

Firm Building

• Apply technical expertise in AI tools and infrastructure to help test and implement improved processes across systems and active projects

• Support analysis and writing for responses to proposal documents (i.e. Requests for Proposals) and concept notes for potential business development opportunities

• Create communications materials and preparing managers for external calls that could lead to new opportunities

• Contribute to capacity-building initiatives, such as recruiting, professional development, knowledge management, fundraising, or other internal projects

• Provide real-time feedback to team members to support professional growth and contribute to high-quality deliverables

• Support senior management, internal functional teams, and Social Finance project teams as needed

• Support our goal to foster a culture of well-being and belonging

Qualifications

We are looking for entrepreneurial candidates with flexibility, aptitude, and passion for our mission. Candidate requirements:

• 2-5 years of full-time professional experience in a role with relevant and transferrable skills, which may include those focused on research, consulting, finance, project management, social impact, or other

• Strong analytical and quantitative skills; basic statistical knowledge is a plus

• Strong verbal and written communication skills

• Ability to quickly research, synthesize and summarize key takeaways on unfamiliar topics

• Experience with AI tools or platforms in a professional setting (e.g. prompt engineering, AI-assisted workflows, or data infrastructure)

• Ability to communicate and work closely with many types of partners across multiple sectors; willingness to constructively express your point of view and hear the point of view of others, both internally and externally

• Commitment to high-quality work and accuracy, with an ability to manage multiple and competing priorities simultaneously

• Capacity to work independently while contributing to team projects as appropriate

• Demonstrated interest in and knowledge of or willingness to learn about key issues in nonprofit management, social interventions, government services, and/or impact investing

• Ability to adapt, be flexible and operate with a growth mindset

• Commitment to enhancing a team culture of inclusion, belonging and equity

• The following are not required, but would be considered as a plus for your candidacy:

• Experience in or with the systems we seek to impact

• Advanced PowerPoint experience

• Advanced experience in Excel

Benefits

At Social Finance, we strive to deliver a benefits program that will enhance our overall value proposition to employees. Our current benefit offerings include:

• Comprehensive health care coverage: medical, dental and vision insurance; flexible spending accounts; Employee Healthy Actions programs and more

• Retirement savings plan with employer contribution

• Short-term, long-term and life insurance policies

• Commuter benefits and cell phone reimbursements

• Hybrid work model (in office a minimum of two days per week and on an ad-hoc basis as needed)

• Dedicated budgets for team building and employee recognition

• Annual budget for external professional development opportunities

• Mentorship and onboarding programs

• Collaborative and energizing workspaces in downtown Boston, San Francisco, Austin and Washington, D.C.; New York, NY. This position can be hired in Austin, Boston, San Francisco or Washington D.C.

• Paid vacation and paid holidays (with 12/24-1/1 off every year)

• Paid parental leave

• A truly stellar team of high performing, values-driven and fun (!) professionals

Salary

Social Finance uses a lockstep compensation model for purposes of equity and transparency - we strive for everyone coming in at a given level to be paid equitably. For this position, at the Associate level, the starting base salary is $81,000; however, during the interview process, we will take into account a candidate's full work experience and may adjust the job title, and commensurate starting salary, as appropriate. If joining our San Francisco office, this hire would receive an additional $1,000 for every month they are residing in the state of California within a commutable distance of our office in San Francisco.

At this level, employees typically receive a $2,500 salary increase annually and are eligible to participate in our firmwide annual bonus program (bonuses are typically between 5-10%, though bonuses are not guaranteed and are dependent on both organizational and individual performance).

jobs.title: Electrical and Instrumentation Engineer - Oil and Gas
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Atwell, LLC is a bold leader in the consulting, engineering, and construction services industry, delivering a broad range of creative solutions to clients in the real estate & land development, and energy markets. We have a strong national presence and a diverse, award-winning project portfolio. Atwell is a privately owned company, with 2,000+ passionate team members across 75+ locations and growing!

Atwell, LLC is a proud recipient of the following 2025 awards:

• Ten consecutive years in a row as a “Best Place to Work” by Zweig Group (#11)

• Recognized as #70 in the ENR Top 500 Design Firms, ranked in every region

• Recognized in Crain's “Fast 50” as one of the fastest-growing companies (#14)

• Recognized as the 2025 ENR Design Firm of the year for the Southeastern US

Position Snapshot

Atwell is hiring an Electrical & Instrumentation Engineer with oil and gas experience to support natural gas, CO₂, hydrogen, RNG, and midstream pipeline/facility projects. This role will focus on electrical power distribution, instrumentation, controls coordination, equipment specification, and construction support for pipeline and facility projects.

You’ll support E&I engineering from concept through design, procurement, construction, and commissioning while coordinating with multi-discipline project teams to ensure safe, compliant, practical, and constructible designs.

Essential Functions

• Lead and support electrical and instrumentation engineering tasks for oil and gas pipeline and facility projects.

• Provide technical guidance to designers, engineers, and project teams while reviewing and implementing client-requested design changes.

• Serve as a technical liaison with clients, EPC partners, vendors, internal teams, and construction personnel.

• Support project execution by communicating scope, schedule, technical requirements, risks, and design changes.

• Mentor junior engineers and designers while promoting collaboration across civil, mechanical, structural, process, controls, and survey teams.

• Maintain and apply E&I best practices, industry standards, client requirements, and Atwell design procedures.

• Travel to client sites, Atwell offices, vendor facilities, and active jobsites as needed.

Education

• Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.

• Professional Engineer license preferred, or ability to obtain based on state and project requirements.

• Oil and gas, midstream, pipeline, industrial, or facility engineering experience strongly preferred.

Day to Day

• Act as an E&I engineering resource for pipeline and facility projects, including compressor stations, meter and regulator stations, terminals, valve sites, pump stations, and related midstream facilities.

• Develop and review electrical and instrumentation design deliverables, including one-lines, load lists, cable and conduit schedules, grounding plans, area classification, lighting, heat trace, I/O lists, loop drawings, and instrument location plans.

• Coordinate with process and mechanical teams on P&IDs, equipment layouts, instrumentation requirements, control narratives, and package equipment interfaces.

• Prepare and review equipment specifications and data sheets for switchgear, MCCs, transformers, panels, VFDs, generators, UPS systems, instrumentation, analyzers, PLC/RTU panels, SCADA, telecom, and related E&I equipment.

• Perform or review electrical studies such as short circuit, protective device coordination, arc flash, voltage drop, motor starting, cable sizing, and grounding calculations using SKM, ETAP, or similar software.

• Support procurement through RFP packages, vendor bid evaluations, technical clarifications, equipment reviews, and coordination with suppliers.

• Provide construction and commissioning support, including RFIs, submittal reviews, FAT/SAT support, punch lists, startup planning, energization support, and field issue resolution.

• Review project deliverables for compliance with applicable codes, client standards, company procedures, and project requirements.

• Coordinate with internal teams including Development, Engineering, Permitting, GIS, Land, Survey, and Construction to support project scope, schedule, and budget.

• Maintain organized calculations, design files, QA/QC documentation, change logs, and project records.

Preferred Tools & Experience

• Experience with SKM Power Tools, ETAP, or similar electrical analysis software.

• Experience with AutoCAD, AutoCAD Electrical, Bluebeam, Microsoft Office, and related design/documentation tools.

• Familiarity with PLC/RTU systems, SCADA, telecom, control panels, instrumentation, and control system integration.

• Experience supporting electrical and instrumentation design for compressor stations, meter stations, pump stations, terminals, valve sites, pipeline facilities, or industrial facilities.

• Field experience supporting installation, testing, troubleshooting, commissioning, and startup in operating facilities.

• Consulting, EPC, or owner/operator experience within oil and gas, midstream, hydrogen, CO₂, RNG, or industrial energy projects preferred.

Pay Range - $115,000 - $165,000 base, + bonus, + benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Talent Operations
jobs.description:
Toast is driven by building the all-in-one restaurant platform that helps restaurants operate their business, increase sales, engage guests, and keep employees happy. Our Talent Operations team is the heartbeat of our People and Places function, responsible for building global scalable tools, systems, processes, and dashboards that support our employees at every stage of their employee journey. We are helping transform the way that the People and Places Team delivers service to employees.

As the Senior Manager of Talent Operations (NA) you will help build and deliver a frictionless employee experience spanning across the employee lifecycle for our teams in North America. You will have a critical role on the operations leadership team and will play a part in building out a global “shared services” model. In this role, you will be accountable for the team of people providing front line support for all employee inquiries including benefits and leave administration as well as other operational activities and program delivery. To be successful in this role, you must have a customer-centric and continuous improvement mindset, a proven ability to leverage technology and processes to elevate the employee experience, strong stakeholder management as well as experience building and managing a shared services team in a global matrixed organization.

This role reports to the Director, Talent Operations and will work closely across our global centers of excellence (COEs).

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Lead People Services (Shared Services) delivery for the North America region.

• Coach, manage and develop a team of people operations professionals, with a focus on high-quality service delivery across the employee lifecycle including operations, benefits, compensation, and more.

• Define and monitor metrics and SLAs to measure success of the team and provide insights for decision-making.

• Drive continuous improvements focused on automation, standardization and scalability that improve Toaster experiences, increase efficiency, and ensure compliance with local laws and customs.

• Build strong relationships with stakeholders across the People Team, Legal, Finance, and Business teams to influence change and drive the adoption of an evolving service delivery model.

• Be the local subject matter expert that can influence Global COEs on program design that is locally relevant and compliant while aligned to global principles.

• Partner across the People & Places team globally to prioritize and deliver on a variety of small to large, complex, integrated People team initiatives.

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• Typically requires 12+ years of related experience with a Bachelor’s degree; or 8+ years and a Master’s degree; or a PhD with 5+ years experience; or equivalent experience.

• 7+ years of experience in managing People Operations/Shared Service Functions.

• 5+ years of proven people management and leadership experience in a global organization.

• Experience operating in a matrixed structure.

• Expertise in Global HR Transformation, strategy, design and transition of People Operations to create value for the organization.

• Manage compliance with labour regulations, GDPR requirements and best practices to ensure Toast remains compliant.

• Familiarity with SOX and have managed programs and processes that are SOX compliant.

• Proficiency in leveraging AI technologies, including platforms like Claude, to optimize operational workflows, accelerate service delivery, and elevate overall employee experience.

• Understanding of HR Technology, HR reporting, workflow, and auditing requirements (experience with Greenhouse, Workday and ServiceNow is valuable).

• Excellent analytical, problem solving and decision making skills with a strong attention to detail.

• Prior exposure to or background supporting the EMEA market is highly desirable.

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy
We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits.

The base salary range for this role is listed below. The starting salary will be determined based on skills, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, our total rewards components include cash compensation (overtime, bonus/commissions if eligible), equity, and benefits. You can learn more about how we align pay with local labor markets in our Geographic Pay Zone Philosophy.

Pay Range

$120,000—$192,000 USD

How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. The restaurant industry brings together people with a wide range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives, and we value that same breadth at Toast. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

Apply today!
