Who We Are

East Harlem Scholars Academies are community-based Pre-K to 12 public charter schools operated by  East Harlem Tutorial Program (EHTP). EHTP began in 1958 as a children's reading group and has since grown into a multi-site after-school program for traditional public school students and a network of public charter schools focused on significantly increasing the college graduation rate in East Harlem.

At EHTP we also aim to serve as an agent of change and thoughtfully contribute to the national fight for racial equity. Through our organization-wide commitment to anti-racism work, we prepare our scholars to effect change, challenge the status quo, and thrive in the world around them. As staff members, we face our own racial identities and conscious and unconscious biases. With this in mind, all of our professional development, curriculum, organizational materials, and processes are designed with a goal of racial justice.

We ground all of our work in racial equity, in our core values (Service, Courage, Humility, Originality, Leadership, Achievement, and Reflection), and in our five guiding principles: 1) all children can and will succeed when provided a great education; 2) the best learning occurs when children engage in higher-order, critical thinking; 3) a nurturing and supportive environment supports students' love of learning and of themselves; 4) self-awareness promotes dynamic leadership and global understanding; 5) active community engagement richly enhances educational opportunities. These principles inform and are reflected in our current four key strategic priorities: to increase high-impact, high-quality academic curriculum, programming content, staff capacity, and coaching; to embrace and advance our use of technology; to deepen our embodiment of ethical and equitable radical humanity; and to efficiently operationalize teaching, learning, community, and care.

For more information about East Harlem Scholars Academies, please visit us at www.eastharlemscholars.org.

The role of the Varsity Boys Basketball Coach is to be responsible for coaching, character development and providing direction to student athletes so that they might achieve a high level of skill as well as an appreciation for discipline, sportsmanship and teamwork in cheerleading. Grainger and inspired by our endless assortment business model, we’re on a clear path toward our next big milestone: $2 billion in revenue—and beyond.

jobs.description:
Tenstorrent is leading the industry on cutting-edge AI technology, revolutionizing performance expectations, ease of use, and cost efficiency. Tenstorrent is hiring an ATE Test Development Engineer who can build sophisticated, scalable test solutions on the Advantest V93000 platform using SmartTest 8, custom code, and low‑level tester APIs. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys writing clean, modular software that directly touches hardware, understands how measurements are supposed to work, and can drive experiments that isolate variables across silicon, instrumentation, and test methodology. You will own the development, debug, datalogging, and optimization of ATE test content for NPI and production, ensuring our devices are thoroughly characterized, efficiently tested, and ready for high‑volume manufacturing.

This role is hybrid, based out of Austin,TX; Santa Clara,CA; or Fort Collins, CO.

We welcome candidates at various experience levels for this role. During the interview process, candidates will be assessed for the appropriate level, and offers will align with that level, which may differ from the one in this posting.

Who You Are

• You bring 10+ years of experience in ATE test development, semiconductor test engineering, or post-silicon validation.

• You are proficient with Advantest V93000, SmartTest 8, tester APIs, C++ or Java, and Python automation.

• You understand ATE instrumentation, including DPS, PMU, RF/HSIO, timing sets, multisite execution, and tester-to-DUT behavior.

• You are a structured problem solver with experience in controlled experimentation, root-cause isolation, cross-domain debug, and semiconductor test methodologies.

What We Need

• Develop and maintain modular ATE test programs and measurement libraries for NPI and production on the Advantest V93000.

• Implement and optimize parametric, functional, scan, BIST, and system-level test flows using tester APIs and custom measurement sequences.

• Debug ATE failures and support product engineering with characterization, Vmin/Fmax extraction, guard-band definition, production limits, and correlation to bench, SLT, and validation results.

• Build robust datalogging and automation solutions while improving test time, multisite efficiency, measurement stability, yield analysis, and regression testing.

What You Will Learn

• How to develop scalable production test solutions for high-performance AI and compute silicon.

• How to connect test methodology, instrumentation behavior, silicon performance, and manufacturing requirements.

• Techniques for silicon characterization, Vmin/Fmax extraction, guard-band definition, yield learning, and automated failure triage.

• How ATE test content progresses from NPI bring-up and debug through production release and high-volume manufacturing.

• Valid state certification helpful but not required

About Pinterest:

Millions of people around the world come to our platform to find creative ideas, dream about new possibilities and plan for memories that will last a lifetime. At Pinterest, we’re on a mission to bring everyone the inspiration to create a life they love, and that starts with the people behind the product.

Discover a career where you ignite innovation for millions, transform passion into growth opportunities, celebrate each other’s unique experiences and embrace the flexibility to do your best work. Creating a career you love? It’s Possible.

At Pinterest, AI isn't just a feature, it's a powerful partner that augments our creativity and amplifies our impact, and we’re looking for candidates who are excited to be a part of that. To get a complete picture of your experience and abilities, we’ll explore your foundational skills and how you collaborate with AI.

Through our interview process, what matters most is that you can always explain your approach, showing us not just what you know, but how you think. You can read more about our AI interview philosophy and how we use AI in our recruiting process here.

The User and Content Foundations org is responsible for deeply understanding our content, users and their interactions by generating high-quality, reusable signals and insights that power relevance and personalization across the platform. We work at the intersection of distributed machine learning, large multimodal models, data infrastructure, and product adoption to build foundational capabilities that support our partners, including Discovery, Search, Growth, and Ads. We are looking for an experienced Staff Machine Learning Engineer / Technical Lead who can drive the team’s technical direction, lead the team in building scalable content understanding systems, and make an impact on core Pinterest user and business outcomes.  In this role, you will lead ambiguous, high-impact scientific and engineering efforts that create reusable representations, models, and signals.  You’ll work across research, machine learning, infrastructure, and engineering domains to turn advances in VLMs, LLMs, multimodal learning and sequence modeling into impact.  This role is ideal for a deeply technical leader who combines strong ML judgment with product intuition. Expertise in visual representation learning and content understanding is especially valuable; experience with user understanding, recommender systems and LLMs is also highly relevant.

What will you be doing:

• Set the technical direction and multi-quarter strategy for foundational ML capabilities across visual representation learning, multimodal content understanding, and LLM-based personalization.

• Lead high-impact scientific and technical initiatives from problem definition and research strategy through experimentation, productionization, and adoption.

• Build reusable embeddings, representations, semantic signals, and ML infrastructure while advancing techniques such as VLMs, LLMs, sequence modeling, self-supervised learning, retrieval, and distillation.

• Partner with Product, Data Science, Applied Science, and Engineering to translate foundational capabilities into product outcomes and influence cross-functional roadmaps and investments.

• Establish rigorous practices for modeling, data pipelines, distributed training, inference, evaluation, experimentation, and operational excellence while mentoring engineers and scientists.

What we’re looking for:

• Minimum 7 years of industry experience, including 2+ years of tech leading teams

• MS or PhD degree in computer science, machine learning, or equivalent industry experience.

• Publications at top machine learning, multimodal and/or data mining conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, CVPR, ECCV, ACL, KDD, SIGIR, etc.) or open-source ML experience

• Hands-on experience with large-scale distributed training of generative models (LLMs, VLMs, sequence models).

• Hands-on experience with distributed tooling for ML data pipelines (e.g. Spark, Hive, MapReduce)

• Hands-on experience leading ambiguous ML and research efforts in building, applying and improving GenAI models for content understanding, search and recommendation systems.

• Technical leadership and experience in setting direction for roadmaps that span modeling, data pipelines and productionization, and aligning stakeholders on priorities, trade-offs, and execution plans.

• Excellent cross-functional communication and collaboration skills

jobs.title: Business Development Representative
jobs.description:
ABOUT CANALS

Canals builds software for wholesale distributors, helping them operate more efficiently through automation and AI.

Our customers are the companies responsible for moving the materials that power the real economy; electrical supplies, plumbing products, roofing materials, HVAC equipment, and more. Every day, thousands of people rely on Canals to help process orders, manage purchasing, handle accounts payable, and streamline critical business workflows.

We're a profitable, rapidly growing company with a team of roughly 140 people distributed across North and South America. We care deeply about building great products, hiring exceptional people, and creating an environment where talented individuals can do the best work of their careers.


THE ROLE

We're hiring our first BDRs. As a founding member of the team, you'll work directly with Jonathan http://linkedin.com/in/jonathan-mcdaniel-914863128, who leads our BDR team, and partner with our Account Executives to create pipeline across electrical, plumbing, HVAC, and other industrial distributors. It's a market where reputation travels: these businesses share people, systems, and relationships, so doing right by one account opens doors at the next.

This role is heavily outbound. Our buyers run distribution businesses. They don't spend their days reading about AI. They answer the phone, go to trade shows, and respect people who have done their homework. You'll reach them through cold calls, emails specific enough to earn a reply, LinkedIn, and conversations on trade-show floors.

"Founding" means the playbook doesn't exist yet. You'll help write it: which messages land, which roles respond, how we qualify, and what a great handoff to an AE looks like. What you figure out becomes how every BDR after you works.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Prospect into industrial wholesale distributors, researching each account well enough to say something specific about how they take orders or process invoices.

 - Run high-volume, high-quality outbound across phone, email, and LinkedIn. Phone is a core part of this job.

 - Book qualified meetings for AEs and hand them off with enough context that the AE never starts from zero.

 - Work industry events: outreach before the show, starting conversations on the floor, and following up after.

 - Learn the industry and product deeply, including what an inside sales rep's day looks like, how distributors use their ERP, and why invoice matching matters to a controller.

 - Write down what works so the next hire can use it, and share wins and misses openly with the team.

 - Bring what you hear from the market back to marketing and product, candidly.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

Grit. You've done something hard that took a long time, and you kept going when it stopped being fun. You follow up after silence and call back after a "not now."



You lean into discomfort. You'll walk up to a stranger at a trade show, cold call an owner who has run his business for 30 years, and ask questions that reveal what you don't know yet. You do these things because they're how excellence happens, not because you enjoy them.



Coachability. You want direct feedback, and the next call is different because of it. You can tell us about a specific time feedback changed how you work.



Creativity. You find angles others miss: a new way into an account, a better first line, a reason to call that isn't "just checking in."



Intelligence. You learn fast and ask sharp questions. You can understand a business you've never seen, from distribution margins to ERP data, and explain it back simply.

jobs.title: Product Engineer
jobs.description:
About PointOne

PointOne is reinventing how law firms operate. Our AI platform helps attorneys capture billable time automatically, apply billing rules correctly, and get insights that change how legal work is managed. We're a Series A venture-backed startup (Y Combinator, Bessemer, 8VC, General Catalyst) made up of software engineers (Jane Street, Google, Stanford, Princeton) and former attorneys. More than 225 law firms use PointOne today, and demand is growing faster than we can build for it.

The Role

Product Engineers at PointOne build the AI systems attorneys trust with their billable hours. You'll take work that currently lives in someone's head, or in a spreadsheet, and turn it into software that just handles it.

The job spans engineering, product, and the firms themselves. You'll be the technical owner for a set of key firms, spending real time with the people who use PointOne every day. You'll form your own view of what would make their work meaningfully better, and then build it. What you learn from them becomes the platform every other firm uses.

You'll write production code and own the outcome, not the ticket.

We're looking for technically strong engineers who are as comfortable building AI products as they are in a room full of law firm partners: people who can take a half-explained process and come back with a working system.

What You'll Do

 - Own a product surface end to end, from the first sketch to the version attorneys are using the following week.

 - Work directly with attorneys, firm leadership, and billing teams to understand how each firm practices, what constrains them, and what their technical environments require.

 - Build new AI products: entirely new workflows for a profession that has used the same ones for forty years.

 - Work where the problem isn't defined yet. Figure out what's actually being asked for, align with colleagues across functions on a plan, and ship against it.

 - Lead by example through mentoring future hires, pairing, and code reviews. You'll help shape our engineering culture.

To Apply
After you apply, the best way to stand out is to email me at reily@pointone.com. Attach your resume with a brief introduction to yourself, something underrated that you learned in your current role, and one thing you've built that you're proud of.

The compensation for this position is determined by multiple factors, including prior experience and expertise. A competitive equity component will also be offered as part of the package.

Benefits include comprehensive health, dental, and vision insurance, meals in office, regular team events, a personal wellness fund, a personal learning fund, and more!

jobs.title: Senior Incident Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About this role

At Chime, we help our members achieve financial peace of mind. To do this we need features that are highly available and human & technical systems that are resilient. That’s where you come in. You will be a member of our Incident Response team to help Chime improve our readiness, response and drive organizational change from incidents.

As an Incident Operations Manager on Chime's Incident Operations team (Platform Engineering), you'll manage incidents end to end: from declaration and coordination, through member communication and member remediation, to review and follow-through. You'll work across Engineering, Product, Member Experience (MX), Core Experience, Risk, Compliance, Legal, and Finance, and lead through influence rather than authority. You'll bring a proactive, solution-oriented mindset and keep the member at the center of every decision. Alongside on-call work, you'll own defined improvement workstreams that make our response better every quarter.

In this role, you can expect to:

• Coordinate incidents end to end. Serve on the incident on-call rotation, including some after-hours coverage on weekends, nights, and holidays. Independently run incidents from declaration to resolution: setting severity, paging the right responders, running the bridge, confirming member impact, and driving mitigation decisions.

• Help drive communication during incidents. Draft clear, accurate member messages across in-app, push, inbox, email, and support channels; move them through Compliance and Legal approval within severity-based timelines; and keep Support and MX teams equipped with talking points.

• Drive member remediation to closure. Run the Remediating phase: define workstreams, DRIs, and exit criteria; partner with Data to size the impacted population; coordinate credits and bulk adjustments with Finance, Compliance, and Core Experience

• Keep stakeholders informed. Deliver timely status reports and sitreps for leadership, and supply impact summaries and timelines that Compliance and Legal use for bank partner and regulatory notifications.

• Close the loop. Facilitate incident reviews for the incidents you manage, capture learnings, and make sure corrective actions have owners and due dates.

• Get ahead of problems. Spot risks and gaps before they become incidents or repeat incidents, raise them early, and come up with a proposed solution.

• Improve how we respond. Own at least one program workstream, such as pre-approved member message templates, runbooks, or response metrics, and ship measurable improvements.

• Cross-train and share knowledge. Build working fluency on both the technical-command and member-impact sides of an incident, and help train coordinators and responders.

To thrive in this role, you have

• 3+ years in incident management, or a similar operational role, including hands-on coordination of live, customer-impacting incidents.

• A strong member focus. You think first about how an incident affects real people and their money, and you measure success by whether members are informed and made whole, not just whether systems are restored.

• A proactive, solution-oriented approach. You act before being asked, look for the next risk instead of waiting for it, and bring options and recommendations.

• Experience managing the customer side of an incident: writing customer-facing communications, working with support teams, and coordinating remediation.

• Calm, structured judgment under pressure; you know when to decide, when to escalate, and when to ask for help.

• Enough technical fluency to follow engineers through an investigation and ask good questions (observability, deploys, dependencies, distributed systems).

• Experience with incident and observability tools such as PagerDuty, incident.io, Datadog, Slack-based incident tooling, Jira, and Google Workspace.

• Clear, concise writing for different audiences: members, technical SMEs, compliance partners, and executives.

• Strong follow-through; you drive action items and remediation work to closure without being chased.

Nice to have

• Experience in fintech, banking, payments, or another regulated industry.

#LI-Onsite #LI-Onsite

Below is the base salary offered for this role and level of experience. Full-time employees may also be eligible for bonus(es), competitive equity, and benefits. For commissioned roles, the base salary listed in this job description does not include incentive/variable pay. The actual base salary offered may be higher, depending on your location, skills, qualifications, and experience.

Wage Notice

$141,000—$195,000 USD

A little about us

At Chime, we believe that everyone can achieve financial progress. We created Chime—a financial technology company, not a bank*—on the premise that core banking services should be helpful, easy, and free. Through our user-friendly tools and intuitive platforms, we empower our members to take control of their finances and work towards their goals. Whether it's starting a savings account, purchasing a first car or home, launching a business, or pursuing higher education, we're proud to have helped millions unlock their financial potential.

We're a team of problem solvers, dreamers, and builders with one shared obsession: our members. From day one, Chimers have worked tirelessly to out-hustle and out-execute competitors to bring our mission to life. Their grit and determination inspire us to work harder every day to deliver the very best experience possible. We each bring an owner's mindset to our work, refusing to be outdone and holding ourselves accountable to meet and exceed the highest bars for our teams, our company, and our members.

We believe in being bold, dreaming big, and taking risks, while also working together, embracing our diverse perspectives, and giving each other honest feedback. Our culture remains deeply entrepreneurial, encouraging every Chimer to see themselves as stewards of our mission to help everyday Americans unlock their financial progress.

We know that to achieve our mission, we must earn and keep people's trust—so we hold ourselves to the highest standards of integrity in everything we do. These aren't just words on a wall—our values are embedded in every aspect of our business, serving as a north star that guides us as we work to help millions achieve their financial potential.

Because if we don't—who will?

*Chime is a financial technology company, not a bank. Banking services provided by The Bancorp Bank, N.A. or Stride Bank, N.A., Members FDIC.

What we offer for our full-time, regular employees

• 🏢 Our in-office work policy is designed to keep you connected - with four days a week in the office and Fridays from home for those near one of our offices, plus team and company-wide events depending on location. Whether you’re coming in regularly or are part of our fully remote program, you’ll stay engaged with your work and teammates.

• 💻 Benefits that support your work and life, including backup child, elder, and pet care and subsidized commuter benefits for eligible employees.

• ✨ Comprehensive health, financial, and wellbeing benefits designed to support you at every stage of life.

• 🏝 Generous vacation policy and company-wide paid days off

• 🫂 1% of your time off to support local community organizations of your choice

• 👟 Annual wellness stipend to use towards eligible wellness related expenses

• 👶 Up to 22 weeks of paid parental leave for birthing parents and 12 weeks of paid parental leave for non-birthing parents

• 👪 Access to family planning reimbursement

• 💚 A challenging and fulfilling opportunity to join one of the most experienced teams in FinTech and help millions unlock financial progress

We know that great work can’t be done without a diverse team and inclusive environment. That’s why we specifically look for individuals of varying strengths, skills, backgrounds, and ideas to join our team. We believe this gives us a competitive advantage to better serve our members and helps us all grow as Chimers and individuals.

Chime is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital or family status, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other legally protected basis under provincial, federal, state, and local laws, regulations, or ordinances. We will also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the requirements of state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, Cook County Ordinance, NYC Fair Chance Act, and the LA City Fair Chance Ordinance, and consistent with Canadian provincial and federal laws. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation during any stage of the application process, please contact: accommodations@chime.com.

jobs.title: Customs Brokerage Agent - Post Entry
jobs.description:
***Duration***

We are seeking a Post Entry Brokerage Agent for a fixed-term assignment until                                          December 31, 2027 or until the work is completed, whichever is sooner.  Possible                                        opportunity to transition to permanent position will be available at the end of the                                                                                                  assignment.

**Position is open for Full-Time, Part-Time and Internships**

SUMMARY DESCRIPTION:

Ensure timely and accurate transmission and monitoring of post entry activity, while providing exceptional customer service.

Tasks and Duties

• Understand all the elements of the import customs standard operations procedures and correctly interpret this information to fulfill our customer´s instructions and expectations.
• Understanding and use of Expeditors’ operations system and tools such as workboard, exp.o Customs, Raft, CFIT, etc
• Transfer customs declaration information from documents, or other sources into the customs entry system to allow for the building of a valid customs declaration
• Ensure proper and timely filing of Post Summary Corrections (PSCs), protests, 520(d)s, petitions, supplemental duty tenders, etc., in accordance with regulatory, Operational Performance Standards (OPS) and corporate guidelines. This includes:Perform entry status queries and assemble all documentation from the customerMake corrections to the entry summaryReview to ensure corrections are applicable for the requested changes (e.g., chapter 99 tariff headers are inserted for the right lines in the correct order)Prepare narratives for PSCs or for protests. Importer will review and provide final approval.Review and obtain supporting documentation for the PSC reason, Protest, 520(D) (e.g., product specifications and photos to support HTS classification changes, purchase orders to support valuation changes, binding rulings, or certificates of origin with elements indicated in the appropriate General Note related to the FTA etc.)Transmit the PSC via ABI for each declaration that requires correctionUpload full entry document packages to DIS (Document Imaging System) or the CBP ACE Protest Module for each declarationProvide additional information to CBP as required (e.g., specialized line-item reporting)Monitor the PSC until it is accepted by CBPProvide status reports and regular notifications to the importer after PSC, Protest or 520(D) is filedManage all post entry activities, from start to finish, using Post Entry Management Application (PEMA)
• Ensure accurate and timely data entry into Expeditors’ operational system
• Ensure compliance at all times to regulations
• Ensure accurate and timely client billing
• Provide excellent customer service

WHAT QUALIFICATIONS YOU BRING TO US :

• US Licensed Customs Broker (preferable)
• Certified Import Clearance Specialist Certified (preferable)
• US Customs Brokerage experience
• Good computer skills (e.g., MS Excel, MS Word)
• Fluent in English

Expeditors offers excellent benefits:

• Paid Vacation, Holiday, Sick Time
• Health Plan: Medical
• Life Insurance
• Employee Stock Purchase Plan
• Training and Personnel Development Program
• Growth opportunities within the company
• Employee Referral Program Bonus

jobs.title: 2027 Summer Operations Intern
jobs.description:
About Marshall Wace

Marshall Wace is a leading provider of alternative investment solutions with over $90 billion in assets under management. Our global investment process operates around the clock, deploying capital across a diverse range of systematic and fundamental strategies. We have a track record of providing market leading returns for over 25 years.

Our success is underpinned by a perpetual effort to innovate and optimize upon our existing investment process, embracing sophisticated, proprietary technology and data sources at every level of the organization. Our small, but impactful group fosters a collegial culture that demands entrepreneurship and personal responsibility, presenting ample opportunity to employees for meaningful impact on our profitability.

Our Intern Program

Our 10 week Summer Intern Program includes the following:

• Business critical projects and problems to solve, with the opportunity to produce high-impact work

• Highly personalized mentoring

• Weekly lunch seminars with senior managers across all teams

• Opportunities to participate in charitable events

• Finance days hosted by other financial institutions

• Social events

Operations Internship – Summer 2027

We are seeking a self‑motivated undergraduate senior student who is passionate about learning, problem solving, and efficiency in the context of global financial markets. Based in New York, you will join our Global Operations team and contribute to a high‑volume, technology‑driven investment management environment. Interns gain a front‑row view of how operational excellence and automation underpin the success of a leading hedge fund, while delivering real value through both tactical work and dedicated projects.

Key Responsibilities

• Collaborate with a close‑knit, technical operations team to support the firm’s activity across multiple markets and asset classes, including equities, credit, volatility, macro, and fixed income.

• Build knowledge of core operational processes such as trade processing, securities lending, settlement, asset servicing, data management, and compliance.

• Develop an understanding of how automation, data analytics, and AI‑driven solutions enable the firm to manage a high volume of global trading efficiently.

• Use Python, SQL, and other programming tools to analyze and manipulate data, and contribute to automation and AI initiatives that enhance operational efficiency.

• Identify workflow and system improvements and partner with the team to implement change.

• Engage with colleagues across Trading, Investment Analysis, Risk, Treasury, and Compliance.

• Attend seminars hosted by prime brokerage counterparties to learn how the buy side and sell side interact.

Qualifications

• Candidates graduating between December 2027 and June 2028.

• Working toward a bachelor’s degree in a related field such as (but not limited to) Finance, Economics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or Engineering.

• Minimum cumulative GPA of 3.5.

• Exceptional communication skills (verbal and written) and strong attention to detail.

• Ability to manage time effectively and proactively engage with team members.

• Demonstrated curiosity about financial markets and enthusiasm for data‑driven and AI‑enabled process improvement.

jobs.title: Delivery Operations Manager
jobs.description:
About Nebius:

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. We are building a full-stack AI cloud platform that supports developers and enterprises from data and model training through to production deployment, without the cost and complexity of building large in-house AI/ML infrastructure.

Built by engineers, for engineers. From large-scale GPU orchestration to inference optimization, we own the hard problems across compute, storage, networking and applied AI.

Listed on Nasdaq (NBIS) and headquartered in Amsterdam, we have a global footprint with R&D hubs across Europe, the UK, North America and Israel. Our team of 1,500+ includes hundreds of engineers with deep expertise across hardware, software and AI R&D.

The role

Token Factory is scaling AI inference across PoC and production environments. As we grow, operational clarity and structured delivery become critical.

We are hiring a Delivery Operations Manager to build and maintain the operational system that connects sales, delivery, and customer success — and ensures every customer interaction runs smoothly from first deal to production.

You’re welcome to work remotely from the United States.

Your responsibilities will include:

Post-Sales Operations

• Own day-to-day operational processes across active PoCs and production customers

• Ensure seamless transitions from PoC to production without loss of context

• Build and maintain documentation for complex operational scenarios: customer migrations, model changes, GPU type changes, contract renewals

• Define cleanup processes for customer offboarding and scope reductions

• Triage incidents together with SA and Support, maintain clear escalation paths

Customer Lifecycle & Commercial Operations

• Support transitions to new legal entities, updated contracts, and SKU changes

• Build and maintain instructions for AE, SE, and Sales Ops on how to work with Token Factory customers

• Align post-sales processes with broader Nebius Cloud standards

• Define upsale processes — new PoCs for existing customers, operational and billing setup, transition to production

Operational Visibility

• Maintain a single source of truth on customer health, active workloads, and contract status

• Track upcoming renewals, capacity changes, and operational dependencies

• Surface risks early and drive resolution across teams

Cross-Functional Coordination

• Improve handoff clarity across Sales, Pre-Sales, Engineering, and Delivery

• Run structured operational reviews

• Work comfortably with technical teams — you don't need to write code, but you need to understand what engineers are building and why it matters for customers

Automation & Tooling

• Drive automation initiatives: Salesforce / Jira / Backoffice integrations, customer notifications, contract expiry alerts, cleanup workflows

• Identify where manual processes can be replaced with tooling

We expect you to have:

• Experience in cloud, AI, or SaaS operations

• You are comfortable working across sales, legal, finance, and engineering teams

• You bring structure without adding bureaucracy

• You are proactive in surfacing risks and improving execution

• You can hold a conversation with a technical team without getting lost

What success looks like:

• Active PoCs and production customers are visible and tracked

• Transitions to production are structured and predictable

• Commercial and operational changes reach customers without friction

• Cross-team delivery clarity improves over time

Pay Transparency

We offer competitive compensation and benefits packages. Actual compensation will be determined based on job-related factors, including experience, skills, qualifications, the level at which the candidate is hired, and geographic location, consistent with applicable law.

Base Compensation Range

$224,000—$270,000 USD

Benefits & Perks:

• Competitive compensation

• Career growth and learning opportunities

• Flexibility and ownership

• Collaborative and innovative culture

• Opportunity to work on impactful AI projects

• International environment and talented teams

What's it like to work at Nebius:

Fast moving - Bold thinking - Constant growth - Meaningful impact - Trust and real ownership - Opportunity to shape the future of AI

Equal Opportunity Statement:

Nebius is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace and to providing equal employment opportunities in all aspects of employment. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Applicants must be authorized to work in the country in which they apply and will be required to provide proof of employment eligibility as a condition of hire.

If you need accommodations during the application process, please let us know.

jobs.title: Early Career Primary Care Physician - 4 days in clinic, 1 day remote [Farragut Square Office]
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

This job posting is for current Residents / Fellows completing their training in 2026 or 2027 who are interested in any of our offices based in Washington D.C.

Why One Medical is the best place to launch your career in primary care: One Medical is transforming healthcare, and we're looking for dedicated primary care physicians to join us right out of residency. You'll practice in a supportive, tech-enabled environment where you can build lasting patient relationships and deliver high-quality care. Our robust 12-week onboarding includes one-on-one mentoring, an individualized learning plan, and ongoing access to primary care experts nationwide. From day one through every stage of your career, we invest in your growth with continuing education and leadership development.

Employment type:

• Full time

What you’ll be working on:

• Managing a patient panel with a broad array of patient needs; conducting a mix of acute, chronic, and well visits

• Treating patients in-office or in testing centers as well as conducting occasional tele-health visits

• Continuous learning during weekly Clinical Rounds and through other modalities

• Ongoing collaboration with in-office teammates via daily huddles, as well as with virtual clinical teams

• Utilization of your specific clinical training and opportunities to perform in-office procedures

• Supervising one or more NP or PA colleagues

Education, licenses, and experiences required for this role:

• Currently enrolled in, or completed within the last year, an accredited Family Medicine, Internal Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics residency program

• Must presently be a Board Eligible Family Medicine, Internal Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics Resident, or have completed a Family Medicine, Internal Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics Residency Program within the last calendar year and scheduled to take the next available Board Exam

• State licensed in Washington DC, obtained before your One Medical start date

One Medical providers also demonstrate:

• A passion for human-centered primary care

• The ability to successfully communicate with and provide care to individuals of all backgrounds

• The ability to effectively use technology to deliver high quality care

• Clinical proficiency in evidence-based primary care

• The desire to be an integral part of a team dedicated to changing healthcare delivery

• An openness to feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into strengths and weaknesses

• The ability to confidently navigate uncertain situations with both patients and colleagues

• Readiness to adapt personal and interpersonal behavior to meet the needs of our patients

This is a full-time role based in one of our Washington D.C. offices. During your interview process, we will determine the exact office location based on your preferences and business needs.

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The base salary range for this role is $253,200 to $284,900 based on a full-time schedule. Final determination of starting pay may vary based on factors such as practice experience and patient care schedule. Additional pay may be determined for those candidates that exceed these specified qualifications and requirements. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

Nebius is leading a new era in cloud infrastructure for the global AI economy. General Support:

jobs.title: Design & Release Engineer (DRE) - Interior Cockpit
jobs.description:
We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.

As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.

When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.

WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

• Experienced DRE – Interior Cockpit to join our growing team.

• This role will be responsible for leading the Cockpit components development, validation and integration of cockpit trim components including IP carrier, PAB chutes, bins, glove box, and finish trim for Client vehicles ensuring that cockpit trim target performance and features, as well as FMVSS requirements, are met.

• The individual will be responsible for understanding the vehicle’s technical specifications and performance targets.

• Utilizing the APQP process and supporting documentation, this position will ensure Client quality, performance, and regulatory objectives are achieved and sustained throughout the vehicle lifecycle.

WHAT YOU GET TO DO

• Lead safety validation, development, material selection and launch of cockpit system components (bins, trims, glove box, IP door panels and more)

• Work with internal and externa safety departments to ensure component level and system level testing is completed and meeting cockpit targets (DVP, FMVSS, and system level targets)

• Ensure validation of the cockpit systems, reviewing test loads, set ups, reports, and results for both internal and external testing.

• Ensure packaging compatibility, interface alignment, and system level functionality.

• Lead product development, material selection, tooling reviews and launch of new components from concept to launch

• Conduct supplier and internal technical reviews to ensure packaging and design issues are addressed/resolved.

• Work with affected teams to ensure that plastic trim components (like removable trim covers, bin doors, bins more) are properly accommodated by the Cockpit system.

• Ensure compatibility with interfacing systems and components, including attaching hardware and joint design.

• Define and integrate critical characteristics (CC/SC) with adjacent systems.

• Deliver products to meet quality and reliability requirements and arrive on time for program milestones, with all necessary PPAP documentation

• Support prototype builds, DV/PV and launch readiness

WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM

• Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Automotive Engineering, or a related field is required. Master's degree is preferred.

• 5+ years of experience in automotive Cockpit System engineering.

• Applications-specific experience in at least 3 of the following areas / components:

• Cockpit complete FMVSS, IIHS and other 3rd party rating validation.

• Cockpit and trim plastic design.

• Interior trim plastic materials and injection molding

• Experience working within a PLM and releasing components and processing engineering changes.

• Functional experience with all NHTSA / FMVSS, CARB, EPA, FCC, or other regulatory requirements.

• Ability to lead teams and meetings through technical tradeoffs and optimized solutions with attention to detail.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate with cross-functional teams to achieve common goals.

• Highly adaptable and proactive, excelling in fast-paced start-up and new model launch environments.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office (Outlook, Teams, Word, Excel, PowerPoint)

jobs.title: Operations Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT OBSERVABLE SPACE

At Observable Space, we're redefining how humanity observes and connects with the universe. We're a vertically integrated, high-growth, space technology company building industry-leading precision optics platforms for Earth and in space. Our systems are trusted by thousands of customers, including NASA, JPL, SpaceX, Boeing, RTX, the US Space Force and the U.S. Department of War, leading research institutions and international partners.

We combine precision opto-mechanical hardware, embedded compute, cloud orchestration, and developer-friendly APIs into world class products at scale with in-house manufacturing. From advanced ground stations, on-orbit sensor suites, free space optical lasercom, to distributed compute platforms, we deliver the foundational systems enabling continuous, real-time navigation, observation, and communication in space.

Observable Space is backed by top-tier institutional investors including Lux Capital, Upfront Ventures, RTX Ventures, Detroit Venture Partners and Embedded Ventures. To learn more, visit observable.space http://observable.space.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Observable Space is hiring an Operations Associate to join our growing Business Operations function and bring structure, ownership and follow through to critical business processes across the company. You’ll start by building structure around contract administration and expand into operational tracking, documentation, vendor coordination, and broader business operations responsibilities as the company grows.

A major initial focus will be contract administration. Without an internal legal or contracts function, agreements ranging from customer contracts and vendor agreements to NDAs require disciplined coordination — preparing and routing documents for review and signature, tracking status and key dates, maintaining accurate records, and knowing when something needs to be escalated. You’ll own the administrative process from draft through execution, ensuring agreements move efficiently and accurately at every stage.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Contract Administration

 - Own the end-to-end coordination of agreements from initial receipt through execution, including routing for review and signature, tracking status, and following up with internal and external parties

 - Prepare, convert, and format contracts and other business documents to facilitate review and execution

 - Maintain a central contract tracker, including agreements under review or awaiting signature, executed agreements, key dates, renewal terms, and other relevant information

 - Review agreements against established templates and processes, flagging deviations or non-standard terms for the appropriate business owner or outside counsel to assess

 - Maintain an organized repository of executed agreements and supporting documentation

 - Help establish and improve contract administration processes, templates, and approval workflows as the company grows

Process & Documentation Support

 - Maintain key operational trackers and documentation so leadership has an accurate, current view of priorities and outstanding actions

 - Support documentation organization and process improvement across company systems

 - Prepare materials, track action items, and drive follow-up for the COO and VP of Operations

 - Identify opportunities to bring greater structure and efficiency to recurring administrative and operational processes

Vendor & Operational Coordination

 - Coordinate vendor onboarding and related documentation, compliance, and administrative requirements

 - Support company and vendor registrations, certifications, compliance documentation, and renewals, ensuring requirements and deadlines are tracked and completed

 - Support coordination across Operations, Finance, and other teams to keep operational processes moving

 - Provide ad hoc operational support as priorities shift and take on broader responsibilities as the Business Operations function grows




WHAT YOU'LL BRING

 - 3+ years experience in business administration, contract administration, executive support, or a similar coordination focused role; exposure to contracts or vendor management

 - Exceptional attention to detail and a high bar for accuracy

 - Strong organizational instincts and the discipline to keep processes, trackers, and documentation current without being asked

 - Strong follow-through and the ability to manage multiple open items without letting things fall through the cracks

 - Comfortable operating in ambiguity and good judgment about when to resolve something independently versus escalate

 - Proficiency with tools such as DocuSign, Adobe Acrobat, Google Workspace, and Microsoft Office, with comfort learning new tools and systems

 - Comfort using AI and other productivity tools to work efficiently and solve administrative problems




WHO YOU ARE

 - Experience at a technology company and/or startup

 - Organized by nature, not just by job description

 - A clear, proactive communicator who follows up without being chased

 - Resourceful and comfortable figuring things out when there isn't an established process

 - Trustworthy with sensitive information

 - Excited to grow the scope of a role as the company scales, rather than needing it fully defined on day one



WHY YOU'LL LOVE IT HERE

 - Help build the processes and infrastructure that will support Observable Space as we scale


WHAT WE OFFER

Competitive Compensation – A salary package aligned with industry standards and your experience.

Equity Opportunities – Take part in our success with stock options.

Flexible Work Environment – Enjoy working from our office or in a hybrid work setup with the flexibility to work remotely part of the week. We require a minimum of 3 days per week in our office to support collaboration and team culture. (LA Office only)

Unlimited PTO (exempt only) – Take the time you need with our flexible, trust-based vacation policy, including paid holidays. We encourage everyone to rest, recharge, and take care of themselves.

Health & Wellness – Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage with 100% of the premium paid by the employer for employees.

Cutting-Edge Tools – Get access to the latest hardware and software you need to do your best work.

Mission-Driven Culture – Be part of a team working on meaningful challenges with real-world impact.

Inclusive Team – We foster a supportive and diverse workplace where all voices are valued.



Observable Space is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, national origin, ancestry, age, disability, genetic information, marital status, veteran or military status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Monstro provides the AI-powered Financial Intelligence System for regulated financial institutions. It enables banks and wealth managers to deliver continuous, personalized, governed Financial Guidance to every client, not just the top tier, across their entire financial life: saving, borrowing, investing, planning, protecting, and preparing.

Meaningful Financial Guidance has only ever been available to a small portion of people. We are changing that, through the institutions people already trust. Institutions already have the relationships, the data, and the context to understand each client; Monstro turns that understanding into guidance that helps each person understand, decide, and act. For clients, that means clearer decisions, proactive support when life changes, and a better view of their financial lives. For institutions, it means deeper relationships, more clients served consistently, and more of each client’s financial life managed in one place.

What makes this possible is how the system is built. Governance is not an added feature; it is foundational. Every recommendation reflects the institution’s own views, policies, and permissions. Every output can be audited, traced, and reversed, and client data stays under the institution’s control. Generative AI is used to build and configure the system; at runtime, execution is deterministic, so every output can be explained and stood behind, not just trusted.

The Work

We are building for a high-stakes industry where the work has real consequences. Guidance only matters if people can trust it and institutions can govern it. The challenge is to make Financial Guidance more personal and more available without making it less trusted: to build AI that institutions can audit, explain, and reverse, in a domain where being wrong carries real cost. That is what makes the problem hard, and the work meaningful. This is not a simple AI problem; it takes product judgment, technical depth, regulatory discipline, design quality, and a team that moves quickly without lowering the bar.

Monstro is moving from vision to market: launching with financial institutions, growing the team, and building for the enterprise in one of the most regulated industries. You will be expected to think clearly, communicate directly, move with urgency, hold a high standard, and take responsibility for work that matters. We are an early team building something ambitious, and what you do here will shape both the product and the company.

The role:

Monstro is hiring a Director, Strategic Business Development to open the doors that allow our senior commercial team to sell. You will get Monstro into banks where we have no existing relationships, at the level where decisions are made.

This is not a lead-generation role. It is an access-generation role. You will be measured on meetings with the executives who own budget and priorities, not on emails sent or calls logged. This role will require occasional travel.

Access, not leads

Your work is measured in one unit: the qualified access meeting.

A first meeting with a named economic buyer or executive sponsor at a target-list bank, with at least one additional stakeholder from a different function engaged, that our senior commercial team accepts as a hand-off.

Each part has a rule behind it:

• Target-list bank: only accounts on the agreed target list count.

• Economic buyer or executive sponsor: titles are agreed in advance, such as head of wealth, head of retail banking, chief digital officer or CIO.

• Second stakeholder: someone from a different function, such as risk, technology or a business line. Two people from the same team don't count.

• Accepted hand-off: the senior commercial team confirms the opportunity is worth pursuing, within five business days, with a reason logged if they decline.

What doesn't count: emails, calls, sequences, social activity, events attended, meetings with junior staff, and meetings the senior team declines.

What you'll do:

Every responsibility leads to one outcome: an accepted hand-off.

• Research each target bank. Map its leadership, strategic priorities, recent changes and likely buyers before any outreach.

• Plan access account by account. Decide who to reach, through which route, and what gives them a reason to take the meeting.

• Reach senior executives directly. Get to decision-makers without relying on existing relationships, using research, referrals you create, events and persistent, well-judged outreach.

• Secure the first meeting and engage a second stakeholder from another function, so no single gatekeeper can stall the account.

• Write a hand-off brief. Cover who was met, why they engaged, what they care about, who else is involved, and the agreed next step.

• Stay involved through the transition so the relationship doesn't go cold between you and the senior team.

• Feed what you learn back. Share which messages, routes and titles open doors, and help refine the target list and positioning.

You will work closely with Managing Directors of Stargicand Enterprise Accounts, GTM team to agree the target list and the qualifying titles each quarter.

How success is measured:

We measure outcomes, not activity. We don't track email or call volume.

• Qualified access meetings per quarter: Tells us you are getting in at the right level. (Owned by: You)

• Target accounts reached through more than one contact: Tells us access is broad enough that one gatekeeper can't stall it. (Owned by: You)

• Hand-off acceptance rate: Tells us the access is real and well qualified. (Owned by: You)

• Accepted hand-offs that become active opportunities: Tells us the doors you open are worth walking through. (Owned by: Shared with the senior team)

Numeric targets will be set together after your first 60 days, once we know how reachable these banks are. As a guide to the arc of the role:

• Weeks 1–2: Monstro's existing target list researched and mapped, and access plans written for the priority accounts.

• From week 3: active outreach to senior executives, with your proposed additions agreed into the final target list.

• By day 60: first qualified access meetings accepted by the senior team.

• By 6 months: a steady quarterly rhythm of accepted hand-offs, with several target accounts reached through more than one contact.

• By 12 months: accounts you opened are active opportunities, and a repeatable access playbook the team can use.

Who we're looking for:

You are unusually good at getting into places you haven't been invited into. When you hear "we don't know anyone at this bank," you see the start of a problem to solve, not a reason the account can't be reached.

You will probably have 5 to 10 years of experience in enterprise sales, business development, or another role where you had to reach senior people at large organizations. You don't need 15 years of enterprise sales, and this isn't an entry-level SDR role.

The qualities we will screen hardest for:

• Tenacity: you keep going after the first, second and third route fails.

• Resourcefulness: you find routes others miss.

• Comfort with senior executives: you approach C-level leaders as peers.

• Research ability: you understand a bank's priorities before you reach out.

• Relationship-building: people who meet you once want to meet again.

• Disciplined follow-through: nothing you start goes quiet.

Banking or wealth-management experience is useful but not required. We would rather hire an exceptional enterprise hunter who knows how to navigate large organizations than a banking veteran used to managing existing relationships.

What this role is not:

• Not lead generation. A list of names, a booked call with a junior contact, or a high outreach count is not the output.

• Not relationship management. Existing bank relationships are not what we're hiring for. We want someone who can create new ones.

• Not a closing role. Once a hand-off is accepted, the senior commercial team runs the sale. You stay involved, but you don't own the deal.

• Not an entry-level SDR role. You will be engaging senior executives at large banks and need the judgment to match.

How we'll evaluate you:

Our process tests resourcefulness, not your contact list. Expect to:

• Plan access to a named bank where you know nobody. Tell us how you would reach its head of wealth or chief digital officer within 30 days, and what your research would uncover first.

• Walk us through two or three times you got into an organization cold. Who you reached, how, what failed first, and what finally worked.

• Show us a hand-off you've made. What you passed on, to whom, and what happened next.

• Describe an account you couldn't crack. What you tried, and what you would do differently.

• Critique our target list and messaging. Tell us which banks you'd prioritize and why.

Compensation:

• Base salary (New York City): $180,000 – $210,000

• On-target earnings (indicated OTE): $300,000 – $450,000

• Variable Pay included

• Equity included

• Benefits: 100% employer-paid medical, dental and vision, disability coverage, flexible PTO, paid parental leave and catered meals.

Why Monstro:

• Impact: Help define the category of Financial Intelligence and bring governed Financial Guidance to millions of bank clients.

• Ownership: High trust and high standards, with meaningful problems to own from day one.

• Experienced team: Leadership with a track record of scaling companies from early stage to major exits.

• In person: We work from The Spiral in Hudson Yards four days a week, because our pace depends on fast collaboration.

The standard is simple: do great work, own the outcome, communicate with purpose, move with urgency. If that sounds like you, we'd love to hear from you.

At Morning Brew Inc., we mix what you need to know with our unique brand of wit to attract, and build real relationships with, the next generation of business leaders. Whether scrolling, reading, watching, or listening, our audience trusts us for credible, entertaining business content that makes an impact on their personal and professional lives.

The Morning Brew team is clever, creative, and growing fast. Want in? Read on. 


OVERVIEW
We are looking for a Manager, Creator Brand Partnerships to join Morning Brew’s growing creator partnerships business.
This role sits at the intersection of sales, creators, media, and content. You’ll work closely with senior leadership, the broader sales organization, and our content and creative teams to turn advertiser objectives into compelling creator partnerships across Morning Brew’s growing portfolio of personalities, franchises, and social platforms. It’s a chance to help build a growing revenue stream within a modern media company. 
This is not an Account Executive or Direct Sales quota-carrying role. This role will report to the Sr Manager, Creator Brand Partnerships.
WHAT YOU'LL DO
Creator Partnerships & Sales
Support the development and sale of creator-led advertising partnerships across Morning Brew’s portfolio.
Work with senior sales leaders to identify advertisers and agencies that are strong fits for creator-led opportunities.
Develop creative partnership concepts that connect brand objectives with Morning Brew creators, personalities, and content franchises.
Help build proposals, pitch decks, media plans, and other materials used to win new business.
Participate in client and agency pitches and presentations, increasingly taking ownership of portions of the sales process.
Identify opportunities to expand existing advertiser relationships through creator content, social, video, podcasts, events, and other integrated offerings.
Maintain an active pipeline of creator partnership opportunities and help move prospects from idea through close.
Strategy & Ideation
Develop repeatable creator packages and partnership frameworks that can be leveraged across the broader sales organization, and act as an internal resource for sales on creator partnerships and talent opportunities.
Bring forward proactive ideas tied to major cultural moments, tentpole events, and advertiser priorities.
Cross-Functional Collaboration
Partner closely with sales, content, creative strategy, production, and operations teams.
Help ensure creator-led programs are strategically aligned with both advertiser objectives and Morning Brew's editorial and brand identity.
WHAT YOU BRING
4–6 years of experience in media sales, brand partnerships, creator/influencer marketing, advertising, entertainment, sports, talent partnerships, or a related field.
Demonstrated experience developing and selling creative advertising or partnership ideas, ideally involving creators, social content, video, podcasts, or personality-driven media.
Strong understanding of the creator ecosystem, including talent, platforms, content formats, and emerging trends.
Strong presentation, writing, and communication skills.
Highly organized with strong attention to detail, comfortable managing multiple projects and stakeholders at once, particularly around campaign deliverables, timelines, and commercial terms.
Commercially minded with an understanding of how advertisers evaluate media partnerships.
Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment where processes and products are continually evolving.
Entrepreneurial and proactive — you see an opportunity and figure out how to make it happen.
SUCCESS IN THIS ROLE
In this role, you'll be successful if you can make creator partnerships easier to sell, easier to execute, and more valuable to Morning Brew and its advertisers.
You'll progressively take ownership of creator-led opportunities while partnering closely with senior leadership to grow the business and establish the playbook for how Morning Brew sells creators.

jobs.title: OSP Engineer
jobs.description:
At PEARCE, we've got a career for you!

Pearce is a leading technology-enabled provider of asset management solutions for mission-critical electromechanical infrastructure throughout North America. Pearce provides technical maintenance, repair, operations, and engineering services for uninterruptible power supply (UPS) systems, backup power generators, battery energy storage systems (BESS), critical cooling systems, and other electrical and mechanical infrastructure across end markets such as renewable energy, telecom, and data centers. Founded in 1998, Pearce has more than 4,000 employees and 28 locations across the U.S. Pearce is a wholly owned subsidiary of CBRE Group, Inc., the world’s largest commercial real estate services and investment firm. To learn more about Pearce visit http://www.pearce-services.com.

Your Impact

As an OSP Engineer supporting Lumen, you will perform engineering activities supporting the design, documentation, permitting, and construction readiness of outside plant telecommunications networks. This position supports all aspects of OSP engineering, including aerial, underground, buried, conduit, fiber, and copper infrastructure.

You will work with project managers, construction teams, permitting teams, utilities, and other stakeholders to develop accurate and constructible OSP designs. You will also be responsible for maintaining accurate project and engineering information within Lumen databases, systems, and other required client platforms.

Success in this role requires strong OSP engineering knowledge, attention to detail, familiarity with field conditions and industry standards, and the ability to manage engineering documentation and data throughout the project lifecycle.

Core Responsibilities

OSP Engineering & Design

• Perform all aspects of OSP engineering for aerial, underground, buried, conduit, fiber, and copper telecommunications infrastructure.

• Develop and update OSP engineering designs, construction work prints, routing plans, splicing information, bills of materials, and supporting engineering documentation.

• Support work-order engineering, including road moves, relocations, network modifications, and new construction.

• Review proposed routes for constructability, existing infrastructure, capacity, clearances, and potential conflicts.

• Support fiber and copper network planning, including applicable loss-budget, splicing, and network-design considerations.

• Identify design conflicts and recommend practical engineering solutions that support project requirements, cost, and schedule.

Field Validation, Standards & Quality

• Perform and/or review field surveys and measurements for pole lines, conduit systems, buried facilities, and proposed OSP routes.

• Verify field conditions and ensure designs comply with NESC requirements, Lumen specifications, applicable utility standards, and Pearce engineering requirements.

• Identify make-ready requirements, clearance issues, facility conflicts, and other conditions that may affect construction.

• Review field changes and prepare or update redlines, as-builts, and related engineering documentation.

• Perform QA/QC reviews to ensure engineering packages are accurate, complete, and construction-ready.

Permitting, ROW & Joint Use

• Prepare and support permit packages for municipal, county, state, utility, and other applicable authorities.

• Support right-of-way (ROW), easement, and joint-use activities associated with OSP construction.

• Coordinate pole-attachment, make-ready, and utility requirements as applicable.

• Work with permitting teams, utilities, agencies, and project stakeholders to resolve engineering or documentation issues affecting approvals.

Project Coordination & Tracking

• Coordinate with Project Management, Construction, Permitting, vendors, and other engineering resources to maintain project schedules and resolve outstanding issues.

• Track engineering deliverables, permit requirements, design changes, and other project dependencies.

• Support job-cost and project tracking by identifying design changes or field conditions that may affect scope, schedule, or cost.

• Participate in project meetings and provide engineering updates, technical clarification, and status information.

Documentation & Lumen Systems

• Perform required data entry and record maintenance within Lumen databases, systems, and client platforms.

• Maintain accurate engineering records, designs, permits, ROW documentation, work orders, property/accounting records, and as-built information.

• Ensure engineering and project information is entered accurately and updated throughout the project lifecycle.

• Prepare reports and status updates regarding engineering progress, outstanding requirements, and project risks.

• Maintain complete and organized documentation in accordance with Lumen and Pearce requirements.

Core Experience

• Experience performing OSP engineering within the telecommunications industry.

• Knowledge of aerial, underground, buried, conduit, fiber, and/or copper OSP infrastructure.

• Experience developing or reviewing OSP designs, construction work prints, work orders, routing plans, splicing information, and related engineering documentation.

• Working knowledge of NESC standards and telecommunications OSP engineering requirements.

• Experience performing or interpreting field surveys, measurements, and existing-condition information.

• Knowledge of permitting, ROW, easements, pole attachments, joint use, and make-ready processes.

• Experience identifying constructability issues, utility conflicts, clearance concerns, and other field conditions affecting OSP designs.

• Experience with telecommunications engineering databases, record systems, CAD/design platforms, mapping tools, and client portals.

• Ability to accurately perform data entry and maintain engineering records within Lumen systems and databases.

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple engineering assignments, deadlines, and project priorities.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills with the ability to coordinate effectively with engineering, construction, permitting, utilities, vendors, and project-management teams.

• Ability to work independently while maintaining accuracy, quality, and compliance with client engineering standards.

Preferred

• Previous Lumen/CenturyLink OSP engineering experience.

• Experience working directly within Lumen engineering databases, systems, or client portals.

• Experience with both aerial and underground/buried OSP engineering.

• Experience with joint-use, pole attachments, make-ready engineering, and utility coordination.

• Familiarity with CAD, GIS, mapping, drafting, and electronic markup tools used for OSP engineering.

• Experience supporting projects from initial engineering and field validation through permitting, construction release, and closeout.

One change I would especially recommend is making previous Lumen/CenturyLink experience a preferred qualification. At $35–$35.50/hour, the revised description is also better aligned with an OSP Engineer-level position rather than the senior/lead scope of the original description.

Your Impact and Responsibilities

Purpose of the position:
