We're looking for a compassionate, detail-oriented Care Companion to join our team supporting Carrot members. In this role, you'll guide members through their family-forming journeys, starting from their very first interaction with Carrot, primarily through phone and email support. You'll bring warmth and empathy to every conversation, helping members feel understood and supported as they navigate fertility and family-building care.

This is an onsite position in West Des Moines, IA.  The schedule is Monday-Thursday from 11:00 am-8:00 pm and Friday from 10:00 am -7:00 pm CST.  Training will take place over the first 6-8 weeks, from 8:30 am to 5:30 pm CST.

What You’ll Own 💼

In this role, you will:

• Serve as a member's primary point of contact, guiding them through their family-forming journey from their very first interaction with Carrot

• Respond to member inquiries via phone and email with empathy, accuracy, and urgency

• Help members understand and navigate their Carrot benefit, including eligibility, coverage, and next steps

• Support members across the full range of family-forming paths — fertility treatment, fertility preservation, adoption, donor-assisted reproduction, and gestational carrier arrangements

• Document every member interaction accurately and consistently in Zendesk.

• Recognize when a case needs escalation — clinical, sensitive, or otherwise — and route it to the right resource promptly

• Meet or exceed team benchmarks for response time, quality, and member satisfaction within your part-time schedule

• Flag trends or gaps you notice in resources, processes, or FAQs that could improve the experience for Urdu-speaking members specifically

What Success Looks Like  📈

• Guide members through their family-forming journeys via phone and email.

• Support members across all legal paths to parenthood, including adoption, fertility treatment, fertility preservation, and donor-assisted reproduction.

• Support members across our parenting, pregnancy, menopause and low-testosterone journeys.

• Document member interactions accurately and escalate complex cases, as needed.

• Partner with the broader Care Companion team to continuously improve the member experience

In your first 6 months, you will have:

• Participated in approx 12-16 weeks of onboarding. This includes:

• Learning about Carrot including journey types

• Platform utilization including Zendesk, Jira, Confluence, and Slack

• Shadowing other Care Companions, including reverse shadowing

• Consistently met response-time and quality benchmarks for phone and email support

About You ✨

You likely have:

• A Bachelor's degree

• 1-3 years of experience in a direct customer service, healthcare, or client-facing role

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• The ability to empathetically support a diverse member population through all paths to parenthood

Nice to Have ⭐

While not required, we would be especially excited if you bring:

• Deliver support in both English and Spanish, ensuring Spanish-speaking members receive the same quality of care as every other member

• Previous call center experience and an understanding of call center KPIs

• Experience working at a fast-growing tech or digital health company

• Experience with Zendesk or a similar CRM platform

• Past experience in the family-forming space, such as fertility care, adoption, donor-assisted reproduction, or gestational carrier arrangements

Why This Role Matters 🧡

Care Companions are at the heart of the member experience at Carrot. In this role, you help people navigate deeply personal fertility, family-building, and hormonal health journeys with clarity, empathy, and confidence. You are often the person who turns a complex or overwhelming moment into one that feels supported, informed, and actionable.

This role matters because every interaction shapes how members experience Carrot’s care model. Care Companions do more than answer questions- they build trust, guide members through important next steps, and connect them to the right resources at the right time. Their work helps members feel seen and supported while ensuring they can make the most of their benefit during some of the most meaningful moments in their lives.

Interview Process 🤝

We believe in a thoughtful and transparent interview process designed to create alignment for both candidates and our team.

For this role, candidates can expect:

• Recruiter Screen — 30 minutes

• Hiring Manager Interview — 30 minutes

• Leadership Conversation — 30 minutes

Throughout the process, we will share additional context about the team, business priorities, customer landscape, and what success looks like in this role.

Why Candidates Join Carrot 🌍

Carrot offers the opportunity to do meaningful work in service of a deeply human mission.

Highlights include:

• A mission-driven company focused on expanding access to fertility and family-forming care globally.

• A high-growth environment where leaders are empowered to shape strategy and drive impact.

• Competitive compensation, equity, and comprehensive benefits.

• Comprehensive parental leave and family-forming benefits.

• A collaborative, inclusive, and values-driven culture.

• The opportunity to work alongside passionate, thoughtful teammates committed to improving healthcare outcomes worldwide.

Compensation  💰

Carrot offers a holistic Total Rewards package designed to support our employees in all aspects of their life inside and outside of work, including health and wellness benefits, retirement savings plans, short- and long-term incentives, parental leave, family-forming assistance, and a competitive compensation package. The starting base salary for this position will be $28.00 per hour, plus a variable. Actual compensation may vary from posted base salary depending on your confirmed job-related skills and experience.

Fraud and Security Notice: Please note that all communication regarding job opportunities at Carrot will come exclusively from an @get-carrot.com email address. If you receive messages from any other domain, please disregard them and report the incident to: securityreporting@get-carrot.com

A Note on AI

At Carrot, we believe AI can help us work smarter, move faster, and create more meaningful experiences for our members, customers, and each other. While not every role requires deep technical AI expertise, we value people who are curious, eager to learn, and excited to thoughtfully incorporate AI into their day-to-day work.

For some roles, AI fluency is a core requirement—and we'll call that out clearly in the qualifications. For everyone else, we're looking for people who embrace new ways of working, use AI responsibly to improve quality and efficiency, and continue to learn as the technology evolves.

Why Carrot?

Carrot has received national and international recognition for its pioneering work, including Fast Company's Most Innovative Companies and World Changing Ideas, Inc. Power Partners, and Modern Healthcare’s Innovators. Carrot’s global workforce has been acknowledged with several accolades, including Fortune’s Best Workplaces in Healthcare, Great Place to Work, and Age-Friendly Employer certifications. jobs.title: Law School Admissions Consultant
jobs.description:
About Inspira Education

Inspira Education Group is one of the fastest-growing edtech startups in the US. We started with a simple mission to democratize access to high-quality coaching so that every student in the world has an equal opportunity to access the best opportunities.

As the world’s leading network of top admissions coaches in medical, legal, business, and college studies, we’re building software and services in one place—disrupting long-entrenched application processes with products and experiences that strive to provide an equal platform for candidates from diverse backgrounds worldwide.

As one of the fastest-growing edtech firms in the world, we are backed by some of the leading venture capital firms and investors in the world, including Zeev Ventures, Quiet Capital, Craft Ventures and Jeff Fluhr (Founder of Stubhub).

The Role

We are looking for a Law School Admissions Consultant with a deep understanding of the law school admissions process. If you're passionate about mentoring and guiding future law students through law school applications, this could be the perfect fit. In this role, you'll work closely with students to build law school application strategies, refine their personal statements and application essays, prepare for law school interviews, and support them in choosing the right law schools and programs. You'll be a trusted coach throughout the law school admissions process, helping students present their strongest selves and gain admission to their top-choice law schools. This is a part-time, remote, 1099 contract role that can be based anywhere in the United States or Canada.

Responsibilities

• Work one-on-one with prospective law school applicants, helping them strengthen their applicant profile and develop compelling personal statements, application essays, and other application materials

• Manage relationships with applicants and families while providing strategic and tactical guidance on law school selection, personal statements, application essays, resumes, recommendations, interviews, and the overall law school admissions process

• Identify optimal law schools and programs for individual students; provide feedback and guidance regarding law school research, admissions resources, and school selection based on each student's background and goals

• Support students with project planning, application timeline management, and progress tracking through internal organizational tools

• Stay up to date on the law school admissions process, admissions trends, and law school programs to advise prospective and existing students on school selection and the nuances of applying to law school

Qualifications

• Graduated from a U.S. law school

• Experience serving on a law school admissions committee, including reviewing applications and making admissions decisions

• Experience mentoring and advising pre-law students throughout the law school admissions process, particularly those applying to T-14 U.S. law schools

• Strong English reading, writing, and editing skills, particularly for law school personal statements and application essays

• Strong verbal communication and interpersonal skills

• Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple students, deadlines, and application timelines

• Passion for student mentorship and education

For more information about our company, please visit our website: Inspira Education Group.

Inspira Education Group does not discriminate based on race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital status, disability, veteran status, genetic information, sexual orientation, gender identity, or any other reason prohibited by law in providing employment opportunities and benefits.

jobs.title: Senior Security Engineer (Azure)
jobs.description:
About Nava

Nava is a consultancy and public benefit corporation working to make government services simple and effective. Since 2015, federal, state, and local agencies have trusted Nava to help solve highly scrutinized technology modernization challenges.

As a client services company, we guide agencies constrained by legacy systems to a future with sharp user experiences built on secure, reliable, fault-tolerant cloud infrastructure. Through human-centered design and modern engineering best practices, we help our government partners understand user needs and deliver on their missions more effectively. This focus gives everyone at Nava the opportunity to do work that is meaningful, impactful, and deeply connected to public good.

This role is open for multiple levels and titles. Final title/compensation will be determined by how your interview weighs against our core competencies during your interview cycle

Position summary

We are seeking a Security Engineer to support the design and implementation of a secure Azure cloud environment for a large-scale government modernization effort. This role will focus on establishing strong security and compliance foundations, including identity and access management, monitoring, and policy enforcement across the tenant. The Security Engineer will partner closely with cloud architects, engineers, and client stakeholders to define and implement security best practices aligned with federal and state requirements.

What you'll do

• Design and implement identity and access management (IAM) models, including RBAC and privileged access controls

• Configure and advise on security tools such as Microsoft Defender for Cloud

• Define and enforce security policies and governance guardrails using Azure Policy

• Set up and guide centralized logging, monitoring, and threat detection capabilities

• Design key management and secrets handling solutions (e.g., Azure Key Vault)

• Support compliance efforts, including HIPAA alignment and ATO preparation activities

• Collaborate with teams to identify security risks and define remediation approaches

• Contribute to secure cloud architecture decisions, including networking and access patterns

• Support Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and CI/CD practices to ensure secure deployments

• Create security documentation, runbooks, and provide guidance to enable client teams to operate securely

Required skills

• Experience with Azure cloud security, including Microsoft Entra ID and Defender for Cloud

• Strong knowledge of Identity and Access Management (IAM), including RBAC and privileged access controls

• Familiarity with security and compliance frameworks (e.g., HIPAA, state security standards, ATO processes)

• Experience implementing cloud security monitoring, logging, and incident detection

• Knowledge of Azure Policy and governance guardrails for enforcing security standards

• Experience with key management and secrets handling (e.g., Azure Key Vault)

• Understanding of secure network architecture and connectivity (including hybrid/on-prem integrations)

• Experience supporting Infrastructure-as-Code (IaC) and secure CI/CD pipeline practices

• Ability to define and document security architecture, standards, and operational runbooks

• Strong collaboration skills to work with engineers, architects, and stakeholders on security design and remediation

Compensation

$135,900—$153,000 USD

Other requirements

Legal authorization to work in the United States

Ability to meet any other requirements for government contracts for which candidates are hired

Work authorization that doesn’t require visa sponsorship, now or in the future

Insurance coverage — Nava provides disability, life, and accidental death insurance at no cost

Time off — vacation, holidays (including Juneteenth), and floating holidays to rest and recharge

Company holidays — enjoy 12 paid federal holidays each year on top of your regular PTO

Annual bonus — when Nava meets its goals, eligible employees receive a performance-based annual bonus

Parental leave — paid time off for new parents, plus weekly meals delivered to your home

Wellness program — full platform offering physical, mental, & emotional health resources & support tools

Virtual care — see doctors online with no copay through a virtual visit program (depending on available providers)

Sabbatical leave — earn extended unpaid leave after continuous service for personal growth or rest

401(k) match — Nava matches 4% of your salary to support your retirement savings plan

Flexible work — remote-first environment with flexibility built around your schedule and responsibilities

Home office setup — company laptop & setup assistance provided via Staples for remote work needs

Utility support — monthly reimbursement to help offset eligible home office utility expenses

Learning opportunities — internal training programs and resources to help grow your professional skills

Development opportunities — LinkedIn Learning access & an annual allowance for courses, tuition, & certs

Referral bonus — get rewarded when you refer great people who join the Nava team

Commuter benefits — pre-tax commuter programs to support in-office travel when applicable

Supportive culture — A collaborative and remote-friendly team environment where people genuinely care

Location

We have fully remote options if you reside in one of the following states:

Alabama, Arizona, California, Colorado, Connecticut, DC, Delaware, Florida, Georgia, Illinois, Louisiana, Maine, Maryland, Massachusetts, Michigan, Minnesota, Missouri, Nevada, North Carolina, New Jersey, New York, Ohio, Oklahoma, Oregon, Pennsylvania, Rhode Island, South Carolina, Texas, Tennessee, Utah, Virginia, Washington, Wisconsin

*If you are not living in one of the states listed above, unfortunately, you will not be considered for a position at this time.

Stay in touch

Sign up for our newsletter to find out about career opportunities, new partnerships, and news from the broader civic tech community.

Please contact the recruiting team at recruiting@navapbc.com if you would like to request any form of reasonable accommodation during the application or interviewing process.

Equal Employment Opportunity

Nava is committed to providing equal employment opportunities without discrimination or harassment on the basis of race, gender and/or gender identity or expression, color, creed, religion, religious creed, age, national origin, ethnicity, disability, veteran or military status, sex, sexual orientation, reproductive health autonomy, pregnancy, childbirth, and medical conditions related to pregnancy or childbirth, genetic information, domestic violence victim status, marital status, citizenship status, or any other characteristic protected by law. jobs.title: Implementation Lead - ASO Employer Health Benefits
jobs.description:
XO Health believes healthcare is fixable. Become part of the community changing the face of the industry.

XO Health is the first health plan designed by and for self-insured employers that delivers a more unified health experience for everyone – from those who receive care, to those who deliver it, to those who pay for it.

We are growing a multi-disciplinary team of diverse and digitally empowered employees ready to rebuild trust in healthcare through comprehensive and unified transformation.

ABOUT XO HEALTH:

XO Health is a technology-driven health plan built for self-insured employers. We serve employers, members, and providers through a value-based care network, a risk contracting engine, and a real-time data and analytics platform. We are a small, fast-moving team where every person owns outcomes, not just tasks.

ABOUT THE ROLE:

The Implementation Lead owns the end-to-end onboarding of new employer groups and TPA partners, from signed agreement through effective date and a stable first 60 days. You are the single point of accountability for a clean, on-time go-live: the plan is built correctly, eligibility flows, ID cards and welcome kits land, the member app is configured, and the client knows exactly where things stand at every step.

This is a hands-on, build-the-playbook role. You will run implementations yourself while standardizing how XO does them, so that each one is faster and cleaner than the last. You will work across Commercial, Plan Operations, Claims, Network, IT, and Compliance, and you will be the person clients, brokers, and TPAs trust to get them live.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

Client and TPA Onboarding:

• Lead the full implementation lifecycle for new employer groups and TPA partners, from kickoff through effective date and post-go-live stabilization.

• Build and maintain the implementation plan for each client: benefit design and plan documents, group structure, eligibility and enrollment setup, stop-loss coordination, vendor and partner integrations, member communications, and compliance requirements.

• Own the accurate setup of each group across XO’s systems and partner platforms, including benefit configuration, eligibility file testing, ID card and welcome kit production, member app configuration, and any SSO or portal integrations.

• Translate client-specific requirements into clear instructions for internal teams and confirm they are executed correctly before go-live.

Project Management:

• Run the cross-functional implementation team and ensure critical milestones are completed. Surface risks early, resolve blockers, and escalate with a recommendation when needed.

• Coordinate with Claims, Plan Operations, Network, IT, Compliance, and Finance to ensure ownership is properly assigned and dates are adhered to .

• Maintain a regular reporting cadence with leadership and flag anything that puts a go-live at risk.

Client Communication:

• Serve as the primary contact for the client, broker, and TPA throughout implementation. Lead recurring status meetings and keep a clear record of open items and decisions.

• Prepare client-facing implementation documentation, checklists, and readiness sign-offs.

• Hand off cleanly to the ongoing account owner at the end of the stabilization period, with full documentation of the group’s setup and any open items.

Playbook and Continuous Improvement:

• Own XO’s implementation playbook: standard timelines, checklists, templates, and data requirements for employer and TPA onboarding.

• Identify manual steps and failure points in the process and work with Operations and Product to automate or remove them.

• Turn lessons from each implementation into playbook improvements that strengthen the process and enable scale ahead of growth.

EXPERIENCE and EDUCATION:

Required:

• 5+ years in implementation, client onboarding, or project management within self-funded health benefits, TPA operations, or a health plan.

• Working knowledge of self-funded medical and pharmacy plan design, and the compliance landscape that comes with it (ERISA, ACA, CAA, Mental Health Parity).

• Direct experience running complex, multi-party healthcare implementations on a fixed effective date.

• Fluency in the employer and TPA distribution channel, including how brokers, consultants, benefits administrators, and stop-loss carriers fit together.

• Comfort with eligibility files, enrollment data, and system configuration. You do not need to be technical, but you need to be precise and unafraid of the details.

• Clear, concise communicator who can confidently lead client discussions and provide leadership with direct, well-informed answers.

• Strong organizational skills and the judgment to prioritize when everything feels urgent.

Preferred:

• Experience implementing on behalf of, or alongside, a TPA.

• Experience at an early-stage or high-growth company where you built the process rather than inherited it.

• Familiarity with health plan technology platforms, member apps, or provider directory tools.

• PMP or similar project management credentials.

KEY PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL ATTRIBUTES:

Accountability: you own the outcome and say so when something is off track.

Critical Thinking: you solve problems from first principles and learn what the organization needs next.

Change Champion: you are committed to building and comfortable when the plan changes.

Relationships: you build trust quickly with clients, partners, and colleagues.

Full compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.

jobs.title: Manufacturing Engineer
jobs.description:
US Conec, Ltd.

Engineering Innovation. Precision Plastics. Powering AI.

US Conec, Ltd. is a trusted, global company that prides itself on engineering excellence—creating innovative connectivity solutions that support today’s most important technologies. We foster a friendly, inclusive culture that values teamwork, creativity, and mutual respect. At US Conec, you’ll find real opportunities to grow and make a meaningful impact in a company that genuinely cares about its people and its customers. With competitive compensation, excellent benefits, and a supportive environment, this is a place where you can build your future—whether your interests lie in manufacturing, engineering, operations, or beyond.

Manufacturing Engineer

Future Opportunities

We're always interested in connecting with talented Manufacturing Engineers. This posting may be used to identify candidates for both current and upcoming openings. As a result, timing for follow-up may vary, and not all applicants will be contacted immediately. Qualified candidates will remain in our talent community and may be considered for future opportunities that align with their background and experience.

Overview
Welcome to US Conec, where we take pride in being a global leader in high-density fiber-optic connector solutions! With over 30 years of precision engineering, injection molding, and plastics manufacturing expertise, we are excited to invite you to join our team as a Manufacturing Engineer. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to design and optimize manufacturing systems—especially precision molds, processes, and metrology—to support both new and existing products while leading our continuous-improvement initiatives.

Responsibilities

• Design and develop injection molds, molding processes, manufacturing systems, and techniques that make a difference!

• Identify and implement system/process improvements and cost-reduction projects to enhance efficiency.

• Create and maintain manufacturing process documentation (work instructions, data sheets) to keep everything organized.

• Develop and perform tight-tolerance measurement methods to ensure our product specifications are met with excellence.

• Provide day-to-day technical support to production operations and troubleshoot equipment issues with a positive attitude.

• Procure new equipment and training; coordinate repairs for manufacturing machinery to keep our operations running smoothly.

• Analyze customer returns to determine root causes of failures or complaints, helping us improve our products.

• Lead and mentor Process Technicians and hourly associates on assigned projects, fostering a supportive learning environment.

• Deliver process and equipment training to production staff as needed, sharing your knowledge and expertise.

Must Haves

• Bachelor’s degree in mechanical, manufacturing, or a related engineering field.

• Solid understanding of statistical techniques (DOE, Measurement R&R, SPC) to guide our processes.

• Working knowledge of machining, tooling, fixturing, and assembly practices to contribute effectively.

• Excellent interpersonal, verbal, and written communication skills to collaborate with our team.

• Advanced proficiency in MS Office applications to help with documentation and reporting.

Nice to Haves

• Experience with mechanical (indicators, micrometers) and electronic metrology (CMM, CT, interferometry, confocal microscopy) is a plus!

• Exposure to hydraulic and pneumatic control system installation, troubleshooting, or repair would be beneficial.

• Familiarity with PLCs, data-acquisition hardware, and industrial software programming is a great asset.

• Hands-on experience with a 3D CAD system to bring your designs to life.

What We Offer

• A competitive base salary with performance-based bonus potential, rewarding your hard work.

• 4 weeks of PTO to ensure you have time to relax and recharge.

• Health, dental, and vision plans to keep you and your family healthy.

• 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match and planning resources to help secure your future.

• A collaborative, team-based culture that fuels innovation and creativity.

• Paid time off, holidays, and employee recognition programs celebrating your achievements because you deserve it!

• Community engagement and STEM outreach opportunities to give back locally and make a difference. Relocation Assistance Available We welcome candidates from across the country. Relocation assistance may be available for qualified candidates to support a successful transition to the Hickory, NC area. Our team is committed to helping new employees settle into both their role and the local community.

US Conec will only employ those who are legally authorized to work in the United States. This is not a position for which sponsorship will be provided. Individuals with temporary visas such as E, F-1, H-1, H-2, L, B, J, or TN or who need sponsorship for work authorization now or in the future, are not eligible for hire.

Join US Conec today and be part of a team that values each other, promotes innovation and growth, and strives to exceed customer expectations in everything we do.

jobs.description:
Great Hill Solutions, LLC is part of the Seneca Nation Group (SNG) portfolio of companies. Our portfolio comprises multiple subsidiaries that participate in the Small Business Administration 8(a) program. To learn more about SNG, visit the website and follow us on LinkedIn.

Our team of talented individuals is what makes us successful. To support our team, we provide a balanced mix of benefits and programs. Your total rewards package includes competitive pay, benefits, and perks, flexible work-life balance, professional development opportunities, and performance and recognition programs. We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, vision, life, and disability, voluntary benefit programs (critical illness, hospital, and accident), health savings and flexible spending accounts, and retirement 401K plan. One of our fundamental principles is to offer competitive health and welfare benefits to our team members, providing coverage and care for you and your family. Full-time employees working at least 30 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in our benefits and paid leave programs. We pride ourselves on our collaborative work environment and culture, which embraces our mission of providing financial and non-financial benefits back to the members of the Seneca Nation.

Great Hill is seeking a Quality Assurance Specialist to join our team in Atlanta, GA. The Quality Assurance Specialist provides comprehensive laboratory quality assurance, quality management system (QMS), and safety program support for the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention's (CDC) Coronavirus and Other Respiratory Viruses Division (CORVD). This role supports laboratory quality initiatives by ensuring compliance with federal regulations, laboratory accreditation requirements, quality standards, biosafety requirements, and CDC policies. The QA specialist assists with audit readiness, corrective action management, quality improvement initiatives, safety compliance monitoring, equipment management, risk assessments, and Quality Management System implementation across laboratory operations.

The position serves as a key liaison between laboratory personnel, quality management staff, safety officers, and leadership to promote continuous quality improvement, operational excellence, and regulatory compliance.

MAJOR DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

• Support implementation, maintenance, and continuous improvement of Laboratory Quality Management Systems (QMS) to ensure compliance with CDC, CMS, CLIA, and applicable regulatory requirements.

• Conduct quality assessments, gap analyses, compliance reviews, and corrective action follow-up activities to identify and resolve quality management issues.

• Review, document, and monitor Non-Conforming Events (NCEs), deviations, corrective actions, preventive actions, and quality performance metrics.

• Coordinate laboratory audit readiness activities, including inspection preparation, compliance assessments, documentation reviews, and regulatory support.

• Manage laboratory temperature monitoring and environmental control programs, including review of alarm notifications, temperature excursions, trend analyses, and corrective actions.

• Maintain equipment inventories and support calibration, preventive maintenance, qualification, and replacement planning activities for laboratory systems and instrumentation.

• Support laboratory safety programs through safety compliance monitoring, training record management, hazard assessments, biosafety reviews, and incident investigations.

• Develop, revise, and maintain quality and safety Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), policies, work instructions, and controlled documentation.

• Provide quality and safety training support, communicate quality initiatives to laboratory personnel, and participate in laboratory improvement and compliance working groups.

• Conduct risk assessments, identify quality and safety risks, recommend mitigation strategies, and support implementation of continuous quality improvement initiatives.

QUALIFICATIONS

Education and Experience:

• Bachelor's degree in Medical Laboratory Science, Biology, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biochemistry, Life Sciences, or a related scientific field.

• Master's degree preferred.

• Certification as a Medical Technologist (MT), Medical Laboratory Scientist (MLS), Clinical Laboratory Scientist (CLS), or equivalent certification from an accredited professional certification board (e.g., ASCP, AMT, or AAB) is preferred.

• Experience working within CLIA, CMS, CAP, or ISO-regulated laboratory environments is highly desirable.

CORE COMPETENCIES (Required Skills):

• Quality Management Systems (QMS)

• CAPA Management

• Risk Assessment & Mitigation

• Audit & Inspection Readiness

• CMS/CLIA Compliance

• Biosafety & Laboratory Safety Programs

• Equipment Lifecycle Management

• Temperature Monitoring Systems (e.g., MESA)

• SOP Development & Document Control

• Quality Metrics & Reporting

• Regulatory Compliance Management

• Must be a United States citizen or permanent resident or have authorization for employment in the United States to obtain and maintain the necessary security clearance for this role.

jobs.description:
The Community Health Worker I reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines, and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

The NMHC Community Health Worker (CHW) is a frontline health professional who is a trusted member or has a very close understanding of the community served.  This trusting relationship enables the CHW to serve as bridge between health system, social services, and the community.  The CHW facilitates access to services and improves the quality and cultural competence of service delivery.  A CHW also builds individual and community capacity by increasing health knowledge and self-sufficiency through outreach, community education, informal counseling, social support and advocacy.  The CHW reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

• Act as liaison between health system, social services and the community.
• Provides telephonic support to patients to assist them in achieving social stability and close caps in care.
• Supports individuals, families, and communities to strengthen their access to resources related to NM’s social drivers of health screening.
• Facilitates patient and family education which promotes social wellness and increases knowledge of the health care system.
• Collaborates with the Population Health team, Primary Care, Community Affairs and FQHCs as appropriate to provide comprehensive patient support.
• Complete social drivers of health screenings and provide appropriate resources.
• Follows regulatory reporting requirements
• Documents appropriate data in the electronic medical record to track patient needs and intervention.
• Utilizes motivational interviewing and conflict resolution skills as necessary to ensure timely resolution of issues and system problems.

Required:

jobs.title: Senior Project Manager of Early Childhood Initiatives and Partnerships
jobs.description:
Position Summary

This position reports to the Chief of Early Childhood Education and is responsible for supporting the city’s most needed ECE initiatives and working alongside other city departments to ensure those initiatives are fully supported.  The successful candidate will be responsible for interacting with local, regional, and national ECE leaders and thought partners to develop and execute policies to best prepare children and families of Philadelphia for the Kindergarten and elementary school experience. Some/all the initiatives this individual will be responsible for managing include:

• Workforce Development: Oversee successful implementation of a strategic plan for a future well-trained and compensated ECE workforce that is nationally competitive and locally representative of the community(ies) it intends to serve. This includes engaging with local training providers to ensure an ample supply of ECE Directors, Lead Teachers, Assistant Teachers, and staff are available. Reports and data analysis will be required for the ECE workforce landscape, considering demographics, quality, and professional development opportunities.

• Early Intervention: Support the systemic remodeling of the process of identifying and serving children with exceptionalities for children between the ages of 3-5. This will require supporting the Local Education Agency (and relevant partners) responsible for screening, identifying, and serving children with exceptionalities between the ages of 3-5. It will further require developing a more streamlined process that includes mental, emotional, and behavioral health supports.

• Intragovernmental Partnerships: Lead all partnerships with other city and governmental agencies that support the initiatives necessary to operate Philadelphia’s public early learning sector. This includes, but is not limited, to the Departments of Public Health, Behavioral Health and Intellectual disAbilities, Community Behavior Health, Free Library of Philadelphia, Human Services, Parks and Recreation, Commerce, Business and Economic Development, Licensing & Inspections, and

• Stakeholder Engagement: Provide a variety of opportunities to engage a broad base of stakeholders, including parents, ECE providers, K-12 educators, advocates, policymakers, business and philanthropy throughout the year. Oversee the development of an annual report on the state of early learning in Philadelphia.

• Other Initiatives, as needed: emergency needs; trauma-informed practices; inclusionary policies; kindergarten and elementary school transition supports; etc.

• Capable and detail-oriented multitasker who can prioritize and remain professional in demanding situations.

• Knowledge of and familiarity with the Commonwealth of Pennsylvania’s Quality Rating System, Keystone STARS.

• Ability to interpret relevant local, state, and federal rules and regulations pertaining to childcare program administration.

• Ability to reference and identify small and medium business best practices.

• Ability to collaborate effectively with colleagues at all levels of the organization.

• Ability to learn quickly and succeed in a rapidly changing environment.

jobs.title: Staff AI Test and Evaluation Engineer
jobs.location: Washington, District of Columbia, United States
jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

ABOUT THE TEAM

Discovery is Anduril's team for taking the newest problems across domains- space, missile systems, air, sensor capability, autonomy, and cyber- and proving out what is worth solving. We build the models, run the tests, and carry what works to the point where a program can pick it up. Discovery works alongside Air Defense, Space, Intelligence, Cyber, GNC, Hardware, and every other group at Anduril to incubate the solutions to the hardest problems.

ABOUT THE JOB

Discovery is building an expeditionary force: a team of engineers who want to solve difficult problems and who navigate unfamiliar territory as an operating standard. As a Discovery engineer, you pick up a concept nobody has proven and build the analysis or prototype that tests it to get to an answer. Whether you spend your time working on hard problems on our autonomy stack, acoustic sensor analysis, or battle space management, we tackle every challenge the same way: by questioning assumptions and building our way to the answer.

We are focused on taking AI models from research into production—onto classified platforms and edge hardware where they have to perform reliably in the real world. As our model portfolio and classified work grow, rigorous, repeatable evaluation of how these models actually perform has become mission-critical.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Develop Test Scenarios Simulation Environments: Develop comprehensive test scenarios, and simulation environments to assess agentic AI performance in classified simulations.

• Validate AI on Classified & Edge Platforms: Lead the integration and validation of agentic AI systems onto classified platforms and edge hardware.

• Build Reusable Evaluation Pipelines: Build reusable evaluation pipelines, automated test harnesses, and monitoring dashboards for continuous validation.

• Define Actionable Metrics: Figure out what good metrics look like for AI models and traditional models—establishing systematic, historic capture of performance rather than one-shot, deployment-specific measurement.

• Partner Cross-Functionally: Partner with cross-functional teams to define requirements, document test results, and contribute to AI model cards and deployment readiness reviews.

• Own End-to-End Evaluation: Architect, build, and maintain the evaluation and validation infrastructure for our agentic AI and ML models, from unit-level model checks through full-system, scenario-based assessment.

• Troubleshoot and Debug: Analyze and resolve issues uncovered in evaluation and in deployment, ensuring reliability and operational success across every release.

REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Technical Expertise: Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Machine Learning, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or a related technical field.

• Programming Proficiency: At least 12+ years of hands-on experience writing production-grade code, with strong Python skills for building evaluation pipelines, test harnesses, and tooling.

• Evaluation Ownership Mindset: Demonstrated experience owning evaluation or automated testing for production ML or software systems—test scenarios, metrics, regression suites, and CI infrastructure.

• AI/ML Evaluation Experience: Hands-on experience designing evaluation methodologies for AI or machine learning models—defining metrics, building benchmarks, and assessing model behavior against real-world scenarios.

• Simulation Experience: Experience designing or working extensively with simulation environments to exercise model and system behavior.

• Metrics Discipline: Working knowledge of how to define, capture, and reason about performance metrics for AI models and traditional models, including systematic historic capture over time.

• Systems-Level Thinking: Ability to navigate and contribute to complex systems and established codebases.

• Program Ownership: Comfort operating between technical program management and software engineering—defining requirements, coordinating across teams, and documenting results.

• Real-World Impact: Passion for building the evaluation infrastructure that proves AI works—directly influencing mission-critical outcomes.

• Security Clearance: Must be eligible for a US security clearance.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

• Prior Title Background: Experience as an ML Test & Evaluation Engineer, SDET for ML systems, ML/Evaluation Engineer, Simulation Engineer, or Technical Program Manager for AI/ML.

• Agentic AI Evaluation: Experience designing test methodologies for agentic AI systems—tasking, decision-making, and scenario-based behavior validation.

• Classified / Edge Deployment: Familiarity with validating and deploying AI models onto classified platforms, edge hardware, or resource-constrained environments.

• Model Cards & Readiness Reviews: Experience contributing to AI model cards, deployment readiness reviews, or similar model-governance and release-gating practices.

• Aerospace/Defense T&E: Familiarity with test and evaluation practices in aerospace or defense, including qualification testing, range operations, or operational assessment.

• MLOps & Monitoring: Experience with MLOps tooling, monitoring dashboards, and continuous validation pipelines for ML models in production.

• Programming Skills: Additional experience with Go, C++, or scripting for test automation and tooling.

• Growth into Broader Ownership: Interest in growing from T&E ownership into deeper ownership of the AI evaluation and deployment stack over time.

US Salary Range

$253,000—$336,000 USD

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

Benefits

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

jobs.title: Orthodontic Integration Specialist - Greater Atlanta
jobs.description:
About LightForce

LightForce is leading the digital transformation of orthodontics and redefining the standard of care for patients. Our fully digital, 3D-printed orthodontic platform increases practice efficiency, improves clinical consistency, and enables more predictable treatment outcomes.

Unlike traditional stock brackets, LightForce delivers fully customized, patient-specific brackets paired with AI-driven treatment planning—optimizing outcomes at scale. With recent advancements unlocking the next phase of digital orthodontics, LightForce continues to push the boundaries of what’s possible in personalized care.
Learn more at www.lf.co

Description

As a LightForce Integration Specialist, you will drive the onboarding, adoption, and growth of the LightForce’s orthodontic system in orthodontic practices. You will apply your clinical expertise and demonstrate comprehensive knowledge of orthodontic office processes, workflows, and knowledge of the LightForce sales strategy, to identify opportunities for growth and accelerate revenue and higher case volume. You will build and leverage influential relationships with doctors and staff by providing them with tailored clinical and operational insights with training to enable and inspire them to modernize and grow their business by utilizing the LightForce system.

While collaborating with the sales team, you will perform a thorough customer “current state” assessment, prioritize and created defined work path with each targeted customer to facilitate full adoption of the LightForce system through business needs, by creating and leveraging training resources and implementing processes and procedures with doctors and staff, while maintaining a positive customer experience. As a representative of LightForce Orthodontics, you are instrumental in communicating with customers, internal teams and leaders.

Essential Duties and Responsibilities

• Provide clinical support to doctors to achieve the goal of LightForce onboarding and full integration in orthodontic practices.

• Foster positive relationships with entire practice teams within targeted practices. Build relationships with partners, utilizing a consultative and collaborative approach with the common goal inspiring our customers to modernize and grow their business utilizing the LightForce system.

• Deliver Clinical Training and presentations both virtually and in person to a variety of customer types as well as internal audiences, to maximize implementation, utilization and integration of LightForce technology and refining office processes.

• Demonstrate leadership by being customer focused, displaying strategic thinking, having a global and company mindset, focusing on results, and continuously developing skills.

• Jointly lead and manage the new customer onboarding training strategy, assist with resource and tool development, and deliver full integration with both doctors and staff of orthodontic practices.

• Strategically work with sales and marketing and commercial support functions to prioritize opportunities.

• Work as a clinical mentor to internal partners and external partners regarding best demonstrated practices.

• Stay active and engaged with important orthodontic related organizations to stay abreast of trends and changes in orthodontics that impact our business or customers.

• Utilize up to date knowledge of the orthodontic industry to provide clinical input for new product development and software enhancements

• Utilize data/analytics to help customer’s drive decision making

• Orchestrate additional internal company resources to optimize the customer experience and provide ongoing promotion of LightForce solutions.

• Diagnose positive and negative results and lead triage and execution, accordingly, communicating results to leadership. Handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing tasks based on organizational need and judgment.

• Effective and independently manage booking of travel within company guidelines; ensuring to adhere to personal expenses and expense reporting requirements in a timely manner

• Be creative, self-disciplined and capable of identifying and completing critical tasks independently with a high sense of urgency

Education and Experience

• Clinical certification in dentistry or Orthodontics (RDH, EF, CDA, RDA, LDA etc.)

• 5+ years of relevant work experience in the related health industry specifically Orthodontics

• Valid Driver's license and ability to travel up to 65-75% of the time in Atlanta, other parts of Georgia and Alabama

Required Qualifications

• Self-motivated

• Eager to learn

• Resourceful

• Problem solver

• Reliable and Trustworthy

• Punctual

• Team player

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Internal Communications, Programs & Events
jobs.description:
About Crunchyroll

Founded by fans, Crunchyroll delivers the art and culture of anime to a passionate community. We super-serve over 100 million anime and manga fans across 200+ countries and territories, and help them connect with the stories and characters they crave. Whether that experience is online or in-person, streaming video, theatrical, games, merchandise, events and more, it’s powered by the anime content we all love.

Join our team, and help us shape the future of anime!

About the role

We're looking for a Senior Manager, Internal Communications, Programs & Events to lead global communications, employee programs, and events that help employees stay connected to Crunchyroll’s business, strategy, culture, and leadership.

Reporting to the Director of Internal Communications, you'll lead some of our most visible internal moments, including global All-Staff meetings, leadership forums, cultural programs, and employee events. You’ll own the work from strategy and concept through execution and measurement, partnering with senior leaders and teams across the company.

This is a senior individual contributor role for someone who is both strategic and hands-on, a strong communicator who can shape the approach, advise leaders, and bring programs and events to life.

Core Responsibilities

• Develop and lead global internal communications, employee programs, and events that connect employees to Crunchyroll’s business, strategy, culture, and leadership.

• Lead high-visibility internal events, including All-Staff meetings, leadership forums, employee gatherings, and cultural programs.

• Own programs and events from strategy and concept through planning, production, communications, and measurement.

• Advise senior leaders on communications strategy, messaging, content, audience needs, and employee experience.

• Prepare executives for major internal moments, including agendas, briefings, presentations, talking points, and rehearsals.

• Develop communications plans and employee programs that support key business and engagement priorities.

• Write and edit executive messages, presentations, video scripts, talking points, event materials, and other employee communications.

• Determine the right audience, message, channel, and timing for major communications and programs.

• Build consistent approaches for virtual, hybrid, and in-person events that can scale across Crunchyroll’s global teams.

• Partner across the company to bring communications, programs, and events to life.

• Lead agencies, vendors, contractors, and production partners, including scopes, budgets, timelines, and deliverables.

• Anticipate risks and issues that could affect employees, events, or communications and plan accordingly.

• Use employee feedback, participation, and communications performance to measure results and improve future work.

• Identify new tools and approaches to strengthen Crunchyroll’s internal communications and employee experiences.

About You

• 8+ years in internal or corporate communications, including employee programs and high-visibility events, within a global organization.

• Strong writing and editorial skills, including executive communications, presentations, talking points, and employee-facing content.

• Ability to turn business priorities into clear communications, programs, and employee experiences.

• 3+ years leading high-visibility virtual, hybrid, and in-person events from concept through execution.

• Track record of independently leading complex communications and employee programs involving senior executives and multiple teams.

• Strong judgment and confidence advising senior leaders and building alignment across teams without direct authority.

• Skilled in managing agencies, production partners, vendors, budgets, timelines, and event logistics.

• Ability to manage multiple priorities, anticipate risks, and adapt quickly when plans change.

• Comfortable using employee feedback and performance data to measure results and improve future programs.

• Global mindset and cultural awareness, with the ability to adapt communications and programs for different regions and audiences.

• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, Marketing, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

• Ability to travel domestically and internationally and work across time zones as needed.

• Knowledge of anime, pop culture, and the entertainment industry is a plus; familiarity with Japanese culture is also a plus.

Why you will love working at Crunchyroll

In addition to getting to work with fun, passionate and inspired colleagues, you will also enjoy the following benefits and perks:

• Receive a great compensation package including salary plus performance bonus earning potential, paid annually.

• Flexible time off policies allowing you to take the time you need to be your whole self.

• Generous medical, dental, vision, STD, LTD, and life insurance

• Health Saving Account HSA program

• Health care and dependent care FSA

• 401(k) plan, with employer match

Our co-founders and leadership team have deep commitment to clinical excellence and domain expertise in healthcare. Our CEO, Christina LaMontagne https://www.linkedin.com/in/christina-lamontagne-a289152/, has led two startups and earned her MBA at Harvard Business School. Our Chief Medical Officer, Alesandro Larrazabal, MD https://www.linkedin.com/in/alesandro-larrazabal-m-d-7b4a9623/, trained at UCSF and Stanford. Until recently, he was a Medical Director building specialty care services at Kaiser Permanente. Earlier, he worked at IDEO.

The Nurse Care Coordinator Manager (RN) is an integral member of Clarity Pediatrics' interdisciplinary care team, collaborating with physicians, advanced practice providers, psychologists, and therapists. Under the direction of clinical leadership, the Nurse Care Coordinator lead ensures seamless care delivery for children with chronic conditions by coordinating clinical appointments, providing patient and family education, managing medication authorizations, and serving as a primary point of contact between families, providers, and pharmacies. This role will also be the supervisor for the team of nurses, medical assistants, and community health workers. Note this is a fully remote position.

 

Key Responsibilities


LEADERSHIP RESPONSIBILITIES INCLUDE:


STAFF SUPERVISION & DEVELOPMENT

 - Recruit, hire, train, and onboard new team members

 - Provide direct supervision and performance management for all assigned staff

 - Conduct regular 1-on-1 meetings, performance reviews, and coaching

 - Identify professional development needs and facilitate training and continuing education

 - Address performance issues promptly and constructively; document as appropriate

 - Prepare and deliver staff schedules and manage coverage


OPERATIONAL MANAGEMENT

 - Maintain compliance with healthcare regulations (HIPAA, state nursing boards, etc.)

 - Ensure timely and accurate documentation and record-keeping

 - Participate in quality improvement and process optimization initiatives

 - Track and report key performance indicators and metrics

 - Coordinate with other departments to ensure seamless patient care transitions

 - Maintain appropriate staffing ratios and coverage


COMMUNICATION & COLLABORATION

 - Communicate effectively with patients, families, and interdisciplinary team members

 - Participate in team meetings and clinical huddles

 - Serve as liaison between clinical staff and management

 - Report to leadership on team performance, concerns, and successes

 - Collaborate with community partners and external resources

Also assist with coverage and support of Care Coordination Team duties, including:

Care Coordination & Scheduling

 - Coordinate, schedule, and reschedule clinical appointments across the care team

 - Manage referrals to specialist and external clinical services

 - Proactively follow up with families to reduce gaps in care and no-show rates

Communication

 - Provide clinical updates to referring physicians

 - Coordinate lab work and documentation requirements for treatment planning with referring providers

 - Support the providers for patients requiring escalation of care

 - Provide evidence-based education to families regarding chronic condition management

 - Explain medication regimens, treatment plans, and care goals in accessible language

 - Respond to patient and family inquiries via messaging and phone in a timely manner

Medication Management & Pharmacy Coordination

 - Initiate and manage medication prior authorization requests with insurance payers

 - Communicate with pharmacies to resolve dispensing issues and coordinate refills

 - Track authorization status and escalate delays to the appropriate clinical team member

 - Maintain accurate medication records and document all pharmacy communications



 

Qualifications

Required:

 - Licensure: Active California Registered Nurse (RN) license in good standing (Bachelor's, or Master's degree in Nursing accepted)

 - Experience: Minimum 10 years of nursing experience

 - Leadership: Experience leading a team of clinical staff

 - Tech-Savvy: Demonstrated proficiency with multiple technology platforms and electronic health record (EHR) systems

 - Communication: Strong organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills

 - Virtual Environment: Ability to manage competing priorities and work collaboratively in a remote, virtual environment

 - Cultural Responsiveness: Comfort working with diverse, medically and socially complex pediatric populations

 - Startup Mindset: Excitement about joining a fast-growing startup and iterating on new care models.

 - Internet Access: Reliable internet connection and a dedicated workspace suitable for remote work



Preferred:

 - Experience in pediatric, chronic care, or care coordination settings

 - Familiarity with prior authorization processes and payer requirements

 - Experience working in underserved or urban environments

 

Logistics

 - Full-time position

 - Regular work hours of M-F from 8 AM - 5 PM PT + on-call coverage for escalation of care by Care Coordinator Team

 - $100,000 - $120,000/year with medical and ancillary benefits

 - Remote-friendly culture

jobs.title: Predajný poradca/Predajná poradkyňa skrátený pracovný pomer 30h týždenne Liptovský Mikuláš, Retail Park
jobs.location: Liptovský Mikuláš, Žilinský kraj, Slovakia (Slovak Republic)
jobs.description:
ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ

Ako Predajný poradca/Predajná poradkyňa v H&M zohráte kľúčovú úlohu pri vytváraní vynikajúceho zákazníckeho zážitku. Privítate zákazníkov, prevediete ich predajňou a pomôžete im nájsť, čo potrebujú, pričom budete prezentovať naše produkty. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

• Budete zdieľať svoje znalosti o móde a produktoch, aby ste pomohli zákazníkom urobiť informované rozhodnutia.
• Čaká vás spolupráca s vaším tímom na poskytovaní výnimočnej služby počas celého zákazníckeho zážitku, vrátane aktívnej propagácie vernostného programu H&M.
• Pomôžete zabezpečiť, aby predajná plocha a sklad boli dobre zásobené, organizované a prívetivé.
• Podporovať tím budete aj pri otváraní a zatváraní predajne.
• A taktiež budete pozitívne reprezentovať seba a značku pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

• Skúsenosti so zákazníckym servisom v oblasti módy, retailu alebo v podobných odvetviach (predošlé skúsenosti budú považované za výhodu).
• Vášeň pre pomoc zákazníkom a záujem o módu alebo retail – zvyšok vás naučíme!

A ľudí ktorí…​

• Majú radi spoluprácu a dynamické prostredie.
• Sú komunikatívni, kreatívni, zvedaví na prácu s technológiami obchodu, s veľkou túžbou učiť sa a rozvíjať.
• Flexibilní a orientovaní na výsledky.

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

• 25 %zamestnanecká zľava na všetky značky v rámci H&M Group, v predajniach aj online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories a ARKET).
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Viac o programe sa dozviete tu.
• Stabilný zamestnávateľ,
• Športová karta Multisport,
• Atraktívna mzda a ďalšie príležitostné bonusy.
• Rozsiahly program školení,
• Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),
• Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,
• Občerstvenie na pracovisku,
• Bonus pri narodení dieťaťa v podobe darčekovej karty v hodnote 50 eur,
• Po odpracovaní 10 rokov dovolenka naviac,
• Odmena za odporučenie kolegu až do 300 eur,
• 4 dni Relaxing Days (2 v prvom roku zamestnania).

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​

Ide o pozíciu na skrátený pracovný úväzok v rozsahu 30 hodín týždenne. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, s nerovnomerne rozvrhnutou pracovnou dobou, pričom sa pracuje na ranné aj poobedné zmeny počas pracovného týždňa.

Miesto výkonu práce je v Liptovskom Mikuláši.

Mzdové ohodnotenie je 6,18 € brutto/hod., vrátane príplatku za víkend nad rámec zákona.

Neváhajte a prihláste sa čo najskôr, najneskôr však do 22.10.2026.

Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov môžeme prijímať žiadosti len prostredníctvom našej kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.​

­­­­­­­­*Hodnotenie pozícií v predajni:

Aby sme zvládli vysoký objem prihlášok na pozíciu Predajného poradcu, používame online hodnotenie na základe zručností v rámci niektorých našich predajní. Tento proces budete musieť dokončiť ako súčasť prihlášky a výberového procesu. Vaše odpovede budú hodnotené nástrojom na hodnotenie, ktorý aplikuje vopred stanovené kritériá určené spoločnosťou H&M Group.

Po dokončení hodnotenia budete mať možnosť zdieľať feedback a položiť otázky. Ak narazíte na akékoľvek problémy alebo preferujete alternatívnu metódu hodnotenia, kontaktujte nás na  recruitment_support@hm.com. Výber alternatívy nebude mať vplyv na vašu prihlášku.

Viac informácií o tom, ako spracúvame vaše osobné údaje, nájdete v našich Zásadách ochrany osobných údajov.

** Zaviazali sme sa k spravodlivému a nestrannému výberovému procesu založenému na kompetenciách. Preto vás prosíme, aby ste k žiadosti neprikladali motivačný list.

jobs.title: Staff Cloud Security Engineer
jobs.description:
STAFF CLOUD SECURITY ENGINEER

Remote, Anywhere in the US



We’re looking for a Staff Cloud Security Engineer who thrives on designing scalable, secure cloud systems and enabling data-driven decision-making.

About AnswersNow:

AnswersNow is a venture-backed digital health company delivering virtual autism care to families. Our mission is to empower and enhance the lives of those affected by autism by making personalized therapy more accessible. We connect families with expert clinicians quickly — often moving from assessment to therapy within weeks, without waitlists or commutes — and deliver outcomes that parents describe as life-changing.

Why this role matters:

This is our first dedicated security hire and the single owner of security across our platform, infrastructure, and corporate environment. You'll set the strategy, build the program, and do the hands-on work. You'll partner directly with the CTO and engineering team, and you'll be the technical authority on security for customers, auditors, and leadership.

This is a Staff-level role. We expect you to operate with significant autonomy, make sound risk-based tradeoffs, and raise the security maturity of the whole organization.

What you’ll do:

Cloud & Infrastructure Security

 - Architect, secure, and continuously harden our AWS environment (IAM, VPC design, KMS, CloudTrail, GuardDuty, Security Hub, Config, WAF, etc.)

 - Secure our serverless and data layers, including Lambda, S3, and PostgreSQL (RDS/Aurora): encryption at rest and in transit, least-privilege access, network isolation, backup integrity, and audit logging

 - Implement Infrastructure-as-Code security guardrails and policy-as-code

 - Own secrets management, key management, and certificate lifecycle

 - Manage and harden Amazon Elastic Kubernetes Service (EKS) infrastructure, including cluster security, network policies, and container runtime security

Application & API Security

 - Secure our APIs and application stack: authentication/authorization, session management, rate limiting, input validation, and OWASP Top 10 / API Top 10 risks

 - Embed security into the SDLC with threat modeling, secure design reviews, SAST/DAST, dependency and container scanning, and CI/CD pipeline security

 - Secure our proprietary real-time video platform (WebRTC/media transport, session access controls, recording storage, and encryption)

 - Run our vulnerability management and penetration testing program, including vendor selection, scoping, and remediation tracking

AI Security & Governance

 - Establish company-wide AI usage policies and governance frameworks to ensure safe, ethical, and compliant adoption of internal and third-party AI tools

 - Architect and secure in-product AI/ML capabilities, protecting against OWASP LLM Top 10 vulnerabilities (e.g., prompt injection, insecure output handling, data poisoning)

 - Implement strict data privacy guardrails to prevent unauthorized exposure of PHI/PII in model training, fine-tuning, and prompt contexts

 - Define and enforce model security controls, securing model artifacts, API endpoints, supply chain dependencies, and access controls

 - Build continuous monitoring, telemetry, and comprehensive audit logging across all AI/ML workflows to support compliance, threat detection, and incident response

Compliance (SOC 2 & HIPAA)

 - Own our path to SOC 2 Type I and Type II: scoping, control design, evidence collection, auditor selection and management, and ongoing readiness

 - Own ongoing HIPAA Security Rule compliance, including risk assessments, policies, BAAs, breach notification procedures, and audit readiness

 - Get the most from Vanta: tune integrations, automate evidence collection, and drive remediation of failing tests

 - Maintain the security policy library, risk register, and vendor risk management program

 - Support customer and payer security questionnaires and due diligence

Endpoint & Corporate Security

 - Work with outsourced IT to manage security for laptops and workstations: MDM, disk encryption, EDR, patching, hardening baselines, and device compliance

 - Own identity and access management: SSO, MFA, RBAC, joiner/mover/leaver processes, and periodic access reviews

 - Work with People ops to run security awareness and HIPAA training programs

Detection, Response & Resilience

 - Build logging, monitoring, and alerting for the platform and corporate environment (SIEM or equivalent)

 - Develop and test our incident response plan, run tabletop exercises, and lead response when incidents occur

 - Partner with engineering on disaster recovery, backup, and business continuity planning

Leadership

 - Define the security roadmap and communicate risk clearly to the CTO and executive team

 - Mentor engineers and build a security-conscious culture, such as a security champions model

 - Build the business case for tools, vendors, and (eventually) additional security headcount

What you bring:

 - 8+ years in security engineering, with significant hands-on experience securing production cloud environments, ideally AWS-heavy

 - Deep AWS security expertise (IAM, networking, encryption/KMS, logging and detection services, serverless security)

 - Experience securing PostgreSQL and other data stores containing regulated or sensitive data

 - Strong application and API security background, and the ability to review code and architecture and work effectively with developers

 - Direct experience owning or leading a SOC 2 audit (Type I and/or Type II) and HIPAA compliance, ideally in a healthcare or health-tech environment handling PHI

 - Experience with Infrastructure-as-Code (Pulumi, CloudFormation, or CDK) and CI/CD security

 - Experience with AI security, LLM application security, and guarding against OWASP LLM Top 10 vulnerabilities

 - Strong incident response experience

 - Excellent communication: you can explain risk to engineers, executives, auditors, and customers alike

Nice to have:

 - Experience with compliance automation platforms such as Vanta, Drata, or Secureframe

 - Experience securing real-time communication or video platforms (WebRTC)

 - Familiarity with HITRUST, ISO 27001, or NIST frameworks

 - Experience at a startup or scale-up where you built a security program from scratch

 - Relevant certifications (AWS Security Specialty, CISSP, CCSP, OSCP, or similar)

 - Experience with pediatric or behavioral health data and the added privacy considerations that come with minors' information

What we offer:

 - $151,000- $178,500 annual salary

 - Equity options in a high-growth, venture-backed company.

 - Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision.

 - Generous PTO and remote-first flexibility.



More About AnswersNow

AnswersNow welcomes applicants of all backgrounds, experiences, and abilities. We believe a diverse team is a strong team, and are committed to provide a fair and equitable experience for every candidate. If you require reasonable accommodations at any stage, we encourage you to reach out. We’re here to support!

Learn more about us at getanswersnow.com http://getanswersnow.com.

E-Verify & Right to Work
AnswersNow participates in E-Verify and electronically verifies the work authorization of all new hires upon employment. E-Verify is only used after a job offer has been accepted; it is not used to pre-screen applicants.

For more information, view the E-Verify Participation https://static-assets.ripplingcdn.com/webapp-static/apps/everify/us_poster_participation.pdf and Right to Work https://static-assets.ripplingcdn.com/webapp-static/apps/everify/us_poster_righttowork.pdf posters in English and Spanish.
