jobs.title: DTC Supervisor Distrib Center Ops
jobs.description:
The Supervisor, Distribution Center Operations (DTC) operates in a fast-paced, customer-centric eCommerce environment and is responsible for coordinating, directing, and supervising teams to deliver an exceptional direct-to-consumer experience. This role focuses on order fulfillment, speed to customer, accuracy, and service quality, ensuring all consumer orders are processed efficiently and on time.

To perform this job successfully, an individual must:

• Supervise, coach, and develop team leads and associates supporting DTC order fulfillment operations.
• Coordinate and manage daily workflow to ensure timely processing of consumer orders, prioritizing speed, accuracy, and customer satisfaction.
• Leverage WMS, order management systems, and reporting tools to plan staffing, monitor order flow, and adjust priorities in real time based on demand.
• Ensure all customer orders are fulfilled accurately, packaged to brand standards, and shipped within service level expectations.
• Monitor and drive performance against key DTC metrics such as order cycle time, fulfillment accuracy, units per hour, and on-time shipment.
• Lead training and development initiatives to ensure teams are equipped to meet evolving eCommerce demands and deliver high-quality customer experience.
• Promote a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and customer-first thinking across the operation.
• Ensure compliance with Mattel policies, procedures, and safety standards while maintaining a positive and inclusive work environment.
• Partner with P&C and leadership to address employee relations, engagement, and performance management.
• Collaborate cross-functionally with other teams to resolve order issues and improve the end-to-end consumer experience.
• Support peak planning and seasonal volume surges to ensure operational readiness.
• Lead or participate in special projects focused on process improvement, scalability, and DTC growth initiatives.

• Must have flexibility to work between 1st and 2nd shift
• 3–5 years of leadership experience in a DTC, eCommerce environment
• Experience with WMS
• Experience in high-volume, fast-paced fulfillment operations preferred
• Bilingual (English/Spanish) preferred
• Strong ability to manage multiple priorities in a time-sensitive, customer-driven environment
• Proven ability to collaborate across teams and functions
• Strong communication skills (written and verbal)
• Ability to interpret data, analyze trends, and make operational decisions
• Proficiency in reporting, metrics tracking, and performance management
• Solid problem-solving and decision-making skills
• Strong organizational and time management abilities
• Proficiency with Microsoft Office; Order management systems a plus

What It’s Like to Work Here:

We are a purpose driven company aiming to empower the next generation to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential. We live up to our purpose employing the following behaviors:

• We collaborate: Being a part of Mattel means being part of one team with shared values and common goals. Every person counts and working closely together always brings better results. Partnership is our process and our collective capabilities is our superpower.
• We innovate: At Mattel we always aim to find new and better ways to create innovative products and experiences. No matter where you work in the organization, you can always make a difference and have real impact. We welcome new ideas and value new initiatives that challenge conventional thinking.
• We execute: We are a performance driven company. We strive for excellence and are focused on pursuing best in class outcomes. We believe in accountability and ownership and know that our people are at their best when they are empowered to create and deliver results.

Who We Are:

Mattel is a leading global toy company and owner of one of the strongest catalogs of children’s and family entertainment franchises in the world. We create innovative products and experiences that inspire, entertain and develop children through play. We engage consumers through our portfolio of iconic brands, including Barbie, Hot Wheels, Fisher-Price, American Girl, Thomas & Friends, UNO and MEGA, as well as other popular intellectual properties that we own or license in partnership with global entertainment companies. Our offerings include film and television content, gaming, music and live events. We operate in 35 locations and our products are available in more than 150 countries in collaboration with the world’s leading retail and ecommerce companies. Since its founding in 1945, Mattel is proud to be a trusted partner in empowering children to explore the wonder of childhood and reach their full potential.

Mattel is recognized as a Great Place to Work™ and as one of Fast Company’s Best Workplaces for Innovators in 2022.

Visit us at https://jobs.mattel.com/ and www.instagram.com/MattelCareers.

Mattel is an Affirmative Action/Equal Opportunity Employer where we want you to bring your authentic self to work every day. We welcome all job seekers including minorities, females, veterans, military spouses, individuals with disabilities, and those of all sexual orientations and gender identities.

Pursuant to the Los Angeles Fair Chance Ordinance and the California Fair Chance Act, qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment.

jobs.description:
OUR COMPANY:

EOS IT Solutions is a global technology and logistics company, providing Collaboration and Business IT Support services to some of the world’s largest industry leaders, delivering forward-thinking solutions based on multi-domain architecture. Customer satisfaction and commitment to superior quality of services are our top business priorities, along with investing in and supporting our partners and employees.

WHAT YOU WILL DO:

As a Network Field Technician - Tier 1, you will support the deployment and maintenance of networking hardware and infrastructure at customer sites around the world. Working under the guidance of experienced engineers and project managers, you will play a key role in helping ensure successful onsite installations, upgrades, and troubleshooting.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Assist with the installation, racking, and cabling of network hardware (routers, switches, access points, etc.).

• Run and terminate copper and fiber optic cabling under supervision.

• Conduct basic troubleshooting of physical connectivity issues.

• Follow detailed instructions, network diagrams, and equipment layouts to perform installations accurately.

• Support Wi-Fi survey teams with setup and equipment handling.

• Perform equipment labeling, documentation, and site clean-up post-deployment.

• Collaborate with project teams and escalate issues as needed.

• Assist with site readiness surveys (e.g., rack space, power, cabling paths).

• Adhere to quality standards, safety protocols, and project deadlines.

ESSENTIAL CRITERIA:

• 1–2 years of experience in IT, networking, field service, or a related technical role (internships and school programs considered).

• Basic understanding of networking hardware and cabling types (Cat5e/6, fiber).

• Ability to follow instructions and work well in a team setting.

• Strong attention to detail, time management, and willingness to learn.

• Comfortable using hand tools and working with hardware in various environments.

• Ability to lift up to 50 lbs and work in physically active roles.

• Willingness and ability to travel both domestically and internationally.

• Flexible with working hours including evenings and weekends when required.

• Up to 85% travel

DESIRABLE CRITERIA:

• Relevant certifications (CompTIA Network+, CCT, or equivalent) or working toward certification.

• Familiarity with networking concepts (IP addressing, ports, patching).

• Experience working in structured cabling, telecom, or data center environments.

• Exposure to ticketing or project tracking systems (ServiceNow, Jira, etc.).

Havoc was founded in 2024 and headquartered in Providence, Rhode Island. Learn more at Havoc: All-Domain Collaborative Autonomy http://havocai.com/ .

About the Role

HavocAI is seeking a Government Contracts & Compliance Counsel to support our rapidly growing portfolio of U.S. Government and defense business. This role will serve as a key legal and compliance partner to leadership and teams across contracts, finance, strategy, business development, programs, engineering, and operations.

This is a highly cross-functional role for an attorney who understands the realities of operating in the Defense Industrial Base and can translate complex government contracting requirements into practical, business-oriented guidance. You will advise across the full government contract lifecycle—from capture and proposal activities through negotiation, performance, compliance, and closeout—while helping HavocAI build scalable compliance infrastructure as the company grows.

The ideal candidate is comfortable operating in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where priorities shift quickly and novel questions do not always have a playbook. You should be equally comfortable analyzing a FAR/DFARS clause, negotiating contract terms, developing a compliance framework, and advising executives on risk.

Key Responsibilities

Government Contracts

 - Provide legal counsel across the lifecycle of U.S. Government contracts, subcontracts, grants, OTAs, and other government agreements.

 - Review, draft, and negotiate prime contracts, subcontracts, teaming agreements, NDAs, vendor agreements, and other commercial and government-facing agreements.

 - Advise on FAR, DFARS, agency supplements, flow-down requirements, representations and certifications, and government contracting obligations.

 - Partner with Contracts, Finance, Strategy, and program teams on solicitations, proposals, negotiations, contract modifications, and performance issues.

 - Advise on contract interpretation, changes, disputes, terminations, intellectual property rights, technical data rights, and government rights in software.

 - Support diligence and risk analysis associated with new programs, customers, partners, and contracting vehicles.

Compliance & Risk

 - Develop, implement, and continuously improve HavocAI’s government contracting compliance program as the company scales.

 - Provide practical guidance on procurement integrity, organizational conflicts of interest, ethics, mandatory disclosures, lobbying restrictions, gifts and gratuities, and other federal contracting requirements.

 - Advise on business systems and compliance requirements applicable to government contractors, including accounting, purchasing, estimating, property management, and related controls.

 - Partner with Finance and Contracts on cost and pricing requirements, timekeeping, allowable costs, indirect costs, and audit readiness.

 - Support internal compliance reviews, risk assessments, investigations, and corrective actions.

 - Monitor regulatory developments affecting defense contractors and translate new requirements into actionable guidance for internal teams.

 - Develop policies, procedures, training, and internal controls that enable the business to move quickly while maintaining appropriate compliance standards.

Defense Trade & Regulatory Support

 - Partner with relevant internal and external stakeholders on ITAR, EAR, export controls, sanctions, and foreign-person access considerations.

 - Advise teams on regulatory considerations associated with international business, foreign partners, technical data, and defense-related products and services.

 - Coordinate with security, engineering, People, and business teams where government contracting requirements intersect with export controls, security requirements, or personnel considerations.

Business Partnership

 - Serve as a trusted legal advisor to executives and business leaders, providing clear recommendations rather than simply identifying legal risks.

 - Work closely with teams during fast-moving capture, proposal, contracting, and program decisions.

 - Balance legal and compliance requirements with operational realities, helping teams identify practical paths forward.

 - Partner with outside counsel and specialized advisors when additional expertise is required.

 - Help build scalable legal and compliance processes appropriate for a rapidly growing defense technology company.

Qualifications

 - J.D. from an accredited U.S. law school and active membership in good standing with at least one U.S. state bar.

 - 7+ years of relevant legal experience, with significant experience in U.S. Government contracting and federal procurement law.

 - Strong working knowledge of the FAR and DFARS and experience interpreting and applying government contract requirements.

 - Experience advising defense contractors, aerospace companies, technology companies, government agencies, or organizations operating within the Defense Industrial Base.

 - Demonstrated experience drafting, reviewing, and negotiating government contracts, subcontracts, teaming agreements, and related agreements.

 - Experience advising on government contracting compliance programs and internal controls.

 - Strong understanding of government contract intellectual property and technical data considerations.

 - Ability to independently analyze complex regulatory issues and translate them into clear, actionable business guidance.

 - Excellent judgment, communication, negotiation, and stakeholder-management skills.

 - Ability to manage multiple high-priority matters simultaneously and operate effectively with ambiguity and evolving requirements.

 - High degree of ownership, discretion, and integrity.

 - U.S. Citizenship required.

 - Ability to obtain and maintain a U.S. Government security clearance.

Preferred Qualifications

 - Experience working directly within a defense technology, aerospace, autonomous systems, robotics, or high-growth government contractor.

 - Experience with Other Transaction Authority (OTA) agreements and non-traditional defense acquisition pathways.

 - Experience advising on ITAR, EAR, export controls, and international defense business.

 - Knowledge of government contract cost accounting, CAS, TINA/Truthful Cost or Pricing Data requirements, DCAA audits, and DCMA processes.

 - Experience with government rights in technical data and computer software, including SBIR/STTR data rights.

 - Familiarity with cybersecurity and government contractor requirements, including CMMC, NIST SP 800-171, and applicable DFARS cybersecurity clauses.

 - Experience supporting internal investigations, mandatory disclosures, government audits, or regulatory inquiries.

 - Prior in-house experience within a rapidly scaling organization.

 - Active or previously held DoD security clearance.

What Success Looks Like

You enable the business to move quickly without compromising compliance. You understand government contracting deeply enough to distinguish between meaningful risk and issues that can be solved pragmatically. You anticipate requirements before they become problems, build processes that scale without unnecessary bureaucracy, and become a trusted partner to leaders across the organization.

You are comfortable operating without a perfect roadmap, taking ownership of complex issues, and helping HavocAI successfully navigate the regulatory environment that comes with scaling a defense technology company.


BENEFITS:

 - 100% Employer paid Health Insurance

 - Dental and Vision Insurance for you and your families

 - Life Insurance (Employer Paid)

 - Ability to participate in the companies 401k program (Matching) 

 - Unlimited PTO policy with an enforced 2 week minimum

 - Equity Package

 - Work / Home Office Stipend

 - Global Entry

 - 16 Week Paid Parental Leave

 - Monthly Health and Wellness Stipend



OUR VALUES:

 - Innovation: We are driven to break new ground. Every day presents an opportunity to challenge the status quo, think boldly, and deliver advanced solutions that transform the future of defense technology.

 - Integrity: We hold ourselves to the highest ethical standards, ensuring transparency, accountability, and trust in all our actions and partnerships.

 - Mission-Driven: We are focused on achieving impactful outcomes that align with our core mission—protecting lives through innovation.

 - Forward-Leaning: We continuously seek out new opportunities and remain at the forefront of technological advancements. We embrace change and anticipate the challenges of tomorrow with confidence and creativity.

 - Ownership of All Tasks: At HavocAI, no problem is too complex or too trivial. We believe that greatness comes from tackling the hardest challenges, but also in handling the smallest, sometimes thankless, tasks with the same level of commitment and care.

 - Servant Leadership: We lead by serving others, whether it’s supporting our employees, partners, or the broader community. Empowering those around us is key to achieving long-term success and making a lasting impact.

jobs.title: Registered Nurse-Emergency Department Full Time Days
jobs.description:
The Clinical Nurse reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Based on the NMH framework for practice, the registered professional clinical nurse (RN) is accountable and responsible for the provision and coordination of clinically competent, evidence-based care for an assigned group of patients that includes diagnosis, outcome identification, planning, implementation and evaluation. The nurse adheres to the ANA Scope and Standards of Professional Nursing, the Code of Ethics, and the Nursing Social Policy Statement.   As a member of the clinical care and unit team, the RN participates in decision-making, teaching, mentoring, and collaboration with the multidisciplinary team to advance the patient plan of care, achieve exceptional outcomes and enhance unit operations.  The RN exemplifies the components of what it means to be an NMH nurse, reflects the Mission, Vision, and Values of Northwestern Memorial, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Responsibilities:

The role of the professional clinical nurse is unique and essential to the care of the patient.  The nurse demonstrates that unique and essential function through the framework for nursing practice.

Advocate:

• Practices in accordance with the patient centered care model
• Develops an individualized age-specific culturally sensitive nursing plan of care for the patient that is based on the nursing process
• Incorporates the role of patient advocate into the plan of care
• Uses a team approach to develop and achieve daily patient-centered individualized care goals
• Acknowledges and values the contributions of the patient’s significant others as an integral part of the plan of care
• Identifies potential conflict situations and facilitates resolution using established communication channels
• Promotes and strives to protect the health, safety and rights of the patient
• Protects patients by maintaining a safe environment

Clinical Expert:

• Advances clinical expertise, as demonstrated through pursuit of informal and formal continuing education opportunities and obtaining specialty certification when eligible
• Continuously enhances skills and abilities to ensure the highest quality patient care
• Shares knowledge and expertise through educating team members, patients and students
• Demonstrates critical thinking by integrating theoretical knowledge and expertise to pose relevant clinical questions when evidence and practice differ
• Identifies priorities, sets realistic and measureable goals, prescribes and implements nursing interventions in a safe and timely manner
• Develops and implements individualized education plans for patients and families using suitable instructional materials and methods
• Evaluates and documents the patient’s responses to nursing interventions in the health record and properly individualizes the plan of care based on the evaluation of findings
• Identifies situations that require further intervention and escalates appropriately; Consults appropriate experts and resources when needed
• Participates in the formation, implementation and evaluation of team goals
• Appropriately delegates and supervises interventions to implement the plan of care
• Conveys complete, timely and accurate information at hand off at the bedside or any hand off
• Adheres to ethical standards of practice

Community Volunteer:

• Participates in one or more volunteer initiatives annually, Northwestern Memorial organized or on his/her own

Compassionate:

• Consistently demonstrates interpersonal connections with patients and families from introduction through discharge
• Proactively responds to patient concerns such as speaking to patients about possible/expected delays in plan of care
• Treats patients, families, visitors and staff in a caring manner with respect and dignity
• Facilities recovery and where appropriate helps ensure a peaceful death for patients

Professionally Engaged:

• Is a member of a professional organization or participates on an Northwestern Memorial committee or taskforce at the hospital-wide, departmental, or unit level
• Demonstrates accountability and collaborative practice with co-workers, other disciplines, and departments
• Assumes responsibility for continued professional growth and education reflecting knowledge and understanding of current nursing practice
• Serves as a community mentor for team members
• Serves as a preceptor for new team members
• Participates in the peer feedback process by conducting a constructive assessment and evaluation of peer performance
• Works collaboratively with all hospital services to accomplish daily work and maintain an environment of excellence
• Participates in the development of policies, procedures and systems to support safe and effective care and advance nursing practice at NMH through the Shared Leadership Process
• Assumes personal responsibility for meeting internal (i.e. Best People profile, ELMs, CPR, and health requirements) and external regulatory and accreditation requirements
• Identifies opportunities for innovation and quality improvement; participates in innovation projects and the quality improvement process, including unit based quality committees
• Demonstrates accountability to Northwestern Memorial strategic, operational and fiscal goals
• Exemplifies a professional image in appearance and communications

• Maintains and advances the professional image of nursing and the practice of professional nursing through an ongoing analysis of resources
• Professional Organizations, literature, electronic resources, etc.

Required:

• Graduate of an NLN accredited school/college of nursing
• Baccalaureate degree in Nursing or higher
• Current State of Illinois, Registered Professional Nurse license
• Basic Life Support (BLS) CPR through American Heart Association.
• Analytic ability (conceptual and quantitative)
• Oral, listening and written communication skills
• Strong human relation skills to interact effectively and collaborate with others in difficult situations
• Use of a keyboard to enter or retrieve data

Preferred:

• Experience in specific clinical area
• Nursing specialty certification, if eligible

jobs.title: CNC Machinist
jobs.description:
Pyrotek's CNC Machinist is responsible for producing machined parts by programming, setting up, and operating a computer numerical control (CNC) machine, maintaining quality and safety standards, keeping records, and maintaining equipment and supplies.

** This position is eligible for a $1500 sign on bonus. $750 paid out at 90 days / $750 paid out at 180 days. **

Shift: Monday - Friday, 6:00 am - 2:00 pm

Essential Functions/Responsibilities

• Adhere to production schedules by studying work orders, blueprints, engineering plans, and material specifications; interpret complex geometric dimensions and tolerances (GD&T).
• Operate CNC machines by entering instructions, setting tool registers, offsets, and compensation using G-code and/or conversational programming; apply mathematical and geometric calculations to determine machining requirements.
• Set up CNC machines by programming, editing, installing, and adjusting tools, attachments, collets, bushings, and stops with minimal assistance.
• Load raw material safely and verify settings by measuring positions and first-run parts to adhere to international standards.
• Ensure part specifications by monitoring drilling, grooving, cutting, turning, and facing operations; take measurements, troubleshoot malfunctions, and make corrective adjustments to programs and tools as needed.
• Maintain equipment by completing preventive maintenance, following manufacturer instructions, troubleshooting issues, and reporting repairs in a timely manner.

Education/Experience

• High School Diploma or General Education Development (GED)/Test Assessing Secondary Completion (TASC), plus a minimum of five (5) years of experience as a CNC Machinist or successful completion of a certificated machining program; or equivalent combination of education and experience.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities

• Technical Skills. Ability to set up machines from scratch, touch off all tools, and write basic programs on CNC machine controller. Knowledge and ability to figure proper feeds and speeds of tooling for best life utilization. Knowledge of a wide variety of materials, hardness, and grades. Working knowledge of over-head crane, hoist, and lift tables. Ability to effectively use precise measuring tools such as mics, calipers, height gage, thread gage, bore gage, plug gage, and/or CMM is a plus.
• Training Skills. Ability to provide balanced coaching and guidance to ensure the development and validation of proficiencies in machining techniques and standard operating procedures.
• Core People Skills. Ability to positively interact and work collaboratively with a diverse group of people at all levels of the organization. Ability to apply a large measure of common sense to a variety of situations.
• Communications Skills. Ability to speak clearly and persuasively in positive or negative situations, listen, obtain clarification, and respond well to questions.
• Computer/Application Skills. Proficient CNC machining skills (editing programming, tooling knowledge, and ability to read blueprints.) Working knowledge of arc/radius programming and ability to manually compensate for tool nose radius/clearance.

jobs.title: Staff Product Operations Manager
jobs.description:
WHY SOCURE?

Socure is building the identity trust infrastructure for the digital economy — verifying 100% of good identities in real time and stopping fraud before it starts. The mission is big, the problems are complex, and the impact is felt by businesses, governments, and millions of people every day.

We hire people who want that level of responsibility. People who move fast, think critically, act like owners, and care deeply about solving customer problems with precision. If you want predictability or narrow scope, this won’t be your place. If you want to help build the future of identity with a team that holds a high bar for itself — keep reading.







ABOUT THE ROLE

Product Operations exists to give product teams the systems, data, and processes they need to plan, prioritize, and deliver well — the same way Sales Ops supports Sales or DevOps supports Engineering. This role sits at the center of that discipline, contributing to three core areas: the reporting and analytics that give everyone visibility into what's happening, the process that makes planning and delivery repeatable instead of reinvented pod by pod, and the ongoing work of keeping strategy and execution connected as priorities shift.



We run Product Operations as a hybrid centralized/embedded model: some Product Ops work sits centrally and serves every product team consistently, while other Product Ops work sits embedded inside individual product lines, close to their day-to-day priorities. This role sits in the centralized hub — you're the shared systems, process, and reporting engine that every embedded product manager and product ops partner relies on, rather than being dedicated to any single product line.



We're a small team, so this role is intentionally broad. At larger companies, "owns the tools," "owns the reporting," and "owns the process" are sometimes split into two or three separate roles. Here, one person does all of it, with the flexibility to shift emphasis as priorities and team size change over time.




WHAT YOU'LL DO


SUPPORT REPORTING & ANALYTICS FOR THE PRODUCT ORG

 - Build and maintain the dashboards and reports that give leadership and embedded product teams a reliable view of roadmap status, delivery progress, and portfolio health.

 - Define and track core product operations metrics (e.g., cycle time, roadmap adherence, planning hygiene, tool adoption).

 - Centralize and facilitate Product Performance metrics definition, telemetry builds, and availability to central data and BI teams, and coordinate dashboard and reporting builds with the central Business Intelligence team to enable deeper insights and faster decision making for the Product Team.

 - Partner with Finance, Sales/RevOps, and Engineering to bring commercial and delivery data (e.g., CRM/ARR data) into product prioritization and reporting.

 - Support recurring reporting cadences — business reviews, quarterly/annual planning, board updates — with clean, trusted data.

 - Monitor data quality and drive hygiene standards across the systems that feed reporting.


DRIVE PROCESS, EFFICIENCY & TEAM ENABLEMENT

 - Design and document repeatable processes for planning, prioritization, intake, and roadmap reviews — so teams have a consistent way of working instead of reinventing it pod by pod.

 - Identify friction points and manual, duplicative work in the product development lifecycle, and fix them — through better process, automation, or tooling.

 - Build templates, playbooks, and checklists (e.g., for feature intake, roadmap reviews, launch readiness) that save product managers time and reduce administrative burden.

 - Act as the go-to resource for product managers and embedded product ops partners on how to use shared tools and processes effectively — training, office hours, documentation.

 - Facilitate cross-functional handoffs between Product, Engineering, Design, and GTM so work moves smoothly instead of stalling on a handoff.

 - Continuously look for opportunities to standardize process across pods while leaving room for the flexibility each team actually needs.


KEEP STRATEGY AND EXECUTION ALIGNED

 - Partner with product leadership to translate high-level strategy and company priorities into a concrete, trackable roadmap and planning cadence.

 - Run the rhythm of planning — quarterly/annual planning cycles, roadmap reviews, and business reviews — that keeps execution connected to strategy as priorities shift.

 - Monitor progress against strategic priorities and flag early when day-to-day execution is drifting from what leadership actually intended.

 - Support trade-off and prioritization conversations when competing asks conflict with stated strategic priorities, so decisions get made deliberately rather than by default.

 - Make sure work happening inside individual pods visibly ladders up to company-level strategic themes, not just local priorities.

 - Close the loop after major planning moments — make sure decisions made in a review actually get reflected in the systems everyone works from day to day.




WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

 - Product teams and Leadership trust the systems and data they're working from.

 - Leadership can get a reliable answer about roadmap and delivery status without a scramble.

 - Tooling stays consistent and well-governed instead of fragmenting pod by pod.

 - Planning cycles run on schedule, supported by clean data rather than last-minute reconciliation.

 - Teams spend less time on manual coordination and administrative busywork, and more time making strategic decisions.

 - Roadmap execution visibly ladders up to strategic priorities — and when it drifts, that gets caught and surfaced early, not discovered at quarter-end.

 - Cross-functional handoffs happen through defined, repeatable processes instead of ad hoc effort every time.

 - System and reporting knowledge is documented and shared, not held by one person.




WHAT YOU BRING

 - 6+ years in Product Operations, Business/Sales Operations, or a Product Analyst/Management role, ideally supporting or working inside of a product or engineering organization.

 - Comfort building dashboards and reports (in the PPM tool itself, Tableau, Looker, or Google Sheets/Excel); SQL is a plus.

 - Use of LLM-based tools (e.g. Claude, ChatGPT, Perplexity, etc.) to augment and optimize job and role-related workflows, dashboards, research, etc.

 - Experience designing and documenting repeatable processes — intake, prioritization, planning cadences — rather than just running an existing one.

 - Comfort facilitating conversations where strategic priorities and day-to-day execution are in tension, and helping stakeholders land on a decision.

 - Strong analytical skills — able to turn messy or scattered data into something people can act on.

 - A generalist mindset and genuine comfort moving between technical configuration, process design, and data/reporting work in the same week.

 - A bias toward noticing inefficiency and fixing it, even when it falls outside the "official" scope of the role.

 - Excellent documentation and communication skills — you're the connective tissue between central leadership and embedded product teams.

 - Ability to work autonomously on a small, fast-moving team where priorities shift.




PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS

 - Experience operating inside a centralized or hybrid Product Ops model, supporting multiple embedded product teams or pods.

 - Experience facilitating OKR or strategic-planning cadences and connecting them to roadmap execution.

 - Working knowledge of PDLC and SDLC processes — roadmaps, backlogs, sprints, and prioritization frameworks (e.g., RICE, WSJF), different types of launch and product profiles (0-1 products, mature products, etc) and the PDLC process to support them.

 - Experience with CRM (e.g., Salesforce) or CRM-to-PPM integrations feeding commercial data into prioritization.

 - Background in process improvement (e.g., Lean, Six Sigma, or similar) is a plus, though not required.

 - Experience in SaaS, fintech, or another regulated technology environment.

 - API or scripting experience (REST APIs, Zapier, or similar) for lightweight integrations and automation.

 - Experience supporting company-wide planning cycles — annual/quarterly planning, OKRs, board-level reporting.




WHY THIS ROLE MATTERS

Product teams move faster and make better decisions when the systems, process, and data behind their work are trustworthy. Without a dedicated owner, strategy and execution tend to drift apart — teams stay busy, but on priorities that no longer reflect what leadership actually needs. In a centralized/embedded Product Ops model, this role is the connective tissue: it's why a PM on any pod can trust the roadmap data, why a planning decision made in a leadership review actually shows up in what gets built next sprint, and why leadership can get a straight answer about where things stand. As the team is growing, this role will be focused less on Systems & Tools; and more on Process enforcement, and Data & Analytics

jobs.title: Credentialing Associate
jobs.description:
At Talkspace, we are committed to fostering a diverse, equitable, inclusive, and belonging-centered workplace where everyone can thrive while making a difference in mental health. Want to help over two million people receive quality mental healthcare? Come join our mission of getting therapy in the hands of everyone!

We are looking for an experienced Credentialing Associate to join our team. The Credentialing Associate is responsible for the credentialing, re-credentialing, licensing, and auditing of the Network and Support team at Talkspace. This includes performing administrative tasks such as processing, completing, and inputting key information, coordinating and corresponding with the Credentialing Verification Organization and the providers, and assisting with the reporting and auditing functions. The Credentialing Associate works closely to support and assist the Credentialing Manager in any projects and administrative functions as needed. To work at Talkspace, you need to be as passionate as we are about our work, and excited to partner with us on delivering quality mental healthcare.

This is a remote position based on Eastern Time. Talkspace Headquarters is located in NYC.

What You’ll Do

• Credentialing Perform all daily credentialing functions, such as processing completed provider files, and inputting provider approval dates. Management of all provider Fountain credentialing processes. Coordinate with the Credentialing Verification Organization to ensure timely completion, downloading, and uploading of files as well as updating the system to reflect decisions. Correspond with providers for missing data elements such as NPI numbers and/or CAQH profile information. Ensuring accurate storage record of provider files.

• Recredentialing Ensure timely re-credentialing of the credentialed provider network. Coordinate with the Credentialing Verification Organization toensure timely completion of re-credentialing review for each clinician.

• Licensing Review of credentialed licenses to ensure accuracy of credentialed information.

• Auditing Quarterly internal audits to ensure efficiency and accuracy within the Credentialing Program.

• Performs other related duties as assigned.

About You

• 1+ year(s) of professional work experience in a highly communicative role required.

• Bachelor’s degree in a related field preferred.

• Knowledge of Microsoft and/or of similar applications.

• Credentialing experience is highly preferred.

Benefits

• Comprehensive Medical, Dental and Vision plans coverage since day one

• Pre-tax benefits: HSA/ FSA

• 401k Retirement Savings Program with matching up to 4%

• Voluntary benefits including disability, basic life or pet insurance, etc.

• Monthly Wellness Stipend to promote mental and physical self-care

• PTO and Remote First Environment

• Regular team events, including Wellness Workshops and Team Building Events

• Free access to Talkspace products for you and one household member, as well as access to a friends and family discount!

Compensation

At Talkspace, we believe that pay transparency during the interview process is a critical part of diversity, equity, and inclusion. Our salary bands are based on internal and external compensation benchmarks, which we regularly evaluate to ensure we pay competitively.

The hourly rate for this role is $20-24/hr. Within the salary bands, leveling corresponds to each candidate’s relevant experience, skills as assessed during the interview process, education, and applicable certifications.

Why Talkspace?

Talkspace is the world’s leading online therapy company, serving over 2 million users looking to begin their wellness journey through tele-health. According to the World Health Organization, close to 1 billion people worldwide live with a mental disorder, and on average more than 75% with mental, neurological, and substance use disorders receive no treatment for their condition at all. Additionally, one-third of the world’s population – 2 billion people – live in countries that spend less than 1% of their health budgets on mental health. Therapy is an universal need and it's our mission here to change the world by cultivating an intentional space for people to feel supported through quality care that is simple and accessible.

Combining our passion for innovation along with our desire to help others overcome the stigma behind “getting help,” we are transforming the way patients find the right care provider, making an otherwise impossible feat easily conquerable. Our network of licensed, accredited, and board-certified clinicians are increasing access to mental health for our members through a myriad of high quality therapy services: anytime and for a fraction of the price. Dedicated to our mission, we are looking for candidates that want to bring their talents into a diverse  “for purpose” space. If you’re equally as passionate about making quality mental healthcare accessible to all then Talkspace is the right place for you!

EQUAL OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER

Talkspace welcomes and celebrates talent from all backgrounds, perspectives, and walks of life to foster an innovative and diverse workforce. We encourage you to apply, even if you don’t meet every qualification or if your path has been nontraditional — such as not completing a formal degree program, taking a career break, or having a prior criminal record — if you believe you could make a great addition to this team. Come as you are and learn about the exciting opportunities on our team.

Individuals seeking employment at Talkspace are considered without regard to race, color, religious creed, sex, national origin, citizenship status, age, physical or mental disability, sexual orientation, marital, parental, veteran or military status, unfavorable military discharge, or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

How do we define Diversity, Equity, Inclusion, and Belonging at Talkspace?

Diversity

Diversity encompasses the unique attributes of our employees as individuals. We value and embrace the richness arising from their varied backgrounds, perspectives, and experiences, which include, but are not limited to, age, ability, ethnicity, gender, race, and cultural background.

Equity

Equity refers to a fair and impartial workplace, aiming to ensure equal growth and advancement opportunities for all employees. This involves amplifying underrepresented voices, addressing unconscious biases, and providing inclusive, culturally competent mental health care.

Inclusion

Inclusion signifies the practice of granting equal access to opportunities and resources for all employees, particularly those who might otherwise be excluded or marginalized. It ensures that everyone feels a sense of belonging, value, support, and respect as an individual.

Belonging

jobs.title: Staff Ultrasound Engineer
jobs.description:
Primary Function of Position

The Endoluminal design group at Intuitive is a dynamic and multidisciplinary team developing technologies for the next generation of minimally invasive surgical robotics.

We are seeking a Staff Ultrasound Engineer with expertise in ultrasound technology to support development of the next generation of minimally invasive robotic flexible instruments.

This role sits at the intersection of acoustics, electronics, and system performance, and is critical to ensuring high image quality, product reliability, and successful product development. The engineer will be responsible for transducer design and platform integration efforts from concept through verification and scaled manufacturing, including management of external design partners. The successful candidate will have both a desire to be hands-on and the technical depth to resolve complex electro-mechanical, signal processing and manufacturing design issues.

This is a high-impact technical leadership role requiring the skills to lead an interdisciplinary team to develop ultrasound platforms from concept through commercialization, including development of a roadmap to reach the next leap in clinical imaging technology.

Essential Job Duties

Design and Development

• Own the ultrasound transducers and electrical interfacing design from concept to commercialization. Design and test ultrasound transducers including simulations, fabrication, and limit testing to enhance image performance

• Provide hands-on imaging support during laboratory, preclinical, and clinical activities

• Collaborate with hardware and software engineers on front-end electronics, data acquisition, and system integration. Work closely with product development partners to ensure cohesive system development.
• Drive continual improvement of image quality and reliability through troubleshooting, design and process ideation, product implementation, verification, and clinical validation.

• Partner with systems team to develop and optimize signal processing and system parameter tuning, including management of external design partners.
• Conduct or advise on finite element modeling (FEM) and acoustic simulations (e.g., COMSOL, ANSYS/PZFlex, OnScale) to optimize acoustic stacks, backing, and matching layers.

Subject matter expert:

• Provide transducer and acoustic technical expertise to cross functional groups including operations, regulatory, and clinical teams especially in technical explanation and root cause analysis. Build ultrasound imaging literacy across business unit.
• Collaborate with Research, Marketing and Product Management organizations to define new feature requirements to meet specific clinical applications and market needs. Develop and participate in medical ultrasound feasibility and research projects to support research and development
• Provide technical guidance on design decisions that impact ultrasound image quality performance across the full system

Technical Leadership:

• Set technical direction for external design partners, including transducer, beamforming, and system requirements; review implementations, independently evaluate delivered image quality, and drive partner work to program objectives.
• Define the technical architecture and multi-year imaging roadmap for the business unit.
• Inform product development strategies for ultrasound development programs. Manage the development and implementation of new ultrasound imaging capabilities, including identifying risks and contingency plans and defining integration strategy.

Medical Device Development

• Collaborate with clinical to translate customer imaging needs into product design solutions

• Establish objective image quality methodology — such as contrast, contrast-to-noise ratio, resolution, penetration, SNR, frame rate, and Doppler sensitivity — using phantoms, tissue models, and clinical data, and convert it into acceptance criteria
• Own imaging-related design control deliverables and support regulatory strategy, including requirements, risk and hazard analysis, verification, and alignment with applicable IEC 60601-2-37 and FDA guidance.

Required Skills and Experience

• 12+ years industry experience with a focus on ultrasound imaging, acoustics, or signal/image processing. Advanced degree in a related field may be substituted for a portion of the required experience.
• Expertise in ultrasound physics and beamforming fundamentals including a working knowledge of the full ultrasound signal chain, from transmit sequencing and beamforming through demodulation, detection, scan conversion, and display.
• Strong experience with transducer characterization (impedance, acoustic tank, pulse-echo, force balance, transmitting voltage response) and testing (hydrophone testing, phantom studies)
• Demonstrated ability to set technical direction for and manage the deliverables of external OEM and internal engineering teams.
• Ability to work with minimal day-to-day direction, structuring your own work across commercial support, feature development and future technology exploration, surfacing decisions and risks early.
• Knowledge of design for manufacturing, from feasibility through transfer to production
• Knowledge in Solidworks and Finite Element Analysis.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills
• Familiarity with acoustic standards (IEC 60601-2-62, IEC 60601-2-37, 21CFR1050.10, MIL-STD-1376)

Required Education and Training

Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Acoustics Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Physics, or a related technical discipline. Advanced degree preferred.

Preferred Skills and Experience

• Experience in medical device development, including design controls, V&V, and regulatory documentation
• Medical device product development experience under design controls (ISO 13485, 21 CFR 820), including driving features through verification and validation in support of regulatory submissions.
• Experience with therapeutic ultrasound systems (histotripsy, HIFU, or lithotripsy) and with imaging in the presence of acoustic cavitation.
• Development of Endoluminal imaging applications.
• Knowledge and practice of different bonding technologies a plus

Due to the nature of our business and the role, please note that Intuitive and/or your customer(s) may require that you show current proof of vaccination against certain diseases including COVID-19.  Details can vary by role.

The City of Fort Worth is seeking a Public Information Specialist to support the Transportation and Public Works (TPW) Department in the timely, accurate, and compliant processing of public information requests under the Texas Public Information Act. We're growing fast and adding to our People Operations team. We're looking for an HR Generalist in our Overland Park office to own our payroll, benefits and employer tax administration. You'll bring experience we can learn from and tell us when there's a better way to run things.

This is a generalist role centered on payroll and benefits. Most of your week goes to payroll, benefits and tax. You're also someone people can bring any HR question to, and are team player at your core




WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - US payroll, end to end. Run multi-state payroll in Rippling accurately and on time, including off-cycles, garnishments, payroll audits and year-end (W-2s, reconciliations).

 - Employer tax accounts. Register and maintain state withholding and unemployment accounts as we grow into new states. Handle filings, rate notices and agency correspondence.

 - US benefits administration. Manage our benefit plans: enrollments, life events, open enrollment, carrier and broker coordination, COBRA, and benefits compliance.

 - International payroll support. Help with payroll inputs and employee questions for team members employed through our Employer of Record (EOR) partner in Rippling.

 - Process and scale. Document, automate and improve how we do payroll, benefits and tax. Bring the playbook we don't have yet.

WHAT YOU BRING

 - 3–5+ years of hands-on US payroll and benefits administration, multi-state highly preferred.

 - Experience setting up and maintaining state payroll tax registrations (SIT/SUI) and handling agency notices.

 - Experience owning benefits administration and monthly invoice reconciliation.

 - A high bar for accuracy and confidentiality, and the judgment to know when something looks wrong.

 - Comfort working in a fast-moving startup where some processes don’t exist yet and building it is part of the job.


BONUS POINTS

 - Rippling payroll and benefits experience (strongly preferred)

 - You've helped a company move off a PEO

 - EOR or global payroll exposure

 - Broader generalist experience across employee relations, leave administration and HR compliance

 - You've worked in a high-growth tech company


EDUCATION & CERTIFICATIONS

 - Associate's or Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources or a related field (or equivalent experience).


WHY JOIN US?

 - Collaborate with a talented and innovative team focused on continuously improving security operations.

 - Competitive salary and benefits package.

 - A culture of growth and development, with opportunities to expand your knowledge in AI, cybersecurity, and emerging technologies.

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager, Sales Development
jobs.description:
ABOUT SOTHEBY'S

Established in 1744, Sotheby’s promotes access and ownership of exceptional art and luxury objects through auctions, private sales and retail. Our deep expertise across 70 selling categories is supported by a leading technology platform and a global network of specialists spanning 40 countries. Selling categories include Contemporary Art, Modern and Impressionist Art, Old Masters, Chinese Works of Art, Jewelry, Watches, Wine and Spirits and Design, as well as collectible cars and real estate through RM Sotheby’s and Concierge. Sotheby’s Financial Services is a leading art lender and provides capital solutions for collectors around the world, having originated more than $12 billion in loans since its inception. Sotheby’s new global headquarters is now open at the iconic Breuer building at 945 Madison Avenue in New York City.

The Role

The Business Operations Manager serves as the department's operational lead for sourcing and valuation activity, overseeing valuation strategy, interest and sales development workflow management, reporting, and business development initiatives. Acting as a key partner to specialists and leadership, the Manager leverages opportunities to support sourcing efforts, private sales development, and collection acquisition strategies across Impressionist & Modern Art, American Art, Latin American Art, and Single Owner Collections. The role combines operational leadership, market-facing business development support, and strategic project management to drive departmental growth and efficiency.

Responsibilities

I. Impressionist and Modern Art: Valuations, Collections & Sales

Valuation Oversight & Workflow Management

• Serve as the primary business operations lead for all departmental valuation activity across Impressionist & Modern Art, including Fair Market Value, Estate, Insurance, Retail Replacement, and Sale & Financial Services valuations.

• Manage the intake, prioritization, tracking, and reporting of valuation requests, ensuring timely completion and exceptional client service.

• Partner closely with specialists, Valuations Services, and department leadership to oversee valuation workflows and resolve complex operational issues.

• Lead weekly valuation meetings, establish priorities, and drive accountability for deliverables and follow-up actions.

• Develop reporting and analytics on valuation volumes, turnaround times, conversion rates, and business development opportunities.

• Identify valuation-led opportunities for consignments, private sales, and broader client engagement.

• Establish best practices and process improvements to increase efficiency, consistency, and service quality across valuation activity.

• Partner with specialists to prepare materials for pricing discussions, collection reviews, and strategic client presentations.

• Serve as a central point of coordination for significant estate, fiduciary, philanthropic, and collection-related valuation projects.

Business Development Through Valuations

• Leverage valuation activity as a key source of business generation and client acquisition opportunities.

• Track and report on consignments, private sales opportunities, and collection introductions originating from valuation engagements.

• Work with specialists and Client Development teams to cultivate relationships stemming from valuation activity.

• Support leadership with strategic reporting on valuation-driven revenue opportunities and market engagement.

II. Sourcing, Collections & Business Development

Sourcing Strategy & Pipeline Management

• Lead sourcing pipeline management across Impressionist & Modern Art, American Art, Latin American Art, Private Sales, and Single Owner Collection opportunities.

• Maintain visibility into business-getting efforts, key consignments, and collection opportunities across specialist teams.

• Produce pipeline analysis and reporting for department leadership, identifying trends, risks, and priorities.

• Facilitate sourcing meetings and ensure follow-through on strategic opportunities.

• Partner with Client Development and Business Intelligence teams to identify prospective collectors and collection opportunities.

Single Owner Collections

• Support the development and execution of Single Owner Collection strategies across multiple collecting categories.

• Coordinate collection timelines, stakeholder communication, and cross-department workflows from initial opportunity through sale execution.

• Assist in developing collection proposals, business cases, and presentation materials for prospective consignors.

• Partner with specialists to drive collection-related business development initiatives.

Private Sales

• Support sourcing and inventory development for Private Sales initiatives.

• Track high-priority opportunities and assist specialists in advancing private sale transactions.

• Identify opportunities for collaboration between auction and private sale channels to maximize client outcomes.

III. Sale Strategy & Execution

• Partner with Sale Heads and specialists to support auction planning and execution.

• Coordinate lot targeting initiatives and selling strategies in partnership with Client Development and Business Intelligence teams.

• Oversee internal sales reporting, pipeline updates, and business development materials.

• Support sale week operations, interest tracking, bidder analysis, and post-sale reporting.

• Produce executive-level analyses highlighting market performance, sourcing outcomes, and business opportunities.

IV. Business Operations & Strategic Initiatives

• Serve as a strategic operational partner to department leadership. Lead cross-functional projects and process improvement initiatives across Fine Arts departments.Develop departmental reporting and dashboards to support decision-making and performance management.

• Coordinate initiatives involving specialists, Client Development, Marketing, Finance, Operations, and regional teams.

• Manage department communications, leadership presentations, and business reviews.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in business operations, arts administration, or a related field.

• 2-3 years of experience in business operations, project management, client services, or business development, preferably within the art market, luxury, or cultural sectors.

• Strong interest in fine art and the auction market, with a desire to develop expertise across Impressionist & Modern Art and related collecting categories.

• Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

• Strong analytical, written, and verbal communication skills, with experience preparing presentations and business reporting.

• Collaborative and proactive, with the ability to build effective relationships across specialist, client development, and cross-functional teams.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel and PowerPoint; experience with CRM and business intelligence tools is a plus.

• Adept at handling sensitive and confidential information in a professional manner, maintaining discretion at all times.

• Flexible to support major sale periods, including occasional evening and weekend work.

The proposed base salary for this position ranges from $68,000 - $72,000. In addition to base salary successful candidates are eligible to receive a discretionary bonus, as well as a competitive benefits package. Salary offers are based on a wide range of factors including relevant skills, training, experience, education, and, where applicable, licensure or certifications obtained. Market and organizational factors are also considered.

jobs.title: Elementary Teacher
jobs.description:
Uncommon Elementary School Teachers cultivate a love for learning in every student from the very start. Our teachers and students engage in a culturally-responsive, fast-paced, and fun learning environment. We have built a community where teachers encourage our core values of respect and hard work while celebrating the uniqueness of each student and laying the academic foundations that carry students to and through college.

Responsibilities

1.     Instruction

• You’ll co-teach and build an engaging and joyful classroom environment that encourages mastery and empowers students to engage in academic discourse.
• You’ll teach the basic principles of mathematics.
• You’ll teach reading and writing to build students' literacy skills: phonemic awareness, phonics, fluency, vocabulary, and comprehension.
• You’ll teach an ELA curriculum that prioritizes meaningful texts and topics that are interesting and relevant.
• You'll teach a Science curriculum that prioritizes knowledge of geology, astronomy, ecology, and cycles in nature to ensure students understand climate change and how to take care of the Earth.
• You'll teach a Social Studies curriculum that incorporates analyses of America's diverse histories, with an emphasis on cultural and civic awareness.

2.     Data Analysis

• You'll meet weekly with your principal and/or instructional coach to analyze and respond to trends in student work samples and assessments.
• You'll learn and implement strategies to differentiate instruction for all learners in your classroom.

3.     School Culture

• You’ll build positive relationships with students to ensure they feel seen, loved, and heard.
• You’ll partner with students’ families to ensure appropriate resources are available to support their children’s learning needs.
• You'll engage in practice-based professional development, mentorship, and coaching sessions.
• You’ll support morning arrival, lunch duty, student assemblies, class transitions, and after-school dismissal.
• You'll participate in weekly, school-wide meetings to foster community, model our core values, and encourage student achievement.
• You'll partner with your grade level team to develop academic goals and practice instructional strategies.

• A demonstrated commitment to supporting students’ social emotional and academic development
• An enthusiasm for working with families in the best interest of students
• A self-directed learner who solicits and implements feedback to improve outcomes and achieve objectives
• Required Experience:A demonstrated interest in impacting K-12 students in urban schools and communities (1-2 years experience preferred).Academic expertise in Elementary Education, Humanities, English, Social Sciences, or other related fields of study.Prior to the start of employment, you must have a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university. Certification is not required to be hired at Uncommon, but you do need to meet NY state certification eligibility requirements. To meet these requirements, you must enroll in a teacher preparation program and maintain a GPA of 2.5 or higher during your employment with us if you do not have a degree in education. Uncommon Schools teachers are required to become certified in the state of New York within a reasonable period after beginning employment.

Our people are what make us Uncommon. We offer competitive compensation and comprehensive benefits that support the personal health, wellness, and finances of our staff and their families. Our compensation philosophy values equity & fairness and attracting & retaining top talent.

jobs.description:

We defend some of the world’s largest organizations and critical infrastructure in more than 68 countries and we’re just getting started. Our AI-powered cybersecurity platform secures operational technology (OT) and Internet of Things (IoT) infrastructures for enterprises and government entities across energy, manufacturing, transportation, resources, and critical infrastructure.

We are looking for a driven Business Development Representative (BDR) with Cybersecurity/IT Sales experience to join our global BDR team. In this role, you will spend your day prospecting and researching target accounts, identifying key decision-makers, and generating qualified pipeline through a high volume of outbound calls, personalized email, and social outreach. You'll need the energy and organization to manage a steady flow of active MQLs while driving your own proactive, cold outbound prospecting, consistently hitting monthly targets for qualified opportunities.

jobs.title: Systems Administrator - SME
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Who you are:

The Systems Administrator (SME) serves as the principal authority for enterprise systems architecture, infrastructure modernization, and zero-trust security implementation. This role leads the design, automation, optimization, and governance of highly available infrastructure environments across complex, cross-enclave systems. The SME provides strategic and technical leadership for Infrastructure as Code (IaC), configuration management, disaster recovery, and compliance automation while ensuring resilient, scalable, and secure operations.

What you need:

• Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, or related field.

• Minimum of 10 years of experience in systems administration and infrastructure management.

• Extensive experience supporting Windows, Linux, and hybrid-cloud environments.

• Expertise with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) and configuration management tools such as Terraform, Ansible, Puppet, or Chef.

• Experience with cloud platforms including AWS, Azure, or Google Cloud.

• Strong knowledge of system monitoring, disaster recovery, backup solutions, and performance optimization.

• Deep understanding of enterprise security controls, compliance requirements, and infrastructure governance.

• Proven ability to lead enterprise infrastructure initiatives and technical teams.

Nice to have:

• Master's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Cybersecurity, or related field.

• Experience supporting federal, defense, intelligence, or highly regulated environments.

• Expertise in zero-trust architecture and secure infrastructure design.

• Experience with containerized platforms such as Docker and Kubernetes.

• Relevant certifications such as AWS Solutions Architect, Azure Administrator/Architect, RHCE, VMware, CISSP, or similar.

• Experience with DevSecOps, CI/CD pipelines, and enterprise automation frameworks.

jobs.title: Medical Referral Coordinator
jobs.description:
As a Referral Management Clerk, you'll provide administrative support within a military healthcare environment, helping patients navigate specialty-care referrals. You'll review and process referrals, verify eligibility and covered benefits, schedule referred-care appointments, maintain documentation, and track referral activity while assisting patients, providers, and healthcare personnel.

Schedule: Monday–Friday, with an assigned eight-hour shift between 6:00 a.m. and 6:00 p.m., excluding federal holidays.

• Review referrals for administrative completeness and research covered benefits before processing.

• At least six months of experience in a medical office setting.
• The ability to type at least 50 words per minute

• At least six months of administrative support experience in a medical facility supporting multiple practitioners, including experience handling multiple telephone lines and working with medical terminology, medical-documentation requirements, standard patient-scheduling practices, and administrative correspondence and reports.

jobs.title: H&M Visual Keyholder - Colonie Center
jobs.description:

You will actively drive sales in the store and are responsible to implement the Visual Identity. The Visual Keyholder will always meet the expectations of customers and colleagues, as well as follow H&M procedures and standards.

This position reports to our Store Visual Manager (Based on volume).

Your Day to Day*

Sales and profit

The Visual Keyholder will set the garment presentation on the Sales Floor & Windows according to the Commercial Handbook. Together with the Department Manager, the Visual Keyholder will determine additional commercial opportunities in the store within the H&M brand guidelines. The role will execute floor moves based on those joint discussions.

Fashion Knowledge

• Share, inspire and educate the store team on seasonal trend information, upcoming campaigns, and brand standards

Direct Customer Service

• Ensure you meet customer expectations on direct service according to H&M standards.
• Support the store to achieve an excellent customer experience.

Indirect Customer Service

• Follow up on the H&M Visual Identity through the implementation of the Commercial Handbook and secure well-styled mannequins in windows and in-store.
• Create a clear red thread from windows to A-area with wearable buying suggestions.
• Ensure high-quality garment presentation every day together with the store team
• Maintain clear customer flow through fixture placement and navigation in line with H&M standards
• Launch and maintain all sales campaigns and activities on time and according to H&M standards.

• Together with the Department Manager, follow up on store KPIs and initiate actions to reach store goals and budgets
• Adapt the store planning according to store needs and budget from the Commercial plan
• Complete and take action on the Best Brand portion of the Customer Audit Tool to maximize commercial opportunities

• Complete the sample picking as well as execute the floor moves in a way that creates clear stories and wearable buying suggestions
• Complete all sales floor and window morning routines daily before the store is open
• Ensure quantity and maintain the condition of all incoming visual props and marketing material with a sustainability mindset.
• Keep visual room organized and safe.
• Keep all Visual materials in the store current and share information with the team on seasonal changes.
• Paint & maintain the windows as necessary.

TEAM

The Visual Keyholder will support the Store team to enhance the customer and working experience in-store through coaching and Development. Together with the Store Management team, the Visual Keyholder will ensure that all legal requirements and H&M policies are fulfilled.

Training and Development

• Evaluate & develop the visual and commercial skills of the store team through regular visual training for all colleagues to support garment presentation in line with the Commercial Handbook
• Maintain overview, follow up, and give feedback while executing floor moves together with the store team.
• Seek Visual Merchandiser potential for succession

• Ensure that all communication in the windows and sales floor complies with local legislation

• Perform all store routines, including the opening and closing of the store, by following all Company practices and procedures
• Work with timekeeping and scheduling system including approving timesheets
• May be assigned overall store responsibility in absence of Store Manager or Department manager when opening and closing store

Security

• Resolve health & safety, legal, and security issues

jobs.title: Senior Product Solutions Architect (Cloud Cost Management)
jobs.location: Boston, Massachusetts, USA; Denver, Colorado, USA; New York, New York, USA; San Francisco, California, USA
jobs.description:
The Product Solutions Architecture (PSA) team acts as a technical multiplier across Datadog. PSAs are domain experts who partner with Field teams on complex customer use cases across pre- and post-sales engagements and scale their impact by producing reusable collateral, including reference architectures, technical guides, and enablement assets. By feeding real-world customer insights back to Datadog Product teams, PSAs help influence product roadmaps while accelerating adoption, usage, and long-term customer success.

Datadog's Cloud Cost Management (CCM) suite helps Platform, Application Teams, Operations, FinOps, and Finance teams understand, allocate, and reduce cloud spend by putting cost data next to the observability data that explains it. As a Product Solutions Architect, you will partner closely with Datadog customers and the Cloud Cost Management product team to design product use cases, implement best practices, and drive adoption of CCM across customer environments. This includes infrastructure cost allocation, cloud costs, token usage, container costs, budgets, and optimization recommendations.

At Datadog, we place value in our office culture - the relationships and collaboration it builds, and the creativity it brings to the table. We operate as a hybrid workplace to ensure our Datadogs can create a work-life harmony that best fits them.

What You'll Do

• Serve as the in-house subject matter expert for Datadog's Cloud Cost Management products, including cost visibility across AWS, Azure, and GCP, Kubernetes and container cost allocation, custom and SaaS cost ingestion, budgets, anomaly detection, and cost optimization recommendations

• Provide architectural guidance on capacity planning, comparing cloud service cost models, and balancing performance vs. cost trade-offs across different cloud environments

• Guide customers on tokenomics and AI cost attribution across providers (Anthropic, OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, Google Gemini, Vertex AI, and GitHub Copilot), helping teams map API keys, models, and usage to teams and business units using Tag Pipelines.

• Help enterprise clients track real-time AI spend changes, set up cost anomaly monitoring, and connect token usage back to business outcomes and unit economics (such as cost per user or cost per ticket).

• Partner with Field teams to provide hands-on technical and architectural guidance to enterprise customers adopting CCM, including designing tagging and cost allocation strategies, showback and chargeback models, and cost reporting that connects spend to services, teams, and business units

• Create high-impact technical collateral, including reference architectures, technical guides, blog articles, and documentation to enable Field teams and the broader customer community, covering topics like cloud billing data onboarding (AWS, Azure, GCP billing), Kubernetes cost attribution, token usage, unit economics, and rightsizing and commitment optimization

• Act as a trusted advisor to Product Management by delivering actionable feedback informed by real-world field experience, helping shape the roadmap for cost allocation, multi-cloud cost visibility, token usage, optimization workflows, and FinOps integrations

Who You Are

• You bring a strong engineering foundation, with hands-on experience managing, allocating, or optimizing cloud spend, or building FinOps programs and internal cost tooling in production environments at a large scale, and are comfortable diving deep into billing data and architectural tradeoffs to understand what drives cost

• You are familiar with cloud infrastructure and core observability concepts, such as tracing, metrics, and logging, and understand how compute, storage, networking, and container platforms (including Kubernetes) translate into cloud bills

• Deep understanding of cost models, performance characteristics, and capacity planning across various cloud services and managed platforms

• Experience with languages such as Python and/or SQL, and familiarity with querying and modeling large billing datasets, tagging strategies, and infrastructure-as-code

• Comfortable operating in rapidly evolving, ambiguous technical domains

• You build deep context across teams and translate it into reusable, scalable solutions

• You take ownership from problem definition through implementation and measurable outcomes

• Highly detail-oriented, particularly when working on architectures and customer-facing technical assets

• You bring strong listening and consultative skills and are experienced supporting customers across engineering, FinOps, and finance stakeholders, including in high-stakes situations such as cost spikes, budget overruns, and commitment planning

• Demonstrates capability of utilizing AI tooling and scaling it

• Able to sit up to 4 hours, traveling to and from client sites

• Able to travel via auto, train, or air up to 40% of the time

Bonus Points

• Successful track record with 5+ years experience working as a Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or FinOps practitioner supporting cloud cost management, FinOps, or cloud financial optimization tools (e.g., Cloudability, CloudHealth, Vantage, Kubecost, native AWS Cost Explorer, Azure Cost Management, or GCP Billing)

• Experience using Datadog and/or other observability tools in an SRE, DevOps, or platform engineering capacity, particularly owning cloud cost accountability or building internal cost reporting and automation

• Familiarity with FinOps Foundation practices, and with commitment management such as Savings Plans, Reserved Instances, and committed use discounts

• FinOps certification (e.g., FinOps Certified Practitioner) is a plus

Datadog values people from all walks of life. We understand not everyone will meet all the above qualifications on day one. That's okay. If you're passionate about technology and want to grow your skills, we encourage you to apply.

Benefits and Growth

• Best-in-breed onboarding

• Generous global benefits

• Intra-departmental mentor and buddy program for in-house networking

• New hire stock equity (RSUs) and employee stock purchase plan (ESPP)

• Continuous professional development, product training, and career pathing

• An inclusive company culture, able to join our Community Guilds and Inclusion Talks

Datadog offers a competitive salary and equity package, and may include variable compensation. Actual compensation is based on factors such as the candidate's skills, qualifications, and experience. In addition, Datadog offers a wide range of best in class, comprehensive and inclusive employee benefits for this role including healthcare, dental, parental planning, and mental health benefits, a 401(k) plan and match, paid time off, fitness reimbursements, and a discounted employee stock purchase plan.

The reasonably estimated yearly salary for this role at Datadog is:

$185,000—$246,000 USD

About Datadog:

Datadog is the leading observability and security platform for the AI era, providing businesses with unified visibility across the technology stack to manage complexity at scale. It brings applications, infrastructure, data, models, and security into one place, using AI to detect and resolve issues before they impact customers. Trusted globally by Fortune 500 companies and high-growth AI leaders, Datadog enables businesses to move faster with clarity and confidence. Learn more about #DatadogLife on Instagram, LinkedIn, and Datadog Learning Center.
