jobs.title: Principal Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
Clarity Innovations is a trusted national security partner, dedicated to safeguarding our nation’s interests and delivering innovative solutions that empower the Intelligence Community (IC) and Department of Defense (DoD) to transform data into actionable intelligence, ensuring mission success in an evolving world.

Our mission-first software and data engineering platform modernizes data operations, utilizing advanced workflows, CI/CD, and secure DevSecOps practices. We focus on challenges in Information Warfare, Cyber Operations, Operational Security, and Data Structuring, enabling end-to-end solutions that drive operational impact.

We are committed to delivering cutting-edge tools and capabilities that address the most complex national security challenges, empowering our partners to stay ahead of emerging threats and ensuring the success of their critical missions. At Clarity, we are people-focused and set on being a destination employer for top talent, offering an environment where innovation thrives, careers grow, and individuals are valued. Join us as we continue to lead innovation and tackle the most pressing challenges in national security.

Position Summary

We are seeking an experienced and creative Technical Program Manager - Remote (on-site travel as needed) - to join our dynamic program team. As a Technical Program Manager at Clarity Innovations, you will play a pivotal role in the development and success of the team products and projects. You will act as the bridge between our stakeholders, SOCOM development and program teams, and end users; to ensure the delivery of high-quality products and projects that meet both business and customer needs. This role requires a strategic mindset, unrelenting communication skills, and a passion for driving program excellence.

The Technical Program manager will work as an integral part of the team toward the following established overall goal: Building, expanding, and sustaining a resilient distributed command and control architecture leveraged across the cloud platform, gateway routing, cross-domain mechanisms, and USSOCOM programs of record.

Key Responsibilities:

Own the Program Vision: Clearly define and articulate the long-term vision and goals/deliverables for the program, aligning them with the overall mission support strategy and follow-on field support plan. Tell a compelling story for audiences of all levels including senior executives and commanders. Establish the program’s vision, strategy, outcome-driven integrated roadmap, and product/project/program backlog; including (1) sensor integration efforts, (2) resilient gateway routing solutions, (3) tactical data management, and (4) DevSecOps/cybersecurity/cloud support.

Facilitate and Communicate: Drive the narrative in both verbal and written communication. Facilitate meetings with team members and stakeholders, communicating effectively at the senior, most executive levels, using methods your audience will participate in. Communicate the program vision, strategy, integrated roadmap, and backlog to different audiences with a tailored message they will understand to ensure deliverables meet performance measures, on time, and within scope.

Decision Making and Problem Solving: Make timely and informed decisions on program supported features, scope, and priorities based on input from stakeholders, expert analysis, and feedback. Identify pain points and opportunities for the team and be proactive in actioning towards resolutions.

Work Prioritization: Lead and influence a balanced cross-functional team in daily activities to execute against a vision. Maintain and prioritize the program backlog, ensuring that it reflects the highest mission value and is aligned with the program vision.

User Story Creation: Document and package detailed operational requirements and experiences. Write clear and detailed user stories with acceptance criteria to communicate product/project requirements to the development team. Champion user-centered design philosophy within the internal product/project team and externally with customers. Collect requirements and manage the requirements traceability matrix for each project within the program.

Strategic Stakeholder Communication: Act as a bridge between stakeholders and the development team, ensuring that stakeholders' needs and expectations are understood and incorporated into the program backlog. Communicate sophisticated ideas, anticipating potential objections, and persuading others, often at senior levels, to adopt a different point of view.

Other Important Areas of Responsibility include:

Release/Deployment Planning ● Acceptance Testing ● Feedback Handling ● Risk Management ● Team Resource Management ● Lean Project Management ● Team Collaboration ● Quality Management

Minimum Experience Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in a relevant field (Business, Computer Science, Engineering, etc.)

• At least 10 years of relevant work experience in Program/Product Management.

• Strong understanding of Agile development methodologies.

• Strong understanding of Lean Project Management principles.

• Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

• Experience with leading projects/programs from idea to market/IOC to FOC

• Experience with user-centered design, concept and usability testing, and other research methods

• Experience in stakeholder management, communication, and presentation

• Experience working in a balanced team to build, measure, and learn

• Experience working in a rapid and iterative development environment

• Experience balancing customer and user feedback to create a desirable solutions

• U.S. Citizenship: Must be eligible to hold a Common Access Card (CAC), and Secret security clearance is required

Preferred:

• Knowledge of US Air Force emerging technologies

• Experience providing input on program decisions through user research, customer development, and iterative feedback loops

• Experience in the design and/or development of full-service applications

Salary Range: $108,000 - $267,000

Pay Range

The posted pay range reflects the anticipated base salary range for this position and is provided to give candidates a general understanding of the compensation opportunity. The actual salary offered will be determined based on the requirements of the position and a variety of job-related factors, which may include geographic location, applicable Federal Government contract labor categories and wage rates, relevant experience, skills and competencies, education, certifications, and the scope and responsibilities of the role.

Because this position may be performed in multiple locations and may be subject to different contract requirements, the salary ultimately offered may vary based on the applicable location and contract. The posted range is not a guarantee of a specific starting salary or an indication that an offer will be made at any particular point within the range.

Total Rewards

In addition to competitive base pay, Clarity provides a Total Rewards package designed to attract and retain exceptional professionals committed to excellence. Our benefits reflect the value we place on skilled individuals who drive our impact in critical digital missions.

At Clarity, a career means joining a high-performing team advancing vital work in the digital landscape. We encourage you to consider the total value of joining us—competitive compensation, comprehensive benefits, and resources that support your growth and impact.

Our Total Rewards package includes performance-based bonuses, extensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with company match, substantial paid time off and holidays, flexible work arrangements where possible, and a range of income protection benefits. We are committed to supporting your well-being, professional growth, and ability to contribute to essential digital missions.

We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or veteran status.

Braintrust is the agent observability platform. By actively applying intelligence to agent traces and automatically surfacing the most critical patterns, Braintrust gives teams the visibility to understand how agents behave in production and the tools to improve them.

Teams at Notion, Stripe, Box, OpenAI, and Cloudflare use Braintrust to trace their agents, find the issues in their observability data, and run evals that tell them how to improve.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We’re hiring engineers to build the open-source libraries that customers use to observe, understand, and optimize how AI operates inside their production applications. These SDKs are a critical part of Braintrust’s platform. They power evaluation and observability pipelines across a wide range of environments, frameworks, and AI providers.

This role is ideal for engineers who are passionate about developer experience, API craftsmanship, and building fast, reliable, and idiomatic libraries. Your work will be embedded in thousands of applications and help define how AI is adopted and operationalized across industries.

jobs.title: Customer Support Specialist II
jobs.location: Los Angeles, California, United States, Seattle, Vancouver, Nevada
jobs.description:
About Upshop:

Upshop is hiring a Customer Support Specialist II (CSS II) to own our most complex customer issues, including the ones for which we don’t have a playbook yet. As the primary escalation point from Level 1 support, you will dig into production problems across Upshop's fresh retail platform and its integrations and find what went wrong: configuration, data, integrations, in-store environment, or application bugs. You will fix what support can fix, and when you cannot, you will hand engineering a clear write-up with the evidence, so they are not starting from zero.

The work crosses systems. You will check tenant and license settings, query Cosmos/Mongo and SQL Server, review feature flags, follow logs and traces in Datadog. You will not ship features full time, but you should be able to follow code, data, and logs far enough to prove the cause. You will use AI tools every day, customer data, and you will help mentor the CSS I team. The goal is fewer bounce-backs, faster answers on tough issues, and engineering partners who trust what you send them.

This role is for someone who enjoys complex tickets, follows the evidence, and leaves the team better than they found it.

Key Responsibilities:

• Escalation Ownership: Act as the primary escalation point for Level 1 support and own complex escalated tickets that need deep investigation across Upshop's product suite and integrations.

• Deep-Dive Investigation: Trace issues through tenant and license configuration, data, integrations, feature flags, logs and traces, and product code when needed. Replicate user environments and prove the root cause rather than treating symptoms.

• Resolution & Engineering Handoff: Resolve what support can resolve. When an issue needs engineering, send a clear package with reproduction steps, evidence, impact, and what has been ruled out, so defects move quickly without bounce-backs.

• In-Store & Environment Support: Troubleshoot issues involving network connectivity, hybrid on-prem and cloud setups, host feeds, and in-store hardware (e.g., label printers, scales, scanners, and handheld devices).

• Ticket Management & SLAs: Document every ticket with what is known, what has been ruled out, troubleshooting steps, resolutions, and any system changes made. Track tickets from creation through resolution and meet SLA targets.

• Customer Communication: Write clear customer updates, manage expectations on complex or long-running issues, and deliver difficult information with empathy and professionalism.

• Cross-functional Partnership: Partner with product and engineering on recurring issues and release-related problems, provide feedback, and suggest enhancements.

• On-Call & Incident Support: Participate in the on-call rotation and incident response, resolving issues promptly, including outside business hours.

• Knowledge Base & Playbooks: Create and maintain documentation, playbooks, and routing knowledge for both common and complex issues so the whole team can resolve them faster.

• AI-Assisted Workflows: Use AI tools such as Cursor, Claude, Copilot, and in-house Agents every day to speed up investigation and cut busy work. Build and share prompts, skills, or small automations, and handle customer data responsibly when using them.

• Mentoring: Guide CSS I team members, sharing troubleshooting techniques and best practices for customer interactions.

• Performance Metrics & Continuous Improvement: Meet or exceed targets for response time, resolution time, and customer satisfaction, and keep improving how the team works.

Required Qualifications:

• Proven Experience: 4+ years of technical support, application support, or a similar role, including supporting multi-tenant SaaS and troubleshooting complex software and system issues.

• Troubleshooting Discipline: Strong root cause analysis habits: follow the evidence, write down what you know and what has been ruled out, and decide the next steps carefully and independently.

• Technical Fluency: Comfortable reading APIs, JSON, SQL results, and application logs.

• Data & Platform Experience: Hands-on experience with at least two of: MongoDB/Cosmos-style databases, relational SQL (e.g., SQL Server), cloud observability (e.g., Datadog), feature flags, and Azure (or an equivalent cloud).

• AI Tools: Hands-on experience with AI platforms such as Cursor, Claude, CoPilot, or similar.

• Strong Communication: Clear written and verbal communication for both customers and engineers, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Escalation Handling & Mentoring: Demonstrated ability to handle escalated issues and provide technical guidance to junior team members.

• Queue Management & Organization: Ability to manage multiple support requests and competing priorities efficiently while maintaining attention to detail and a high standard of customer service.

Desired Skills:

• Senior Support Experience: Prior escalation-tier or senior support experience.

• Industry Background: Experience with retail, grocery, food service, or store operations software.

• Automation Experience: Experience building prompts, skills, scripts, or small automations that help support work.

• Support & Defect Tools: Familiarity with Zendesk (or similar), Jira or Azure DevOps for defect handoffs, and API tools such as Postman.

• Incident Management: Incident work with tools like PagerDuty.

• Hybrid & Integration Environments: Exposure to hybrid on-prem and cloud systems, host feeds, multi-tenant configuration models, and in-store hardware peripherals.

• Certifications: CompTIA A+, ITIL, Zendesk, or related technical certifications are a plus.

• Leadership Potential: Interest in leading technical projects or taking on leadership responsibilities within the support team.

jobs.title: Compliance Senior Manager - Malta
jobs.description:
About us:

BVNK is the stablecoin-powered financial stack for enterprises. We're now part of Mastercard, and together we're building a network for every form of money – one that delivers more reach, more capability and more choice.

We enable businesses to build financial products, unlock new markets, and move money in seconds across 130+ countries, with 40+ licenses for fiat and digital assets globally. Processing billions annually, we empower enterprises worldwide to send, receive, convert, and settle stablecoins and fiat seamlessly through a single integration.

Our mission is to accelerate global money movement, and we're assembling a world-class team to make it happen.

Trusted by industry leaders like Corpay, Worldpay, Deel, and Flywire, we deliver the infrastructure that makes new forms of money usable within the financial systems customers already rely on today.

By combining Mastercard's global payment reach and trusted networks with BVNK's stablecoin infrastructure, we're building the trusted operating layer for the evolution of money movement, helping customers participate in emerging digital networks without having to rebuild their businesses around every new innovation.

We're a diverse team spread across EMEA, North America, and APAC, with a shared belief that stablecoins are the new infrastructure layer for financial services, and that BVNK is at the forefront of this shift.

We're incredibly honored to have been recognized by:

• CNBC World's Top Fintech Companies (2026)

• FXC Intelligence Top 100 Cross-border Payment Companies (2026)

• Newsweek's The Top 100 Global Most Loved Workplaces (three years running, most recently 2025)

• LinkedIn as one of the Top 20 Startups in the UK (2025)

About this role in the team:

We are seeking a Malta Compliance Manager to oversee regulatory compliance for our Malta Electronic Money Institution and CASP.

This role sits within our 2nd Line of Defence, executing and maintaining the compliance monitoring program, firm-wide policies, and regulatory oversight across both our Electronic Money Institution (EMI) and Crypto-Asset Service Provider (CASP) operations. You will play a pivotal role in ensuring adherence with MFSA regulations, MiCA standards, and payment services rules - overseeing client asset safeguarding and conduct of business requirements.

Your primary focus will be Malta, but, as part of a global team, you will get the opportunity to support other regions and company-wide initiatives.

Key Areas of Responsibility:

• Draft and coordinate responses, regulatory notifications, thematic review submissions and gap analyses for submission to the Regulators (MFSA and CBM).

• Conduct ongoing regulatory horizon scanning across EMI and MiCA/CASP frameworks, keeping product, operations, and key stakeholders informed while ensuring timely operational compliance.

• Maintain the master regulatory compliance calendar to track and monitor all mandatory filings, statutory deadlines, and regulatory queries.

• Assist in drafting compliance reports and presentation decks for the Board of Directors, Internal Controls Committee (ICC), and the MFSA.

• Assist policy owners across the business in drafting, updating, and reviewing firm-wide compliance policies and procedures in alignment with new regulations, while overseeing policy review schedules.

• Oversee the execution of the Annual Compliance Monitoring/Testing Plan and track remediation plans.

• Log, investigate, and assess regulatory breaches, evaluating notification thresholds under regulatory frameworks such as DORA.

• Perform compliance impact assessments on new product offerings, features, and operational changes.

• Conduct token risk assessments and maintain compliance reviews for crypto assets in alignment with MiCA expectations.

• Manage and maintain the firm's Insider Register and process Personal Account Trading (PAT) requests to prevent market abuse.

• Serve as the designated compliance approver for all marketing collateral, financial promotions, and promotional communications across fiat and crypto channels for regulatory compliance.

• Oversee the 2LoD review of consumer complaints handling processes, assist with complex escalations, and perform root-cause analysis.

• Assist in monitoring capital adequacy requirements and the subsequent regulatory notifications and submissions

• Collaborate with IT and Operations to ensure compliance with operational resilience frameworks, business continuity plans (BCP), and third-party outsourcing requirements.

• Develop, deliver, and update compliance training materials for general staff and new joiners, while maintaining accurate logs of training completed by the Board and Key Function Holders.

• Act as a primary regulatory compliance Subject Matter Expert (SME) for internal teams on day-to-day regulatory compliance inquiries.

What we need from you:

• Experience: Relevant experience in a similar compliance role within financial services (preferably in a fintech or crypto firm)

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Law, Finance, Business or a related discipline

• Knowledge: Working knowledge of the MFSA Financial and CASP Rules and Handbooks, EMD, PSD2 (and awareness of PSD3/PSR transitional provisions), and demonstrated capacity to rapidly master new regulatory frameworks.

What you can expect from us:

• Fair and competitive salary at every stage of your growth

• Flexible working hours, with hybrid working at its heart

• A culture built on passionate, growth-minded people

• A flexible approach to holiday

• Opportunities to travel to our offices around the world

• An open and creative environment where you can help us define the future of BVNK, its culture, and its opportunity sets

At BVNK, we are focused on building a diverse and inclusive team. While you may not meet all of our requirements, we’d encourage you to apply if you meet the majority of our expectations. You may be a great fit for this role or another role in our team.

Compensation packages are based on candidate experience and relevant certifications.

Malta Salary Range

€60.000—€100.000 EUR

jobs.title: DBAs
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

You Are: DBAs

The Work:

The Oracle 19c Database Administrator leads the extraction and migration of the legacy system database, producing a clean, integrity-validated NIPR snapshot for load into Palantir and reverse-engineering the highly normalized, time-variant schema that drives the migration. Working from the existing Dataguard replication topology, the DBA supports source-to-target data mapping, incremental sync design, and analysis of legacy Oracle ETL/PL-SQL objects to determine what carries forward into the Vantage pipeline. The role emphasizes migration and transition engineering – data profiling, reconciliation, and system data-quality validation – rather than steady-state database maintenance.

Key Responsibilities:

Migration & extraction

• Snapshot and extract the legacy Oracle 19c database (NIPR) for load into G-1 Palantir – consistent point-in-time capture, integrity validation, and staging (Task 1)

• Design and support source-to-target data mapping of key processes and data objects; application-dependency mapping across source systems to sequence the migration safely

• Analyze legacy Oracle ETL/PL-SQL jobs and objects to determine what must be refactored vs. retired in the move to the Palantir pipeline

• Data profiling, cleansing, and reconciliation to enforce system data-quality/validation rules on migrated data (source-to-target row/field integrity)

Transition engineering

• Work the existing replication/sync topology to establish repeatable extract/sync without disrupting the legacy system during the PoC

• Support incremental sync design from the Oracle source into Palantir

• Partition, bulk-load, and performance-tune specifically for one-time and incremental migration throughput

Foundational Oracle 19c depth (enabler, not the focus)

• Oracle 19c internals sufficient to migrate confidently – RMAN, Data Pump, ASM, PL/SQL, partitioning; enough Data Guard familiarity to work the replication seam

Environment/compliance

• DoD/Army migration context: STIG-hardened Oracle baselines, RMF, NIPR constraints, and handling of controlled data during transition

Bonus if you have:

• Oracle Certified Professional (OCP) 19c

• Security+ (DoD 8570/8140 baseline for privileged access)

Eligibility Requirements:

• Must have Secret clearance

• Must be a U.S. Citizen

jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

You Are: Oracle Cloud Conversion Sr Developer

The Work:

You will be responsible for designing, building, and executing the technical solutions required to convert legacy data into Oracle Cloud. This includes developing complex SQL scripts for data transformation, creating reusable conversion templates, and leading data validation efforts. You will collaborate closely with functional consultants to understand data requirements and with client stakeholders to ensure data integrity. Your role is critical to ensuring a successful transition to the new platform during all phases of the implementation, from mock cycles to final cutover.

Key Responsibilities:

• Conversion Design and Strategy: Lead the technical design of data conversion strategies and create detailed source-to-target mapping documents for complex data objects
• Development and Transformation: Develop, test, and optimize complex SQL queries, PL/SQL packages, and other ETL processes to transform and cleanse legacy data into Oracle Cloud-compatible formats (FBDI/HDL)
• Process Ownership: Own and manage the execution of data load cycles, including Mocks, Dress Rehearsals, and production Cutover, ensuring all technical dependencies are met
• Complex Issue Resolution: Troubleshoot and resolve complex technical issues, data errors, and performance bottlenecks during the conversion process, serving as the final point of escalation for the technical team
• Validation and Governance: Design and implement robust data validation and reconciliation processes. Develop scripts and reports to ensure data accuracy and completeness post-load
• Mentorship and Guidance: Mentor and provide technical guidance to junior data conversion developers, conduct code reviews, and establish best practices for the team
• Collaboration: Partner with functional leads, business analysts, and client SMEs to interpret data requirements, define transformation logic, and support data cleansing initiatives

Here’s What You Need:

• Minimum 3-5 years of hands-on experience in data conversion/migration for Oracle Fusion Cloud (ERP, SCM, or HCM)
• Expert-level proficiency in SQL and PL/SQL for complex data extraction, transformation, and validation
• Proven experience leading technical data conversion activities through multiple project lifecycles
• In-depth, hands-on experience with Oracle Cloud data loading tools, including FBDI and HDL
• Strong understanding of ETL principles and the entire data migration lifecycle, from analysis to post-go-live support

Bonus Points If:

• Experience with Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) or other enterprise ETL tools (e.g., Informatica)
• Background in federal, regulated, or public sector environments
• Skills in performance tuning of SQL and data loading processes
• Experience in a client-facing or consulting role, with strong communication and leadership skills

We use an online assessment tool called Maki for skills-based selection of applicants for sales advisor positions within some of our stores. Maki is not an automated decision-making tool. Choosing an alternative method will not affect your chances of being considered for the position, nor does any assessment method provide an advantage or disadvantage in the selection process. You will have the opportunity to provide optional feedback immediately after the assessment and you may always ask questions.

When you take the assessment, we collect your responses and use this information to evaluate your suitability for the role to which you have applied. The answers are saved in your applicant profile. We do not sell the information captured in the questionnaire and do not use any personal information to train any AI models. Our applicant tracking system provider has access to this information but is contractually prohibited from using it for any other purpose.

During this process, we may collect information from you through cookies, with your consent. This may include details such as your electronic network activity information (IP address, timestamps, and device identifiers). This information is accessible to our hiring team but is otherwise kept confidential. For more information, please refer to our Cookie Notice.

We retain this information for 3 years in your applicant file and use it as set forth in our Applicant Privacy Notice. For more information on how your personal data is processed by us, please refer to our Applicant Privacy Notice.

jobs.description:
Coordinate field operations and keep maintenance running like clockwork – so our radars stay mission-ready worldwide.

As our Service Specialist & Planner, you orchestrate the end-to-end planning, scheduling, and execution of global service operations. You align site requirements, engineering resources, and logistics to ensure seamless maintenance windows with minimal downtime. You report to the Team Lead Service Operations, serving as a vital link between customer operators, field engineers, and internal supply chain teams.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Logistics and parts coordination: Partner with Supply Chain to ensure spare parts, RMA items, and test gear arrive on schedule. Keep inventory stages aligned with planned maintenance windows worldwide.

 - Hands-on experience with service management platforms and ERP or ticketing systems

 - Practical understanding of SLAs, service scope, and commercial contract structures

 - Fluent English, both spoken and written

 - Detail-oriented planner with strong multi-tasking skills under changing priorities

N.B. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. Our mission is a journey, and there's plenty to learn along the way. If most of this fits, we'd love to hear from you.

A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and a background check are part of our screening process. We appreciate your understanding.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Comprehensive pension plan;

 - Commuting allowance;

 - 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

 - Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

Robin Radar is a technology leader in tracking and classifying small objects. Our radars and software help prevent bird strikes in aviation, reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife, and protect critical infrastructure from drone threats. Our work shows up at airports, wind farms, military sites and nature reserves around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

jobs.title: Reliability Technician
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Predictive Maintenance (PdM) Technician is responsible for executing Perry's condition-based maintenance program to improve equipment reliability, reduce unplanned downtime, extend asset life, and lower maintenance costs. This position performs vibration analysis, thermography, ultrasound inspections, motor testing, and condition monitoring activities across the facility's manufacturing, packaging, utilities, refrigeration, and support systems.

The PdM Technician partners closely with the Reliability Engineer, Maintenance Supervisors, Asset Reliability Planner, Controls Engineering team, and Operations leadership to identify equipment failures before they occur and drive proactive maintenance actions.

The position plays a critical role in supporting Perry's reliability strategy, TPM deployment, and 2027 operational growth objectives.

Key Responsibilities

Predictive Maintenance Program Execution

• Conduct scheduled vibration analysis routes on critical rotating equipment.
• Perform infrared thermography inspections of electrical and mechanical assets.
• Execute airborne and structure-borne ultrasound inspections.
• Collect oil and lubricant samples for analysis.
• Conduct motor circuit testing and electrical condition assessments.
• Monitor equipment condition using predictive maintenance technologies.
• Maintain condition monitoring databases and historical equipment records.

Equipment Reliability

• Identify developing equipment failures before breakdown occurs.
• Generate work requests based on PdM findings.
• Recommend corrective actions to maintenance and reliability teams.
• Assist with asset criticality reviews.
• Support bad actor equipment analysis.
• Participate in root cause failure investigations.
• Assist in reducing repetitive equipment failures.

Reporting & Data Analysis

• Review vibration, thermal, oil analysis, and ultrasound results.
• Document findings and communicate risks to the Reliability Engineer.
• Develop equipment condition reports and maintenance recommendations.
• Maintain accurate PdM inspection records.
• Track equipment health indicators and reliability trends.

Maintenance Planning Support

• Provide condition-based maintenance recommendations.
• Assist Asset Reliability Planner with work prioritization.
• Help define repair scopes based on inspection findings.
• Identify equipment requiring immediate intervention.
• Support planned shutdown activities.

TPM and Continuous Improvement

• Support TPM implementation initiatives.
• Participate in focused improvement teams.
• Assist in developing operator asset-care programs.
• Support reliability-driven cost reduction projects.
• Recommend improvements to maintenance effectiveness and asset performance.

Food Safety and Regulatory Compliance

• Follow all food safety, GMP, HACCP, and sanitation requirements.
• Adhere to Lockout/Tagout procedures.
• Comply with all safety, environmental, and facility regulations.
• Maintain equipment access procedures that protect product integrity.

Primary Assets Supported

Packaging

• Multivac systems
• Thermoformers
• Packaging conveyors
• Labelers
• Checkweighers
• Metal detectors
• Vacuum systems

Processing

• Mixers
• Grinders
• Pumps
• Stuffers
• Conveying systems

Utilities

• Air compressors
• Boilers
• Water systems
• Refrigeration systems
• HVAC systems

Facility Equipment

• Motors
• Gearboxes
• Bearings
• Fans
• Electrical distribution equipment

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

The PdM Technician will be measured on:

Reliability

• Reduction in unplanned downtime
• Increase in Mean Time Between Failure (MTBF)
• Reduction in emergency work orders

Predictive Maintenance

• PdM route completion rate (>95%)
• PdM findings converted to planned work
• Defect identification rate
• Condition-monitoring compliance

Maintenance Performance

• Reduction in reactive maintenance
• Reduction in maintenance overtime
• Increased planned maintenance percentage
• Reduction in repeat failures

Financial

• Downtime cost avoidance
• Maintenance cost avoidance
• Reduced contractor spending
• Reduced emergency repair costs

Education

One of the following:

• Associate degree in Industrial Maintenance Technology, Engineering Technology, or related field; OR
• Technical certification in Predictive Maintenance Technology; OR
• Equivalent industrial experience

Experience

• Minimum 3 years of industrial maintenance experience.
• Minimum 2 years of condition monitoring experience preferred.
• Manufacturing experience required.
• Food manufacturing experience preferred.

Preferred Certifications

Preferred certifications include:

• Vibration Analysis Category I or II
• Infrared Thermography Certification
• Ultrasound Inspection Certification
• Machinery Lubrication Technician (MLT)
• Certified Maintenance & Reliability Technician (CMRT)

Technical Skills

Required

• Vibration analysis
• Root cause problem solving
• Mechanical troubleshooting
• Industrial maintenance practices
• CMMS systems
• Microsoft Excel

Preferred

• SKF vibration systems
• Emerson AMS
• Fluke reliability tools
• Infrared cameras
• Motor circuit analysis equipment
• SAP PM
• Maintenance Connection
• Fiix CMMS

Physical Requirements

• Ability to work in manufacturing environments.
• Ability to climb stairs and ladders.
• Ability to work in refrigerated areas.
• Ability to lift up to 50 pounds.
• Ability to stand and walk for extended periods.
• Ability to wear required PPE.

Success Measures - First 12 Months

The successful PdM Technician will:

Within 90 Days

• Establish PdM routes for critical assets.
• Complete baseline equipment health assessments.
• Develop asset condition reports.

Within 6 Months

• Achieve >95% route completion.
• Identify top reliability risks within Perry.
• Support reduction of maintenance emergency work.

Within 12 Months

• Reduce unplanned downtime on critical packaging assets.
• Contribute to lowering maintenance overtime from 12.9% toward <8%.
• Improve equipment reliability across packaging, utilities, and refrigeration systems.
• Support Perry's reliability strategy supporting 21MM+ pounds of annual production.

Why This Position Exists at Perry

The PdM Technician is a key component of Perry's Reliability Organization and serves as the primary execution resource for the facility's predictive maintenance program. The role exists to transition Perry from a reactive maintenance environment toward a predictive, reliability-centered maintenance culture capable of supporting future growth, reducing maintenance costs, increasing equipment uptime, and improving overall plant performance.

The pay range for this role is $35 -$38 (Hourly). Actual wage will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Link Snacks Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS:

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to be successfully perform the essential functions of this job.  Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, use hands to finger, handle, or feel, lift and/or move up to 25 pounds, and talk or hear.  The employee is occasionally required to sit, and reach with hands and arms.  The employee must occasionally lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.  Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT:

The work environment characteristics described here are representative of those an employee encounters while performing the essential functions of this job. The work environment is a plant / office setting with varying degrees of temperatures and noise levels. Exposure to manufacturing equipment movement and wet / slippery floors. Travel may be required.

Equal Employment Opportunity Employer

Link Snacks is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation and gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

E-VERIFY:

Link Snacks is participant in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees.  For information about the E-Verify program, please visit:  http://www.uscis.gov/e-verify/employees

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Events Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
About StarRez

StarRez is the global leader in student housing software, providing innovative solutions for on and off-campus housing management, resident wellness and experience, and revenue generation. Trusted by 1,400+ clients across 25+ countries, StarRez supports more than 4 million beds annually with its user-friendly, all-in-one platform, delivering seamless experiences for students and administrators. With offices in the United States, Australia, the UK, and India, StarRez blends the robust capabilities of a global organization with the personalized care and service of a trusted partner.

The Role

We’re seeking a highly organized, proactive, and customer-focused Events Marketing Manager to lead StarRez’s North American in-person and virtual Housing Fair program for College Pads. This role is ideal for someone who thrives on managing multiple events at once and enjoys creating efficient, repeatable processes. You’ll oversee the College Pads Housing Fair program from strategic planning through execution, including scheduling, registrations, shipping and inventory, staffing coordination, event materials, budget tracking, and post-event reporting. Success in this role requires exceptional organization, attention to detail, strong communication, the ability to confidently manage multiple events and deadlines at once, and a passion for developing and executing strategies to increase student attendance at College Pads hosted housing fairs.

Role Specifics

• Location: Remote – United States

• Travel: Up to 30% domestic travel

• Compensation Structure: In addition to the base salary listed below, this role is eligible for bonus opportunities based on performance.

• Reports to: This role reports to the Director, Corporate Marketing

What You Will Own

Planning

• Own the annual planning of StarRez’s North American in-person and virtual Housing Fair program, establishing event calendars, timelines, priorities, and key milestones.

• Manage Housing Fair registrations and maintain accurate event details, deadlines, staffing requirements, and participation information.

• Partner with Sales, Customer Success, Community Relations, Product Marketing, and other teams to align event participation with broader business and customer goals.

• Coordinate StarRez employee staffing and develop clear pre-event communications, schedules, logistics, and expectations.

• Manage Housing Fair budgets, forecast expenses, and track event costs against plan.

• Build and maintain strong relationships with Housing Fair organizers, campus partners, vendors, and internal stakeholders.

Operations & Execution

• Manage end-to-end logistics for in-person and virtual Housing Fairs, including registrations, signage, giveaways, event materials, shipping, tracking, inventory, and virtual event setup.

• Serve as the primary point of contact for Housing Fair organizers and internal stakeholders throughout the event lifecycle.

• Ensure employees attending Housing Fairs are prepared with the information, materials, objectives, and resources needed for successful execution.

• Maintain accurate inventory and coordinate the timely shipment and return of event materials.

• Ensure StarRez delivers consistent, professional, and engaging brand experience across all Housing Fairs.

• Track event participation, attendance, costs, engagement, and other key performance metrics and provide post-event reporting.

• Identify and implement process improvements that make the Housing Fair program more efficient, consistent, and scalable.

Strategic Growth

• Develop and execute strategies to increase student awareness, adoption, and attendance at StarRez Housing Fairs, with a focus on reaching and engaging the college student demographic.

• Partner with participating institutions and internal teams to identify new ways to promote Housing Fairs directly to students before and during events.

• Explore new marketing channels, promotional tactics, incentives, partnerships, and engagement strategies designed to increase student participation.

• Use attendance trends, engagement data, student feedback, and event performance to identify opportunities to improve the Housing Fair experience and drive year-over-year growth.

• Develop best practices and repeatable promotional strategies that participating institutions can use to increase awareness and attendance among their students.

• Evaluate new event formats, experiences, and technologies that can make Housing Fairs more accessible, relevant, and engaging for college students.

• Establish and track measurable goals for Housing Fair growth, including student registrations, attendance, engagement, and adoption across participating institutions.

Required Qualifications

• 2+ years of experience in event planning, event marketing, field marketing, tradeshow coordination, or a related role.

• Demonstrated ability to manage a high volume of events or projects simultaneously.

• Experience coordinating event logistics, including registrations, shipping, inventory, staffing, and event materials.

• Ability to think strategically to grow the attendance and engagement at fairs

• Strong project management, organization, and attention to detail.

• Experience managing event budgets, expenses, and vendors.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively across multiple teams.

• Ability to travel domestically as required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience managing university, campus, student-facing, housing, or community events.

• Experience with VFairs Platform or similar virtual event platform

• Experience developing processes that make high-volume event programs more efficient and scalable.

• Strong problem-solving skills and ability to adapt to changing priorities.

• Ability to build positive relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.

Reasons to join our Team:

• Opportunity to be a part of a well-established, high-performance company that has been in business for over 30+ years

• Full benefits including health care, paid time off, life insurance, and 401k plan with company match for eligible team members.

• A supportive team environment with emphasis on learning and development opportunities

• Our Promise: You will learn, grow, and be appreciated for your impact and contributions.

• Z-Factor: Our most celebrated value, you will work with a team of caring, high-performing, and passionate people who have fun supporting our vision, innovation, and continuous improvement.

Even if you don't have all of the Preferred Qualifications listed above, but feel you have what it takes to succeed in the role, we would love to hear from you!

We are proud of our diverse workforce and are dedicated to creating a safe and welcoming environment for all employees. People from various ethnicities, ages, genders, and abilities are encouraged to apply.

StarRez will not accept unsolicited resumes from recruitment agencies, headhunters, or any other third parties for this role through this website or directly to any employee. StarRez and any of our subsidiaries will not pay fees to any third-party agency or company. In addition, we ask that you do not reach out to any employee with regards to this position, or any other positions, now, or in the future.

jobs.description:

Trusted Home Service Partners (“THSP”) is a private-equity backed, Dallas-based, customer-focused and people-centric group of home service businesses focused on investing in and partnering with small business owners primarily in the residential HVAC, plumbing, and electrical markets throughout the U.S. The company’s mission is to improve the lives of homeowners, business partners, and team members by providing the highest quality customer service possible in an honest, respectful, dependable, and collaborative environment. jobs.title: Team Lead Service Operations
jobs.description:
Keep operations sharp and service seamless – so our radar support runs smoothly when customers need it most.

As our Team Lead Service Operations, you guide the daily operations of our support crew to maintain exceptional service delivery standards. You oversee workload queues, resolve escalated technical cases, manage spare parts logistics, and build scalable service subscription models. You report to the Services & Support Operations Manager, working closely with engineering and product teams to keep our radars and software running flawlessly worldwide.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Operational leadership and coaching: Set clear daily priorities for your sub-team through regular check-ins and active coaching. Support professional growth while balancing empathy, accountability, and smooth daily team administration.

 - Queue and spare parts management: Oversee Jira Service Management ticket queues, incident assignments, and spare parts requests. Keep resolution swift and enforce strict compliance with contractual SLAs and warranty obligations.

 - Escalation and technical de-escalation: Serve as the primary operational point of contact for complex technical support cases. Coordinate cross-team troubleshooting and maintain clear, calming communication with customers.

 - Commercial service strategy: Help design and roll out structured Service and Support subscription models. Align SLAs and commercial offerings to deliver long-term value to our global customer base.

 - Process improvement and documentation: Identify operational bottlenecks in daily workflows and refine ticket routing. Upgrade runbooks, service bulletins, and Confluence documentation to keep knowledge organized and accessible.

 - Product and engineering feedback: Partner with Service Engineering, Product Management, and I&D to feed back incident root causes. Turn operational data and customer insights into direct product improvements.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - BA or BSc degree in Engineering, Business Administration, Operations Management, or a related technical field

 - 5+ years of experience in spare parts management and technical customer support, ideally in high-tech hardware or electronics

 - Proven experience leading or guiding operational sub-teams in a technical service environment

 - Hands-on expertise with service management platforms like Jira Service Management and ERP systems

 - Practical commercial experience with SLAs, warranty terms, and service subscription models

 - Professional fluency in written and spoken English

 - Strong de-escalation skills and clear communication across diverse global cultures

 - Analytical mindset with a knack for turning service data into workflow improvements

N.B. Don't worry if you don't tick every box. Our mission is a journey, and there's plenty to learn along the way. If most of this fits, we'd love to hear from you.

A Certificate of Conduct (VOG) and a background check are part of our screening process. We appreciate your understanding.


WHAT WE OFFER

 - Working for a Great Place to Work® certified company;

 - Comprehensive pension plan;

 - Commuting allowance;

 - 30 days of paid holiday leave (with the possibility to buy 3 additional days);

 - Opportunities to develop your skills even further through training and certifications;

 - High quality laptop/desktop, monitor, headphones, and any other equipment necessary for your role;

 - An international team of 30+ nationalities, full of high performance colleagues you can exchange experiences with and learn from. As well as having a lot of fun in our social events and Friday drinks!

Robin Radar is a technology leader in tracking and classifying small objects. Our radars and software help prevent bird strikes in aviation, reduce the impact of wind farms on wildlife, and protect critical infrastructure from drone threats. Our work shows up at airports, wind farms, military sites and nature reserves around the world.

We're one of the top 10 fastest-growing companies in the Netherlands, with a crew of bright minds across 30+ nationalities. Growth doesn't mean we lose the plot – eyes on the skies, feet on the ground. Our values keep us grounded: WE TRUST. WE OWN IT. WE AIM HIGH.

Want to work on next-level radar tech, solve real problems, and never have to pretend your job has meaning?

You'll fit right in – we're saving you a seat

jobs.title: Member Care Excellence Lead
jobs.description:
MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.



Role Purpose

Most companies treat support as a cost to contain. We think it can be the thing members tell their friends about.

Neko Health is building a new kind of healthcare: proactive, human, and built around the member. The service around it has to live up to that, in every conversation, every language, and every market. Right now, the foundations of that service are yet to be built, and you would shape them.

As Member Care Excellence Lead, you will set the vision and strategy for how we deliver excellent member care. That strategy will define how QA, Training, and Content work together, and how they fit into our wider Operations architecture. All of it serves one common goal: to reinforce the Neko brand in everything we do and to exceed expectations every time. You will use AI to make this faster, sharper, and more consistent, without losing the human care at its heart.

You will partner directly with the Director of Member Care on strategy and roadmap, and you will lead Member Care Excellence performance day to day. The scope is global across the EU, UK, and US, so you will need to hold one uncompromising standard while respecting the nuance of each region, language, and healthcare context.

We are scaling aggressively, and this is the moment to get it right, before the gap is too deep to unwind. If you want to build something extraordinary, something people talk about long after the call ends, this is the role.



What You’ll Deliver in the First 6 to 12 Months

• A Member Care Excellence strategy and roadmap, aligned to our Operations architecture and the Neko brand, that defines how QA, Training, and Content work together. (Impact, not activity)

• A QA rubric and calibration process are defined and live, so “good” is consistent across reps, languages, and regions rather than a gut check. (Impact, not activity)

• Real onboarding, certification, and a train the trainer protocol are built and running, so training no longer lives in one person’s head. (Chase 10X, not 10%)

• QA findings feed directly into training, coaching, and content, fixing issues at the root rather than one conversation at a time. (Optimistic truth seeking)

• A content system of macros, FAQs, and Help Center is live both globally and region specifically, with clear ownership and localisation, so reps aren’t building their own answers. (Tech enabled, human centred)

• AI is embedded across QA, training, and knowledge, for example in scoring at scale, surfacing coaching themes, and keeping content current, with humans firmly in the loop on care and judgment. (Tech enabled, human centred)

• The approach works consistently across EU, UK, and US, delivering one standard of excellence with local expertise where it matters. (Hard truths, high hopes)

• A measurable lift in member experience, with a service standard strong enough that members mention it unprompted. (Impact, not activity)


Minimum Requirements

• 8+ years building or scaling Training and/or QA functions, ideally in a contact centre or member support environment, with senior leadership experience across more than one region.

• A track record of setting vision and strategy for a service quality function and turning it into a roadmap that teams deliver.

• Experience designing training, certification, and QA systems that work across multiple regions and languages, and that respect cultural and regulatory nuance.

• Proven ability to connect quality data back into coaching, curriculum, and content, not just score interactions.

• Practical, hands on AI fluency applied to support operations, such as AI assisted QA, knowledge management, or agent enablement, with sound judgment on where human care must lead.

• Comfort owning content and knowledge base infrastructure alongside people development.

• Understanding of the sensitivities of healthcare or other high trust, regulated member interactions.


Preferred

• Experience building a QA or Training function from scratch rather than scaling an existing one.

• Familiarity with knowledge base or content management tooling (Zendesk Guide, Confluence, or similar).

• Experience operating across EU, UK, and US simultaneously, including multilingual support teams.

• Background in healthcare, healthtech, or another premium, high touch service brand.

• A history of building a service reputation that became a differentiator for the business.

jobs.title: Administrative Coordinator - Facilities Operations & Construction
jobs.description:
PURPOSE

The Administrative Coordinator – Facilities Operations & Construction provides high-level administrative, financial tracking, documentation, and follow-up support across capital, facilities maintenance, and construction, initiatives. The role creates a single point of coordination for project records, deadlines, vendor documentation, invoice workflow, reporting, and follow-through across the U.S. portfolio. This position supports project delivery from an administrative and data-management perspective but does not replace the technical, field, approval, or financial-accountability responsibilities of the designated project owner.

DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES

Project Administration and Follow Up

• Create and maintain a complete administrative record for assigned projects, including scope documents, contracts, purchase orders, change orders, RFIs, submittals, permits, inspection reports, closeout documents, warranties, and correspondence.
• Enter and update project data in approved systems; track milestones, deliverables, approvals, open items, and document status based on information supplied by the project owner.
• Coordinate bid-package distribution, proposal logs, bid due dates, meeting logistics, and follow-up communications without performing technical bid evaluation or award approval.
• Maintain project dashboards and exception reports that clearly identify overdue items, missing documentation, budget variances, and decisions needed from the project owner or leadership.
• Support administrative closeout, including final documentation, lien waivers, warranties, permits, inspection records, vendor files, and archive completion.

Facilities Operations and Compliance Support

• Maintain capital and operational trackers, facilities documentation, compliance calendars, inspection records, lender requirements, environmental-program records, and maintenance or safety audit files.
• Coordinate vendor onboarding, COIs, W-9s, licenses, service agreements, renewals, and other vendor compliance records in alignment with company processes.
• Serve as the administrative point of contact for assigned national partnerships; maintain national-contract records, track agreements and renewals, administer rebate-program documentation and reporting, and support communication among vendors, property teams, Area Service Managers, and leadership.
• Support emergency and disaster coordination through logistics tracking, supply and inventory records, utility information, site updates, and leadership reporting as directed

Job Cost and Financial Coordination

• Set up and maintain assigned project cost trackers using approved budgets, commitments, invoices, payment applications, change orders, forecasts, and actuals provided through company systems and project records.
• Reconcile administrative trackers to available accounting and project-system reports; identify discrepancies and route them to the project owner and Accounting for resolution.
• Provide administrative support for accounts payable and accounts receivable processes, including routing invoices, payment applications, purchase orders, coding requests, billing information, and related documentation through approved workflows.
• Prepare recurring cost summaries and variance reports for review by the project owner and leadership.
• Support job-cost administration for projects assigned within annually approved thresholds. The role is not the job-cost owner and does not approve budgets, commitments, change orders, forecasts, coding decisions, or payments.

Administrative Support

• Manage calendars, meetings, travel, expense reports, correspondence, and presentation materials for designated facilities and construction leaders.
• Prepare agendas, meeting materials, decision logs, action-item trackers, and leadership updates; follow up with responsible parties on commitments and due dates.
• Assist Area Service Managers, Assistant Director of Construction and other designated team members with the preparation, allocation, documentation, and timely submission of monthly expense reports.
• Coordinate effectively across Operations, Construction and Development, Accounting, Risk Management, Environmental, Procurement, and property teams.

Reporting, Systems, and Process Improvement

• Prepare and analyze operational performance metrics and key performance indicators; develop and maintain executive-ready dashboards, presentations, summaries, and status reports covering project delivery, cost, compliance, vendor activity, and outstanding decisions.
• Draft and distribute department communications, policy notices, strategic memoranda, leadership updates, and other internal communications as directed.
• Work closely with the Director of Maintenance Services to develop and maintain standardized templates, naming conventions, filing protocols, intake forms, and tracking tools that improve data quality and portfolio visibility.
• Support technology adoption and workflow standardization across construction and facilities administration, including Microsoft 365 and approved property, accounting, vendor, and construction platforms.
• Identify recurring administrative gaps and recommend practical process improvements, controls, and escalation paths.

MEASURES OF SUCCESS

• Project and compliance records are current, complete, organized, and readily auditable.
• Reports accurately reflect source information and clearly flag exceptions, overdue items, and decisions required.
• Invoices, purchase orders, changes, bids, and vendor documentation move through approved workflows on time.
• Leadership and project owners receive consistent, timely, and decision-ready information.
• Administrative support capacity is allocated transparently and adjusted as portfolio volume changes.
• No ambiguity exists between administrative coordination and project, technical, or financial ownership.

QUALIFICATIONS

• High school diploma or equivalent required; associate or bachelor’s degree in business administration, Construction Management, Facilities Management, Accounting, Analytics, or a related field preferred.
• Three or more years of administrative or project-coordination experience in construction, real estate development, property management, facilities, or a related environment preferred.
• Working knowledge of construction and facilities terminology and documents, including contracts, purchase orders, change orders, RFIs, submittals, payment applications, lien waivers, permits, inspections, and closeout records.
• Experience supporting budget, invoice, commitment, and job-cost tracking; ability to reconcile records, recognize inconsistencies, and escalate questions appropriately.
• Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Outlook, and Teams; experience with Yardi, Entrata, VendorPM, Procore, Bluebeam, Smartsheet, or similar systems is preferred.
• Strong organization, written communication, analytical judgment, follow-through, and attention to detail.
• Ability to manage competing priorities across a geographically dispersed portfolio while maintaining confidentiality and professionalism.
• Notary Public certification, or willingness to obtain it, is preferred.

COLLABORATION

The role works closely with the Director of Maintenance Services as well as the Director of Development and Construction, Construction project leaders, the Maintenance Operations Executive Assistant, Area Service Managers, Accounting, property teams, corporate departments, contractors, consultants, and national vendor partners. Specific project assignments and support coverage are established by leadership based on business need and capacity.

OTHER DUTIES

Perform other related administrative, reporting, coordination, and special-project duties as assigned. Responsibilities may be adjusted as systems, portfolio needs, and organizational priorities evolve.

At Morguard, our employees are our greatest investment. We make people our priority and strive to create a culture of respect, health and safety, and equal opportunity to support employees to meet their goals.

jobs.title: Safety, Health & Environment Specialist IV
jobs.description:
AECOM has a position available for Senior Construction Safety Professional in Salisbury, MD.  In this role, the person will be working at a client’s construction sites full-time and act as an owner's representative at a large data center campus construction sites. As the client’s representative, this person will review, report, escalate, and collaborate on the site’s safety programs and environmental compliance plans to promote a culture of safety across the sites and ensure environmental compliance.

The responsibilities of this role include, but may not be limited to, the following:

• Monitor and advise on client’s EHS culture and support implementation of EHS procedures and regulatory requirements at the site.
• Independently develop, implements and maintain safety and health programs, systems, and procedures to reduce risk and exposures.
• Under minimal direction, supervise personnel engaged in the EHS functions within the company or on the same project.
• Monitor and work toward minimization of potential hazards and diseases in the work area.
• Supervise personnel engaged in monitoring and preventing hazards and diseases that could be present throughout the work sites.
• Work with and advise contractors on the identification and implementation of corrective actions for identified deficiencies or issues.
• Review and advise on Contractor Environmental Health and Safety Plans (CEHSP) for conformance with owner requirements and local regulations.
• Serve in a liaison capacity with the resident contract agency representative and other various agencies engaged in promoting EHS activities.
• Interface and support the construction management team at site by delivering current, accurate and timely data on Contractor EHS performance, including Leading and Lagging Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), trends, incident management, environmental monitoring/responsibilities', EHS metrics and other measurable information that enables the construction management to make informed timely decisions.
• Represent client’s Construction EHS Team by participating/attending essential meetings not limited to general contractor’s (GC) all-hands, Stand Downs, Orientations, Safety Committee, EHS Leads, Activity Briefing, Coordination Meeting etc.
• Draft all necessary reports to Federal, State, and local agencies, as well as client stakeholders.
• Keep informed of existing and proposed changes in occupational health and safety regulations. Assist in the development and conduct of basic EHS training to employees.
• Communicate incidents, as required, to local and area leadership.
• Communicate programs to enhance employee awareness of prevention and compliance.
• May administer an EHS program on a large, specialized, complex project or multiple projects.
• Support compliance with construction environmental programs, not limited to waste management, stormwater management and plans, spill prevention, control, & countermeasure plans, and air permitting requirements.
• Independently determine and develop approaches to solutions.
• Ensure site safety walks are conducted as needed with the Contractor management representative.
• Evaluate the completeness and effectiveness of the Contractor’s hazard assessments (RAMS, JHAs, ARTs, PTPs, etc.) and communicate opportunities for improvement.
• Create, validate, and communicate lessons learned via Significant Events (SE) and Significant Potential Events (SPE) with trade partners.
• Advise client, GC, and Trade Partners on applicable client’s EHS requirements and Contractual Exhibits.
• Recommend improvements in processes, design, procedures, and operating equipment to minimize hazards.
• Establish a collaborative relationship with the client’s operation team to facilitate the management of EHS aspects of construction activities.
• Attend and facilitate client-specific training, campaigns and initiatives as requested.
• Prepare and provide site-specific construction health and safety training as requested.
• May act as a lead role for a team of EHS specialists and/or support personnel.
• Support global construction EHS team in developing, reviewing, and executing global programs and initiatives.
• Assist with localization of global programs such as translation and transculturation as needed.
• Conduct topic-specific focused field audit, document verification and personal interviews as needed.
• Provide technical leadership and functional guidance to ensure regulatory standards are being enforced.
• Ensure that quality control procedures are executed to monitor all aspects of regulations.
• Investigate accidents, injuries, and complaints concerning hazards in the workplace.
• A minimum of 60% of working hours shall be in the field, engaging, coaching, and walking.
• May include travel to multiple local project locations, as requested.

Minimum Qualifications:

• BS/BA +6 years of experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education.
• Experience in construction safety or related field.
• Experience in environmental compliance and industry standards.
• Valid Driver’s License and as a condition of employment must be able to pass AECOM’s Motor Vehicle Records review.

• Data center construction or operation experience
• Experience overseeing a variety of construction trades

jobs.title: SEO & GEO Strategist
jobs.description:
CaseGuard is expanding its team and seeking a SEO & GEO Strategist who is passionate about search visibility in a rapidly changing landscape. We are looking for a self-motivated individual who is proactive in seeking answers and is willing to assist in various areas as needed.

The SEO/GEO Strategist owns how CaseGuard shows up in both places: traditional organic search and AI-generated answers. You will optimize our existing site, build the documentation and guide library that AI systems pull from, monitor how our keywords and prompts perform, and work alongside our content writer and video creator to make sure everything we publish gets found.

​Responsibilities

• Own on-page, technical, and content SEO across caseguard.com, including page structure, internal linking, metadata, image optimization, and site health.

• Make CaseGuard more discoverable in AI search by structuring content for retrieval and citation: answer-first formatting, clear Q&A headings, FAQ blocks, concise machine-readable copy, and consistent entity and brand signals across the web.

• Implement and maintain structured data that supports both traditional rankings and AI answer citation.

• Conduct regular SEO and AEO audits (technical, content, keyword, schema, entity) and turn findings into a prioritized roadmap rather than a list of observations.

• Stay current on how AI Overviews, answer engines, and LLM citation behavior are evolving, and adapt our approach accordingly.

• Create and maintain guides, help center documentation, and product playbooks that serve real users first and rank and get cited as a result.

• Run keyword research and prompt monitoring: track where CaseGuard appears (and where it doesn't) across search engines and AI assistants, at the prompt-cluster level as well as the keyword level.

• Track performance in GA4, Google Search Console, and an SEO platform such as Semrush; report on organic traffic, rankings, AI visibility and citations, conversions, and content performance.

• Work cross-functionally with Product, Sales, and Support to identify high-intent topics, common customer questions, and competitive gaps worth targeting.

Requirements

• Bachelor's degree in Marketing, Communications, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience). 2–4 years of experience in SEO, AEO/GEO, content marketing, or digital marketing.

• Hands-on experience with an SEO platform such as Semrush (or Ahrefs, Moz, or similar), Google Search Console, and GA4.

• Working knowledge of technical SEO fundamentals: crawling and indexation, site speed, redirects, canonicals, sitemaps, and structured data.

• Demonstrated understanding of how AI answer engines surface and cite content.

• Strong writing and editing skills, with the ability to turn technical product details into clear, useful content.

• Demonstrated ability to come up to speed quickly on a new project, balance multiple tasks, and provide a quick return on a documentation project.

• Analytical mindset with comfort pulling, interpreting, and presenting data.

• Attention to detail and strong organizational skills.

• Experience in B2B SaaS, government tech, or a regulated industry is a plus.

• Familiarity with WordPress is a plus.

Benefits:

• Competitive Salary

• Stock Option

• Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

• 401K

• Paid Vacation

• Ten paid holidays per year

• Friendly and Learning environment

Pay Range: $65,000 - $85,000 Annually

About CaseGuard

CaseGuard is a software company that helps law enforcement agencies, federal agencies, hospitals, schools, airports, and others manage all their media redaction needs in one easy-to-use redaction software. CaseGuard Studio is one of a kind. Our team is driven by a passion for great software design, creating great products, and creative processes; CaseGuard implements innovative ideas across multiple services and agencies. We invest in people. We nurture skills consistent with our values and our future strategy. Our passionate pursuit of excellence, the application of our creativity to solve our clients’ challenges, our technical expertise, and our collaborative spirit are measures of our success.
