jobs.title: Global Media Relations Director
jobs.description:
About IonQ:

IonQ, Inc. [NYSE: IONQ] is the world’s leading quantum platform and merchant supplier - delivering integrated quantum solutions across computing, networking, sensing, and security. IonQ’s newest generation of quantum computers, the IonQ Tempo, is the latest in a line of cutting-edge systems that have been helping customers and partners including Amazon Web Services, and AstraZeneca achieve 20x performance results and accelerate innovation in drug discovery, materials science, financial modeling, logistics, cybersecurity, and defense. In 2025, the company achieved 99.99% two-qubit gate fidelity, setting a world record in quantum computing performance.

Headquartered in College Park, Maryland, IonQ has operations in California, Colorado, Massachusetts, Tennessee, Washington, Italy, South Korea, Sweden, Switzerland, Canada, and the United Kingdom. Our quantum computing services are available through all major cloud providers, while we also meet the needs of networking and sensing customers across land, sea, air, and space. IonQ is making quantum platforms more accessible and impactful than ever before.

Location: Remote, US
Job ID:  1797

The Role:

IonQ is seeking a dynamic, strategic, and high-energy Global Media Relations Director to lead our global media strategy and external narrative.

As a key leader within the Global Marketing and Communications team, you will drive premium earned media, safeguard our brand reputation, and articulate IonQ’s technology and market leadership. This role demands a seasoned communicator who pairs deep top-tier media relationships with strong financial and technical communications expertise. You must excel at translating complex quantum hardware, software, and scientific breakthroughs into compelling, digestible stories for global business, financial, and tech audiences—all without losing scientific integrity.

Responsibilities:

• Drive Top-Tier Earned Media: Lead proactive pitching across global business, financial, broadcast, deep-tech, and scientific media outlets to secure high-impact coverage.

• Agency Oversight: Work as a member of the Global Marketing & Communications leadership team to oversee the daily activities and results delivery of IonQ’s external agencies.

• Executive & SME Coaching: Serve as the primary communications partner for IonQ’s executive team, top scientists, and engineers. Develop custom briefing materials and conduct intensive media training for spokespeople.

• Thought Leadership: Proactively position internal subject matter experts for commentary, features, and key industry moments, working closely with the Global Head, Strategic Content, Insights & Market Intelligence.

• Technical Translation: Collaborate across GTM, Product, R&D, Applications; Social Media and Strategic Content, Insights & Market Intelligence teams globally to distill complex quantum concepts (computing, networking, sensing, security) into clear, engaging narratives.

• Media Collateral: Write and edit high-quality external materials, including press releases, pitch decks, media alerts, executive bios, FAQs, and messaging playbooks.

• Message Architecture: Own and maintain the central repository for core media messaging and talking points to ensure brand consistency across all external touchpoints.

• Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner with Investor Relations, Legal, Compliance, Government Affairs and People teams to ensure all external communications adhere to regulatory standards and internal alignment.

• Crisis & Issues Management: Assist in developing crisis playbooks, protocol updates, and reactive messaging for regulatory, governance, or M&A-related events.

• Media Monitoring & Analytics: Partner with the Media Monitoring and Social Intelligence Specialist to track brand sentiment, share of voice, and competitor narratives, leveraging data to refine strategies.

• Industry Trendjacking: Actively monitor macro industry trends, tech policy, and market movements to insert IonQ into relevant news cycles.

• Operations: Maintain media distribution lists, editorial calendars, press kits, and collaborative tracking tools to streamline team workflows.

Requirements:

• Bachelor’s degree in Communications, Public Relations, Journalism, English, or a relevant scientific/technical field (e.g., Physics, Engineering).

• 8+ years in media relations or corporate communications, with 4+ years specifically in a deep-tech, scientific, or highly technical industry (e.g., Quantum Computing, Semiconductors, Aerospace, AI, or Advanced Engineering).

• Track Record: Proven portfolio of securing impactful earned media placements across top-tier financial (e.g., WSJ, FT, Bloomberg) and tech/trade publications.

• Writing/Storytelling Mastery: Exceptional ability to write with speed, precision, and clarity under tight deadlines, transforming abstract scientific data into clear business narratives.

• Executive Presence: Extensive experience media-training C-suite executives and PhD-level Subject Matter Experts (SMEs).

• Demonstrated ability to leverage technology — including AI-powered tools for drafting, monitoring, and sentiment analysis — to increase team efficiency and sharpen strategic decision-making.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Experience navigating late-stage, high-growth tech startups or publicly traded deep-tech companies.

• Working knowledge of financial media relations and regulatory compliance (e.g., SEC guidelines/Reg FD).

• Familiarity with media tools and PRM software (e.g., Cision, Muck Rack, Meltwater, Brandwatch).

The total compensation package includes base, bonus, and equity.

Factory Shift Lead | Nox Metals | Ferndale, MI



About Nox Metals. American factories deserve a supply chain that moves as fast as they do. Nox Metals is building it, along with the tools that run it. We’re a technology company in Metro Detroit supplying aluminum plate, bar, and rounds to aerospace and defense manufacturers. We use software and automation to supply metal to American factories faster than the industry thought possible.



The role. We're hiring Factory Shift Leads to run our floors in Ferndale. Every order Nox ships starts on the floor, and you will own your shift: safety, quality, and output. You set the pace, assign the work, and train the people who run our saws. When a machine goes down or a job runs late, you are the first call and you fix it.

Part of your shift is leading: coaching your team, enforcing the standard, and passing a clean handoff to the next lead. The other part is hands on: you run the equipment and know every job on the floor. You start by learning every station in the building, and you report to the General Manager.

If you've led a crew in a factory, a metals service center, or a skilled trade, this is your next step.



Shift hours:

Weekdays, First Shift: Monday through Thursday, 7:00 AM to 5:30 PM

Weekdays, Second Shift: Monday through Thursday, 5:30 PM to 4:00 AM

Weekends, First Shift: Friday through Sunday, 7:00 AM to 7:00 PM

Weekends, Second Shift: Friday through Sunday, 7:00 PM to 7:00 AM



You will:

· Lead your shift team, set the pace, and own the outcome for safety, quality, and output

· Assign work, set priorities, and keep the shift on the production schedule

· Train and coach team members on equipment, safety, and our software

· Enforce safety rules and PPE, stop unsafe work, and report incidents and near misses

· Run a clean handoff, pass open jobs and issues to the next shift lead

· Operate saws, CNC, and handling equipment to cut and inspect aluminum to spec

· Run forklifts and overhead cranes, we’ll train and certify you

· Record cut data and job completions in our software systems, accurately, every time

· Complete other tasks as assigned



You are:

· A natural leader, people follow you because of how you work, not because of a title

· A clear communicator, comfortable giving direction and holding people accountable

· Knowledgeable or experienced in a factory, metals center, or with skilled trades

· Committed to safety

· Attentive with regards to quality, every cut, every cert, every shipment

· Always thinking about how to make processes better

· Customer obsessed

· Someone who takes ownership, if it is your shift, it is your responsibility

· Self-directed, you can run the floor with a smaller team and keep production moving

· Able to lift up to 50 lbs., operate heavy equipment and be on your feet for a full shift with or without reasonable accommodation

· Not afraid to work outside normal hours when America demands it



Nice to have:

· Prior shift lead or supervisory experience in manufacturing

· Experience in metals, aluminum, or aerospace/defense supply chains

· Forklift and/or overhead crane certification

· Comfortable using AI tools to work faster and smarter



Pay and benefits:

· $26 to $30 per hour, depending on shift and experience

· Equity in Nox Metals

· Company-paid medical, dental, and vision insurance



This role is full time, in person in Ferndale.

jobs.title: Head of Environmental Health and Safety
jobs.description:
ABOUT PERIODIC LABS

We’re an AI and physical sciences company building state-of-the-art models to accelerate breakthroughs across materials, energy, and beyond. Backed by world-class investors and growing rapidly, we operate at the pace the frontier requires. Our team brings deep expertise, genuine ownership, and an insatiable drive to push the boundaries of what’s scientifically possible.




ABOUT THE ROLE

Periodic Labs is building an AI that can simulate science and verify its own predictions — training on the full scientific method. Central to that mission is a high-throughput experimental materials science lab that handles hazardous chemistries, high-pressure and high-temperature processes, air-sensitive synthesis, toxic gas exposure risks, and an expanding suite of thin-film deposition tools including PVD, PLD and the complexity of what we run overnight and autonomously is increasing every month.

We believe EHS is integral to this ambition, not a compliance function bolted on after the fact, but a core design discipline that makes autonomous science possible. This EHS leadership role will build our safety architecture, defining permitting strategy, designing life safety systems, conducting process hazard analyses, and ultimately training our AI to reason about risk during experimental planning and execution.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead the site EH&S team through a hands-on approach to problem solving and operational support while promoting a strong safety and environmental culture. Ensure compliance with applicable EH&S regulations and standards, develop and improve programs aligned with company goals, and actively partner with lab and operations teams on day-to-day safety challenges. Own the digital EHS infrastructure, integrating inspections, training records, incident reporting, compliance tracking, KPI dashboards, action-item tracking, and audit workflows into a unified operational safety platform.

 - Own and manage all permitting processes with local, state, and federal agencies: Fire Department/CUPA via Accela, CERS submissions for hazardous materials, AQMD/BAAQMD air permits, and TSDF coordination for hazardous waste.

 - Maintain and update chemical inventory systems, SDS library, and hazard labeling in compliance with OSHA, CalEPA, and permitted MAQ thresholds including managing the expansion of our chemical inventory as new thin-film processes introduce HF-based wet chemistry, fluoride compounds, and specialty gases.

 - Lead Hazard Communication (HazCom) and SDS training programs for lab staff, including night shift and autonomous overnight operation protocols.

 - Coordinate EHS inspections and maintain required documentation and postings across both the existing powder lab and thin-film facility.

 - Design and review life safety systems, including fire suppression, e-stop networks, gas detection (including toxic gas alarms for HF, H2Se, and other process chemistries), interlocks, alarm interfaces, and emissions/waste abatement systems such as baghouses and scrubbers.

 - Conduct and document HAZOPs, PHA/FMEA, and risk assessments for new processes and lab systems, including high-pressure furnace operations, glovebox workflows, and thin-film deposition platforms.

 - Establish operational readiness and laboratory reliability systems for autonomous operations, including pre-startup safety reviews (PSSR), commissioning validation, alarm rationalization, startup/shutdown procedures, and critical equipment inspection programs.

 - Partner with automation and controls teams to implement machine safeguarding, fail-safes, interlocks, robotics safety controls, functional safety validation, safety PLC reviews, and automated motion hazard assessments for autonomous experimental systems.

 - Collaborate with ML/AI engineers on training an LLM to reason through process hazards, risk assessments, and safety constraints during experimental planning and autonomous execution — making EHS a first-class input to our AI’s decision-making.
   


YOU WILL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU HAVE

 - 10+ years of experience in EHS, process safety, or chemical operations in labs, pilot plants, or manufacturing environments preferably in solid-state chemistry, materials science processing, or lab automation.

 - Strong knowledge of EH&S regulations, standards, and best practices.

 - Hands-on experience conducting HAZOPs or FMEAs and designing or reviewing functional safety systems.

 - Certification in EH&S (e.g., Certified Safety Professional, Certified Industrial Hygienist) is a plus.

 - Comfort working on-site in a fast-paced, high-complexity lab environment where experiments run 24/7 and the hazard profile evolves as new processes and equipment are introduced.


ESPECIALLY STRONG CANDIDATES MAY ALSO HAVE

 - Experience designing EHS systems for autonomous or semi-autonomous lab environments where processes run without continuous human supervision.

 - Background supporting the build-out of a new laboratory facility, including coordinating permitting and safety system design in parallel with construction.

 - Familiarity with AI or ML tools as applied to risk assessment, safety documentation, or experimental planning or genuine curiosity about how to apply them.

 - Active participation in technical committees contributing to OSHA, NFPA, or IEC standard development.

 - Demonstrated accomplishments recognized in your field.


MECHANICS

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or similar experience

Location: Menlo Park, CA

Compensation:  $250,000–$325,000 + equity

Visa sponsorship: Yes, we sponsor visas.

Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

• Ensure adherence to project deliverables, escalating and raising awareness of critical issues in advance

Location & Travel Expectations:

What you’ll bring

You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

jobs.description:
Join Axon and be a Force for Good.

At Axon, we’re on a mission to Protect Life. We’re explorers, pursuing society’s most critical safety and justice issues with our ecosystem of devices and cloud software. Like our products, we work better together. We connect with candor and care, seeking out diverse perspectives from our customers, communities and each other.

Life at Axon is fast-paced, challenging and meaningful. Here, you’ll take ownership and drive real change. Constantly grow as you work hard for a mission that matters at a company where you matter.

Your Impact

As the Senior Manager, R&D Product Enablement, you will own how Axon's product knowledge reaches customers. You will lead a team of ~8 direct reports, aligned to various Axon product lines, that produces and governs the content customers rely on to understand, adopt, and get value from Axon products: release notes, help and technical documentation, localized content, and the communications that accompany product launches and updates.

You will partner closely with Product, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, Marketing, and Training to make sure the right information gets to the right audience at the right time, at global scale and with consistent quality. You will also help shape how AI is used to create and maintain that content, making the team faster and more effective.

Key Responsibilities

Strategy and Roadmap

• Own the Product Enablement strategic plan and annual roadmap, bringing a clear point of view on where the function is headed and why

• Translate operational work (documentation, release communications, localization, AI investment) into a coherent narrative told in terms of business impact, including adoption, support deflection, and customer satisfaction

• Build and maintain relationships with senior leaders across Product and customer-facing pillars, and represent Product Enablement in strategic planning forums

• Establish prioritization frameworks that align content investment to the highest business and customer needs across product pillars

Product Documentation and Help Content

• Lead the team responsible for the Help Site, technical documentation, and product knowledge content across Axon's product portfolio

• Set quality standards, style guidelines, and standard operating procedures for content creation, review, and maintenance

• Ensure content is accurate, timely, and kept current as products evolve, in partnership with Product and Engineering

Release Communications and Governance

• Own the Release Notes process and governance, including the internal-only Release Notes Hub, so that customers and internal teams receive clear, consistent, and timely information on product changes

• Establish and run regular stakeholder communications for major product areas and launches, including quarterly updates

• Lead content and communications response for high-visibility product events and incidents, maintaining quality while managing competing stakeholder priorities

Localization

• Own the sequencing and delivery of localized content, including the Help Site, working with Axon's Localization Center of Excellence and external vendors

• Balance global market needs, budget, and release timing to deliver accurate translated content on schedule

AI-Enabled Content Operations

• Drive responsible adoption of AI tools (e.g., Claude) across content creation, review, and maintenance workflows

• Document use cases, define guardrails and best practices, and lead cross-team forums that share learning and raise AI fluency across content-producing teams

• Identify opportunities to use AI to increase throughput, consistency, and quality

People Leadership

• Directly manage a team of ~8 direct reports (technical writers, instructional designers, and/or program managers) aligned across various product lines

• Ensure each product line has clear content ownership, consistent standards, and appropriate coverage, and balance team capacity across software and non-software products as priorities shift

• Lead, coach, and develop the team, building product and role-specific expertise

• Build a deliberate delegation and ownership model so every workstream has a clear owner and the team scales without depending on any single person

• Manage performance, compensation, career development, and retention; advocate for your team with data and a clear narrative

• Onboard new team members and integrate newly acquired or transitioning teams

Cross-Functional Partnership

• Partner with Product Managers, Engineering, Customer Success, Support, Professional Services, Training, and Marketing to gather inputs, resolve blockers, and align on timelines

• Manage intake, tracking, and prioritization of content work using Jira and related tools, with clear visibility into status and risk

• Handle escalations and stakeholder concerns with tact, clarity, and accountability

Your Day-to-Day

As Senior Manager, Product Enablement, you will:

• Set priorities and review progress across documentation, release notes, localization, and communications workstreams

• Lead and coach your direct reports across multiple product lines and remove blockers so work keeps moving

• Meet regularly with Product, Customer Success, Support, and pillar leaders to align on upcoming releases and content needs

• Monitor quality, timeliness, and customer feedback metrics, and adjust the team's approach accordingly

• Communicate status, risks, and impact clearly to senior leadership

• Explore and pilot new tools, workflows, and AI use cases that improve how content is produced and delivered

This role requires strong consultative and execution skills, exceptional people leadership, and the ability to build and develop relationships across Axon.

Basic Qualifications

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience

• 5+ years of experience in technical documentation, product content, product communications, enablement, or program management

• 2+ years of experience as a people manager

• Experience leading a team of 8 or more direct reports, ideally spanning multiple product lines or content domains

• Proven ability to manage multiple workstreams and stakeholders simultaneously in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment

• Experience owning content or communications quality standards and governance processes

• Experience using project and work-tracking tools (e.g., Jira, Smartsheet) and ensuring on-time delivery

• Clear, concise, and effective communicator, written and verbal, including with senior stakeholders

• Demonstrated ability to partner across teams and hold others accountable to a plan

• Occasional travel may be required

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience managing technical writing or documentation teams

• Experience leading content for Saas, hardware, or software products

• Experience with localization and translation programs, including working with vendors or a Localization Center of Excellence

• Hands-on experience applying generative AI tools to content workflows

• Experience with release communications for SaaS, hardware, or software products

• Experience in a product or customer enablement function

• Experience leading teams through organizational change or transition

• Experience working with public safety customers

• Project Management Professional (PMP) certification

Benefits that Benefit You

• Competitive salary and 401k with employer match

• Discretionary paid time off

• Paid parental leave for all

• Learning & Development programs

jobs.title: Sr. Business Operations Manager (Starlink Growth)
jobs.description:
SpaceX was founded under the belief that a future where humanity is out exploring the stars is fundamentally more exciting than one where we are not. Today SpaceX is actively developing the technologies to make this possible, with the ultimate goal of enabling human life on Mars.

SR. BUSINESS OPERATIONS MANAGER (STARLINK GROWTH0

Starlink is a revolutionary satellite constellation, delivering low-latency broadband internet around the world – bringing an unprecedented opportunity to significantly impact communities, businesses, and governments worldwide. The North America Business Development team is seeking a Sr. Business Operations Manager to serve as a pivotal partner in defining and executing go-to-market (GTM) strategy across both third-party and direct starlink.com selling channels. This role owns the operational backbone of North American Business Development initiatives while driving foundational GTM strategy work that shapes the team’s long-term direction. In addition, the role owns day-to-day channel growth for starlink.com in North America and works cross-functionally to maximize Starlink fulfilments and subscribers. It is vital that Starlink deals, partnerships, and direct-to-consumer efforts be optimized for speed, scale, and balanced growth. This role requires deep program management and business operations expertise, comfort working with both people and data, and fluency in financial analysis, reporting, pricing, promotions, and the day-to-day mechanics that make Starlink business development and direct channel initiatives run.

The ideal candidate combines strong program management, business operations, and chief-of-staff capabilities with strategic rigor, GTM expertise, and long-term vision. This is a unique opportunity to work at the cutting edge of connectivity technologies with a world-class team focused on connecting every household and traveler.

RESPONSIBILITIES:

• Own and drive GTM strategy for North America across both third-party channels and Starlink.com, ensuring alignment on prioritization, resource allocation, and growth objectives

• Own day-to-day channel growth for starlink.com in North America, including performance tracking, conversion optimization, and cross-functional coordination to maximize the business

• Provide strategic insight across the North America Business Development team to minimize cannibalization and maximize balanced growth between third-party and starlink.com

• Assist with pricing strategy and promotions development for both Starlink.com and third-party channels, partnering with finance, marketing, and commercial teams to design and evaluate programs that drive incremental growth

• Own the operationalization of existing and upcoming business development and GTM initiatives, driving program management, deal pipeline tracking, cross-functional coordination, and execution discipline so initiatives move with speed and scale

• Create data visualization and present analysis on leading and lagging indicators, along with clear recommendations and optimization planning to leadership stakeholders

• Conduct new vertical, competitor, and market research, develop big-bet hypotheses, and perform structured assessments of broad business intelligence, target partners, channels, and direct GTM opportunities to inform team prioritization and resource allocation

• Report on progress of strategy, operations, and GTM initiatives, presenting insights, risks, and recommendations directly to Starlink leadership

BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:

• Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, engineering, or a related field

• 7+ years of experience in business operations, program management, strategy, GTM and ecommerce, consulting, investment banking, or related roles involving complex initiatives

• 4+ years of experience driving execution of revenue or growth-oriented programs, including tracking, reporting, and operationalizing commercial or direct-to-consumer initiatives

PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:

• Proven background in program management, business operations, GTM strategy, or chief-of-staff roles supporting high-growth or commercial teams in technology, telecommunications, utilities, or subscription-based services

• Experience owning or supporting direct-to-consumer (e.g., e-commerce) channel growth alongside third-party or partner channels, with demonstrated ability to balance growth and minimize cannibalization

• Experience in management consulting or investment banking, with demonstrated ability to structure problems, build rigorous analyses, and drive recommendations to action

• Familiarity with business development, partnerships, pricing strategy, or promotions in consumer technology, telecommunications, or adjacent sectors

• Strong analytical, financial modeling, and data fluency; comfort with accounting concepts, KPI design, pricing analysis, and building clear reporting for leadership

• Demonstrated success operationalizing complex commercial, product, or direct-channel initiatives and driving them from concept through execution and scale

• Excellent interpersonal, communication, and presentation skills; able to work effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders

• MBA or master’s degree with a business or technical focus preferred

ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:

• Must be available to work extended hours and weekends as needed

• Willingness to travel approximately 25-50% of the time to customer locations and other SpaceX locations as required

COMPENSATION AND BENEFITS:

Pay Range:
Level 3: $135,000.00 - $205,000.00

Your actual level and base salary will be determined on a case-by-case basis and may vary based on the following considerations: job-related knowledge and skills, education, and experience.

Base salary is just one part of your total rewards package at SpaceX. You may also be eligible for long-term incentives, in the form of company stock or long-term cash awards, as well as potential discretionary bonuses and the ability to purchase additional stock at a discount through an Employee Stock Purchase Plan. You will also receive access to comprehensive medical, vision, and dental coverage, access to a 401(k) retirement plan, short and long-term disability insurance, life insurance, paid parental leave, and various other discounts and perks. You may also accrue 3 weeks of paid vacation and will be eligible for 10 or more paid holidays per year. Employees in Washington State accrue paid sick time in compliance with state and federal law. Company shuttles are offered to employees for roundtrip travel from select Seattle locations to the SpaceX Redmond office Monday to Friday.

jobs.title: Human Resources Specialist
jobs.description:
At ConvenientMD, we’re on a mission to make good health more convenient for all – working to improve how patients and providers experience healthcare in New England. To support this belief, we’re building a team of dedicated professionals who genuinely care about improving lives, are passionate about work that can make a difference, and are driven to learn from one another.

The Opportunity

Reporting to the Human Resources Manager, Payroll & Benefits, the Human Resources Specialist is responsible for administering employee benefits and the 401(k) plan, supporting payroll and HRIS operations, and assisting with HR initiatives and special projects. This role requires a high level of confidentiality, attention to detail, and discretion. The Human Resources Specialist partners closely with external vendors, brokers, payroll, finance, and internal stakeholders to ensure compliance, accuracy, and an exceptional employee experience across all benefits and HR programs.

Your Impact

• Administer and continuously improve employee benefits programs and processes.

• Maintain current knowledge of applicable federal and state employment, benefits, and leave laws to support compliance efforts.

• Communicate benefit offerings effectively and provide employee education and training across clinical and corporate locations.

• Manage new hire enrollments, qualifying life events, status changes, and benefit terminations.

• Assist with the planning, coordination, and execution of annual open enrollment activities.

• Audit benefit enrollment reports and vendor invoices to ensure accuracy and timely resolution of discrepancies.

• Serve as the primary contact for benefit-related claim issues and insurance dispute resolution.

• Coordinate and process benefit invoice payments.

• Work closely with HR team members to manage benefit repayments and reconciliations related to leaves of absence.

• Generate and maintain standard and ad hoc reports as needed.

• Ensure accuracy of employee data through ongoing review, validation, and maintenance of HRIS, payroll, and benefits records.

• Support the development, implementation, and enhancement of processes, workflows, and organizational structures within the ADP HRIS platform.

• Serve as backup support for payroll processing

• Assist with the testing, review, and implementation of HR technology upgrades and system enhancements.

• Respond to employee inquiries promptly and professionally, delivering exceptional service consistent with ConvenientMD's core values.

• Support HR programs and special projects, including compensation, performance management, employee engagement, diversity and inclusion initiatives, and other strategic people initiatives.

• Collaborate across departments to improve HR processes, employee communications, and operational efficiency.

Who You Are

• Experience supporting a multi-state, high-volume payroll, non-exempt payroll; prior payroll processing experience in ADP strongly preferred.

• Two (2) or more years of proven experience using ADP Workforce Now; experience in ADP WFM or UKG timecards strongly preferred.

• Experience supporting a large hourly population related to timecard accuracy.

• Five (5) or more years of experience overseeing benefits and 401k administration.

• Bachelor’s Degree in Human Resources, Finance, Accounting, Business Administration or similar field and/or equivalent experience.

• Excellent organization skills and high attention to detail.

• Able to work independently to prioritize work and meet tight deadlines.

• Strong computer skills including the MS Office suite, with Smartsheet experience strongly preferred.

• Positive, solution-focused attitude, excellent teamwork capabilities, and strong communication skills.

• Prior experience managing a team of 1 or more employees, including directing and reviewing daily work.

• High level of discretion managing and maintaining sensitive and/or confidential information.

• Critical thinking skills that provide an ability to seek out new methods and principles; capable of implementing new practices.

• Able successfully complete all pre-employment screenings/activities in a timely manner.

Why You'll Love Working With Us

• Collaborative team environment that encourages professional growth

• Urgent care services at no cost to our team members and their families

• Extensive benefit offerings including health, dental, and vision coverage, company paid short-term disability, and optional pet insurance

• 401k match after one year of service

jobs.title: Director, SEO + AEO
jobs.description:
ABOUT VAYNERMEDIA

VaynerMedia is a global integrated creative and media agency, built for today's consumers. As the Modern Agency of Record, it understands the nuances of today's attention landscape, empowering brands to win attention, drive relevance, and deliver business results. Founded in 2009, by Gary Vaynerchuk, the independently owned agency operates in 15 offices worldwide, including Amsterdam, Bangkok, Chicago, New Delhi, Kuala Lumpur, London, Los Angeles, Mexico City, Miami, New York, Tokyo, Toronto, Singapore, and Sydney. VaynerMedia is part of the VaynerX family of companies.

OVERALL PURPOSE

VaynerMedia is looking for an Director of Organic Search to lead SEO & AEO engagements and elevate our agency's organic search offering across a portfolio of high-profile client accounts. In this senior role, you will architect the strategic vision spanning traditional SEO and Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), ensuring our clients achieve meaningful visibility not just in blue-link results, but inside AI-generated answers on major LLM platforms like Google AI Overviews, ChatGPT, and Gemini. You will guide a team of organic search professionals, collaborate cross-functionally with media, content, creative, and engineering teams, and serve as a thought leader who keeps VaynerMedia's search practice on the cutting edge. This is a role for someone who can think at a systems level, drive measurable outcomes, and bring contagious energy to a fast-moving, culturally plugged-in agency.

KEY AREAS OF RESPONSIBILITY

• Lead and mentor a team of organic search Managers by setting performance goals, fostering a culture of continuous improvement and learning, and ensuring consistent application of best practices across all campaigns

• Define and lead the overarching organic search strategy across all assigned client accounts, aligning SEO & AEO initiatives directly to each client's business objectives, revenue targets, and customer growth goals

• Analyze performance data holistically across Google Search Console, GA4, and enterprise SEO platforms (SEMrush, Ahrefs, Conductor, BrightEdge, etc.), translating insights into clear strategic adjustments and executive-ready reporting

• Collaborate cross-departmentally with paid media, content, creative, and engineering teams to embed SEO & AEO best practices into every touchpoint of the digital experience

• Present organic search strategy, performance, and competitive landscape to senior client stakeholders in a clear, compelling, and ROI-focused manner

• Lead comprehensive technical SEO programs, including site architecture, Core Web Vitals, mobile optimization, crawl/index health, and advanced schema markup implementation to ensure client sites are structurally sound for both traditional crawlers and AI-driven retrieval systems

• Experiment and scale AEO strategies: optimize content and structured data to earn citations within AI-generated answers, develop new KPIs to quantify brand visibility inside LLMs, and systematize proven tactics across accounts

• Drive local SEO strategy for multi-location and regional clients, including Google Business Profile optimization, local listing management, geo-targeted content, and localization frameworks for international, multi-language accounts

• Implement AI-powered tooling and automation across the organic search workflow. Leverage generative AI for scalable content optimization, automate internal linking and entity extraction pipelines, and monitor real-time intent shifts to keep strategies ahead of algorithm changes

• Track Google core algorithm updates, the rapid evolution of AI-search features, and industry shifts while proactively adapting strategies and briefing clients on impacts and opportunities

EXPERIENCE / KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED

• 7-10 years of progressive SEO experience, with at least 5-7 years in a senior or leadership capacity managing SEO strategy across multiple client accounts or websites

• Deep, hands-on expertise across all SEO disciplines: technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, link acquisition, and local/multi-location SEO

• Demonstrated hands-on experience with AEO, including optimizing content and structured data for citation in AI-generated answers in the major LLM platforms

• Strong command of core analytics and SEO tooling: Google Analytics 4, Google Search Console, SEMrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, BrightEdge, or comparable enterprise platforms

• Proven track record of measurable organic growth across multiple accounts that increased rankings, traffic, and conversion from organic search channels

• Experience leading and developing SEO teams, with strong project management skills and the ability to orchestrate cross-functional initiatives

• Advanced analytical skills and the ability to synthesize large datasets, identify trend patterns, and translate data into actionable strategy

• Familiarity with AI/ML-powered SEO tools, workflows, and enthusiasm for experimenting with generative AI applications in search marketing

• Excellent communicator capable of translating technical SEO complexity into business value for non-technical clients and internal stakeholders

• Current knowledge of Google algorithm updates, E-E-A-T principles, Core Web Vitals, and the evolving AI search landscape

jobs.location: East Coast, United States; Jersey City, New Jersey
jobs.description:
Company introduction:

Compass Pathways plc (Nasdaq: CMPS) is a biotechnology company dedicated to unlocking urgently needed new treatment options in mental health care.

The Company is headquartered in London, UK, with a U.S. office in New Jersey. We believe mental health patients deserve the possibility of a better future. Our initial focus is developing COMP360 psilocybin, a proprietary, investigational, synthetic psilocybin treatment under evaluation for treatment-resistant depression (TRD) and post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD). COMP360 is a potentially first-in-class treatment and has Breakthrough Therapy designation from the U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA), as well as Innovative Licensing and Access Pathway (ILAP) designation in the UK for TRD.

We are leading the world’s largest classic psychedelic clinical program in TRD, and building upon that robust foundation, we are executing a late-stage trial evaluating COMP360 for PTSD, another condition with high unmet need. Our goal is to advance treatments that move the field of psychiatry towards treatment options that offer rapid onset and sustained durability with infrequent dosing. - Compass Pathways

Job overview:

The Senior Manager, REMS & Specialty Pharmacy Operations will support the implementation, execution, and ongoing optimization of the REMS program and specialty pharmacy operational model for COMP360 in the United States. Partnering closely with the Senior Director, this role will help translate approved regulatory requirements and business objectives into compliant, scalable, and patient-centered operational processes.

jobs.title: HVAC Technician
jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

HVAC Technician

Job Type: Full Time, Non-Exempt

Shift: Monday to Friday from 7:00 am to 4:00 pm

Pay: $30.50 to $34.00+ per hour

Location: Taneytown, MD

Who You Are:

As an HVAC Technician, you’ll be responsible for installing, maintaining and repairing heating, ventilation, and air conditioning (HVAC) systems to ensure optimal climate conditions for cannabis cultivation, processing, and storage.

You’ll ensure precise temperature, humidity, and airflow to support healthy plants, top-quality products, and regulatory compliance. Working closely with cultivation and operations teams, you’ll help keep systems running efficiently.

What You’ll Do:

• Install, maintain, and repair HVAC systems: Keep air handlers, dehumidifiers, ventilation units, and CO₂ enrichment systems running smoothly for optimal plant growth.

• Monitor and adjust climate controls: Ensure ideal temperature, humidity, and air circulation levels to maintain a stable cultivation environment.

• Troubleshoot and repair issues: Quickly diagnose and resolve HVAC-related problems to minimize downtime and maintain efficiency.

• Perform preventive maintenance: Regularly clean, replace filters, and inspect system components to extend equipment life and prevent breakdowns.

• Ensure compliance: Follow state and local cannabis industry regulations for climate control, air filtration, odor mitigation, and EPA refrigerant handling guidelines.

• Support energy efficiency efforts: Assist in identifying and implementing solutions to optimize system performance and reduce operating costs.

• Maintain accurate records: Track system performance, maintenance schedules, and compliance reports for internal and regulatory needs.

• Collaborate with teams: Work closely with cultivation, processing, and retail teams to meet facility climate requirements.

• Follow safety and SOP guidelines: Adhere to OSHA standards, company procedures, and assist with contractor coordination for major repairs and inspections.

What You’ll Bring:

• High school diploma or equivalent (required)

• Technical school certification or 1-2 years of experience in commercial or residential HVAC (required)

• At least 5 years of hands-on experience in HVAC installation, repair, and maintenance

• EPA 608 Universal certification (required)

• Strong knowledge of HVAC systems, including heating, cooling, dehumidification, and ventilation

• Understanding of climate control for indoor cultivation, with expertise in temperature and humidity management

• Ability to diagnose and troubleshoot mechanical, electrical, and refrigeration components of HVAC systems

• Attention to detail and efficiency, with the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

Even Better If:

• You have an HVAC certification (preferred).

• You’ve worked in controlled environment agriculture, food processing, or the cannabis industry—a big plus!

• You have a basic understanding of cannabis industry regulations related to air quality and climate control.

• You’re familiar with Building Management Systems (BMS) and how they integrate with HVAC operations.

• You have experience with Variable Frequency Drives (VFDs), including installation, troubleshooting, and programming.

• You’re comfortable using Microsoft Office Suite for documentation and reporting.

Physical Requirements:

While performing the duties of this Job, the employee is regularly required to stand, walk, sit, talk or hear, use hands to finger or feel, reach with hands and arms, climb and balance, stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl. The employee is occasionally required to lift up to 50 lbs. This position has allergen warnings, potential exposure to dust, pollen, and plant pathogens, requires the ability to work in confined spaces, requires a high-stress tolerance, adaptability, and flexibility, and the ability to work in an ever changing environment.

The role will be responsible for taking our hardware from engineering builds to repeatable, on-time production and managing certifications and delivery for our software products.

When an order comes in, you figure out everything that has to happen to deliver on time (materials, builds, testing, certifications, and shipping) and you drive it to completion. You'll lead a small, growing team that covers supply chain, certification management, production coordination, and assembly.

This is a hybrid position working from our Arlington, VA office.

• Lead manufacturing transfer. Move products from prototype to production at our Dayton, OH site and/or contract manufacturers. You'll own build plans, work instructions, test procedures, first-article inspection, and yield ramp, and you'll get hands-on with build and test issues when needed.

• Enable engineering teams. Coach engineers on the documentation that makes a clean handoff possible (BOMs, drawings, test procedures, configuration records).

• Implement and manage PLM. Make the PLM system the single source of truth for BOMs, revisions, and change control, and set up serialization and delivery tracking for full unit traceability.

• Build product operations across the portfolio. Oversee certification and compliance activities for hardware and software products. Over time, extend release, delivery, and operational processes to the full Two Six Products team.

• Lead the team and budget. Manage and grow the team. Own the operating budget and production cost plans, and report on-time delivery, cost, and quality metrics to leadership.

What you will need:

• Bachelor's degree in engineering or a related field

• 9+ years in hardware manufacturing, new product introduction (NPI), or production and product operations for electronics or complex software systems

• 3+ years leading people or cross-functional programs

• A strong record in project or program management, including owning complex product deliveries end to end against committed dates

• Hands-on experience leading at least one manufacturing transfer from prototype through production ramp

• Experience with supply chain management and forecasting for electronic components

• Experience implementing or managing a PLM system

• Experience with budget planning and management

• Familiarity with ATOs, FIPS 140-3, CSfC, or similar certification and authorization processes

• Experience with product operations for software products (release management, delivery, compliance)

• Experience building operations from scratch in a startup or scale-up environment

Security Clearance:

jobs.title: Senior Mechanical Design Engineer
jobs.description:
Key Responsibilities

Mechanical Design & Subsystem Ownership

• Lead the mechanical design of components, mechanisms, and subsystems supporting optics, illumination, electronics packaging, sealing, sterilization, and thermal performance.
• Translate system and subsystem requirements into detailed mechanical designs, specifications, and drawings.
• Drive detailed design execution from concept through prototype build, verification, and manufacturing transfer.
• Apply precision engineering principles, tolerance-driven design, and best practices for robust mechanical integration.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Work closely with Optics, Electrical Engineering, Firmware, Manufacturing, Reliability, Test, and Materials teams to resolve design tradeoffs and integration challenges.
• Actively participate in design reviews, risk assessments, and failure analysis discussions.
• Communicate technical concepts clearly across disciplines a

Prototyping, Testing & Analysis

• Build and iterate on proof-of-concept and engineering prototypes.
• Perform detailed 2D/3D tolerance analysis, stack-up modeling, and basic FEA/simulation to validate design margins.
• Develop and execute verification plans, DOEs, and durability testing to validate performance over the product lifecycle.
• Troubleshoot design and prototype issues using data-driven root-cause analysis.

Manufacturing, DFM/DFA & Supplier Engagement

• Drive DFM/DFA/DFS for assigned components and subsystems to enable scalable manufacturing.
• Collaborate with suppliers on fabrication, finishing, and joining processes (precision machining, molding, casting, coatings, bonding, etc.).
• Support supplier qualification, manufacturing ramp, and yield improvement activities.
• Partner with Manufacturing and Quality to support design transfer, sustaining engineering, and reliability improvements.

Documentation & Compliance

• Generate complete engineering documentation including drawings, tolerance analyses, specifications, test reports, and DHF content.
• Support regulatory and quality-system requirements throughout development.
• Contribute to intellectual property through invention disclosures and technical documentation.

Mentorship & Technical Growth

• Mentor junior engineers through design execution, best practices, and technical problem solving.
• Contribute to continuous improvement of design processes, tools, and standards within the team.

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Expertise

• Strong experience designing precision mechanical components and assemblies for electro-mechanical or opto-mechanical systems.
• Proficiency in SolidWorks 3D CAD, including complex assemblies, GD&T, and functional dimensioning.
• Solid understanding of tolerance analysis, stack-up modeling, and mechanical simulation tools.
• Experience applying DFM/DFA principles for complex or high-volume assemblies.
• Hands-on understanding of mechanical–optical interfaces, electronics packaging, thermal effects, and sterilization-driven design constraints.
• Experience designing fixtures, jigs, and basic calibration or alignment tools.

Execution & Collaboration

• Proven ability to independently own and execute complex mechanical designs.
• Strong problem-solving skills and comfort working in fast-paced, iterative development environments.
• Effective written and verbal communication skills for cross-functional collaboration.
• Ability to manage multiple technical efforts while maintaining clarity and accountability.

Education & Experience Requirements

• BS or higher in Mechanical Engineering, Mechatronics, Robotics, Biomedical Engineering, or a related discipline.
• Minimum 6 years of mechanical design experience in medical devices, robotics, imaging systems, or similarly demanding fields.
• Demonstrated experience across multiple phases of the product lifecycle: concept, design, prototyping, verification, and manufacturing transfer.
• Medical device experience preferred but not required.

jobs.title: Senior Site Reliability Engineer II
jobs.location: New York, NY; Pittsburgh, PA; Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

Responsibilities

• Define and drive observability strategy for IT system and process health, performance, and reliability, including alerting quality, dashboards, and service health indicators.

• Design and implement software-driven solutions within the IT domain, automating manual processes and eliminating operational complexity and toil.

• Act as a technical leader and force multiplier, helping set priorities and influencing decision-making across the entire IT team - support, systems and networks.

• Take ownership of large, ambiguous initiatives, driving them from concept to delivery while aligning stakeholders across IT, engineering and partner teams.

• Proactively identify systemic risks and reliability gaps in both tools and processes, recommending and leading platform upgrades and architectural improvements before they become incidents.

• Provide technical mentorship, architecture guidance, and high-quality design and code reviews for engineers across IT teams.

• Lead by example in documentation and knowledge sharing, ensuring systems and processes are well-understood and not dependent on individual ownership.

• Participate in and help mature incident response, escalation practices, and post-incident learning across the organization.

Desired Experience

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent practical experience.

• 5+ years of experience in site reliability engineering, infrastructure engineering, or platform engineering roles, with demonstrated impact at scale.

Reliability & Troubleshooting

• Expert-level, methodical troubleshooting across the entire stack, from application to kernel to network.

• Strong command-line proficiency and deep expertise in Linux systems and operating system fundamentals.

• Advanced understanding of networking concepts including load balancing, proxies, DNS, TCP/IP, NAT, and service-to-service communication.

Software & Automation

• Experience working across multiple languages (e.g., Python, Go, Bash, and familiarity troubleshooting application stacks such as React or similar). Strong proficiency in at least one.

• Strong track record of automating repetitive and complex operational work to reduce toil and increase reliability.

• Ability to design and build internal tools (Python or Go) that standardize and scale IT practices.

• Comfortable operating in an agile environment, with disciplined testing and quality practices.

Cloud & Platform Engineering

• Experience with cloud platforms (AWS preferred, GCP/Azure acceptable), particularly managed services and production-grade architectures.

• Expertise in Kubernetes and container orchestration (EKS, Helm), including lifecycle management and operational best practices.

• Proven experience designing and implementing observability systems, including metrics, logging, tracing, dashboards, and alerting.

• Deep understanding of container technologies, security scanning, secrets management, dynamic configuration, and microservices architectures.

• Familiarity with service meshes and advanced traffic management concepts.

Infrastructure as Code

• Experience designing and maintaining company-wide IaC codebases using tools such as Terraform, Pulumi, CloudFormation, or Ansible.

• Ability to think holistically about infrastructure design, cost, reliability, security, and long-term maintainability.

Why Join Us:

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

jobs.title: Senior Manager, Database Platform
jobs.description:
Get to Know Us

Horizon3 is a fast-growing, remote cybersecurity company dedicated to the mission of enabling organizations to proactively find and fix and verify exploitable attack vectors before criminals exploit them. Our flagship product, the NodeZeroTM platform, delivers production-safe autonomous pentests and other key assessment operations that scale across the largest internal, external, cloud, and hybrid cloud environments. NodeZero has been adopted by organizations of all sizes, from small educational institutions to government agencies and Global 100 enterprises. It is used by ITOps/SecOps teams, consulting pentesters, and MSSPs and MSPs. 

We are a fusion of former U.S. Special Operations cyber operators, startup engineers, and formerly frustrated cybersecurity practitioners. We're committed to helping solve our common security problems: ineffective security tools, false positives resulting in alert fatigue, blind spots, "checkbox” security culture, cybersecurity skills shortage, and the long lead time and expense of hiring outside consultants. Collectively, we are a team of learn it alls, committed to a culture of respect, collaboration, ownership, and results.

 

What You'll Do

You will lead the Database Platform team — the engineering team responsible for the data infrastructure that underpins every NodeZero pentest, finding, and report. NodeZero operates at scale: millions of discovered assets, tens of millions of vulnerability findings, and audit-critical data that our customers rely on to remediate risk. The Database Platform team owns the design, operation, and reliability of our core data layer — currently PostgreSQL as the primary store and Neo4j for the asset graph, with time-series and analytical stores on the roadmap as NodeZero's data volume and use cases grow. You will lead a team of ~8 engineers including a Principal Engineer, and you will build this team from a strong foundation into a fully staffed, world-class data platform organization.

 - Team Building & Culture: Hire, mentor, and grow the Database Platform team to full capacity. Establish database engineering norms and a culture of ownership for engineers who share responsibility for the most critical data layer in our stack.

 - Data Architecture: Partner with the Principal Engineer to define the technical direction for NodeZero's data platform — schema design standards, query patterns, migration strategies, and scalability principles.

 - Reliability & Operations: Own SLOs for database availability, query latency, and data integrity across production environments. Drive oncall maturity and runbook quality.

 - Data Modeling & Schema Governance: Establish schema review processes and data modeling standards. Ensure NodeZero's data model evolves cleanly as new pentest capabilities ship.

 - Cross-team Partnership: Collaborate with Data Ingestion, Security Research, and API Platform teams to align on data contracts, API design, and pipeline dependencies.

 - Act as a Product Owner: Translate data platform needs from Security Research and Product into a clear, prioritized engineering roadmap.

 

What You'll Bring

Data Platform Leadership & Architecture

 - Demonstrated experience leading teams that design, scale, and operate relational databases (PostgreSQL preferred) and hybrid data stores (graph, time-series, or document) in production at scale.

 - Experience defining schema migration strategies for high-velocity production environments with zero-downtime requirements.

 - Experience with multi-tenant data architectures: customer data isolation, row-level security, and data residency concerns.

 - Strong understanding of database performance: query optimization, indexing strategies, EXPLAIN analysis, and connection pooling.

Team Building & Engineering Culture

 - Experience building or significantly growing an engineering team — including hiring, onboarding, and establishing engineering norms tailored for data-intensive systems.

 - Proven ability to define and instill engineering culture: rigorous schema review, data integrity standards, operational runbooks, and oncall rotation.

 - Drives high-impact architecture decisions rigorously — requires design documents, runs structured reviews, builds consensus across platform teams.

 - Able to partner effectively with a Principal Engineer and leverage their technical leadership without diminishing team ownership.

Technical Expertise

 - Proficient in Go, Python, or SQL (deep expertise).

 - Production experience with PostgreSQL at scale: partitioning, logical replication, pg_bouncer/pgpool, read replicas.

 - Experience with AWS data services: RDS/Aurora, DynamoDB, ElastiCache, or equivalent.

 - Familiarity with graph databases (Neo4j, AWS Neptune) or time-series stores (TimescaleDB, InfluxDB) is a strong plus.

 - Kubernetes and containerized database operations — stateful workload management.

 

Nice to Haves

 - Background in cybersecurity data, threat intelligence feeds, or vulnerability databases.

 - Experience with data platform compliance: SOC 2, FedRAMP, or GDPR/CCPA data handling requirements.

 - Familiarity with analytical query patterns: BI tooling, OLAP workloads, or customer-facing analytics.

 - Experience operating databases in multi-region or active-active configurations.

 

Travel Required

We are a fully remote company, and this job may require up to 5% of travel to be successful.

 

Compensation and Values

At Horizon3, we believe that our people are our greatest asset, and our compensation philosophy reflects this core value. We are committed to fostering an environment where all employees feel valued, respected, and rewarded for their contributions. Our compensation structure is designed to be fair, competitive, and transparent, ensuring that every team member is recognized and compensated equitably across roles, levels, and locations.

In accordance with various State's transparency regulations, we provide the following salary range information for this position:

 - Base salary range: $242,250 - $275,000 annually. The exact salary will be determined based on the selected candidate's location, qualifications, experience, and relevant skills.

 - Additional compensation: All full-time roles are eligible for an equity package in the form of stock options.

 

Perks of Horizon3

 - Inclusive Team: We value diversity and promote an inclusive culture where everyone can thrive.

 - Growth Opportunities: Be part of a dynamic and growing team with numerous career development opportunities.

 - Innovative Culture: Work in a collaborative environment that encourages creativity and out-of-the-box thinking.

 - Hybrid & Remote Work: We embrace a mix of remote and hybrid work models depending on role and location, including our Chicago office, where some roles require regular in-office presence.

 - Competitive Compensation: We offer competitive salary, equity and benefits. Our benefits include health, vision & dental insurance for you and your family, a flexible vacation policy, and generous parental leave.



You Belong Here

Horizon3 is not just an equal opportunity employer - we are a community that values diversity, equity, and inclusion as fundamental principles of our culture and success. We are dedicated to fostering a workplace where everyone feels welcome and respected, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetic information, marital status, or any other legally protected status by law.

Our commitment to diversity and inclusion means we strive to attract, develop, and retain a workforce that reflects the varied communities we serve. We believe that diverse perspectives drive innovation and strengthen our ability to create cutting-edge cybersecurity solutions. At Horizon3, every team member is valued and supported in an environment that encourages personal and professional growth.

We welcome candidates from all backgrounds and experiences, and we encourage all qualified individuals to apply. Come be a part of Horizon3, where your unique contributions are recognized, and your potential is limitless.



Other Duties

jobs.title: Member Care Operations Workforce Optimization Lead
jobs.description:
MISSION

Neko is redefining what prevention means, from treating illness when it arrives, to sustaining health before it's ever at risk. Our mission: make data-driven, preventative care accessible to more people, before symptoms appear. 

In a single, non-invasive visit under an hour, proprietary technology and direct clinical care combine to deliver personalised, actionable insights. It's a team that thinks in 10x, not 10%. Every role here plays a part in building a world where prevention is the norm, and where your work genuinely helps people live longer, healthier lives.



Role Purpose

Great service doesn’t happen by accident. It happens when someone sees demand coming, plans for it with precision, and makes sure the right people are in the right place, at the right time, in the right way.

Neko Health is building a new kind of healthcare: proactive, human, and built around the member. Behind every call answered, every message returned, and every clinic visit that runs smoothly is a team that was in the right place at the right time. Right now, the workforce and analytics foundations that make that possible across our markets are still being built, and you would shape them.

As Workforce Optimization Lead, you will set the vision and strategy for how Member Care Operations forecasts, plans, and optimises its people. That strategy will use data and analytics to anticipate demand across an ever changing mix of channels, and it will fit into our wider Operations architecture. All of it serves one common goal: to reinforce the Neko brand in everything we do and to exceed expectations every time. You will use AI and analytics to make it faster, sharper, and more predictive, without losing the human care at its heart.

You will work cross functionally across the whole of Neko, partnering with teams in every function and region. The scope is global, so you will need to hold one consistent standard while respecting the nuance of each market, language, and labour environment.

We are scaling aggressively, and this is the moment to get it right, before the gap is too deep to unwind. If you want to build something extraordinary, something members feel every time they reach us, this is the role.



What You’ll Deliver in the First 6 to 12 Months

• Build and maintain data driven global and regional demand forecasts across a dynamic, evolving mix of channels (such as phone, email, chat, and messaging), adapting models as new channels launch, volumes shift between them, and member preferences change. Factor in bookings, scan volumes, campaigns, market launches, and seasonality.

• Create capacity plans and schedules that balance service levels, team wellbeing, and cost across time zones, languages, and sites.

• Plan staffing for new market and clinic launches, from opening headcount to ramp up curves.

• Manage real time operations: monitor queues, adjust staffing, and coordinate intraday changes, including follow the sun and cross region coverage.

• Own scheduling processes (shift bids, leave, absence, swaps) while ensuring compliance with local labour laws and working time rules in each country.

• Track, analyse, and report on key metrics such as service level, occupancy, adherence, shrinkage, and forecast accuracy.

• Produce global headcount and hiring plans with Member Care leaders and Talent Acquisition, including onboarding and training schedules.

• Design scalable WFM processes, standards, and playbooks that new markets can adopt quickly.

• Evaluate, implement, and optimise WFM tooling, and explore automation and AI to improve forecasting, scheduling, and analytics.

• Build dashboards and regular reporting for leadership, using analytics to surface trends and flag risks early.

• Coach regional leads and team managers on WFM best practices.



Minimum Requirements

 - 5+ years in workforce management, ideally in a high growth, multichannel, multisite or multicountry service operation.

 - Proven experience supporting international expansion or launching new markets.

 - Strong forecasting, capacity planning, and analytical skills, with high comfort in Excel/Sheets and SQL or a BI tool.

 - Hands on experience with WFM platforms (e.g. NICE, Verint, Assembled, Genesys, or similar).

 - Familiarity with Zendesk or comparable support tooling.

 - Analytical mindset with the ability to turn data into clear recommendations.

 - Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills across cultures and time zones.

 - Calm, proactive approach to real time changes.

 - Working knowledge of labour regulations across multiple countries is a plus.

 - Fluent English; additional European languages are a plus.
   

Preferred

 - Experience in healthcare, wellness, or premium consumer service.

 - Experience building WFM from early stage to a global function.

 - Experience with process automation or AI assisted workflows.
