jobs.title: Senior Territory Account Executive, San Francisco
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Location: San Francisco Bay area

About the Department

Account Executives, Channel Account Managers, Business Development Representatives, Solution Engineers, Customer Success, and Sales Operations - all working together help our customers adopt Cloudflare and create great Internet-enabled experiences. The sales team at Cloudflare helps customers solve real, technical problems while creating the revenue streams that help the company provide free service to millions in our community.

About this Role

This role within the mid-market segment focuses on both the acquisition of new Territory accounts, as well as the expansion of existing customer accounts.  Within the mid-market segment, you will work a set of accounts in the territory sub-segments. The ideal candidate will have both a sales and technical background that enables them to drive customer engagement from technical professionals through to senior executive levels, and across Security, Network, Development and Infrastructure teams.

Key Responsibilities

• Develop and execute a comprehensive account/territory plan to achieve quarterly sales and annual revenue targets in a defined territory and/or account list.

• Drive new business acquisition (new customer logos), customer expansion (upsell and cross sell Cloudflare solutions), and renewal within your territory.

• Engage in account mapping sessions with partners, including training new partners on our technology and GTM strategies.

• Developing scalable relationships with target partners, to expand partner ecosystem in a specific region.

• Build a robust sales pipeline through continual engagement and nurturing of key prospect accounts.

• Understand customer use-cases and how they pair with Cloudflare’s portfolio solutions in order to identify new sales opportunities.

• Craft and communicate compelling value propositions for Cloudflare services. Drive awareness through regular outbound campaigns on product and feature roadmap updates.

• Accurately forecast commercial outcomes by running a consistent sales process, including driving next step expectations and contract negotiations.

• As a trusted advisor, build long-term strategic relationships with key accounts, to ensure customer adoption, retention and expansion. Regularly evaluate usage trends and articulate value to show Cloudflare impact and provide strategic recommendations during business reviews.

• Network across different business units with each of your accounts, and multi-thread to identify and engage new divisional buyers.

• Position Cloudflare's platform in each of your target customers, including Cloudflare One and the Connectivity Cloud to realize our full potential in every customer.

• Operate internally as a liaison with cross-functional teams to share key customer feedback and insights to improve customer experience and further investments with Cloudflare.

Requirements:

• 3+ years of direct B2B selling experience

• Strong interpersonal communication (verbal and written) and organizational skills

• Self-motivated; entrepreneurial spirit

• Comfortable working in a fast paced dynamic environment

• Bachelor's degree required

• Demonstrated analytical and quantitative abilities

• Software and system skills are a must (SFDC, Tableau, G-suite, MSFT suite)

Examples of desirable skills, knowledge and experience:

• 5+ years in Software/SaaS/Security Sales & Channel management.

• Existing relationships and/or strong familiarity of the partner ecosystem in the region that they cover.

• Understanding of cloud infrastructure ecosystem and cloud security is highly preferred.

• Experience working in a start-up environment.

• Ability to travel up to 25% of the time.

• Technical competence strongly preferred.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

For Bay Area-based hires: Estimated annual salary of $244,000 - $336,000

This role is eligible to earn incentive compensation under Cloudflare’s Sales Compensation Plan. The estimated annual salary range includes the on-target incentive compensation that may be attained in this role under the Sales Compensation Plan.

Equity
The role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare's equity plan.

Benefits

Cloudflare offers a complete package of benefits and programs to support you and your family.  Our benefits programs can help you pay health care expenses, support caregiving, build capital for the future and make life a little easier and fun!  The below is a description of our benefits for employees in the United States, and benefits may vary for employees based outside the U.S.

Health & Welfare Benefits

• Medical/Rx Insurance

• Dental Insurance

• Vision Insurance

• Flexible Spending Accounts

• Commuter Spending Accounts

• Fertility & Family Forming Benefits

• On-demand mental health support and Employee Assistance Program

• Global Travel Medical Insurance

Financial Benefits

• Short and Long Term Disability Insurance

• Life & Accident Insurance

• 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan

• Employee Stock Participation Plan

Time Off

• Flexible paid time off covering vacation and sick leave Leave programs, including parental, pregnancy health, medical, and bereavement leave

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. We will continue to abide by our privacy commitment and ensure that no user data is sold to advertisers or used to target consumers.

Sound like something you’d like to be a part of? We’d love to hear from you!

Please note that applicants who progress to the offer stage of the interview process may be asked to attend an in-person interview within one of the Cloudflare Offices or Cloudflare Hubs.  More details about this will be available at that stage of the interview process.

Please note that any offer of employment may be conditioned on your authorization to receive software or technology controlled under these U.S. export laws without sponsorship for an export license.

jobs.title: Practice Access Manager (Bilingual - Spanish)
jobs.description:
Company Overview:

Blink Health is the fastest growing healthcare technology company that builds products to make prescriptions accessible and affordable to everybody.  Our two primary products – BlinkRx and Quick Save – remove traditional roadblocks within the current prescription supply chain, resulting in better access to critical medications and improved health outcomes for patients.

BlinkRx is the world’s first pharma-to-patient cloud that offers a digital concierge service for patients who are prescribed branded medications. Patients benefit from transparent low prices, free home delivery, and world-class support on this first-of-its-kind centralized platform. With BlinkRx, never again will a patient show up at the pharmacy only to discover that they can’t afford their medication, their doctor needs to fill out a form for them, or the pharmacy doesn’t have the medication in stock.

We are a highly collaborative team of builders and operators who invent new ways of working in an industry that historically has resisted innovation. Join us!

The Practice Access Manager (PAM) is a customer-facing role that will be responsible for managing defined accounts within a specific region or territory, to support access for providers. The role will provide education to healthcare providers and office staff on access services and reimbursement solutions based on manufacturer business rules and the BlinkRx platform.

The PAM will demonstrate a compliant and consultative approach providing education to offices related to the BlinkRx access solutions and prior authorizations.

What You’ll Do:

• Educate and inform health care providers and their staff of the services and benefits offered by BlinkRx to help patients get on and stay on medication therapy as prescribed

• Engage with providers and their staff to reconfirm the benefits and grow their usage of BlinkRx

• Conduct proactive outbound outreach to provider offices via phone, identifying and acting on growth opportunities, and positioning access solutions for new and existing patients

• Maintain ongoing account conversations and relationships across an assigned territory. Managing a regular cadence of touchpoints, tracking engagement, and ensuring continuity of service for provider offices

• Act as the first point of contact for an office regarding any inquiries with a specific prescription or patient, while serving as the voice of the field within BlinkRx. Build personal relationships with practices and offices to create an experience they value, removing barriers to access.

• Create custom profiles for the healthcare providers preferences for prior authorization support and status updates

• Become the go-to resource for both reactive and proactive engagement with the Brand Field team by assisting with any Healthcare Provider and BlinkRx related questions

• Introduce partner field reps to BlinkRx as an option for healthcare providers and their patients

• Compliantly provide approved communication to healthcare providers regarding the status of their patients

What You’ll Need:

• Fluent in both English and Spanish (written and verbal) to effectively serve our Spanish-speaking clients

• Background in pharmacy sales, healthcare account management, or outbound sales in a healthcare/pharma setting is strongly preferred

• Understanding of prescription workflows and how they operate across provider offices and pharmacy channel

• Solution oriented mindset with strong analytic capabilities

• A natural client success and account management ability with exceptional communication and interpersonal skills, as well as a keen ability to build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external clients.

• Comfort with an outbound call motion. Must have the ability to contact provider offices, introduce new products or services, and drive conversations forward with confidence and professionalism

• Willingness to travel as business needs demand, including attendance at internal training sessions, industry conferences, and occasional in-person HCP (Healthcare Provider) visits.

• Ability to thrive in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

• Ability to prioritize duties and manage multiple projects from start to finish with minimal supervision. Strong time-management and organizational skills

• Must be able to exercise strict confidentiality and have impeccable judgment

• Ability to coordinate several tasks simultaneously

• Experience in working with a CRM (eg Salesforce) and softphone system is preferred

Why Join Us:

It is rare to have a company that both deeply impacts its customers and is able to provide its services across a massive population.  At Blink, we have a huge impact on people when they are most vulnerable: at the intersection of their healthcare and finances. We are also the fastest growing healthcare company in the country and are driving that impact across millions of new patients every year.  Our business model not only helps people, but drives economics that allow us to build a generational company. We are a relentlessly learning, constantly curious, and aggressively collaborative cross-functional team dedicated to inventing new ways to improve the lives of our customers.

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity of all kinds. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Actuarial Associate, Insurance Risk Modeling
jobs.description:
COMPANY OVERVIEW

KKR is a leading global investment firm that offers alternative asset management as well as capital markets and insurance solutions. KKR aims to generate attractive investment returns by following a patient and disciplined investment approach, employing world-class people, and supporting growth in its portfolio companies and communities. KKR sponsors investment funds that invest in private equity, credit and real assets and has strategic partners that manage hedge funds. KKR’s insurance subsidiaries offer retirement, life and reinsurance products under the management of Global Atlantic Financial Group. References to KKR’s investments may include the activities of its sponsored funds and insurance subsidiaries.

Actuarial Associate, Insurance Risk Modeling

Build the models that move the business

If you love being hands-on with models — architecting them, breaking them, stress-testing them, and making them better — this role is built for you. As an Actuarial Associate on GA Risk's modelling team, you'll spend your days deep in the mechanics of insurance liability models that drive real decisions: how products are priced, how billions in liabilities are valued, how risk is hedged, and how the firm manages its balance sheet. You'll own models end to end and see your work shape live pricing and risk decisions.

What makes this role different

You won't be maintaining someone else's black box. You'll be developing and enhancing liability models directly in our risk platform, running stresses across GAAP, Stat, Econ, and Bermuda lenses to understand how liabilities behave under pressure, and building the analytical tools that let Risk challenge the status quo on modeling and pricing.

You'll also sit close to the action. As new products launch and institutional transactions come onboard, you'll be the one bringing them onto the platform — which means you'll understand the full picture of both actuarial and market risk, not just a narrow slice of it.

AI is going to be central in what you do.  It is already elevating everything the team does and you will be asked to explore and integrate with AI with your daily work in every way possible.

What you'll do

• Develop and enhance insurance liability models in KKR Insurance Risk's liability modeling platform.

• Perform liability stresses under multiple lenses (GAAP / Stat / Econ / Bermuda), building a deep understanding of both actuarial and market risk.

• Onboard institutional transactions onto the Risk platform.

• Support new product launches and keep risk models current with rate changes and new product features

• Run validation and control reviews of actuarial and financial models, including critical assessment of the methodologies and assumptions behind them

• Build quantitative models and analytical tools that empower Risk to provide constructive challenges to current risk management, modeling, and pricing practices

• Communicate findings and their implications clearly to Risk's leadership and business stakeholders

What you'll bring

• Bachelor's degree in quantitative disciplines

• 4+ years in a diversified life and annuity / financial or actuarial consulting environment

• 4+ years modeling insurance products, with a proven track record on complex products, ideally with MG-ALFA/Pathwise/PolySystem experiences.

• Clear, compelling communication skills, especially when translating technical concepts for both technical and non-technical audiences

Nice to have:

• Professional designation such as FSA / ASA or CFA

• Working knowledge of life and annuity products

• Prior hedging or ALM experience

• Strong Python skills — highly desired.

This role is not eligible for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

This is the expected annual base salary range for this New York-based position. Actual salaries may vary based on factors, such as skill, experience, and qualification for the role. Employees may be eligible for a discretionary bonus, based on factors such as individual and team performance.

jobs.title: Director of Security Operations and Engineering
jobs.description:
A Little About Us

EDB provides a data and AI platform that enables organizations to harness the full power of Postgres for transactional, analytical, and AI workloads across any cloud, anywhere. EDB empowers enterprises to control risk, manage costs and scale efficiently for a data and AI led world. Serving more than 1,500 customers globally and as the leading contributor to the vibrant and fast-growing PostgreSQL community, EDB supports major government organizations, financial services, media and information technology companies. EDB’s data-driven solutions enable customers to modernize legacy systems and break data silos while leveraging enterprise-grade open source technologies. EDB delivers the confidence of up to 99.999% high availability with mission critical capabilities built in such as security, compliance controls, and observability. For more information, visit www.enterprisedb.com

The Role:

You'll lead Security Operations and Security Engineering at EDB, reporting to the CISO as a trusted member of the security leadership team. You own how we detect, respond, and (increasingly) prevent. That means the people, the platforms, and the playbooks behind threat detection, incident response, and the engineering that makes them scale.

You'll be a peer to the leaders across security, including Governance, Risk & Compliance and Application Security & Vulnerability Management, and you'll help shape the direction of the broader InfoSec organization. You'll also partner closely with peer leaders in IT and Product, because most of the controls we define live in their systems, pipelines, and roadmaps. This is a scaling role. The business is growing fast, and so is everything security has to cover: more products, more cloud, more acquired companies and environments to bring up to a common standard. You'll decide what to build, what to automate, and where to add people, so the program grows ahead of the risk instead of behind it. As EDB grows, so will the scope and opportunity of the role.

One leader owns both Security Operations and Security Engineering on purpose: the best incident is the one that never happens. What we learn from detection and response feeds directly into the engineering of preventive controls, so we move from detecting bad things to making them impossible, and from manual triage to automation and agents that give analysts leverage. If you want to build that, and grow a program and a team as the company grows, this is the seat.

What your impact will be:

• Incident response end to end, from intake and severity model through after-action and improvement, including partnership with Legal on investigations

• Detection engineering, threat hunting, and the SIEM, EDR, SOAR, and cloud security platforms that support them

• Security Engineering strategy and delivery, with the goal of preventing incidents rather than responding to them: preventive controls, least privilege, and identity assurance across employees, contractors, and build systems

• The insider threat program, built with HR, Legal, and IT

• Automation and agentic AI that extends analyst capacity (the analyst always owns the decision)

• Security integration of acquired companies and new environments into EDB's standards

• Close partnership with IT and Product leadership to build preventive controls into the platforms, pipelines, and products they own, plus security input to third-party risk and device posture with GRC

• Scaling the program: the org design, operating rhythms, roadmap, budget, and vendor strategy that let coverage grow with the business without growing linearly with headcount

What you will bring:

• 5+ years of management experience leading security teams

• 7+ years of hands-on experience in security operations, incident response, detection, or security engineering

• A track record of scaling a security function through rapid growth (hiring, automation, and operating discipline), not just running one

• Strategic thinking that goes beyond the immediate scope of the role

• The ability to translate technical risk into business impact for executives, legal, customers, and your IT and Product counterparts

• Comfort in a global, remote-first environment with flexible schedules and on-call responsibilities

What will give you an edge:

• Hands-on scripting or automation experience (Python, Go, etc.)

• Experience applying AI or agent-based automation to security workflows

• Cloud security experience and background in M&A security integration

• Experience building an insider threat or identity assurance program

EDB is committed to supporting our employees' overall well being by offering a range of benefits and resources to promote a healthy work-life balance and wellness. We provide access to CuraLinc to aid employees in health and wellness tips and practices, as well as Wellness Fridays extending to December 2026! Check out our career site for more information on perks and benefits and reach out to our Talent Acquisition team for region specific benefits.

We know it takes a unique mix of people and skills to help us in our mission to supercharge Postgres, and we understand that not everyone will check every box. We’d love to hear from you and we want you to apply!

As an Advertising Campaign Strategist (ACS) at Demandbase, you'll play a critical role in helping our customers realize the full value of their investment in our advertising solutions. jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash’s mission is to grow and empower local economies. By building intelligent, last-mile delivery technology for local cities, DoorDash connects people with the local businesses they care about — helping grow businesses and the communities that support those businesses. The Marketing Technology team is responsible for delivering best-in-class tools, data, and processes so teams at DoorDash can effectively acquire new customers, drive retention, and grow new business lines across all our audiences. Our mission is to enable teams to deliver personalized, engaging, and relevant content across all our owned and paid channels. We partner closely with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and Analytics teams to translate Marketing’s technology needs into measurable business outcomes for our Growth and Performance Marketing teams.

The B2B Marketing Technology team does this for DoorDash's business customers. It owns marketing automation, the B2B websites, and the data flows between the tools used by our marketing and sales teams.

About the Role

We're seeking a Senior Manager to lead B2B Marketing Technology at DoorDash. You will own the B2B marketing technology stack: our marketing automation platform, its connection to sales tools, the B2B websites, and the data model and flows that connect them. You will set web and information architecture, define attribution priorities, close data gaps, and redesign our B2B marketing system architecture, building automations yourself when needed. You will lead the B2B MarTech team and partner with B2B Marketing, Go-to-Market Technology, Sales and Operations, Product, Engineering, and Data to set the long-term B2B marketing technology roadmap.

This role will report to the Director, Marketing Technology within the Growth Marketing organization.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Own the strategy, architecture, and roadmap for B2B marketing automation across our business lines.

• Design how leads move between HubSpot, Salesforce, and the data warehouse, including deduplication, scoring, routing, and lifecycle stages.

• Define the marketing data model and attribution priorities with B2B Marketing, Sales and Operations, and Data, and close data gaps across web, marketing automation, CRM, and the warehouse.

• Put monitoring, data quality standards, and governance in place so problems are caught before they affect campaigns, lead routing, or reporting.

• Set web and information architecture for the B2B websites. This covers the CMS, forms, tracking, tag governance, and the move to AI-native site infrastructure. Define standards rather than fulfilling page requests one at a time.

• Run an experimentation program on the B2B websites to improve conversion.

• Make keep, add, build, and retire decisions on B2B marketing tools based on cost, usage, and business impact.

• Own adoption of the B2B marketing stack, including the processes, training, and documentation that let B2B Marketing teams get full value from HubSpot and the B2B websites.

• Lead and grow the B2B MarTech team across web platforms, web development, and marketing operations.

• Partner with Go-to-Market Technology on architecture, system ownership, and the Salesforce roadmap.

• Serve as B2B Marketing’s technical lead with Product and Engineering, building business cases and prioritizing requests so resources go to the highest-impact problems.

• Advise marketing and go-to-market leadership on B2B marketing technology, with clear recommendations as goals and business needs change.

• Report on speed of lead handoff to sales, lead-to-pipeline conversion, data reliability, and time to launch.

We’re excited about you because you have…

• 8+ years in B2B marketing technology, marketing operations, or revenue operations, including 2+ years managing people across technical and operations roles.

• Deep expertise with an enterprise marketing automation platform (such as HubSpot, Marketo, or Pardot) and Salesforce, and a strong technical understanding of how marketing systems connect: APIs, webhooks, data warehouses, CMS, and tag management. You can review a system design and identify risks.

• Experience designing a marketing data model (objects, fields, lifecycle and lead status, deduplication) and setting attribution and data quality priorities.

• Experience owning a B2B marketing website's architecture and improving conversion through experimentation.

• Experience selecting and managing B2B marketing and sales tools (such as 6sense, ZoomInfo, Clay, or Chili Piper), including vendor and agency relationships and build, buy, or retire decisions.

• A track record of turning marketing requirements into technical specifications with Product and Engineering, and of influencing senior stakeholders without authority by explaining tradeoffs clearly.

• A bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience.

• Nice to have: experience with data enrichment tools such as HubSpot Data Hub, querying data in Sigma or Tableau, and building automations or integrations, including with AI coding tools such as Claude Code or Cursor.

Why You’ll Love Working at DoorDash because…

• We are leaders - Leadership is not limited to our management team. It’s something everyone at DoorDash embraces and embodies.

• We are doers - We believe the only way to predict the future is to build it. Creating solutions that will lead our company and our industry is what we do -- on every project, every day.

• We are learners - We’re not afraid to dig in and uncover the truth, even if it’s scary or inconvenient. Everyone here is continually learning on the job, no matter if we’ve been in a role for one year or one minute.

• We are customer-obsessed - Our mission is to grow and empower local economies. We are committed to our customers, merchants, and dashers and believe in connecting people with possibility.

• We are all DoorDash - The magic of DoorDash is our people, together making our inspiring goals attainable and driving us to greater heights.

We expect this position to be filled by 08/12/2026

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

At DoorDash, our mission to empower local economies shapes how our team members move quickly, learn, and reiterate in order to make impactful decisions that display empathy for our range of users—from Dashers to merchant partners to consumers. We are a technology and logistics company that started by enabling door-to-door delivery, and we are looking for team members who can help us go from a company that is known as the place you order food to a company that people turn to for any and all goods.

DoorDash is growing rapidly and changing constantly, which gives our team members the opportunity to share their unique perspectives, solve new challenges, and own their careers. You’ll be at the forefront of building the repeatable pipeline: uncovering attractive market opportunities, finding exceptional underwriting leaders, helping find capacity partners, and launching programs.

Our approach starts with people and opportunity—not just a predetermined list of product lines. When we find an underwriting leader with deep expertise in a profitable niche, we want to explore building a program around them on the Nirvana platform. You’ll help make those connections happen.

This is a hands-on, relationship-driven, new program development role for someone who already knows the insurance ecosystem and has a network they can put to work. You’ll report directly to the General Manager, and have a front row seat in shaping the future of our growth.

jobs.title: Inference Optimization Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT HEDRA

Hedra is the platform, models, and infrastructure for visual intelligence.

We build models and systems that push the frontier of visual intelligence, along with the infrastructure required to make those models fast, efficient, reliable, and accessible at scale.

We’re a small, highly technical team in San Francisco, backed by a16z and other leading investors. Researchers and engineers at Hedra work closely across boundaries, own problems end to end, and have significant influence over both what we build and how we build it.


THE ROLE

We’re looking for an Inference Optimization Engineer to work alongside our research team on making state-of-the-art visual models fast and efficient at inference time.

You’ll work at the boundary between research and systems, taking new model architectures and figuring out how to run them efficiently on modern hardware. That means understanding where time and memory are being spent, identifying opportunities for algorithmic and systems-level improvements, and implementing optimizations across model architecture, inference algorithms, runtimes, kernels, and distributed execution.

The problems rarely live neatly within one layer of the stack. Depending on what you find, you might modify how a model executes, develop a new inference technique, write a custom GPU kernel, rethink memory movement, or change how work is distributed across accelerators.

We care more about technical depth, curiosity, and demonstrated ability than years of experience. We’re open to experienced ML systems engineers as well as exceptional early-career engineers or researchers who have already gone unusually deep on model performance, GPU systems, or efficient inference.


WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Work directly with research scientists and engineers to make new visual models fast and efficient at inference time.

 - Profile model architectures and workloads to understand bottlenecks across compute, memory, communication, and model execution.

 - Develop and implement new approaches to improving inference latency, throughput, memory efficiency, and GPU utilization.

 - Explore algorithmic optimizations including quantization, sparsity, caching, compilation, attention optimizations, and alternative execution strategies.

 - Build or optimize GPU kernels using CUDA, Triton, or similar technologies when existing implementations leave performance on the table.

 - Optimize model execution across single-GPU, multi-GPU, and multi-node environments.

 - Reason about the interaction between model architecture and hardware, and work with researchers when architectural changes can unlock meaningful performance improvements.

 - Investigate communication, memory movement, parallelism, and distributed execution strategies for large visual models.

 - Build rigorous benchmarking, profiling, and performance-regression infrastructure to understand performance and evaluate new optimization ideas.

 - Evaluate new inference runtimes, compilers, frameworks, optimization techniques, and accelerator hardware.

 - Stay close to advances in efficient inference, GPU programming, model architectures, compilers, and ML systems research, and rapidly test promising ideas.

 - Help turn research breakthroughs into models that can be deployed and served efficiently at scale.


WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR

 - Deep technical ability in efficient ML inference, ML systems, GPU computing, or adjacent research, demonstrated through research, production engineering, open-source contributions, or unusually ambitious independent work.

 - Strong understanding of how modern deep learning models execute on hardware, including the relationship between compute, memory, communication, and performance.

 - Experience profiling ML workloads, identifying bottlenecks, forming hypotheses, and driving measurable performance improvements.

 - Strong programming fundamentals in Python, C++, or another systems-oriented language.

 - Experience with some combination of PyTorch, CUDA, Triton, TensorRT, vLLM, SGLang, or comparable technologies.

 - Ability to reason across abstraction layers rather than treating model architecture, framework, runtime, kernel, and hardware boundaries as fixed.

 - Strong intuition for performance tradeoffs across latency, throughput, memory, numerical precision, model quality, and complexity.

 - Curiosity about how models work internally and a willingness to modify or rethink existing approaches when the performance problem calls for it.

 - Comfort working on ambiguous problems where the bottleneck, and sometimes even the right question, is not known in advance.

 - Ability to communicate technical ideas clearly and collaborate closely with research scientists and engineers.

We don’t expect every candidate to have experience across the entire stack. Exceptional depth in one or more relevant areas, combined with the ability and curiosity to reason across the others, matters more to us than checking every box.


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience optimizing large generative, multimodal, vision, or video models.

 - CUDA, Triton, CUTLASS, or other GPU kernel development.

 - Deep knowledge of GPU architecture, memory hierarchy, and hardware-aware optimization.

 - Experience with attention optimization, kernel fusion, memory-efficient execution, or custom operators.

 - Model compilation or graph optimization experience.

 - Quantization, sparsity, caching, speculative execution, or other efficient inference techniques.

 - Experience optimizing diffusion, autoregressive, transformer, or other large generative architectures.

 - Multi-GPU or multi-node model execution, including tensor, pipeline, sequence, or other forms of parallelism.

 - Experience optimizing communication or data movement between accelerators.

 - Experience with profiling tools such as Nsight Systems or Nsight Compute.

 - Contributions to ML systems, inference runtimes, compilers, GPU libraries, or performance-focused open-source projects.

 - Research or publications in efficient ML, ML systems, GPU computing, compilers, or related areas.


BENEFITS:

 - Competitive compensation and equity

 - 401k

 - Healthcare (Silver PPO Medical, Vision, Dental)

 - Lunch and snacks at the office

This role is based in San Francisco, and we work together in person five days a week.

jobs.title: Scheduling Manager
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a  Scheduling Manager for a critical leadership role supporting complex, multi-project programs. This position is essential to ensuring schedule integrity, alignment, and delivery across programs where precision, foresight, and strong leadership directly impact outcomes.

In this role, you will lead scheduling efforts across medium to large-scale programs, integrating multiple project schedules into a cohesive program framework while managing interdependencies, risks, and resource alignment. This is an opportunity for an experienced scheduling professional to influence program-level delivery, mentor high-performing teams, and contribute to the successful execution of transportation programs within a global organization.

The responsibilities of the Scheduling Manager include the following:

• Oversee and execute scheduling-related activities for medium to large-scale programs with meticulous attention to detail.
• Spearhead scheduling efforts across multiple projects within the program, ensuring strict alignment with overall program objectives and seamlessly integrating project schedules into a comprehensive program schedule.
• Identify, develop, and correlate program schedule activities with associated program plans
• Provide periodic updates and documentation to Program Management
• Conduct thorough analysis to identify and address interdependencies between projects, proactively mitigating risks and resolving conflicts to maintain program integrity.
• Engage in strategic collaboration with project managers to ensure optimal resource allocation and utilization, critical to program success.
• Maintain close working relationships with senior leadership to define and refine program-level objectives, ensuring alignment with organizational goals.
• Provide authoritative scheduling guidance and rigorous oversight to project controls teams, ensuring effective management of individual project elements and overall program cohesion.
• Implement and continuously monitor risk mitigation strategies, conducting regular evaluations to ensure their effectiveness and adjust as necessary.
• Facilitate clear, concise, and timely communication between project teams and stakeholders, ensuring all parties are fully informed of critical program developments.
• Deliver comprehensive and analytical updates to senior leadership on program progress, challenges, and achievements, providing strategic insights for decision-making.

Minimum Requirements:

• BA/BS + 8 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education

Preferred Requirements:

jobs.title: SaaS & Enterprise Application Manager (NY)
jobs.description:
Position Title: SaaS & Enterprise Application Manager (NY)

Entity: KBRA Holdings, LLC

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: New York, New York

Summary/Overview:

KBRA is seeking an experienced, hands-on SaaS & Enterprise Application Managerto lead, mature, and scale its Business Applications function within our Infrastructure department.

This role is responsible for leading and evolving KBRA's Business Applications practice and enterprise application portfolio. The position will own the strategy, governance, lifecycle management, and day-to-day operation of KBRA's SaaS and business application ecosystem, while serving as a key technology partner to business stakeholders across the firm. This is not a developer or product manager role.

As KBRA continues to expand its SaaS footprint, the Business Applications function is expected to play an increasingly strategic role in evaluating, onboarding, integrating, governing, and optimizing enterprise applications across the organization. This role will establish Business Applications as KBRA's center of excellence for SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, identity integrations, and application governance while building the processes, operational visibility, and business partnerships necessary to support that growth.

This is a highly hands-on leadership role where the manager is expected to actively contribute to engineering, administration, troubleshooting, integrations, and project delivery while simultaneously driving strategy, governance, operational maturity, and team development.

The ideal candidate is a proactive technical leader who does not wait for detailed direction, but instead assesses the environment, identifies priorities, creates plans, communicates clearly, and drives execution. This individual should be capable of building visibility into the team's work, developing operational metrics, creating technology roadmaps, and translating business needs into scalable technology solutions.

This role will participate in team on-call rotations. Occasional travel to other KBRA offices may be required based on operational and project needs.

About the Job:

The SaaS & Enterprise Application Manager will own and lead the management of KBRA's SaaS platforms and enterprise application ecosystem. This includes platforms such as Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, Box, Atlassian products, learning management systems, compliance and communication platforms, document and content management systems, and other business-owned or enterprise SaaS applications.

The role will partner closely with business groups such as Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product, Information Security, Infrastructure Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, IT Support, and other stakeholders on application selection, onboarding, configuration, integration, governance, lifecycle planning, and long-term ownership strategies.

Success in this role requires a leader who can balance strategic planning and people leadership with direct technical execution. This is not a role where responsibilities can be delegated entirely to others. The manager is expected to remain deeply involved in the technical and operational work of the team while helping build a mature, scalable Business Applications function.

About You:

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership, Strategy, and Portfolio Management

• Lead and evolve KBRA's Business Applications function, establishing the strategy, operating model, and roadmap for enterprise applications and SaaS platforms.

• Own KBRA's enterprise application portfolio, including application inventory, ownership models, governance standards, lifecycle management, vendor relationships, operational risk oversight and opportunities for consolidation, rationalization, and modernization.

• Develop and maintain roadmaps for SaaS governance, identity integrations, automation, operational maturity, and application modernization.

• Establish operational metrics, reporting and portfolio insights that provide visibility into application health, team performance, project delivery, platform adoption, operational risks, and workload.

• Mentor and develop team members while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, communication, and continuous improvement.

Business Partnership and SaaS Enablement

• Serve as a strategic technology partner to business leaders, helping evaluate solutions and align technology investments with business objectives.

• Partner with stakeholders across Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product and other business groups to understand requirements, define ownership models, and support long-term application strategy.

• Guide the evaluation, onboarding, adoption and governance of SaaS platforms and business applications.

• Provide technical and operational guidance on application architecture, integrations, access models, governance, support strategies and lifecycle planning.

• Identify opportunities to improve business processes through automation, application enhancements, integrations and better utilization of existing technology investments.

SaaS Engineering, Governance, and Operational Excellence

• Provide hands-on administration, configuration, support and troubleshooting across KBRA's SaaS and enterprise application ecosystem.

• Configure and maintain SSO integrations for internally developed applications, third-party SaaS platforms, and enterprise systems using Microsoft Entra ID and related technologies.

• Manage identity, access, provisioning, entitlement management and authentication services across enterprise applications.

• Administer and support platforms such as Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, Box, Atlassian products, learning management systems, compliance platforms and other business-critical applications.

• Lead enterprise application initiatives, including integrations, APIs, provisioning workflows, reverse proxy solutions, platform implementations and operational transitions from planning through ongoing support.

• Own application governance, including onboarding standards, access reviews, testing, deployment coordination, upgrade planning, lifecycle management and retirement processes.

• Partner with Information Security, Infrastructure Engineering, Endpoint Engineering and IT Support to ensure applications remain secure, compliant, supportable and aligned with enterprise standards.

• Coordinate vendor relationships, technical escalations, platform reviews, renewals and optimization initiatives.

• Act as the senior escalation point for complex application, integration, identity and access-related issues while driving automation, process improvements and service maturity across the function.

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, identity management, business systems or related technology functions.

• 2+ years of experience leading projects, mentoring engineers, managing technical teams or owning enterprise application initiatives.

• Strong hands-on experience administering SaaS and enterprise application environments.

• Strong experience with Microsoft 365 administration, configuration, governance and operational support.

• Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure/Entra enterprise applications, SSO, SAML/OIDC, access controls, identity integrations, and authentication troubleshooting.

• Experience managing SaaS integrations, user provisioning, identity governance, entitlement models and access management.

• Experience supporting or leading enterprise SaaS implementations and application modernization initiatives.

• Experience developing technology roadmaps, operational metrics, governance processes or service maturity initiatives.

• Experience partnering directly with business leaders to evaluate, implement and support technology solutions.

• Strong understanding of application lifecycle management, change management, testing, deployment planning and operational support.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, project leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to balance hands-on technical responsibilities with leadership, planning, mentoring and strategic ownership.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent work experience.

• Familiarity with Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, data insights, and general productivity is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with platforms such as Slack, Zoom, Box, Atlassian products, CMS/DMS platforms, learning management systems, compliance platforms, vendor management platforms, asset management platforms, ERP systems and similar enterprise SaaS tools.

• Experience supporting Microsoft 365 add-ins, application permissions, administrative controls and governance processes.

• Experience with SaaS automation, scripting, APIs, provisioning workflows, reporting or operational automation.

• Experience serving as a technology partner to business stakeholders for enterprise application selection, implementation and governance.

• Experience building operational metrics, dashboards, roadmaps, standards or governance processes for an enterprise applications team.

• Experience in financial services, regulated environments or organizations with strong compliance and security requirements.

Salary Range:

The anticipated annual base salary range for this full-time position is $130,000 to $160,000. Offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience, skills, geography, and other job-related factors.

Benefits:

jobs.title: Lead Vulnerability Researcher
jobs.description:
At Two Six Technologies, we build, deploy, and implement innovative products that solve the world’s most complex challenges today. Through unrivaled collaboration and unwavering trust, we push the boundaries of what’s possible to empower our team and support our customers in building a safer global future.

Overview Opportunity

Two Six Technologies is actively seeking a Lead Vulnerability Researcher to join our Communication Systems team in Arlington, Virginia. The team is composed of intellectual individuals, passionate about software and firmware reverse engineering to uncover vulnerabilities in wireless and embedded communications systems. The team is growing and looking for someone with a cybersecurity research background who has an understanding on how to lead task execution, discover security weaknesses, and develop innovative proof-of-concept exploits on complex, real-world targets. If you are actively using IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, Ghidra, Python, and C/C++, the team wants to talk to you!

What You Will Do

• Lead the technical planning, task prioritization, and schedule management for a group of reverse engineering and vulnerability research assignments supporting mission-critical government programs.

• Reverse engineer wireless and embedded communications systems to identify security weaknesses, assess their operational impact, and analyze firmware, software protections, and network protocols.

• Develop maintainable proof-of-concept exploits for discovered vulnerabilities following DevOps best practices, while creating and refining custom binary analysis and disassembly tools.

• Work autonomously with latitude for independent judgment, providing technical direction, guidance, and task-level mentorship to CNO developers and team members in a fast-paced environment.

• Support business development and program growth by contributing ideas, technical solutions, and content to proposal development efforts.

What You Will Need (Basic Qualifications)

• Bachelor’s (or higher) degree in Computer Science, Computer/Electrical Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent practical experience).

• Extensive experience with programming/scripting languages in C/C++, Python, and Linux command-line environments, with a demonstrated track record of providing thorough solutions to a wide range of difficult technical problems.

• Proven capability in leading technical task execution, managing schedule priorities, and providing technical direction and guidance to team members.

• Extensive hands-on experience in software/firmware reverse engineering and vulnerability research using industry tools such as IDA Pro, Binary Ninja, or Ghidra.

• Applied domain expertise in one or more core areas: firmware analysis (ARM, MIPS, PowerPC, RTOS), firmware rehosting/emulation (QEMU), fuzzing and exploit development, binary obfuscation/anti-analysis techniques, wireless protocol/RF signal analysis, or fault injection frameworks.

Nice to Have (Preferred)

• Experience contributing technical content, solutions, and ideas to proposal and business development efforts.

• Experience scripting with the Binary Ninja API or Ghidra plugin framework, and embedded software development in C/C++ for RTOS or Linux environments.

• In-depth knowledge of cryptographic security, secure boot mechanisms, side-channel analysis, and defeating modern exploit mitigations (ASLR, DEP, Stack Canaries).

• Hands-on experience working with hardware debugging tools (JTAG/SWD), software-defined radio (SDR) frameworks, digital signal processing, or client-facing technical demonstrations.

Clearance Requirement

• Active U.S. Security Clearance at the Top Secret level with the ability to obtain and maintain TS/SCI.

jobs.title: Manager, Global Demand Gen Operations
jobs.description:
Why Choose Bottomline?

Are you ready to transform the way businesses pay and get paid? Bottomline is a global leader in business payments and cash management, with over 35 years of experience and moving more than $16 trillion in payments annually. We're looking for passionate individuals to join our team and help drive impactful results for our customers. If you're dedicated to delighting customers and promoting growth and innovation - we want you on our team!

What’s the role?

As Manager, Global Demand Gen Operations, you will be the operational partner to the Head of Global Sales Development and SDR Managers, helping the global SDR organization run efficiently every day while building the capabilities needed for the future. You will connect people, process, data, technology, reporting, and AI so SDRs and managers can focus on execution, coaching, and pipeline creation.

This is a strategic and hands-on role. You will translate frontline needs into practical workflows, clear operating standards, trusted reporting, connected systems, and responsive support across North America and the UK. You will own the roadmap for the SDR technology ecosystem while staying close to the day-to-day needs of the team, including lead and account flow, system access, reporting, process questions, adoption, and issue resolution.

You will establish and lead an SDR Operations Center of Excellence that creates consistency without slowing the business down. The Center of Excellence will bring together intake and prioritization, process ownership, documentation, training, governance, adoption, and continuous improvement. You will lead two direct reports, one based in North America and one based in the UK, to provide dependable regional coverage and a consistent global service model.

How you’ll contribute

• Serve as the primary operational partner to the Head of Global Sales Development and SDR Managers, maintaining a clear view of team priorities, operational pain points, and day-to-day support needs.

• Build and run an SDR Operations Center of Excellence that provides clear ownership, service standards, intake and prioritization, documentation, training, governance, and continuous improvement.

• Lead day-to-day SDR operational support across North America and the UK, ensuring requests and issues are captured, prioritized, routed, resolved, documented, and communicated consistently.

• Own and improve core SDR workflows, including lead and account routing, assignment, ownership changes, handoffs, recycling, attribution, territory updates, tool access, and exception management.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Strategy (Influencer Marketing)
jobs.description:
At Viral Nation, we specialize in building social-first ecosystems for brands to connect with the modern consumer journey. Our integrated solutions align strategy, talent, media, and technology with culturally relevant creativity to scale the world’s fastest-growing digital brands. Viral Nation offers a fluid, creative, and growth-oriented environment that will support your ambitions to apply your talents in an open, collaborative, and fast-paced culture. Our ability to stay at the forefront of the industry has fuelled our success and will guide us in paving the path forward. We’re driven to push boundaries and think beyond today to deliver strategies, and we’re just getting started.

While we continuously exceed our goals, we need your help – our success is only as great as our people. Strong performance leads to high expectations, and we must keep raising the bar!

The Associate Director, Strategy is an elite strategic leader who independently runs senior-level strategy work across both client and business growth and ongoing delivery. They turn culture, data, and business challenge into strategy that earns attention and drives growth. As a strong day-to-day senior partner, they present and sell strategic thinking with confidence, and act as a cultural lead within the team, bringing fresh thinking on platforms, subcultures, creator behavior, and emerging consumer signals into every strategic recommendation.

This role owns the quality and delivery of major projects or workstreams within a larger account or business context, and remains hands-on across research, synthesis, briefing, planning, and deck development. The Associate Director mentors and may manage junior team members, helps guide key strategic decisions, drives constant innovation in our strategic approach, and contributes to the evolution of frameworks, ways of working, and team standards. They are a critical connector across COEs, ensuring strategy is sharp, on-brief, and driving measurable outcomes for our clients and our business.

What You'll Do Here:

Strategic Output & Ownership

• Independently lead senior-level strategy work end-to-end across client and business growth opportunities and ongoing account delivery.

• Turn qualitative and quantitative insights into clear, actionable recommendations that drive measurable outcomes for clients and the business.

• Own the quality and delivery of strategic work across major projects or workstreams within larger accounts or business contexts.

• Architect integrated, social-first strategies with fluency across Influencer, Community Management, Earned, Experiential, and Owned, with a clear POV on how each lever drives audience, business, and brand outcomes.

• Partner with clients to define the true nature of the business problem before solutioning, translating data-backed recommendations into clear direction that drives real creator performance.

• Define KPIs, measurement frameworks, and success metrics for strategic recommendations in alignment with Business Intelligence, and continuously adapt strategy based on performance and market shifts.

• Recommend strategic direction and help guide key decisions on assigned accounts, pitches, and workstreams.

• Drive constant strategic innovation by introducing new frameworks, tools, and points of view that elevate the team’s output.

Client Partnership & Business Growth

• Serve as a strong day-to-day senior client partner, alongside client services, presenting and selling strategic thinking confidently to mid-senior and executive client stakeholders.

• Lead strategy across major RFPs, proposals, pitches, and existing client expansion opportunities.

• Identify and capitalize on client expansion opportunities through deep account intimacy and a clear view of client business challenges.

• Translate complex business challenges into innovative, social-first solutions that demonstrate clear client and commercial value.

• Partner with Sales, Client Service, Business Intelligence, and senior leadership to articulate Viral Nation’s competitive advantages and shape compelling strategic narratives.

Team Development & Internal Operations

• Mentor junior strategists and support the development of strategic upleveling across the department.

• Manage direct reports as assigned, with accountability for performance, growth, coaching, and quality of output.

• Contribute to the evolution of ways of working, strategic frameworks, templates, and team standards.

• Support resourcing, capacity planning, and workflow management in partnership with department leadership and the PMO.

• Participate in recruitment, onboarding, and continuous learning initiatives that elevate team capability.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Partner cross-functionally with Creative, Talent, Accounts, Paid Media, Community, and Measurement to ensure strategic alignment across delivery.

• Lead and participate in internal strategy reviews and QA checkpoints, ensuring sharp, on-brief, on-strategy output before it reaches clients.

• Act as a connector and expert across Viral Nation’s full suite of solutions, creating frameworks that enable productive collaboration across COEs.

• Contribute to Viral Nation’s external strategic presence through thought leadership, POVs, and competitive intelligence shared across the organization and, selectively, with clients.

Success Measures:

• Strength and quality of strategic output and thinking.

• Consistent strategic innovation across assigned accounts, pitches, and workstreams.

• Ability to lead major assignments effectively and independently, end-to-end.

• Tangible contribution to client expansion, business growth, and delivery excellence.

You'll Need To Have:

• 8+ years of agency or in-house experience across social, creative, content, influencer/creator, business development, and/or strategy.

• Proven track record independently leading senior-level strategy work on Fortune 500 and enterprise brands.

• Extensive experience developing integrated, social-first strategies that drive both client and business growth.

• Strong track record leading RFPs, proposals, pitches, and client expansion plans end-to-end.

• Demonstrated ability to mentor junior talent and manage direct reports.

• Visionary mindset with the ability to turn thought-starters into fully integrated strategies, pitch decks, and campaigns.

• Experience interfacing and presenting to c-suite executives.

• Fluency in AI tooling, measurement platforms, and emerging social/creator tech, with a clear POV on how to apply them to elevate strategic output.

• Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills, with strong senior client-facing presence.

• Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple major workstreams simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.

• Entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for innovation.

• Experience working directly with brands and at agencies.

• Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, or a related field.

Compensation Philosophy:

At Viral Nation, compensation is structured, performance-led, and market-aligned. Pay decisions are intentional, based on role requirements, performance, and market alignment by country, and are set to maintain internal pay equity across comparable roles and levels.

Compensation progression is tied to demonstrated performance, expanded scope, and sustained contribution over time, not tenure alone. Employee compensation is reviewed regularly through formal performance reviews and check-ins to ensure alignment with role expectations and impact.

AI in Recruitment:

Viral Nation does not use AI-enabled tools to screen, assess, rank, or select candidates – our hiring teams make all hiring decisions. AI note-taking tools may be used during interviews.

DEI Commitment:

Viral Nation is committed to diversity, equity and inclusion in our agency. Viral Nation welcomes applications from people with visible and non-visible disabilities. Accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the recruiting and selection process.

jobs.title: Business Applications Engineering Manager (NY)
jobs.description:
Position Title: Business Applications Engineering Manager

Entity: KBRA Holdings, LLC

Employment Type: Full-time

Location: New York, New York

Summary/Overview:

KBRA is seeking an experienced, hands-on Business Applications Engineering Manager to lead, mature, and scale its Business Applications function.

This role is responsible for leading and evolving KBRA's Business Applications practice and enterprise application portfolio. The position will own the strategy, governance, lifecycle management, and day-to-day operation of KBRA's SaaS and business application ecosystem, while serving as a key technology partner to business stakeholders across the firm.

As KBRA continues to expand its SaaS footprint, the Business Applications function is expected to play an increasingly strategic role in evaluating, onboarding, integrating, governing, and optimizing enterprise applications across the organization. This role will establish Business Applications as KBRA's center of excellence for SaaS platforms, enterprise applications, identity integrations, and application governance while building the processes, operational visibility, and business partnerships necessary to support that growth.

The Business Applications function is currently supported by a single Business Applications Engineer. Upon filling this position, the team will consist of two members, including the manager. As a result, this is a highly hands-on leadership role where the manager is expected to actively contribute to engineering, administration, troubleshooting, integrations, and project delivery while simultaneously driving strategy, governance, operational maturity, and team development.

The ideal candidate is a proactive technical leader who does not wait for detailed direction, but instead assesses the environment, identifies priorities, creates plans, communicates clearly, and drives execution. This individual should be capable of building visibility into the team's work, developing operational metrics, creating technology roadmaps, and translating business needs into scalable technology solutions.

This role will participate in team on-call rotations. Occasional travel to other KBRA offices may be required based on operational and project needs.

About the Job:

The Business Applications Engineering Manager will own and lead the management of KBRA's SaaS platforms and enterprise application ecosystem. This includes platforms such as Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, Box, Atlassian products, learning management systems, compliance and communication platforms, document and content management systems, and other business-owned or enterprise SaaS applications.

The role will partner closely with business groups such as Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product, Information Security, Infrastructure Engineering, Endpoint Engineering, IT Support, and other stakeholders on application selection, onboarding, configuration, integration, governance, lifecycle planning, and long-term ownership strategies.

Success in this role requires a leader who can balance strategic planning and people leadership with direct technical execution. This is not a role where responsibilities can be delegated entirely to others. The manager is expected to remain deeply involved in the technical and operational work of the team while helping build a mature, scalable Business Applications function.

About You:

Key Responsibilities:

Leadership, Strategy, and Portfolio Management

• Lead and evolve KBRA's Business Applications function, establishing the strategy, operating model, and roadmap for enterprise applications and SaaS platforms.

• Own KBRA's enterprise application portfolio, including application inventory, ownership models, governance standards, lifecycle management, vendor relationships, operational risk oversight and opportunities for consolidation, rationalization, and modernization.

• Develop and maintain roadmaps for SaaS governance, identity integrations, automation, operational maturity, and application modernization.

• Establish operational metrics, reporting and portfolio insights that provide visibility into application health, team performance, project delivery, platform adoption, operational risks, and workload.

• Mentor and develop team members while fostering a culture of accountability, ownership, collaboration, communication, and continuous improvement.

Business Partnership and SaaS Enablement

• Serve as a strategic technology partner to business leaders, helping evaluate solutions and align technology investments with business objectives.

• Partner with stakeholders across Legal, Compliance, Finance, Product and other business groups to understand requirements, define ownership models, and support long-term application strategy.

• Guide the evaluation, onboarding, adoption and governance of SaaS platforms and business applications.

• Provide technical and operational guidance on application architecture, integrations, access models, governance, support strategies and lifecycle planning.

• Identify opportunities to improve business processes through automation, application enhancements, integrations and better utilization of existing technology investments.

SaaS Engineering, Governance, and Operational Excellence

• Provide hands-on administration, configuration, support and troubleshooting across KBRA's SaaS and enterprise application ecosystem.

• Configure and maintain SSO integrations for internally developed applications, third-party SaaS platforms, and enterprise systems using Microsoft Entra ID and related technologies.

• Manage identity, access, provisioning, entitlement management and authentication services across enterprise applications.

• Administer and support platforms such as Microsoft 365, Slack, Zoom, Box, Atlassian products, learning management systems, compliance platforms and other business-critical applications.

• Lead enterprise application initiatives, including integrations, APIs, provisioning workflows, reverse proxy solutions, platform implementations and operational transitions from planning through ongoing support.

• Own application governance, including onboarding standards, access reviews, testing, deployment coordination, upgrade planning, lifecycle management and retirement processes.

• Partner with Information Security, Infrastructure Engineering, Endpoint Engineering and IT Support to ensure applications remain secure, compliant, supportable and aligned with enterprise standards.

• Coordinate vendor relationships, technical escalations, platform reviews, renewals and optimization initiatives.

• Act as the senior escalation point for complex application, integration, identity and access-related issues while driving automation, process improvements and service maturity across the function.

Required Qualifications

• 7+ years of experience supporting enterprise applications, SaaS platforms, identity management, business systems or related technology functions.

• 2+ years of experience leading projects, mentoring engineers, managing technical teams or owning enterprise application initiatives.

• Strong hands-on experience administering SaaS and enterprise application environments.

• Strong experience with Microsoft 365 administration, configuration, governance and operational support.

• Experience with Microsoft Entra ID, Azure/Entra enterprise applications, SSO, SAML/OIDC, access controls, identity integrations, and authentication troubleshooting.

• Experience managing SaaS integrations, user provisioning, identity governance, entitlement models and access management.

• Experience supporting or leading enterprise SaaS implementations and application modernization initiatives.

• Experience developing technology roadmaps, operational metrics, governance processes or service maturity initiatives.

• Experience partnering directly with business leaders to evaluate, implement and support technology solutions.

• Strong understanding of application lifecycle management, change management, testing, deployment planning and operational support.

• Strong communication, stakeholder management, project leadership, and cross-functional collaboration skills.

• Ability to balance hands-on technical responsibilities with leadership, planning, mentoring and strategic ownership.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field or equivalent work experience.

• Familiarity with Generative AI tools such as ChatGPT for research, data insights, and general productivity is a plus.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with platforms such as Slack, Zoom, Box, Atlassian products, CMS/DMS platforms, learning management systems, compliance platforms, vendor management platforms, asset management platforms, ERP systems and similar enterprise SaaS tools.

• Experience supporting Microsoft 365 add-ins, application permissions, administrative controls and governance processes.

• Experience with SaaS automation, scripting, APIs, provisioning workflows, reporting or operational automation.

• Experience serving as a technology partner to business stakeholders for enterprise application selection, implementation and governance.

• Experience building operational metrics, dashboards, roadmaps, standards or governance processes for an enterprise applications team.

• Experience in financial services, regulated environments or organizations with strong compliance and security requirements.

Salary Range:

The anticipated annual base salary range for this full-time position is $130,000 to $160,000. Offer amounts are determined by factors such as experience, skills, geography, and other job-related factors.

Benefits:

• Competitive benefits and paid time off

• Paid family and disability leave

• 401(k) plan, including employer match (100% vested)

• Educational and professional development financial assistance

• Employee referral bonus program

About Us:

Kroll Bond Rating Agency, LLC (KBRA) is a full-service credit rating agency registered with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission as an NRSRO. Kroll Bond Rating Agency Europe Limited is registered as a CRA with the European Securities and Markets Authority. Kroll Bond Rating Agency UK Limited is registered as a CRA with the UK Financial Conduct Authority pursuant to the Temporary Registration Regime. In addition, KBRA is designated as a designated rating organization by the Ontario Securities Commission for issuers of asset-backed securities to file a short form prospectus or shelf prospectus. KBRA is also recognized by the National Association of Insurance Commissioners as a Credit Rating Provider.

More Info:

• The discipline to work self-directed, keep a CRM honest, and plan a big territory well

About the Opportunity

AbbVie Westport is the largest operating facility in the AbbVie global network and a recognised centre of excellence for aseptic fill-finish operations. Our Westport site is a dynamic, fast-paced environment with a strong pipeline of new product introductions, technology transfers, and development projects spanning both small and large molecule programmes.

We are looking for a talented and driven Shift Supervisor for our Contamination Control team.

The Contamination Control Supervisor at AbbVie Westport is responsible for leading a team of contamination control operators (CCO) responsible for sanitising of cleanrooms, support and ancillary areas in the Biological cores at Abbvie Westport. This is a shift based role rotating between days and nights on a monthly basis, so ability to work shifts is essential.

Responsibilities:

• Manage, motivate, and develop the contamination control team through effective communication, performance reviews and coaching.
• Lead and coordinate all contamination control activities on the assigned shift, ensuring activities are prioritised and executed in line with production requirements, schedules and Key Process Indicators (KPIs).
• Escalate risks and performance issues in a timely manner to the Contamination Control Manager.
• Ensure assigned areas and CCO associated documentation is audit ready at all times.
• Perform cleanroom sanitisation of the Biologics manufacturing areas which includes Core 1, Core 2, Core 3, Core 4, PFS and sterility suites. This includes performing post batch, routine and triple cleans in accordance with the relevant procedures and Good Manufacturing Practices.
• Ensuring the relevant areas are stocked with cleaning disinfectants/gloves/gowns/goggles and removal of waste from the area.
• Complete autoclave cycles and filter testing in compliance with procedures.
• Understand and follow gowning procedures and protocols assigned to assure consistent, reliable, and timely performance of contamination control responsibility within the team and to ensure minimal contamination of the clean room through inadequate gowning.
• Accurately complete documentation and logbooks on time, accurately and legibly in compliance with Good Documentation Practices
• Report equipment issues to relevant departments
• Attend all the relevant training sessions and ensure training is completed in a timely manner.

• Ensure compliance with all EHS, Quality and housekeeping standards notifying management of any discrepancies.

• Adhere to all policies and procedures in support of achieving site metrics.

• 3rd level qualification in science or engineering related discipline
• Strong technical knowledge and application of concepts, practices, and procedure
