Our team is standing up USCYBERCOM’s AI Enterprise capability — the central hub that mission teams turn to when they want to move an AI solution from prototype to a secure, governed, enterprise-scale service. • Implement AI governance guardrails — content/safety filters, policy enforcement, and approval gates — for agentic workflows, and document model/agent architectures and evaluation results for reuse.

• Active TS/SCI clearance w/Poly

The contributions you will make:

This position independently designs, develops, tests, deploys, operates, and improves secure, reliable, maintainable software solutions. Working within a cross-functional product team, this role owns features and moderately complex outcomes from refinement through production, translates product and technical requirements into effective designs and implementations, and makes sound engineering decisions within established architecture and standards. Applies proficient knowledge of the team's programming languages, frameworks, APIs, data patterns, automated testing, CI/CD, cloud-native engineering, observability, DevSecOps, and production support practices; diagnoses moderately complex defects and operational issues; and evaluates trade-offs involving quality, security, performance, reliability, maintainability, and cost. Responsibly applies AI-enabled engineering tools, Agentic AI patterns, and AI agents to improve productivity and solution quality. Contributes technical judgment to team decisions, supports less-experienced engineers, and connects engineering choices to product objectives, client needs, operational risk, and business value.

A typical day:

• Owns software engineering delivery by independently owning features and moderately complex software outcomes from refinement through production. Clarifies technical requirements, decomposes work, designs and implements components and integrations, writes and maintains automated tests, deploys changes, monitors production behavior, and resolves defects. Makes sound implementation decisions within established architecture and remains accountable for security, quality, reliability, performance, maintainability, supportability, accessibility, and completion of assigned outcomes.

• Advances technical mastery and engineering judgment by applying proficient knowledge of the team's programming languages, frameworks, APIs, data access and integration patterns, development tools, and software lifecycle. Designs cohesive components using established architecture and design principles; evaluates implementation options and trade-offs; applies automated testing, debugging, CI/CD, cloud-native, observability, DevSecOps, and production engineering practices; and learns unfamiliar technologies or domain concepts as needed to solve moderately complex problems. Responsibly applies AI-enabled engineering tools and practices, Agentic AI patterns, and AI agents for coding, testing, analysis, documentation, and automation while critically validating outputs, protecting sensitive information, maintaining human accountability, and exercising sound engineering judgment.

• Connects engineering to business outcomes by understanding product goals, client needs, business processes, acceptance criteria, operational expectations, and risk relevant to owned outcomes. Refines requirements with product and business partners, identifies technical implications and constraints, evaluates practical trade-offs, and recommends implementation options that balance delivery needs with sustainable engineering. Operates as a trusted, value-added partner by communicating clearly, bringing technically informed recommendations, and following through on commitments.

• Strengthens Engineering Quality and Team Effectiveness by actively shaping technical design discussions, code reviews, automated testing, deployment readiness, incident response, root-cause analysis, documentation, and continuous improvement for owned work. Identifies design, quality, maintainability, reliability, security, and operational concerns; improves test coverage and observability; helps resolve delivery or production impediments; and contributes reusable practices that improve team effectiveness and software quality.

• Collaborate across teams by working across software and quality engineering, product, architecture, platform, UX, security, data, operations, and business teams to deliver integrated outcomes. Communicates technical decisions, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs clearly; incorporates relevant perspectives; coordinates dependencies; constructively challenges assumptions when evidence warrants; and helps resolve issues that cross component or team boundaries.

• Builds team capability and supports others by sharing engineering knowledge, providing useful review feedback, supporting less tenured engineers and peers, maintaining reusable documentation, and seeking coaching when needed. Continues to expand technical and domain expertise, applies feedback and evidence to improve decisions, and demonstrates accountability, curiosity, trust, resilience, and constructive collaboration while building the depth and leadership capability required for more complex technical ownership.

The skills and experience we prefer you have:

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Computer Engineering, Information Technology, or a related technical discipline; or an equivalent combination of education and experience.

• Professional knowledge of software engineering principles, data structures, algorithms, software design, debugging, automated testing, and the software development lifecycle.

• Professional experience designing, developing, testing, deploying, or supporting production software using modern programming languages, frameworks, and software engineering practices.

• Experience independently delivering software features or comparable technical outcomes using a modern programming language, Git-based source control, automated testing, and continuous integration and delivery practices.

• Experience analyzing moderately complex software problems, making and communicating implementation or design decisions, evaluating technical trade-offs, and applying secure development, reliability, observability, and quality engineering practices.

• Experience designing or operating cloud-native, API-based, event-driven, distributed, or data intensive application components, preferred.

• Experience with APIs, relational or non-relational data stores, integration patterns, and production troubleshooting, preferred.

• Experience with CI/CD, DevSecOps, observability, automated testing, or production support practices, preferred.

• Experience responsibly applying AI-enabled engineering tools and practices, Agentic AI patterns, AI agents, or intelligent automation throughout the software development lifecycle, preferred.

• Ability to independently design and deliver features, components, integrations, and moderately complex software outcomes using established architecture and engineering patterns and produce clean, maintainable, appropriately documented, and well-tested code through production.

• Ability to analyze and resolve moderately complex software and production problems by using code, logs, metrics, traces, debugging tools, and systematic problem solving to identify root causes, evaluate alternatives, implement durable fixes, and escalate systemic or high-risk concerns appropriately.

• Ability to apply software design principles to define component responsibilities, interfaces, APIs, data models, dependencies, and error-handling approaches; evaluate implementation trade-offs; and make sound design decisions within established architecture, security, and engineering standards.

• Ability to independently use source control, automated testing, build and deployment pipelines, observability, development environments, and delivery tools to move changes safely through the software lifecycle and support them in production.

• Ability to responsibly apply AI-enabled engineering tools and practices, Agentic AI patterns, and AI agents to coding, testing, analysis, documentation, and automation while evaluating generated approaches, validating outputs, protecting sensitive information, maintaining human accountability, and upholding engineering standards.

• Ability to communicate technical designs, implementation choices, defects, dependencies, risks, and trade-offs effectively with technical and non-technical partners; clarify requirements; provide informed recommendations; incorporate feedback; and build trust through reliable follow-through.

• Ability to independently decompose and organize moderately complex work, estimate and communicate progress, coordinate dependencies, adapt to changing priorities, contribute meaningful code and design reviews, and help improve testing, documentation, operational readiness, and team delivery practices.

• Advanced knowledge in one or more areas relevant to the team's software, such as application architecture, cloud-native development, APIs and integration, data persistence, distributed systems, security, or performance, preferred.

• Working knowledge of infrastructure automation, DevSecOps, observability, platform engineering, or production reliability practices, preferred.

• Understanding of financial services, agriculture, or other regulated industries, preferred.

Please note that compensation decisions are made thoughtfully and may vary from the listed range to reflect individual circumstances and evolving business needs. Our total rewards package also includes benefits, perks, and opportunities for growth that contribute to overall compensation.

jobs.title: Software Engineer, ML Serving Platform
jobs.location: San Francisco, CA; Sunnyvale, CA; • Seattle, WA
jobs.description:
About the Team

DoorDash’s ML Serving Platform delivers tens of millions of predictions per second, powering search, recommendations, advertising, delivery estimates, and logistics across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo.

Our customers are modelers and engineering teams across our internal business verticals. We build self-serve infrastructure that empowers them to bring new models into production, adopt open source software and models, and expand what they can accomplish with machine learning at scale.

We work at the intersection of a rapidly evolving open source ecosystem and demanding production workloads. With active customer demand and growing modeling ambitions, we’re advancing the infrastructure behind today’s predictions while building the capabilities that enable the next generation of ML innovation.

About the Role

You’ll help build the next generation of our ML serving platform, connecting request routing and online feature retrieval with model inference on CPU and GPU infrastructure. You’ll tackle challenging infrastructure problems involving latency, reliability, resource efficiency, and scale, and make those capabilities accessible through self-serve tools and workflows.

Working alongside experienced platform engineers, you’ll own defined projects from technical design and implementation through testing, rollout, and production support. You’ll partner directly with internal teams to understand emerging modeling requirements, remove adoption barriers, and turn advances in open source technology into measurable production improvements.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Empower modelers through self-serve infrastructure. Build tools, APIs, and workflows that help internal teams deploy, configure, validate, and operate models independently, accelerating ML adoption across business verticals.

• Bring open source innovation into production. Evaluate and integrate evolving inference frameworks and enable open source models, translating promising capabilities into reliable, efficient services at scale.

• Solve demanding inference infrastructure problems. Improve the systems that route prediction requests, retrieve online features, and execute models on a platform serving tens of millions of predictions per second.

• Help evolve our disaggregated serving architecture. Build modular components that allow routing, feature retrieval, and model execution to evolve and scale independently as workloads and modeling requirements change.

• Improve Kubernetes deployment and autoscaling. Help workloads respond to changing traffic while meeting latency and availability requirements and using CPU and GPU resources efficiently.

• Make adoption and rollout easier. Build integrations, validation, and migration tooling that help teams adopt new serving capabilities and our unified global platform with confidence.

• Own performance and reliability in production. Use benchmarking, profiling, metrics, and tracing to identify bottlenecks; participate in on-call and improve automation and runbooks to make the platform easier to operate.

We’re excited about you because…

• You have 2+ years of software engineering experience building and maintaining production services or infrastructure.

• You have strong computer science fundamentals and proficiency in a backend or systems programming language such as Java, Kotlin, Go, C++, or Python.

• You understand distributed systems fundamentals, including concurrency, networking, timeouts, failure handling, and performance trade-offs.

• You enjoy challenging infrastructure problems and can independently turn a defined problem into a technical design, tested implementation, and safe production rollout.

• You have experience debugging production systems and using operational data to improve reliability, performance, or cost.

• You care about the engineers using your platform and collaborate effectively with customers and partners to make complex infrastructure easier to adopt.

• You hold a degree in Computer Science or a related field, or have equivalent practical experience.

Nice to Have

• Experience with ML inference infrastructure, online feature retrieval, or other latency-sensitive distributed services.

• Experience operating containerized workloads on Kubernetes, including deployment, resource management, or autoscaling.

• Experience building self-serve developer platforms, APIs, or automation that helps other engineers move faster.

• Experience integrating open source infrastructure or models and validating their behavior under production workloads.

• Familiarity with CPU/GPU performance profiling, inference runtimes, or model deployment workflows.

Applications for this position are accepted on an ongoing basis

Compensation

The successful candidate’s starting pay will fall within the pay range listed below and is determined based on job-related factors including, but not limited to, skills, experience, qualifications, work location, and market conditions. Base salary is localized according to an employee’s work location. Ranges are market-dependent and may be modified in the future.

In addition to base salary, the compensation for this role includes opportunities for equity grants. Talk to your recruiter for more information.

DoorDash cares about you and your overall well-being. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits package to all regular employees, which includes a 401(k) plan with employer matching, 16 weeks of paid parental leave, wellness benefits, commuter benefits match, paid time off and paid sick leave in compliance with applicable laws (e.g. Colorado Healthy Families and Workplaces Act). DoorDash also offers medical, dental, and vision benefits, 11 paid holidays, disability and basic life insurance, family-forming assistance, and a mental health program, among others.

To learn more about our benefits, visit our careers page here.

About the Team

DoorDash’s GenAI Platform team sits within Machine Learning Platform and builds the shared infrastructure that helps DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo teams safely bring GenAI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalization to production. Our mission is to increase the velocity of business impact from GenAI. A central pillar of that work is running frontier open-weight LLMs and VLMs (such as GLM, Qwen, Kimi, and DeepSeek) ourselves — real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning on autoscaling GPUs — delivering large cost and latency wins (for example, a billion embeddings produced roughly 20× cheaper and visual models served roughly 72% cheaper). We also own core platform surfaces including the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

About the Role

You will join a small, high-leverage team building production infrastructure for Generative AI at DoorDash, with a primary focus on our open-weights model platform spanning inference and fine-tuning: real-time GPU serving, high-throughput batch inference, and model fine-tuning. You’ll work across model serving and inference engines, fine-tuning and training pipelines, GPU autoscaling and utilization, batch pipelines, backend services, and observability. This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys pushing the cost/performance frontier of GPU inference and fine-tuning in a fast-moving technical area where product needs, model capabilities, vendor ecosystems, and cost/performance tradeoffs are evolving quickly.

You’re excited about this opportunity because you will…

• Build the infrastructure that helps DoorDash teams move GenAI ideas from prototype to production, increasing the velocity of business impact from AI across the company.

• Work on our open-weights serving stack — real-time GPU endpoints, high-throughput batch inference, and fine-tuning (SFT/DPO/LoRA) — alongside the LLM Gateway, Agent Gateway, evals infrastructure, guardrails, and cost attribution.

• Design scalable, high-performance systems for model serving, batch inference, GPU autoscaling, and fine-tuning that power real customer and internal automation use cases

• Push the cost and latency frontier of GPU inference — turning batch jobs that took days into hours and cutting inference cost by multiples — while giving product teams a clean choice across open-weight and closed-source models with reliability, fallback, observability, and cost controls built in.

• Build platforms that support rapid experimentation while meeting production standards for latency, scale, monitoring, SLOs, playbooks, and operational excellence.

• Partner closely with ML engineers, product engineers, data scientists, and platform teams across DoorDash, Wolt, and Deliveroo to turn emerging GenAI capabilities into durable platform primitives.

• Shape the future of DoorDash’s centralized GenAI platform — including emerging directions such as reinforcement learning (RLHF/RLVR), agent optimization, and other post-training and agentic techniques — enabling the next generation of AI-powered products, agents, automation, and personalization.

• Proficiency in using AI coding tools (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor) in the full software development lifecycle, including designing, generating code, testing, monitoring and releasing software

• Experience with distributed/multi-node fine-tuning and training pipelines (SFT, DPO/RLHF, LoRA), including data preparation and evaluation

• GPU performance work — multi-node/distributed inference, KV-cache/memory optimization, quantization (FP8/INT8/AWQ/GPTQ), or cold-start/throughput tuning

• Experience with Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure (AWS/GCP), GPUs, serverless/elastic GPU platforms (e.g., Modal), or high-throughput batch systems

• Experience with LLM gateways, model routing, vendor abstraction, or cost attribution

• Experience building developer platforms, internal platforms, or self-serve infrastructure

• Experience building and deploying AI agents or MCP servers in production

• Experience with eval systems, LLM observability, tracing, RAG, search, or vector databases

We’re seeking a hands‑on Automation Technician to install, optimize, and support automated manufacturing systems across injection molding and ferrule posting areas. In this role you’ll use mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills to keep automation running, drive continuous improvement, and collaborate with engineering and operations to deliver reliable, efficient production.

• Hands‑on troubleshooting experience with servo drives, motion systems, sensors, and vision inspection equipment.

• Previous experience authoring or improving work instructions, SOPs, and technical documentation.

• Familiarity with root‑cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement methodologies (5S, Kaizen, Lean).

• Experience coordinating vendor repairs and upgrades for automation systems.

jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

This job posting is for current Residents / Fellows completing their training in 2026 or 2027 who are interested in any of our offices based in Boston.

Why One Medical is the best place to launch your career in primary care: One Medical is transforming healthcare, and we're looking for dedicated primary care physicians to join us right out of residency. You'll practice in a supportive, tech-enabled environment where you can build lasting patient relationships and deliver high-quality care. Our robust 12-week onboarding includes one-on-one mentoring, an individualized learning plan, and ongoing access to primary care experts nationwide. From day one through every stage of your career, we invest in your growth with continuing education and leadership development.

Employment type:

• Full time

What you’ll be working on:

• Managing a patient panel with a broad array of patient needs; conducting a mix of acute, chronic, and well visits

• Treating patients in-office or in testing centers as well as conducting occasional tele-health visits

• Continuous learning during weekly Clinical Rounds and through other modalities

• Ongoing collaboration with in-office teammates via daily huddles, as well as with virtual clinical teams

• Utilization of your specific clinical training and opportunities to perform in-office procedures

• Supervising one or more NP or PA colleagues

Education, licenses, and experiences required for this role:

• Currently enrolled in, or completed within the last year, an accredited Family Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics residency program

• Must presently be a Board Eligible Family Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics Resident, or have completed a Family Medicine or Internal Medicine/Pediatrics Residency Program within the last calendar year and scheduled to take the next available Board Exam

• State licensed in Massachusetts, obtained before your One Medical start date

One Medical providers also demonstrate:

• A passion for human-centered primary care

• The ability to successfully communicate with and provide care to individuals of all backgrounds

• The ability to effectively use technology to deliver high quality care

• Clinical proficiency in evidence-based primary care

• The desire to be an integral part of a team dedicated to changing healthcare delivery

• An openness to feedback and reflection to gain productive insight into strengths and weaknesses

• The ability to confidently navigate uncertain situations with both patients and colleagues

• Readiness to adapt personal and interpersonal behavior to meet the needs of our patients

This is a full-time role based in one of our Boston offices. During your interview process, we will determine the exact office location based on your preferences and business needs.

One Medical is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices.

The base salary range for this role is $252,000 to $283,500 based on a full-time schedule. Final determination of starting pay may vary based on factors such as practice experience and patient care schedule. Additional pay may be determined for those candidates that exceed these specified qualifications and requirements. For more information, visit https://www.onemedical.com/careers/.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

jobs.title: Education Manager, Atlanta & North Florida
jobs.description:
The Education Manager is responsible for bringing Dior’s House of Dreams to life across the Atlanta & North Florida market through elevated education, luxury service excellence, and inspiring brand storytelling. This role drives Dior retail education strategy and execution across fragrance, makeup, and skincare to strengthen brand desirability, elevate client experience, and support business performance across a diverse retail landscape.

As a brand ambassador and training expert of the maison, the Regional Tri-Axe Education Manager empowers retail teams to deliver exceptional Dior service standards in every client interaction. Through impactful education, compelling storytelling, and effective field coaching, this role translates the House’s heritage, product knowledge, and service expertise into meaningful client engagement and retail productivity.

Reporting directly to the Regional Sales Director, this role also receives strategic direction and support from the New York corporate retail development team. The Regional Tri-Axe Education Manager collaborates closely with Sales, Account Executives, the Regional Sales Director, and cross-functional partners to identify development opportunities and deliver targeted training solutions that meet and exceed business goals.

JOB RESPONSIBILITIES

EDUCATION & DEVELOPMENT

• Lead the execution of Dior retail education across fragrance, makeup, and skincare for the Atlanta/North Florida territory.
• Deliver engaging and impactful classroom, virtual, and in-store training focused on Dior savoir-faire, hospitality, service, and selling.
• Bring Dior’s heritage, creativity, and product innovation to life, enabling teams to authentically communicate the values and storytelling of Dior with every client.
• Maintain exceptional expertise across the Dior fragrance and beauty portfolio and serve as a trusted resource for retail partners and field teams.
• Drive excitement through education to support Dior fragrance and beauty launches and key retail initiatives.
• Conduct onboarding training and continued development for beauty consultants and retail partners to ensure consistent Dior standards across the territory.
• Support education across multiple retail channels, including Dior Beauty Boutiques, department stores, and specialty-multi retailers such as Sephora and Ulta, adapting approach to each business model and client journey.

FIELD COACHING & CLIENT EXPERIENCE

• Create focused coaching strategies to elevate client experience according to Dior service standards and develop field teams through ongoing feedback that fosters confidence and performance.
• Empower beauty consultants to ensure every client interaction embodies the brand’s luxury positioning.
• Serve as a role model for Dior presentation, selling, service, and client engagement standards.
• Adapt coaching methods and field support to the needs of varied retail environments, ensuring excellence and consistency across all points of sale.

BUSINESS & PERFORMANCE

• Partner closely with Account Executives and the Regional Sales Director to identify business opportunities and align education plans with business objectives.
• Evaluate the effectiveness of training and field coaching, identify gaps, and adapt education plans accordingly.
• Share field insights and best practices with regional leadership, the New York corporate retail development team, corporate education teams, and cross-functional partners to support continuous improvement.
• Monitor competitive activity, category trends, innovation, and evolving client behaviors to provide relevant insights and strengthen Dior’s position at retail.
• Demonstrate agility in adjusting priorities, training focus, and execution in response to shifting retail trends, business needs, and corporate direction.

PARTNERSHIP & COLLABORATION

• Serve as the territory’s education leader, aligning field performance and development needs with business objectives.
• Foster a culture of collaboration, excellence, and accountability while inspiring teams to embody Dior values.
• Empower beauty consultants and retail partners to maintain consistent brand standards across the territory.
• Act as a key liaison between regional leadership and the New York corporate retail development team to ensure alignment between local market execution and broader strategic priorities.

• Minimum 5 years of training experience in luxury retail fragrance and beauty.
• Strong understanding of luxury retail and client experience.
• Strong presentation, facilitation, and communication skills with the ability to engage diverse audiences.
• Proven ability to develop talent and coach teams to increase performance.
• Highly organized with strong planning, prioritization, and time-management skills.
• Ability to work in a fast-paced environment while maintaining close collaboration with regional and corporate partners.
• Experience supporting or working across multiple retail channels, including department stores and specialty-multi retailers, preferred.

KEY COMPETENCIES

• Passion for education, coaching, and talent development
• Excellent communication skills
• Ability to inspire, influence, and motivate others
• Embody elegance, professionalism, and luxury standards
• Strong business acumen with a results-driven approach
• Creativity, curiosity, and adaptability
• Flexibility, agility, and growth mindset
• Change management capability with the ability to lead teams through evolving priorities and retail dynamics
• Proficient with Office 365 and relevant social media skills for training and communication
• Ability to travel frequently (estimated up to 50%) to support training initiatives

This job description is intended to cover the core accountabilities of the position and is not designed to cover or contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties or responsibilities that are required of the employee. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change, or new ones may be assigned at any time with or without notice.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

LVMH Inc. uses the published salary range as a guideline to provide our employees with market competitive pay while allowing for flexibility to recognize and reward various levels of expertise, performance, and tenure.

While the published salary range is a good faith reflection of the targeted salary level for the position, LVMH Inc. reserves the right to pay outside of the published range of $90,000-115,000.

jobs.title: Sterile Processing Tech Part Time Days
jobs.description:
The Sterile Processing Tech reflects the mission, vision, and values of NM, adheres to the organization’s Code of Ethics and Corporate Compliance Program, and complies with all relevant policies, procedures, guidelines and all other regulatory and accreditation standards.

Receives, cleans, distributes and sterilizes medical instruments and equipment.

RESPONSIBILITIES

• Cleans, disinfects, decontaminates and sterilizes medical instruments and equipment using appropriate methods, substances and equipment.
• Receives, stocks, packages and distributes medical instruments and equipment.
• Performs and documents required quality assurance testing and inspection on stock. Inventories and reorders supplies.
• Properly disposes of biohazardous substances, chemicals, medical waste and unusable equipment and supplies.
• Disassemble, decontaminate, assemble, sterilize, and store procedure trays, instruments, medical equipment, and supplies according to prescribed procedure and aseptic technique.
• Follows preference sheet to accurately dispense instruments and supplies to surgery and patient care areas.
• Demonstrates knowledge and use of the Tray Tracking computer system in assigned areas of the department.
• Inspects sorts and processes surgical instrumentation in accordance to policy and procedures.
• Reports and isolates damaged and missing items to Resource Coordinator and Manager.
• Assembles and organizes surgical instrument sets according to instrument count sheets.
• Maintains logs, prepares, checks and records test results. Approves or refuses materials from Sterilizer based on test results. Reports to management any adverse results.
• Prepares and delivers accurate and timely case carts for use in surgical procedures.
• Checks and reprocesses any expired items.
• Accurately prepares and labels items for the appropriate method of sterilization.
• Dispenses and delivers materials via dumbwaiter, tube system, elevator and/or handcarts
• Performs other duties as assigned.

Required:

• High School Diploma or GED or 2 years related equivalent experience AND must obtain GED within 1 year of start date AND
• Sterile processing certification -National (CBSPD) or International (IAHCSMM) Certification within 2 years of start date AND
• Basic computer skills

Preferred:

• Basic knowledge of medical terminology and human anatomy
• One year of prior sterilizing experience

Northwestern Medicine is an equal opportunity employer (disability, VETS) and does not discriminate in hiring or employment on the basis of age, sex, race, color, religion, national origin, gender identity, veteran status, disability, sexual orientation or any other protected status.

Background Check

Northwestern Medicine conducts a background check that includes criminal history on newly hired team members and, at times, internal transfers. If you are offered a position with us, you will be required to complete an authorization and disclosure form that gives Northwestern Medicine permission to run the background check.  Results are evaluated on a case-by-case basis, and we follow all local, state, and federal laws, including the Illinois Health Care Worker Background Check Act.

Artificial Intelligence Disclosure

Artificial Intelligence (AI) tools may be used in some portions of the candidate review process for this position, however, all employment decisions will be made by a person.

Benefits

We offer a wide range of benefits that provide employees with tools and resources to improve their physical, emotional, and financial well-being while providing protection for unexpected life events.

Click on or copy and paste URL to your browser to view detailed benefits information

https://jobs.nm.org/benefits

jobs.title: Predajný poradca/Predajná poradkyňa, hlavný pracovný pomer 38,75h týždenne, Nitra Mlyny
jobs.description:
ČO BUDETE ROBIŤ

Ako Predajný poradca/Predajná poradkyňa v H&M zohráte kľúčovú úlohu pri vytváraní vynikajúceho zákazníckeho zážitku. Privítate zákazníkov, prevediete ich predajňou a pomôžete im nájsť, čo potrebujú, pričom budete prezentovať naše produkty. Svojimi rozhodnutiami v súlade s našimi hodnotami prispejete nielen k svojmu vlastnému úspechu, ale aj k úspechu celej spoločnosti.

Vaša náplň práce:

• Budete zdieľať svoje znalosti o móde a produktoch, aby ste pomohli zákazníkom urobiť informované rozhodnutia.
• Čaká vás spolupráca s vaším tímom na poskytovaní výnimočnej služby počas celého zákazníckeho zážitku, vrátane aktívnej propagácie vernostného programu H&M.
• Pomôžete zabezpečiť, aby predajná plocha a sklad boli dobre zásobené, organizované a prívetivé.
• Podporovať tím budete aj pri otváraní a zatváraní predajne.
• A taktiež budete pozitívne reprezentovať seba a značku pri všetkých interakciách so zákazníkmi.

S KÝM BUDETE PRACOVAŤ

Naše predajne sú srdcom našej spoločnosti, kde si zákazníci môžu naplno vychutnať zážitok s našou značkou. Ako súčasť dynamického predajného tímu – či už na pozícii Predajného poradcu, Vedúceho oddelenia, Vedúceho predajne, Dekoratéra alebo Hlavného pokladníka – budete prispievať k vytvoreniu inšpiratívneho a prívetivého prostredia. Okrem vášho tímu budete spolupracovať aj so širším Area tímom, vymieňať si poznatky a spoločne prispievať k celkovému úspechu. Spolu s kolegami budete zohrávať dôležitú úlohu pri pomoci zákazníkom cítiť sa sebavedomo, a pomôžete im vyjadriť svoju individualitu prostredníctvom najnovších trendov i nadčasových štýlov. Budovaním pevných vzťahov so zákazníkmi robíme módu prístupnou a udržateľnou pre všetkých.

KOHO HĽADÁME

Hľadáme ľudí, ktorí majú…​

• Skúsenosti so zákazníckym servisom v oblasti módy, retailu alebo v podobných odvetviach (predošlé skúsenosti budú považované za výhodu).
• Vášeň pre pomoc zákazníkom a záujem o módu alebo retail – zvyšok vás naučíme!

A ľudí ktorí…​

• Majú radi spoluprácu a dynamické prostredie.
• Sú komunikatívni, kreatívni, zvedaví na prácu s technológiami obchodu, s veľkou túžbou učiť sa a rozvíjať.
• Flexibilní a orientovaní na výsledky.

KTO SME​

H&M Group je globálna spoločnosť silných módnych značiek a inovatívnych projektov. Naším cieľom je dokázať, že nie je nutné robiť kompromisy medzi výnimočným dizajnom, dostupnými cenami a udržateľnými riešeniami. Chceme sprístupniť módu širokej verejnosti a zákazníci sú v centre každého nášho rozhodnutia. Máme tisícky vášnivých a talentovaných kolegov, ktorých spájajú spoločná kultúra a hodnoty. Spoločne chceme využiť našu silu, rozsah a znalosti na to, aby sme posunuli módny priemysel smerom k inkluzívnejšej a udržateľnejšej budúcnosti.

PREČO SI NÁS OBĽÚBITE

V H&M Group sme hrdí na to, že sme dynamickou a prívetivou spoločnosťou. Ponúkame atraktívne benefity a rozsiahle rozvojové príležitosti po celom svete.

• 25 %zamestnanecká zľava na všetky značky v rámci H&M Group, v predajniach aj online (H&M, COS, Weekday, Monki, H&M HOME, & Other Stories a ARKET).
• H&M Incentive Program – HIP. Viac o programe sa dozviete tu.
• Stabilný zamestnávateľ,
• Športová karta Multisport,
• Atraktívna mzda a ďalšie príležitostné bonusy.
• Rozsiahly program školení,
• Možnosť rastu v rámci spoločnosti (viac ako 70% našich náborových procesov je interných),
• Šanca zažiť unikátnu kultúru spoločnosti H&M,
• Občerstvenie na pracovisku,
• Bonus pri narodení dieťaťa v podobe darčekovej karty v hodnote 50 eur,
• Po odpracovaní 10 rokov dovolenka naviac,
• Odmena za odporučenie kolegu až do 300 eur,
• 4 dni Relaxing Days (2 v prvom roku zamestnania).

PRIDAJTE SA K NÁM​

Naša jedinečnosť spočíva v kombinácii mnohých faktorov – našej inkluzívnej a spolupracujúcej kultúry, silných hodnôt a možností rastu. No predovšetkým sú to naši ľudia, ktorí robia našu spoločnosť tým, čím je.​

Ide o pozíciu na hlavný pracovný úväzok v rozsahu 38,75 hodín týždenne. Pracovný čas je flexibilný, s nerovnomerne rozvrhnutou pracovnou dobou, pričom sa pracuje na ranné aj poobedné zmeny počas pracovného týždňa.

Miesto výkonu práce je v Nitre.

Mzdové ohodnotenie je 1040 € brutto/mesiac, vrátane príplatku za víkend nad rámec zákona. .

Neváhajte a prihláste sa čo najskôr, najneskôr však do 22.10.2026.

Z dôvodu ochrany osobných údajov môžeme prijímať žiadosti len prostredníctvom našej kariérnej stránky.

Urobte ďalší krok vo svojej kariére spolu s nami. Vaša cesta začína tu.​

­­­­­­­­*Hodnotenie pozícií v predajni:

Aby sme zvládli vysoký objem prihlášok na pozíciu Predajného poradcu, používame online hodnotenie na základe zručností v rámci niektorých našich predajní. Tento proces budete musieť dokončiť ako súčasť prihlášky a výberového procesu. Vaše odpovede budú hodnotené nástrojom na hodnotenie, ktorý aplikuje vopred stanovené kritériá určené spoločnosťou H&M Group.

Po dokončení hodnotenia budete mať možnosť zdieľať feedback a položiť otázky. Ak narazíte na akékoľvek problémy alebo preferujete alternatívnu metódu hodnotenia, kontaktujte nás na  recruitment_support@hm.com. Výber alternatívy nebude mať vplyv na vašu prihlášku.

Viac informácií o tom, ako spracúvame vaše osobné údaje, nájdete v našich Zásadách ochrany osobných údajov.

** Zaviazali sme sa k spravodlivému a nestrannému výberovému procesu založenému na kompetenciách. Preto vás prosíme, aby ste k žiadosti neprikladali motivačný list.

jobs.title: Patient Care Coordinator - Pleasant HIlls clinic
jobs.description:
Drayer Physical Therapy, a brand partner of Upstream Rehabilitation, is looking for a Patient Care Coordinator to join our team in Pittsburgh, PA

Are you looking for a position in a growing organization where you can make a significant impact on the lives of others?

What is a Patient Care Coordinator?

• A Patient Care Coordinator is an entry-level office role that is responsible for maintaining pleasant and consistent daily operations of the clinic.

• Our Patient Care Coordinators have excellent customer service skills.

• Patient Care Coordinators learn new things – a lot! The Patient Care Coordinator multitasks in multiple computer programs each day.

A day in the life of a Patient Care Coordinator:

• Greets everyone who enters the clinic in a friendly and welcoming manner.

• Schedules new referrals received by fax or by telephone from patients, physician offices.

• Verifies insurance coverage for patients.

• Collects patient payments.

• Maintains an orderly and organized front office workspace.

• Other duties as assigned.

Fulltime positions include:

• Annual paid Charity Day to give back to a cause meaningful to you

• Medical, Dental, Vision, Life, Short-Term and Long-Term Disability Insurance

• 3-week Paid Time Off plus paid holidays

• 401K + company match

Position Summary:

The Patient Care Coordinator - I (PCC-I) supports clinic growth through excellence in execution of the practice management role and patient intake processes. This individual will work in collaboration with the Clinic Director (CD) to carry out efficient clinic procedures. The PCC-I position is responsible for supporting the mission, vision, and values of Upstream Rehabilitation.

Responsibilities:

• Core responsibilities Collect all money due at the time of service Convert referrals into evaluations Schedule patient visits Customer Service

• Create an inviting clinic atmosphere.

• Make all welcome calls Monitor and influence arrival rate through creation of a great customer experience

• Practice Management Manage schedule efficiently Manage document routing Manage personal overtime Manage non-clinical documentation Manage deposits Manage caseload, D/C candidate, progress note, and insurance reporting Monitor clinic inventory

• Training o Attend any required training with the Territory Field Trainers (TFT) for Raintree and other business process updates. Complete quarterly compliance training.

Qualifications:

• High School Diploma or equivalent

• Communication skills – must be able to relate well to Business Office and Field leadership

• Ability to multitask, organizational detail, ability to meet deadlines, work with little to no supervision

• As a member of a team, must possess efficient time management and presentation skills

Physical Requirements:

• This position is subject to inside environmental conditions: protections from weather conditions but not necessarily from temperature changes; exposed to noise consistent with indoor environment.

• This is a full-time position operating within normal business hours Monday through Friday, with an expectation of minimum of 40 hours per week; May be required to attend special events some evenings and weekends, or work additional hours as needed.

• This position is subject to sedentary work.

• Constantly sits, with ability to interchange with standing as needed.

• Constantly communicates with associates, must be able to hear and speak to accurately exchange information in these situations.

• Frequently operates a computer and other office equipment such as printers, phone, keyboard, mouse and copy machines using gross and fine manipulation.

• Constantly uses repetitive motions to type.

• Must be able to constantly view computer screen (near acuity) and read items on screen.

• Must have ability to comprehend information provided, use judgement to appropriately respond in various situations.

• Occasionally walks, stands, pushes or pulls 0-20 lbs., lifts 0-20 lbs. from floor to waist; carries, pushes, and pulls 0-20 lbs.

• Rarely crawls, crouches, kneels, stoops, climbs stairs or ladders, reaches above shoulder height, lifts under 10 lbs. from waist to shoulder.

This job description is not an all-inclusive list of all duties that may be required of the incumbent and is subject to change at any time with or without notice. Incumbents must be able to perform the essential functions of the position satisfactorily and that, if requested, reasonable accommodations may be made to enable associates with disabilities to perform the essential functions of their job, absent undue hardship.

Please do not contact the clinic directly.

jobs.title: IT Project Manager Junior
jobs.description:
At Accenture Federal Services, nothing matters more than helping the US federal government make the nation stronger and safer and life better for people. Our 13,000+ people are united in a shared purpose to pursue the limitless potential of technology and ingenuity for clients across defense, national security, public safety, civilian, and military health organizations.

Join Accenture Federal Services, a technology company within global Accenture. Recognized as a Glassdoor Top 100 Best Place to Work, we offer a collaborative and caring community where you feel like you belong and are empowered to grow, learn and thrive through hands-on experience, certifications, industry training and more.

Join us to drive positive, lasting change that moves missions and the government forward!

Who you'll be:

The role supports the efficient and effective project management of CSD cybersecurity and IT-based projects, encompassing process improvement, technology implementation, proof-of-concept execution, new feature requests, and policy development. This position covers the full project lifecycle from initiation through close-out, and is responsible for maintaining and updating the CSD Project Management Methodology (CPM2) and the PMO SharePoint site.

What you'll do:

• Provide experienced IT Project Managers to facilitate CSD projects and perform all roles/responsibilities of a project manager across initiation, planning, execution, monitoring & controlling, and close-out.

• Maintain and annually review/update the CSD Project Management Methodology (CPM2).

• Develop and maintain a CSD PMO SharePoint site automating and centralizing the CPM2 process where technically feasible.

• Develop and maintain project management templates, checklists, forms, and flow charts supporting CPM2 and other PM functions.

• Monitor and measure project performance through results-driven metrics; provide recommendations on project resourcing.

• Develop and maintain a formalized CSD PMO training program.

• Develop and sustain a near-real-time CSD PMO reporting format tracking milestones, risks/issues, project health, dependencies, and funding, leveraging tools such as Jira, Risk Register, Power BI, and Power Automate.

• Support development and maintenance of a repeatable process for a multi-year CSD strategic plan and roadmap, plus a granular current-fiscal-year view.

• Provide documentation support (Concept of Operations, metrics, technical writing) and maintain PowerPoint/SharePoint content for PMO efforts.

• Provide meeting minutes for all scheduled meetings within 3 business days; maintain a master action item list.

What you need:

• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in IT/cybersecurity project management; or, with a bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field, 3 years of such experience.

• Experience with CPM2-style project methodologies and Agile/SAFe delivery cadences.

jobs.title: Non-Eng Template
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Privacy Program Manager to join our Legal Team and help build and scale ElevenLabs’ global privacy program. In this role, you will translate privacy requirements into effective, repeatable processes across the company and drive the day-to-day operation of key privacy initiatives.

You will work closely with Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, Safety, and GTM teams to operationalize privacy-by-design, manage privacy assessments and compliance workflows, and strengthen the systems and processes that support ElevenLabs’ growing global business. This role is ideal for someone who combines deep privacy program experience with strong project management skills and enjoys building scalable programs in a fast-moving AI environment.




RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Manage and continuously improve ElevenLabs’ global privacy program, translating legal and regulatory requirements into scalable operational processes and controls.

 - Own and coordinate privacy compliance workflows across frameworks including GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, US state privacy laws, HIPAA, and applicable biometric privacy requirements.

 - Manage privacy impact assessment processes, including Privacy Impact Assessments (PIAs), Data Protection Impact Assessments (DPIAs), and assessments involving AI systems, biometric data, voice technologies, health information, and other sensitive data.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Legal, and Security teams to operationalize privacy-by-design throughout the product development lifecycle.

 - Maintain data inventories, records of processing activities (RoPAs), data flow documentation, and other privacy governance records.

 - Manage processes for data subject and consumer rights requests, including access, deletion, correction, and opt-out requests, and help ensure requests are handled consistently and within applicable deadlines.

 - Partner with Security and Legal on third-party and vendor privacy assessments, data processing requirements, and privacy-related risk remediation.

 - Support privacy incident response and regulatory or customer inquiries by coordinating documentation, stakeholders, timelines, and follow-up actions.

 - Implement and administer privacy tooling and automation to improve the efficiency and scalability of privacy operations including maintaining ElevenLabs’ consent management platform and partnering with Legal, Marketing, Product, and Engineering to ensure cookie, tracking technology, and other consent and preference mechanisms are appropriately configured, documented, monitored, and updated as our products and regulatory requirements evolve.

 - Develop privacy program metrics, dashboards, and reporting to track compliance, identify risks, and communicate program maturity and priorities to stakeholders.

 - Develop and maintain privacy policies, procedures, playbooks, templates, and internal guidance.

 - Coordinate privacy training and awareness initiatives across the company.


WHO YOU ARE

 - Excited by AI and emerging technologies and interested in solving novel privacy challenges involving voice, biometrics, health information, and other sensitive data.

 - An exceptional program manager who can turn complex requirements into clear workstreams, owners, milestones, and measurable outcomes.

 - Comfortable operating across Legal, Product, Engineering, Security, and commercial teams and able to communicate effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

 - Highly organized and detail-oriented, while able to prioritize effectively and maintain momentum across multiple workstreams.

 - Pragmatic and solutions-oriented, with a strong instinct for building processes that manage risk without creating unnecessary friction.

 - Comfortable building programs and processes from the ground up in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 6+ years of experience in privacy program management, privacy operations, data governance, compliance, or a related field, ideally within a technology, SaaS, or AI company.

 - Demonstrated experience operationalizing privacy requirements under frameworks such as GDPR, CCPA/CPRA, and other US state privacy laws as well as sector specific frameworks such as HIPAA and biometric privacy requirements.

 - Technical mindset, you can read a data flow diagram, understand system architectures and keys to data handling and can translate between legal requirements and engineering implementation.

 - Experience building or significantly improving privacy review processes, privacy impact assessments, or privacy control frameworks.

 - Hands-on experience managing consent management platforms and cookie/tracking technology compliance, including consent configuration, preference management, and coordination with technical and marketing teams.

 - Familiarity with security and privacy frameworks such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or similar.

 - Privacy certifications such as CIPP/US, CIPP/E, CIPM, or CIPT are a plus.

 - Excellent project management, communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills.


LOCATION

This role is remote and can be executed in the United States. We have a strong preference for the Eastern time zone, ideally New York.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Regional Sales Director - Central Region
jobs.description:
Regional Sales Director, Central Region

Reunion Marketing · Remote · Full time · Travel up to 50%

Territory: Montana, Wyoming, Colorado, North Dakota, South Dakota, Nebraska, Kansas, Minnesota, Iowa, and Missouri

Ten states. One owner. That could be you.

From the Rockies through the Plains to the Upper Midwest, there are car dealers spending real money on digital advertising that isn't earning its keep. We want someone who will get in front of them, challenge how they think about it, and show them a smarter, more profitable path.

As Regional Sales Director, the Central Region is yours. You set the strategy, you pick the targets, you close the business, and you grow the relationships. If you like owning a number and a map, read on.

About Reunion Marketing

Reunion Marketing helps automotive dealers win online. Our SEO and Paid Media platforms (KeyLift, LocalEyes, and Adapt) turn search and advertising into measurable results for dealerships and dealer groups. We're built on four values, and we hire for them: Grit, Continuous Improvement, Elevating Others, and Embracing Discomfort.

What you'll do

• Build the territory. Create and run the market strategy for the Central Region, deciding which dealers and dealer groups to pursue in each state.

• Sell face to face. Meet dealer owners, general managers, and digital teams in their stores and at industry events. This is an in-market role, not a desk job.

• Lead with insight. Use a consultative approach that pushes dealers to rethink their digital advertising, and turn SEO and paid media data into clear business outcomes.

• Demo and close. Deliver product demos that show the ROI and simplicity of our platforms, and carry each deal from first conversation through proposal, negotiation, and signature.

• Run a clean pipeline. Use HubSpot, Gong, and Seamless.ai to plan visits, keep opportunities current, and give leadership forecasts they can trust.

• Travel smart. With ten states to cover, you'll plan your time in market around the highest-value dealers and meetings.

• Set clients up to stay. Partner with Client Success on a smooth handoff, and keep supporting retention and growth after the sale.

• Be our ears in the market. Bring back what you hear from dealers and what competitors are doing, so product, marketing, and leadership stay ahead.

What success looks like

• New dealer accounts and new revenue against the territory plan

• A healthy, accurate pipeline and reliable forecasts

• Consistent in-market meetings and demos

• Clients who stay and grow after they sign

What you bring

• 5+ years of high-performance, in-market sales in automotive or digital advertising

• A track record of closing new business and growing long-term client relationships

• Experience selling to owners, executives, and other senior decision-makers

• An understanding of how dealerships buy digital advertising, and comfort talking SEO and paid media metrics

• The discipline to work self-directed, keep a CRM honest, and plan a big territory well

• The ability to challenge a client's thinking while keeping their trust

• Willingness to travel up to 50% across the region

Nice to have

• An existing network of dealer contacts in the Central Region

• Experience with HubSpot, Gong, and Seamless.ai

• Experience selling to multi-rooftop dealer groups

You'll thrive here if

• You'd rather be in a dealership than on a video call

• A big, open territory looks like opportunity, not a problem

• You're motivated by a challenge and take ownership of results

• You get better every quarter and make the people around you better too

The details

• Reports to: VP of Sales

• Location: Remote, ideally based within the territory

• Status: Full time, exempt

Reunion Marketing provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law. We provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities; applicants who need an accommodation during the application process should contact Human Resources.

jobs.title: Asset Protection Specialist (Part Time), Carson City (Clearview)
jobs.description:
The Role

At Green Thumb Industries and RISE Dispensaries, we believe the first impression is everything and that starts with you. As an Asset Protection Specialist (APS), you’re not just a security presence, you’re the warm, welcoming face of the dispensary and a key part of creating an elevated, friendly, concierge-style experience for our guests. This role is ideal for individuals who enjoy connecting with others, maintaining physical readiness to act with urgency, and ensuring everyone feels safe, respected, and cared for.

This is not your traditional security role. It’s a dynamic blend of hospitality, customer service, and safety leadership, designed to enhance both the customer journey and team member experience. Asset Protection Specialists are active, professional, and approachable stewards of our culture, safety, and brand values.

Key Responsibilities

Welcoming & Check-In Experience

• Be the first smiling face our guests see—greet all visitors with warmth and positivity.

• Manage check-in with professionalism and efficiency, while upholding compliance standards.

• Set the “RISE Vibe” from the moment customers enter our doors.

• Provide basic concierge-level support: answering common questions and directing traffic.

Safety, Security & Support

• Serve as a visible, approachable, and responsive presence to deter incidents and ensure a sense of calm and order.

• Monitor various areas of the premises, including the store entry/exit and site perimeters, to ensure safety, comfort, and compliance.

• De-escalate situations with empathy, tact, and clear communication.

• Support team members and store operations in matters of safety, cleanliness, compliance, and guest flow by escorting customers and visitors and remaining alert and mobile at all times.

• Report and respond appropriately and urgently to any safety, security, or compliance incidents.

• Support emergency procedures and preparedness, including fire, evacuation, or weather response.

• Conduct visual inspections and checks per SOPs to maintain a secure and hazard-free environment.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Foster strong relationships and mutual trust with store teams, leadership, and customers.

• Share insights on guest interactions, safety concerns, and security risks with transparency and discretion.

• Support training of new APS team members to model warm, professional, and compliant behavior.

• Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

• At least one year of customer-facing or concierge experience strongly preferred.

• Familiarity with POS systems and/or compliance technology preferred.

• Security, military, or law enforcement experience is a plus when paired with a strong commitment to guest-first, hospitality-focused service.

• Meet the scheduling and availability requirements (i.e., ability to work a schedule inclusive of varying shifts such as mornings, days, nights, and weekends) to meet business needs.

• Must have reliable, responsible, and dependable attendance.

• Must pass all required background checks including state-specific cannabis employment requirements.

• Possess valid driver’s license or state ID.

• Must be 21 years or older and meet all state-specific cannabis employment requirements.

• Must be and remain compliant with all legal or company regulations for working in the cannabis industry.

Additional Requirements

Must have the ability to perform the following tasks for prolonged periods of time (i.e., up to the duration of a scheduled shift or workday)

• Capable of remaining alert and responsive during extended periods of time.

• Move about the dispensary to fulfill work assignments and assist patients and/or customers in various locations of the dispensary.

• Remain in a stationary position, if required, to meet the needs of the business.

• Converse and communicate with individuals and groups of people directly.

• Operate point of sale system, computer, and other office productivity machinery to use online programming and software including word processing, database management, spreadsheet applications and email.

• Inspect and receive detailed information, such as patients' and/or customers' dates of birth, order information, or inquiries.

• Move inventory and materials weighing up to 30 pounds independently.

• Position self to move inventory and materials in storage areas.

• Comfortable standing or walking for extended periods, up to the duration of a scheduled shift or workday and working both indoors and outdoors.

• Asset Protection Specialists are expected to maintain a visible and mobile presence throughout their shift. This is not a desk job—APS team members are regularly on their feet, engaging with guests, monitoring site activity, and supporting operations across the dispensary floor.

Skills

• Friendly, professional demeanor with excellent interpersonal skills.

• Ability to remain calm and empathetic in stressful situations.

• Consistent demonstration of excellent customer service skills.

• Ability to establish and maintain effective working relationships with all employees.

• Ability to listen well and effectively communicate, both verbally and in writing, with various audiences.

• Understanding of applicable cannabis laws and regulations, safety regulations, local municipal codes and organizational rules, and standard operating procedures.

• Employee must be able to follow instructions as directed and incorporate constructive criticism from managers.

• Operate with a high level of professionalism and integrity, including dealing with confidential information and complying with HIPAA requirements.

Working Conditions

• Engaging, fast-paced patient and customer-facing retail environment.

• Outdoor duties in varying weather conditions may be required.

• Exposure to cannabis and/or allergens that might be present in an environment where cannabis is present and prevalent.

Our Mission: To promote well-being through the power of cannabis.

We’re humble—We prefer quiet confidence and don’t shout about our success.
We’re hardworking—We put our heads down and get the job done.
We’re grateful—Working in our industry is a privilege and an act of service.
We’re transparent—Honest and open communication keeps us healthy as an organization.
We’re collaborative—And believe good ideas can come from anywhere.
We have a growth mindset—One that’s grounded in well-being.

At GTI we believe that our corporate community should be a reflection of the communities we serve. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive culture that celebrates diversity across race, sex, age, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability, nationality, religion, experience, and thought—not only because it is right, but because it makes us better. Our mission—the right to wellness—informs our commitment to champion economic opportunities in communities disproportionately affected by the war on drugs through employment and community involvement. GTI is proud to be an equal opportunity workplace.

We can't wait to meet you.

jobs.title: Technical Support Engineer
jobs.description:
SpecterOps is looking for a Technical Support Engineer to help BloodHound Enterprise customers troubleshoot complex technical issues and get back to work with confidence. BloodHound Enterprise helps security teams understand identity-driven attack paths, prioritize remediation, and reduce risk across their environments.

You’ll support customers using both SaaS and on-premises deployments, working through issues that span the application, data collection, authentication, integrations, and the customer’s environment. You’ll own support cases from the first response through resolution, partner with Technical Account Managers, and work with Product and Engineering when an issue needs deeper investigation.

We’re looking for an experienced troubleshooter who asks good questions, communicates clearly, and follows through. You don’t need to arrive as a BloodHound expert or know every technology our customers use. You do need a strong technical foundation and the curiosity to learn unfamiliar systems.

• Salary Range: $100,000–$125,000 base salary annually, commensurate with experience.

• Location: This position is remote, based in the U.S. with optional travel quarterly for in person company events and other ad hoc meetings. Candidate must be authorized to work and reside in the United States; we do not currently sponsor immigration visas. Schedule: Regular US business hours, with participation in a rotating on-call assignment for critical support incidents. During your assigned rotation, coverage includes nights, weekends, and holidays.

Responsibilities

• Own technical support cases from initial response through resolution, meeting response expectations and keeping customers informed even when the investigation is still underway.

• Investigate issues methodically: gather relevant context, interpret logs and errors, test hypotheses, and distinguish environmental or configuration problems from potential product defects.

• Troubleshoot BloodHound Enterprise across SaaS and on-premises deployments, including data collection and ingestion, authentication, connectivity, APIs, and application behavior.

• Help customers identify environmental dependencies affecting the product and coordinate troubleshooting with their administrators and internal escalation partners within the agreed support scope.

• Guide customers through clear, actionable troubleshooting steps and join troubleshooting calls when useful.

• Partner with Technical Account Managers to maintain continuity and share relevant customer context.

• Escalate to Product and Engineering with clear descriptions, diagnostic evidence, reproduction steps where possible, and an explanation of customer impact. Stay engaged through investigation, workaround, and resolution.

• Turn troubleshooting lessons into reusable documentation and knowledge base articles and suggest improvements to support workflows.

• Identify recurring issues and share customer feedback that can improve the product and support experience.

• Handle customer diagnostic data securely and follow approved procedures when requesting information, sharing evidence, or recommending troubleshooting changes.

Requirements

• Four or more years of technical support experience involving hands-on troubleshooting and customer communication.

• Exceptional written and verbal communication with the ability to build customer trust, make complex technical issues understandable, adapt to different audiences, and keep customers informed through clear expectations, proactive updates, and honest.

• Strong troubleshooting judgment: you can break down an unfamiliar problem, identify what evidence is missing, and make progress.

• A working understanding of enterprise IT environments and general security principles, with the ability to investigate configuration, permissions, authentication, and connectivity issues.

• Working knowledge of networking concepts with the ability to investigate connectivity issues between customer environments and the application.

• Practical comfort interpreting logs and error messages and inspecting API requests and responses to investigate a problem.

• Familiarity reading PowerShell and Python scripts and query examples, with a willingness to build those skills on the job.

• The ability to manage competing support priorities, work independently, and recognize when to involve others.

• A willingness to learn BloodHound, the technologies it interacts with, and new approaches to troubleshooting.

• Ability to successfully complete a criminal background investigation.

• Authorization to work and reside in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.

Nice to haves

• Experience with BloodHound Enterprise.

• Familiarity with identity systems, directory services, cloud platforms, or enterprise security tooling.

• Experience supporting customer-hosted applications, containerized deployments, or hybrid SaaS and client-side systems.

• Experience troubleshooting single sign-on, writing scripts, working with REST APIs, or using graph query languages such as Cypher.

You don’t need experience with every technology listed here. We value sound troubleshooting, customer ownership, and demonstrated learning more than a checklist of platforms.

What We Offer

• Health/Dental/Vision/life insurance: 100% covered for both the employee and their family

• Flexible time off policy

• 13 paid holidays annually

• 401(k) with up to 4% company match

• Stock Options & quarterly bonuses

• Remote work: $1,500 new hire allowance to set up home office

• $500 annual home office allowance after first year

• $150 monthly cell phone and internet reimbursement

• $5,000 annual professional development allowance

• $5,250 towards continuing education or student loan repayment

• $1,200 annual budget for lifestyle, wellness, pet insurance and more

• A one-time $10,000 benefit towards family planning

• In person and virtual employee events throughout the year

• And of course, company swag!

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or protected veteran status.  To request reasonable accommodations, please contact us at careers@specterops.io

Unsolicited resumes are not accepted.

jobs.description:

There are many reasons why EPIC Insurance Brokers & Consultants has become one of the fastest-growing firms in the insurance industry.
