jobs.title: Senior Manager, Thermal Systems
jobs.description:
Here at Scout Motors, we're carrying forward the heritage of one of the most iconic American vehicles in history. A vehicle dating back to 1960. One that forged the path for future generations of rugged SUVs and trucks and will do so once again.

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

Organizational Leadership & Development

• Lead, mentor, and develop multiple teams of Design Release Engineers, with accountability for team performance and delivery.

• Foster a culture of technical excellence, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Own resource planning, staffing strategy, and capability development for the Thermal Systems organization.

• Identify and mitigate risks across thermal systems at an organizational level.

Program Execution

• Oversee and provide direction for the design, development, and release of thermal systems across multiple programs.

• Ensure timely delivery of engineering releases, specifications, and validation milestones.

• Coordinate cross-functional activities across manufacturing, purchasing, quality, and suppliers.

• Manage program timelines, budgets, and system-level risks.

Technical Oversight

• Provide direction on system architecture, DFMEA, DVP&R, and compliance.

• Approve major design changes and engineering deliverables.

• Lead root cause investigations and resolution of complex system issues.

• Drive integration of simulation, HIL, and vehicle validation.

Stakeholder Engagement

• Act as senior engineering interface with leadership and external partners.

• Communicate program status, risks, and mitigation plans.

• Align product, program, and supplier teams on system requirements.

Process & Quality Management

• Drive adherence to engineering processes and PLM systems.

• Own KPIs for quality, cost, timing, and performance.

• Support audits and ensure compliance with company standards.

• Lead validation strategy including bench, integration, and vehicle testing.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

• Concept teams driving new architectures.

• Performance & simulation ensuring system requirements are met.

• Production teams ensuring launch readiness.

• Finance ensuring cost targets are achieved.

• Drive innovation and continuous improvement across thermal systems.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors corporate headquarters in Charlotte, NC.

• This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

• Travel: occasional travel required. Valid driver's license required.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in engineering or related field.

• 10+ years of experience in thermal or energy systems engineering.

• 5+ years in a leadership role managing teams or organizations.

• Strong expertise in vehicle thermal systems including battery and HVAC.

• Experience with system architecture and vehicle integration.

• Strong understanding of automotive communication protocols (CAN, LIN, FlexRay).

• Excellent analytical, communication, and leadership skills.

• Understanding of VW Group processes preferred.

What you'll gain

The benefits of joining Scout include the chance to build products and a company from the ground up.  This is a chance to create something new and lasting – with an iconic brand at its foundation.  In addition, Scout provides competitive compensation and benefits to support your physical, mental, and financial wellbeing. Program specifics are detailed in company policies and employee benefit guides, select highlights:

• Competitive insurance including: Medical, dental, vision and income protection plans

• 401(k) program with: An employer match and immediate vesting

• Generous Paid Time Off including: 20 days planned PTO, as accrued 40 hours of unplanned PTO and 14 company or floating holidays, annually Up to 16 weeks of paid parental leave for biological and adoptive parents of all genders Paid leave for circumstances related to bereavement, jury duty, voting time, or military leave

• Corporate Vehicle Program with: Eligibility for 1 assigned vehicle A mobility stipend

Pay Transparency

This is a full-time, exempt position eligible to receive a base salary and to participate in an annual performance bonus program. Final salary offered will be determined based on factors including but not limited to the candidate's skills and experience. The annual performance bonus program is preset and not candidate dependent.

Initial base salary range = $180,000.00 - $220,000.00

• Residing in Los Angeles: Scout Motors will consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a manner consistent with the Los Angeles Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance.

• Residing in New York City: This role is not eligible for remote work in New York City.

Equal Opportunity

Scout Motors is committed to employing a diverse workforce and is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, veteran status, disability, pregnancy, or any other characteristics protected by law. Scout Motors is committed to compliance with all applicable fair employment practice laws. If you require reasonable accommodation to complete a job application, pre-employment testing, or a job interview or to otherwise participate in the hiring process, please contact ScoutAccommodations@scoutmotors.com.

jobs.title: Associate Quality Test Engineer
jobs.description:
10Beauty is a robotics startup based in Burlington, MA on a mission to forever change the beauty and wellness space. We have raised $70M from some of the leading venture and celebrity investors in the country to build the world’s first fully autonomous 5-step manicure machine. We have pre-sold our first 1,000 machines to some of the most iconic brands in America, including Ulta Beauty, Nordstrom, Equinox and Marriott.

As of November 2025, we launched our first robot at Ulta Beauty in Everett, MA and are continuing to scale across said brand locations above. We are a fast growing 60+ person organization with deep robotics experience.

Come join the company who will put 'beauty robotics' on the map!

Introduction

We are looking for a detail-oriented Associate Quality Test Engineer to join our team. In this role, you will help ensure the quality of our Pods, applicators, and machines, from incoming inspections and vendor sample reviews to design validation testing and final quality checks. jobs.title: Director, Regulatory Affairs Business Development
jobs.description:
The Director of Regulatory Business Development is responsible for the regulatory scientific assessment, due diligence activity, preparation of development strategy and scenarios, preparation of risk/gap assessment and mitigations, and the preparation of regulatory assessments and recommendations supporting external business development activities. The position is responsible for supporting all aspects of the Business Development and Acquisition strategy that involves Regulatory activities, including: 1) proactively identifying potential new business opportunities, 2) participating and leading cross-functional teams to conduct thorough evaluations of new business opportunities, 3) formulating recommendations and development scenarios related to Regulatory Affairs aspects for executive management consideration, and 4) participating in negotiations and ensuring timely execution of legal agreements with external parties.  This role serves as the primary GRS interface with Business Development, Search and Evaluation, Research and Development, Global Manufacturing and Supply Chain and Commercial Development organizations for the purposes of scientific assessment, due diligence activities, development plan generation, financial modeling support, and contract creation and finalization. The Director, Regulatory Business Development ensures business needs are met by anticipating, identifying, prioritizing and communicating regulatory risks, as well as developing R&D scenarios to address and mitigate the risks associated with candidates undergoing evaluation. This role supports regulatory activities associated with business transactions including in-licensing and out-licensing, co-development/collaborations, acquisitions of new chemical or molecular entities including advanced, tissue, and cell-based therapies, platform technologies, marketed products, and company acquisitions to further the company’s overall strategic business development objectives.

• Responsible for preparing oral and written regulatory scientific assessments for potential in-license/out-license, R&D co-development/collaborations and all company or asset acquisitions based on face-to-face and virtual meetings with external companies/representatives, and confidential and public data review for identified compounds, companies, or entities
• Responsible for preparing GRS evaluations and recommendations for venture investment opportunities of new and emerging platform technologies
• Responsible for leading GRS activities supporting the out-license/divestiture of AbbVie development stage compounds or marketed products to external business partners
• Responsible for developing the regulatory strategy and inputs into future development plans, commercialization, and targeted product profiles (or aspirational product concepts) for candidates undergoing evaluation for financial modeling purposes. The evaluation includes a first pass resource need assessment
• Responsible for incorporating and negotiating the regulatory activities, specifications, and requirements that are in alignment with the planned development scenario and deal model/structure within the final contract and agreement

Experience working in a complex and matrix environment with multiple stakeholders and influencing cross-functional teams. Experience interfacing with major government regulatory
• Required Experience cont'd: Strong communication and proactive negotiation skills. Experience developing and implementing successful global regulatory strategies

jobs.title: Craft Superintendent
jobs.description:
Craft Superintendent

Fay is a self-perform heavy civil and industrial contractor delivering complex infrastructure projects across the Mid-Atlantic, including roads, bridges, dams, utilities, and demolition, through design-build, CMAR, and traditional delivery methods. We execute the work with our own skilled craft workforce and specialized equipment, maintaining direct control of safety, quality, schedule, and cost. This hands-on model allows us to deliver challenging projects safely, efficiently, and predictably. Our teams succeed in demanding environments where planning, experience, and strong partnerships matter most. Safety comes first, collaboration drives results, and every employee takes ownership of doing the job right. As part of S&B USA Construction, Fay pairs a field driven culture with the strength and resources of a larger organization—delivering local execution with national scale.

Basic Position Summary: Direct all field construction activities and personnel to ensure that the assigned project meets budget, schedule and safety objectives

Responsibilities/Functions:

• Plans and supervises all activities including determining method of construction, sequencing, manpower levels, material quantities, equipment and work schedule

• Trains and manages Foremen from various trades and field administrative personnel

• Through assigned Foremen, manages the day-to-day activities of the construction operation

• In conjunction with the Project Manager, creates and maintains project schedule, plans, monitors and reviews critical path dates and milestone schedules

• Communicates site problems, conflicts, schedule and quality issues effectively to the Project Manager and owner

• Resolves field construction problems

• Maintains open communication between all subcontractors to ensure all required materials, equipment, inspections, etc. support project activities and project schedule

• Monitors Foremen & subcontractor compliance with project safety program requirements; ensures that weekly safety inspections and toolbox talks are completed; ensures that corrective measures are implemented

• Assists the Safety Department in performing incident and/or accident investigations and follow-up

• Understands all subcontractors’ scopes; assures subcontractors maintain schedules, and quality standards meet contract requirements

• Assists the Project Manager with subcontractor disputes, quality control and schedule coordination

• Works with the Project Manager and owner’s representatives to ensure work complies with drawings and specifications

• Supports the Project Manager in the negotiation of claims and changes

• Provides input to Project Manager regarding cost and schedule forecasts

• Assists the Project Manager with review (% complete) of monthly pay requests submitted by contractors

• Assists the Project Manager with Change Order review

• Performs project close-out and ensures punch list is completed in a timely manner

• Monitors staffing levels that contribute to EEO goals for minorities and females

• Mentors Project Engineers assigned to the project

• Performs additional assignments per supervisor’s direction

• Ensure that foremen or self does daily recording of quantities, time and daily logs in Heavy Job.

Essential Skills and Experience:

• A minimum of eight years' experience on Heavy Civil and/or Heavy Highway construction projects in a General Foreman or Craft Superintendent position

• Knowledge of earthwork, grading and drainage work. Trench safety experience is a priority.

• Ability to read and interpret construction documents

• Effective communication skills

• Knowledge of construction scheduling, cost control and ability to control and supervise small to midsized groups

• Good organization, multi-tasking, leadership and decision-making ability

• Basic computer skills preferred

• Ability to manage Pipe Installation, Earthwork & Grading operations.

• Knowledge of Machine Control systems.

Physical Demands:

While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to Carry tools and equipment, climb or balance; stoop, kneel, crouch, or crawl; and see and hear well (either naturally or with correction), stand; walk, (stand for long periods of time) handle, or feel; use arms and hands to reach for, handle and manipulate objects. The employee must frequently work or walk on uneven ground and is required to wear steel toed boots at all times. It is mandatory that the employee wear approved personal protective equipment. The employee must frequently lift and/or move up to 50 pounds.  Perform a variety of duties while exposed to outside elements or confined spaces. Repeat tasks of short duration according to set procedures and evaluate information using measurable. Follow set procedures and standards.

What do we offer:

Competitive compensation, medical/dental/vision coverage, paid PTO, 401k with a company match, training, career planning, and more.

Work Safely: Safety is our Culture

Deliver Return:  Earning a fair profit increases our long-term value

Value People: Take Care of Employees and They Will Take Care of Clients

Act with Integrity: Honesty Builds Trust

Provide Solutions: Better Solutions Yield Greater Satisfaction

jobs.title: Solution Analyst (Loan Administration & Private Debt Servicing)
jobs.description:
The Solution Analyst owns the front-end analysis that turns an emerging business need into a clearly defined, well-understood piece of work, with the outcome, scope, and rationale established before delivery begins.

This is a Solution Analyst role within our loan administration and private debt servicing area. This is a business process outsourcing service: we service loans and private debt on behalf of clients, calculating and collecting borrower interest and allocating it to lenders, maintaining the loan records that downstream reporting and fund valuation depend on. The role brings deep loan-servicing and private-debt operational knowledge into the front-end of complex change. In some cases this servicing links into wider fund administration offerings we provide, and in others it stands alone.

The role sits within the Tech Solutions organisation as a deployable analytical and subject-matter-expert resource, not permanently embedded in any one team, and is deployed against the pipeline of complex work in this area.

What you'll do

• Act as the subject-matter expert and analytical lead for the platforms and processes that support our Private Debt offerings: loan administration, loan agency and CLO.
• Bring deep loan administration and servicing knowledge, covering the loan lifecycle from deal and position set-up through interest and fee calculation, drawdowns, repayments, and lender allocations, to the front-end shaping of solutions, so the work handed to delivery teams reflects how loan servicing actually operates and where it can be improved.
• Protect the integrity of the loan data that flows into downstream reporting and fund valuation, making sure that what the servicing platform produces is timely, accurate, and fit for the processes that depend on it.
• Conduct front-end analysis of complex work, covering feasibility, operating-model implications, data quality, and readiness, before a delivery team picks the work up.
• Collaborate across stakeholder groups to define and document business requirements, translating current-state analysis, requirements, and gaps into a clear solution intent.
• Go and get the information needed to do the analysis directly, querying data, reviewing system configuration and behaviour, and running analysis using AI tooling where it helps, rather than waiting for others to provide answers.
• Work alongside Solution Owners at the front-end of complex work to shape intent and acceptance criteria for the parts of the work that carry the most complexity.
• Represent technical limitations and implementation realities back to business stakeholders, and business intent back to engineers, translating in both directions.
• Identify risks a delivery team would not otherwise see, including data gaps, downstream impacts, operational-readiness concerns, and regulatory implications.
• Partner with Integration Quality Engineers on cross-team and cross-solution test scenarios that no single team can cover.
• Support adoption readiness where value realisation depends on more than the build, including communications, training, data clean-up, and operational change, particularly where readiness work spans teams.
• Recognise patterns across the business area, including recurring themes, overlaps, and opportunities for reuse, feeding roadmap shaping.
• Create and maintain supporting product documentation, including system overviews, functional narratives, and use cases.

Required

• 8+ years of experience in loan administration, loan agency, or private debt / private credit servicing, ideally within a fund services, asset servicing, or agency-lending environment.
• Strong working knowledge of the syndicated and bilateral loan operating model: interest and fee accruals, coupon and amortisation schedules, drawdowns and repayments, PIK, unfunded commitments, and the pro-rata allocation of borrower interest to lenders.
• Demonstrable understanding of the loan life cycle end to end - from document interpretation and extraction of loan economics, through reporting build and integrations to downstream systems, all underpinned by reconciliations to safeguard data integrity.
• Substantial experience gathering, analysing, and documenting business requirements, and translating them into clear solution intent and acceptance criteria.
• Ability to model business processes and produce analytical artefacts such as process models, use cases, procedural guides, and scenarios.
• Strong analytical judgement, knowing what to look at, what to ignore, and when analysis is good enough to act on.
• Credibility with both business and technical stakeholders, with the ability to hold a view under questioning.
• Ability to host and drive requirements-gathering sessions using a variety of elicitation techniques (user story mapping, event storming etc).
• Experience or exposure to system integrations using APIs, S3, Snowflake and similar technologies.
• Expert proficiency in Excel and Word.

Preferred

• Hands-on experience with Sentry (Broadridge), is highly valued and will distinguish leading candidates. Experience in similar platforms would also be valuable (e.g. Allvue, Wall Street Office)
• Understanding of how loan servicing connects into fund accounting and NAV production, including exposure to a private markets accounting platform such as Investran, is a plus.
• Experience across multiple servicing locations or a distributed operating model.
• Experience using AI tools to accelerate the development of prototypes and proof-of-concepts (POCs).
• Experience of platform implementation, configuration, or migration projects.

jobs.description:

At Compass, we envision a world where the experience of selling or buying a home is simple and pleasant for everyone. Founded in 2012, Compass provides an end-to-end platform that empowers residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to their seller and buyer clients. This is all in service of our mission to help everyone find their place in the world.

Compass is building the first end-to-end real estate platform that connects agents, buyers, and sellers through technology. No one else has successfully merged the expertise of countless real estate agents with the capabilities of cloud, mobile, and AI technologies.

As one of our generation's fastest-growing tech companies, we are responsible for creating a world-class product, design, and engineering team, and an operating platform that can revolutionize the real estate sector.

Design at Compass:

Product Designers lead the full lifecycle of their designs across all platforms, collaborate with product managers on strategy, participate in research to test and validate designs, and consult with engineering to bring everything to life.

What We Look For:

We’re looking for an experienced product designer to work on complex real estate transaction related workflows and to deliver experiences that are simple and intuitive. You bring a solid knowledge of best practices and a keen ability to leverage data insights to substantially improve the value and performance of the products you work on. You value feedback, care deeply about quality, and are outcomes-focused. You are great at collaborating with cross-functional peers and leading design thinking methodology. You communicate clearly and concisely and are comfortable interacting with executives and stakeholders to define an approach, present cohesive experiences, articulate decisions, and build alignment.

In addition to being a collaborative partner, you love to execute the creation of great user experiences: mapping seamless flows, contributing components to our design system, and prototyping. You’re hands-on and excited to roll up your sleeves and get things done as part of a dynamic team. You have extensive knowledge of best-in-class UX patterns across web and native mobile platforms and an understanding of how to best integrate these patterns into our system. You also have a strong knowledge of platform affordances and how to use their constraints to enhance design features.

You have pixel-perfect standards with exceptional interaction design skills and an eye for accessibility and usability. You collaborate seamlessly with engineers to ensure well-executed, high-quality experiences on Web, iOS, and Android.

As a Senior Product Designer, you will work closely with a cross-functional team of product designers, product managers,transaction ops stakeholders and engineers to own the iterative design process of major feature initiatives from concept to shipping. You will ideate, prototype, and get user feedback on end-to-end platform design solutions that empower residential real estate agents to deliver exceptional service to their seller and buyer clients. This is a contract position reporting to the Design Director, Product Design.

Responsibility

• Contribute to and develop a wide variety of high-impact enterprise workflow experiences for commissions, contracts and financial reporting.

• Wireframe and prototype to turn concepts into high-fidelity designs and design systems

• Produce visually compelling, intuitive end-to-end workflows that fit seamlessly within the platform and broader brand context

• Drive design research to better understand user behavior, identify key pain points and test the direction of your design solutions.

• Leverage analytics, data, and competitive analysis to constantly validate, improve, advocate for, and measure the success of your designs

• Work in close partnership with product managers to help define the strategy, plan the roadmap, and execute product requirements that meet business objectives

• Work closely with our engineering teams to understand technical feasibility, provide guidance, and ensure quality implementation across platforms (web and native)

What you bring

• 4+ years of user experience (UX) design work

• Proven success in simplifying complex workstreams into simple, intuitive experiences

• Expert user research, storytelling, and prototyping skills

• Knowledge of modern, emerging web and mobile UI patterns and design tools

• Production quality, specialist knowledge of Figma tools, Claude Design, Google Suite

• Strong UX writing skills

• Ability to work in a dynamic and fast paced environment

• Ability to work with autonomy and flexibility

• Customer orientation

The Zero Trust Architecture (ZTA) Subject-Matter Expert (SME) provides strategic consultation to enhance the Agency's ZTA maturity in alignment with federal mandates and the Agency's Cybersecurity Strategy. The role involves evaluating current enterprise architecture, updating the ZTA Implementation Plan, and drafting the OIT Zero Trust Optimization Roadmap. The SME supports the Zero Trust Architecture Implementation & Optimization Integrated Project Team (IPT) and maintains dashboards and documentation to communicate ZTA maturity progress.

What you'll do:

• Serve as Zero Trust SME and strategic consultant to Government leadership.

• Evaluate the Agency's Enterprise Architecture and identify adoption opportunities from a ZTA perspective.

• Identify technology/capability gaps and recommend tools to enhance ZTA capabilities.

• Update the ZTA Implementation Plan and draft the OIT Zero Trust Optimization Roadmap.

• Draft and maintain the Agency's Security Modernization Strategy.

• Support ZTA Implementation & Optimization IPT and consensus-building across working groups.

• Prioritize modernization initiatives and track ZTA risks, issues, and metrics.

• Maintain the SecMod/ZT JIRA project board and develop BI dashboards tracking ZTA maturity.

• Develop technical documentation and executive summaries for security modernization efforts.

What you need:

• Minimum 5 years of professional experience in information assurance, cybersecurity, risk management, or compliance; or a bachelor's degree in a related field with 3 years of such experience.

• Demonstrated knowledge and experience with M-22-09, Zero Trust Architecture pillars, CISA Zero Trust Maturity Model, and related frameworks and standards.

• Experience with Risk Assessments, NIST SP 800-37 RMF, NIST Cybersecurity Framework, and security policy writing.

• One of the following certifications: ISC2 CISSP, ISACA CISM, ISACA CRISC, GIAC GCED, or CompTIA CEH.

As the only vertically integrated AI infrastructure company built from the ground up, we own and operate each layer of the stack — from electrons to tokens — to power the world's most ambitious AI workloads. When you join Crusoe, you join a team that is building the future, faster.



We're in the midst of the greatest industrial revolution of our time. The demand for AI compute is boundless, and power is a bottleneck. We're solving that — with an energy-first approach that makes AI infrastructure better for the world and faster for the people innovating with AI.



We're looking for problem-solving, opportunity-finding teammates with a sense of urgency, who believe in the scale of our ambition and thrive on a path not fully paved — people who want to grow their careers alongside a team of experts across energy, manufacturing, data center construction, and cloud services.

The ideal candidate will be a key contributor to all aspects of designing and creating a robust IR function, with significant experience in a dynamic environment that is market-facing with a proven track record supporting the capital markets participants.  Experience in sell-side equity research, capital markets or investor-facing roles within scaled organizations desired. jobs.title: Safety Engineer
jobs.description:
OUR MISSION:

At Sunrise Robotics, we are dedicated to augmenting humanity through intelligent robotics. Our mission is to elevate the world of manufacturing by introducing intelligent, flexible robots that enhance human capabilities and existing machinery, ushering in the next era of production at higher quality, with less waste, and lower cost.



OUR VISION:

We see a future where every element of manufacturing, from design to assembly, is optimised with intelligent automation. Our vision is to integrate flexible robotic solutions, based on generic hardware and advanced software/AI capabilities, into manufacturing, particularly in small and medium-sized enterprises, to make automation economically viable and accessible, for all sizes of manufacturers. We are not just building robots; we are creating the strategically crucial components for autonomous, intelligent agents of the future.


THE ROLE

At Sunrise Robotics, this role owns the safety of our robotic cells as a product, from the first design decision to the cell running on a customer's floor. That covers functional safety, safety in our robotics software, and the sign-off of every deployment.

Our robotic cells combine two industrial robot arms, cameras, a safety PLC, radar presence sensing and software that changes what the cell does from one product variant to the next. Every new application changes the hazards. Your job is to know exactly what changed, and to stop us repeating safety work for everything that didn't.

You are part of the design, not a check at the end. You work with our robotics and software engineers on motion planning, perception and how the cell behaves around people, and decide early which risks need a safety function and which the software can handle.

We are creating a new way of doing high-mix manufacturing, and safety standards were written for machines that do one fixed job. That leaves a grey zone where the standards give no clean answer. We need someone creative who can operate in that grey zone and bring clarity: work out a safe answer, defend it, and write it down so others can follow it. That means being creative about how we reach a safe design, never about whether a design is safe.


WHAT YOU'LL OWN

 - The safety concept for our cell platform: which hazards and safety functions are assessed once, so each new application assesses only what it changes.

 - Safety in design: input to our robotics software from the first design review, safety requirements in every product and application requirements document, and sign-off on each solution design.

 - Functional safety: you specify each safety function in the safety PLC and robot safety controller, including how reliable it must be, and prove it works. Our robotics integration engineer writes the PLC code.

 - Risk assessments, the CE technical file and the Declaration of Conformity for each cell, including our move to the new EU Machinery Regulation.

 - Site safety for each deployment, from layout and guarding to operator access, and safety checks at every acceptance test.

 - Our rules for testing cells safely in R&D, including Reduced Safety Mode.

 - Root cause investigation of safety faults and incidents.

 - Safety content for the cell manual, and customers' safety questions in presales.


WHAT YOU'LL NEED

 - At least five years of machinery safety work on industrial machines or robotic cells, including risk assessments and CE marking you prepared or signed.

 - Functional safety experience: specifying and validating safety functions on safety PLCs, robot safety controllers and safety sensors such as radar, scanners and light curtains.

 - Working knowledge of EU machinery law, including the new Machinery Regulation, and of the two core standards: ISO 12100 for risk assessment and ISO 13849 for functional safety.

 - You can read a software design and talk with robotics engineers about how their algorithms behave around people.

 - You have made safety calls where no standard gave a direct answer, and written them up so others could follow and challenge the reasoning.

 - The judgement to hold a line on safety under schedule pressure, and to bring senior engineers with you.

 - Clear written English. Your requirements can be built and tested without anyone coming back to ask what you meant.

 - Willingness to travel about 25% of the time.


WHAT MAKES YOU STAND OUT

 - A recognised machinery safety qualification, such as TÜV Functional Safety Engineer or CMSE.

 - You have built one safety concept that covered a family of machine variants.

 - Experience with collaborative or fenceless robot applications.

 - Experience bringing safety into robot motion, control or perception software, and a view on where machine learning ends and safety functions begin.

 - Time at a machine builder or integrator that went from a handful of machines a year to dozens.


HOW YOU'LL WORK

You'll work with product, robotics, software and mechanical engineers, our forward deployed engineers, and commercial in presales.

The role is remote, within three hours of Central European Time, with regular time at our cells in Ljubljana and on customer sites.


WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

In the first months, you take over safety sign-off for every cell in progress and know what is open on each.

After that, your recommendations shape every application and software design before it is built, and no deployment waits on a late safety review.

Longer term, a new application on our cell platform needs a safety assessment of its changes only.


WHY SUNRISE

 - You set how safety works here. You are our primary safety engineer, so the approach, the policies and the platform safety concept are yours to define.

 - A new kind of machine under new rules. Our cells change what they do from one product to the next, and EU machinery law gets its first major rewrite since 2006 in January 2027. You work out what safe looks like for this kind of machine as the rules change.

 - Your work runs in production. Our cells run in electronics factories across Europe, and every safety decision you make ships with the next deployment.

jobs.title: Senior Linux & Infrastructure Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
The Senior Linux & Infrastructure Automation Engineer is responsible for engineering, scaling, and maintaining the underlying Valassis DMT platform environment. This individual contributor role focuses heavily on hands-on systems engineering, robust configuration management, and high-availability cloud infrastructure execution across hybrid environments, spanning bare-metal servers, collocations, and cloud architectures. The position requires deep expertise in Linux systems administration, advanced automation using Puppet and Ansible, and experience deploying and operating OpenStack environments.

Core Responsibilities

• Infrastructure Automation & Configuration Management: Design, develop, and maintain declarative configuration modules using Puppet and Ansible to automate system provisioning, application deployment, and continuous compliance across bare-metal and virtualized nodes.
• Linux Systems Engineering: Administer, tune, and troubleshoot enterprise Linux environments (primarily Ubuntu) for optimal performance, kernel optimization, security hardening, and maximum uptime.
• Cloud & Virtualization Operations: Operate and optimize virtualization and hypervisor layers (including OpenStack, LXD, KVM, and ESXi lifecycles) and drive automated bare-metal server provisioning.
• Storage & Infrastructure Maintenance: Administer and maintain persistent storage infrastructure alongside physical SAN equipment (PureStorage or enterprise S3-compatible targets).
• Technical Execution & Migrations: Actively execute platform refreshes, legacy environment decommissionings, and infrastructure migrations across datacenter footprints.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related engineering discipline, or equivalent professional work experience.
• Minimum of 5–7+ years of progressive hands-on experience in Linux infrastructure engineering, systems administration, and cloud infrastructure automation.

Required Skills

• Linux Administration - Expert-level, hands-on experience engineering, hardening, and maintaining enterprise Ubuntu/Debian server environments.
• Automation & CM - Proven mastery authoring custom Puppet modules and Ansible playbooks/roles to automate configuration, orchestration, and system management at scale.
• Orchestration & Virtualization -Strong foundational background in bare-metal provisioning concepts and hypervisor/container runtimes (KVM, LXD, ESXi).
• Storage Fundamentals -Solid understanding of enterprise storage architectures, including SAN/NAS devices, block/object storage concepts, and volume management.
• Identity & Security -Working knowledge of cross-platform Active Directory integration, enterprise PKI/certificate enrollment, and domain identity services.

Preferred Skills (Nice to Have)

• OpenStack Operations: Hands-on experience configuring, troubleshooting, and maintaining production OpenStack deployments (Nova, Neutron, Cinder, Keystone).
• Scale-Out Storage (Ceph): Direct experience configuring, operating, or maintaining Ceph storage clusters.
• Bare-Metal Provisioning Tools (MAAS): Hands-on experience with Canonical MAAS or similar automated bare-metal provisioning platforms.
• MicroCloud & Edge Frameworks: Familiarity with MicroCloud deployment and lightweight cloud infrastructure environments.

jobs.title: Applied ML/CS PhD Internship (6+ months)
jobs.description:
About Cartesian

Cartesian is building spatial intelligence for indoor environments to drive operational efficiency. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in the $35T global retail industry: in-store inventory visibility. Our platform delivers accurate indoor positioning and actionable product location insights, helping retailers streamline operations, optimize workflows, and reduce inefficiencies. By fusing wireless signals and mobile computer vision, we provide a uniquely scalable, infrastructure-free solution already deployed by international fashion brands.

Founded by an MIT engineering professor and alumni behind award-winning, patented core technologies, Cartesian spun out in 2023. Originally backed by a U.S. National Science Foundation SBIR Award, we’ve bootstrapped to a live product now deployed in multiple countries and are scaling aggressively.

About the Role

We are looking for an Applied ML/CS PhD intern to join Cartesian at an exciting moment in our growth. This internship is a chance to contribute to core algorithms, dig deep into a deployed product, and ship changes that reach enterprise customers, while also driving new research directions in spatial AI. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of machine learning, perception, estimation, and signal processing, with direct impact on a deployed enterprise product. You’ll gain exposure to the full journey of research in production, working in a fast-paced, hands-on environment where your work makes a tangible impact.

This internship is product- and impact-driven. Due to the IP-sensitive nature of the core models and algorithms, the internship is not expected to involve publications.

Location: In-person at the Cartesian HQ in Kendall Square, Cambridge.

Internship type: Full-time, PhD internship

Duration and timing: 12–24 weeks, Summer 2026; flexible start dates

What You’ll Do

• Explore new research directions in sensor fusion and spatial AI aligned with product needs

• Develop and improve algorithms for indoor positioning and spatial perception

• Run experiments on real-world customer deployments: collect data, analyze failures, propose fixes, and validate improvements

• Contribute to production ML and signal processing pipelines (modeling, evaluation, deployment)

• Collaborate with engineering and product to ship features to enterprise customers

Qualifications

• Currently enrolled in a PhD program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.

• Research track record of published work in top-tier CS/ML, vision, robotics, or related venues.

• Strong foundations in at least one of: machine learning, perception, sensor fusion, and/or signal processing.

• Demonstrated research output (e.g., strong publications, open-source projects, or impactful applied work)

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a small, fast-moving team.

• Curiosity, ownership, and a bias toward action and real-world impact

Nice to Have

• Startup or early-stage company experience

• Experience shipping products (e.g., part of internships)

• Experience or strong interest in spatial AI (3D vision, SLAM, mapping, sensor fusion, geometric deep learning, …) is highly desirable.

Why Cartesian

• Work on hard, real-world problems with immediate and visible impact

• Join a small, highly technical team with significant ownership and autonomy

• Build systems that are deployed and used globally

• Collaborative, thoughtful, low-ego culture focused on learning and execution

• In-person team culture in the heart of Kendall Square, Cambridge

Interview Process

• Introductory call to assess motivation and overall fit (20m)

• Technical interview focused on past projects (60m)

• Technical design interview (45m)

• Coding interview (45m)

• Meet Prof. Fadel Adib (20m)

• Meet the team and references

jobs.title: Postdoctoral Associate
jobs.description:
About Cartesian

Cartesian is building spatial intelligence for indoor environments to drive operational efficiency. We’re tackling one of the biggest challenges in the $35T global retail industry: in-store inventory visibility. Our platform delivers accurate indoor positioning and actionable product location insights, helping retailers streamline operations, optimize workflows, and reduce inefficiencies. Leveraging wireless signals, we provide a uniquely scalable, infrastructure-free solution already deployed by international fashion brands.

Founded by an MIT engineering professor and alum behind the award-winning, patented core technologies, Cartesian spun out in 2023. Originally backed by the prestigious SBIR Award from the US National Science Foundation, we've bootstrapped to a live product that's now deployed in over a dozen countries and have been aggressively scaling in the market.

About the Role

We are looking for a Postdoctoral Associate to join Cartesian at an exciting moment in our growth. This opportunity is a chance to contribute to core algorithms, dig deep into a deployed product, and ship changes that reach enterprise customers, while also driving new research directions in spatial AI. This is a hands-on role at the intersection of machine learning, perception, estimation, and signal processing, with direct impact on a deployed enterprise product. You’ll gain exposure to the full journey of research in production, working in a fast-paced, hands-on environment where your work makes a tangible impact.

This role is product- and impact-driven. Due to the IP-sensitive nature of the core models and algorithms, this role is not expected to involve publications.

Location: In-person at the Cartesian HQ in Kendall Square, Cambridge.

Role type: Full-time, PhD postdoctoral position

Duration: Minimum 1 year

What You’ll Do

• Explore new research directions in sensor fusion and spatial AI aligned with product needs

• Develop and improve algorithms for indoor positioning and spatial perception

• Run experiments on real-world customer deployments: collect data, analyze failures, propose fixes, and validate improvements

• Contribute to production ML and signal processing pipelines (modeling, evaluation, deployment)

• Collaborate with engineering and product to ship features to enterprise customers

Qualifications

• About to complete or recently completed a PhD program in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Robotics, or a related field.

• Research track record of published work in top-tier CS/ML, vision, robotics, or related venues.

• Strong foundations in at least one of: machine learning, perception, sensor fusion, and/or signal processing.

• Demonstrated research output (e.g., strong publications, open-source projects, or impactful applied work)

• Excellent communication skills and ability to work in a small, fast-moving team.

• Curiosity, ownership, and a bias toward action and real-world impact

Nice to Have

• Startup or early-stage company experience

• Experience shipping products (e.g., part of internships)

• Experience or strong interest in spatial AI (3D vision, SLAM, mapping, sensor fusion, geometric deep learning, …) is highly desirable.

Why Cartesian

• Work on hard, real-world problems with immediate and visible impact

• Join a small, highly technical team with significant ownership and autonomy

• Build systems that are deployed and used globally

• Collaborative, thoughtful, low-ego culture focused on learning and execution

• In-person team culture in the heart of Kendall Square, Cambridge

Interview Process

• Introductory call to assess motivation and overall fit (20m)

• Technical interview focused on past projects (60m)

• Technical design interview (45m)

• Coding interview (45m)

• Meet Prof. Fadel Adib (20m)

• Meet the team and references

This therapy is used to increase critical developmental skills such as language and communication, social, and school readiness behaviors..

jobs.title: Manager, US Facilities Operations & Space Management
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Manager, US Facilities Operations & Space Management serves as the primary leader for facilities operations, infrastructure services, workplace planning, space utilization, project management, vendor management, workplace support services, and facilities-related strategic initiatives across supported U.S. locations. The role combines formal leadership of the entire Infrastructure team with substantial hands-on technical and design contribution, serving as the accountable owner for safe, reliable, compliant, cost-effective, and employee-focused workplaces. This position develops and maintains space, office, production, distribution, and land-use concepts; leads renovations, expansions, consolidations, conversions, relocations, and workplace transformation initiatives; coordinates vendors, contractors, architects, and engineers; supports building systems and operational continuity; and translates business growth requirements into practical facility and workplace solutions. The manager personally develops or reviews AutoCAD and Building Information Modeling (BIM) layouts, models, test fits, and visualizations when needed and directs internal or external design resources when broader project demand or strategy requires. Based on organizational need and the selected candidate’s background, formal responsibility may expand to include the Maintenance Department.

This position includes formal people management responsibilities. These responsibilities include direct supervision of employees, performance management, talent development, resource allocation, employee engagement, and career development. People leaders are accountable for team performance, employee engagement, and career development. This role is intentionally structured as a working manager position that balances leadership, operational oversight, and strategic planning with direct facilities, space-planning, technical, and design contribution.

Responsibilities

• Lead and coordinate daily facilities and infrastructure operations across supported U.S. locations, maintaining safe, reliable, compliant, cost-effective, and customer-focused workplace environments.

• Direct the entire Infrastructure team and establish clear priorities, accountabilities, service standards, schedules, and resource plans; assume leadership of Maintenance Department personnel if organizationally assigned based on business needs and the selected candidate’s background.

• Maintain operational oversight of HVAC, electrical infrastructure, utilities, building automation, security and access control, fire and life-safety systems, grounds, workplace services, emergency response, preventive maintenance, and facility service requests.

• Monitor work-order performance, preventive-maintenance completion, service quality, asset reliability, downtime, customer concerns, energy usage, and other facilities KPIs; implement corrective actions and improvements.

• Serve as a hands-on technical and design contributor by developing, updating, or reviewing floor plans, test fits, space layouts, equipment arrangements, and three-dimensional visualizations using AutoCAD, BIM, and related tools.

• Determine and maintain space requirements and occupancy data; create office, production, laboratory, distribution, storage, and land-use concepts that support business growth, operational flow, safety, accessibility, hybrid-work considerations, and employee experience.

• Lead occupancy planning, space-utilization analysis, workplace planning, furnishing, desk-sharing, moves, additions, and changes, including personnel, furniture, equipment, production, and distribution relocations.

• Prepare or coordinate project plans, scopes of work, design criteria, specifications, functional requirements, cost estimates, schedules, budgets, resource requirements, and technical documentation for renovations, expansions, consolidations, conversions, relocations, and construction projects.

• Manage facilities projects and workplace transformation initiatives from concept through closeout, including feasibility, design coordination, permitting, procurement, risk management, contractor oversight, installation, commissioning, punch-list resolution, and turnover.

• Select, engage, and manage architects, engineers, contractors, suppliers, furniture providers, and other service partners; monitor safety, quality, schedule, cost, performance, deliverables, and contractual compliance.

• Maintain accurate digital facilities records, including BIM models, CAD drawings, as-built documents, equipment and asset records, operations and maintenance manuals, construction files, warranties, and space data.

• Use facilities, space, financial, vendor, energy, and asset-lifecycle data to develop dashboards, KPIs, analyses, and recommendations that support informed decision-making and continuous improvement.

• Partner with Operations, Production, Distribution, EHS, Security, Information Technology, People & Organization, Finance, Purchasing, Real Estate, and business leaders to align facility solutions with operational and workforce needs.

• Support capital planning, annual operating plans, forecasting, spend analysis, purchase requests, invoice review, and fixed-asset coordination; identify risks, alternatives, and recommendations for leadership review.

• Exercise delegated approval authority for operating expenses, capital expenditures, unbudgeted capital expenditures, and purchasing-card transactions in accordance with established financial controls, policies, and authorization limits.

• Ensure compliance with applicable OSHA, environmental, fire and life-safety, accessibility, building-code, permitting, and company requirements, and support inspections, audits, documentation, and corrective actions.

• Develop and maintain facilities standards, multi-site governance, procedures, emergency plans, service expectations, and scalable operating practices aligned with U.S. and global direction.

• Identify and implement opportunities to improve space utilization, facility reliability, energy efficiency, sustainability, process effectiveness, cost performance, risk control, employee experience, and service delivery.

• Lead cross-functional change associated with workplace transformations, facility consolidations, office relocations, site expansions, and operational improvement initiatives.

• Lead, coach, and develop employees through clear expectations, ongoing feedback, performance management, development planning, succession considerations, engagement, and knowledge sharing.

• Allocate work and resources across operational needs, planning activities, projects, and urgent events while maintaining appropriate coverage and business continuity.

• Communicate plans, milestones, budget performance, trade-offs, risks, progress, and recommendations clearly to technical and nontechnical stakeholders and facilitate productive decision-making across functions and locations.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s degree in Facilities Management, Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Construction Management, Operations Management, Industrial Engineering, Architecture, Business Administration, or a related technical or business discipline, or an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.

• Typically requires 10 or more years of progressive experience in facilities operations, workplace services, real estate, space planning, engineering, construction, or operations, including at least 5 years of formal people leadership experience.

• Multi-site facilities management experience within a complex commercial, manufacturing, engineering, laboratory, distribution, or automated warehouse environment.

• Demonstrated experience supporting manufacturing and distribution operations and the associated production, logistics, utility, asset, and infrastructure requirements.

• Demonstrated experience with strategic space programming, occupancy planning, utilization analysis, test fits, hybrid workplace design, site expansion or consolidation planning, office and production layouts, moves, additions and changes, renovation planning, relocations, and workplace-design solutions.

• Working proficiency with AutoCAD and experience using BIM authoring, coordination, or model-review tools to create, modify, interpret, and manage facility drawings, space plans, and three-dimensional models.

• Working knowledge of HVAC, electrical infrastructure, building automation, security and access control, fire and life-safety, utilities, maintenance systems, and facility infrastructure.

• Experience leading facility renovations, expansions, consolidations, workplace transformations, construction, conversions, or relocations through planning, design, permitting, execution, commissioning, and closeout.

• Experience developing and managing project plans, schedules, budgets, resources, risks, milestones, contractors, architects, engineers, and cross-functional deliverables.

• Experience managing operating and capital budgets, forecasts, purchase approvals, contracts, vendors, financial controls, and senior-leadership reporting.

• Experience developing or using facilities KPIs, space-utilization metrics, budget and cost analytics, vendor-performance measures, energy reporting, and asset-lifecycle analysis to support decisions.

• Knowledge of applicable workplace safety, environmental, accessibility, building-code, permitting, and regulatory requirements.

• Demonstrated people leadership capability, including setting expectations, delegating work, coaching, developing talent, managing performance, supporting succession, and building an accountable and inclusive team.

• Strong strategic planning, business acumen, executive communication, stakeholder influence, change leadership, project management, analytical, organizational, problem-solving, negotiation, resource-allocation, and decision-making skills.

• Ability to translate technical facility, space, design, financial, and operational information into clear recommendations for leaders, employees, contractors, and cross-functional partners.

• Ability to work both strategically and hands-on, independently producing technical or design deliverables when needed while directing internal and external resources for larger initiatives.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Office and experience with Integrated Workplace Management Systems, Computerized Maintenance Management Systems, facilities or space-management platforms, project-management systems, building automation systems, energy-management platforms, or document-management systems.

• Demonstrates a willingness to collaborate with others, build relationships, and involve others in decision making.

• Demonstrates the ability to deliver results by solving or supporting others in solving problems, prioritizing tasks, and/or resources, and focusing on outcomes.

• Demonstrates the ability to develop and adapt strategies, communicate convincingly, and regularly track how strategies have been achieved.

• Demonstrates the ability to develop people and teams by providing suitable developmental opportunities, delegating work, and building effective teams.

• Demonstrates self-awareness and the willingness to learn and grow, accept changes, and effectively adapt to changing work demands.

• Demonstrates the ability to drive customer value through knowledge of the business, putting effort into identifying customer needs, and delivering work to maximize the value for customers.

• Demonstrates a willingness to promote the value of improvement and innovation by staying ahead of trends, creating ideas and opportunities, and generating speed.

• Demonstrates a willingness to initiate change and inspire people, provide orientation in uncertain times, and understand and address concerns regarding change.

• Demonstrates a willingness to take ownership by making decisions, taking responsibility, and driving things forward.

Supporting Qualifications

• Advanced degree in Business Administration, Engineering Management, Organizational Leadership, Facilities Management, or a related discipline.

• Professional credential such as Certified Facility Manager (CFM), Facility Management Professional (FMP), Project Management Professional (PMP), Sustainability Facility Professional (SFP), Certified Energy Manager (CEM), OSHA 30, Certified Maintenance & Reliability Professional (CMRP), WELL Accredited Professional, LEED Accredited Professional, or a comparable credential.

• Experience with Autodesk Revit or comparable BIM authoring software, AutoCAD, Navisworks or model-review tools, and Integrated Workplace Management or facility-management platforms.

• Experience supporting electronics, electromechanical, industrial automation, manufacturing, distribution, logistics automation, or other technically complex operations.

• Experience with smart-building technologies, building automation systems, computerized maintenance management systems, energy-management platforms, security and access-control systems, and facility-performance analytics.

• Experience with workplace strategy, hybrid-work environments, change management, furniture standards, move management, real estate planning, occupancy analytics, site expansion, or facility consolidation.

• Knowledge of construction document control, digital-twin practices, scan-to-BIM, as-built validation, and lifecycle facility information management.

Essential Job Functions

• Regular and on-time attendance.

• Ability to travel domestically to supported U.S. locations and project sites as business needs require.

• Ability to respond to urgent facilities matters outside standard business hours when necessary.

Perks & Benefits

Phoenix Contact offers a generous benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k matching, and a generous time off package. There are also a wide variety of additional benefits available including 16 weeks fully paid maternity leave & 10 weeks fully paid paternity leave, life insurance, short & long-term disability, assistance, and more!

Phoenix Contact is committed to the diversity of our employees. We are an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, disability, gender identity or expression, marital status, national or ethnic origin, political affiliation, race, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, veteran status, and family medical or genetic information.

If you need special accommodations to access job openings or to apply for a job, please call 717-944-1300 between the hours of 8 AM and 5 PM, Eastern Standard Time, Monday – Friday or email HR@phoenixcontact.com.

Phoenix Contact will NOT pay a fee for any placement resulting from the receipt of an unsolicited resume. jobs.description:

The concierge is the first person to greet and assist patients, visitors, and staff and coordinates the flow of patients, visitors, and staff in a positive and timely manner.

• Assists patients for clinic-side, outpatient, department needs, inpatient, and alternate locations

jobs.title: Industrial Technician - State College, PA
jobs.description:
JOB POSITION:  Industrial Technician

Are you interested in becoming an experienced Overhead Crane Service Technician? Join Konecranes, one of the world’s largest material handling companies. We're seeking skilled individuals with electrical and mechanical expertise, comfortable working at extreme heights. Our service technicians, the heart of our industry, thrive in a safety-first environment. You'll troubleshoot 480 3-phase motors, address crane issues, and collaborate with clients and facility directors to meet service needs across the United States.

Principal Responsibilities:

• Conduct inspections, maintenance, and repairs on electric overhead traveling cranes and hoists at customer locations.
• Provide on-call service as part of a rotation, including after-hours support.
• Troubleshoot electrical, mechanical, structural, and electronic issues on-site.
• Perform post-repair audits to ensure safety features are functional.
• Document findings and recommend corrective actions, including safety notifications to customers.
• Consult with customers on repair and safety issues, offering recommendations for material handling improvement.
• Produce electronic documentation using company tools, obtaining customer signatures.
• Stay updated on industry codes and regulations (OSHA, ANSI, CMAA, HMI).
• Complete service reports and other required documents accurately and promptly.
• Communicate with the Field Operations Manager and Service Coordinator following established practices
• Maintain company-issued equipment, vehicles, and assets in proper working order.
• Operate tools, equipment, and vehicles, reporting deficiencies to the supervisor.
• Follow established safety rules and procedures, including customer guidelines.
• Participate in monthly safety meetings.
• Perform other responsibilities as assigned by the supervisor.

Education: High School Diploma required. Associate degree in Industrial Electrical and/or Mechanical Technology or related field preferred or equivalent vocational/technical training and experience.

Experience: Minimum one (1) year experience involving electrical troubleshooting and mechanical repair. Some electronic experience but not necessary. Prior experience with cranes is a benefit, but not required.

Other Requirements: Must have and maintain a good driving record, including a valid driver's license. Must be willing to work off the ground. Can work varied overtime, as needed by customer, be available for "on call" as part of the service office rotation and be able to travel and work out of town, on occasion.

Must be able to frequently lift to 25 lbs. Must be able to lift up to 50 lbs. on a daily basis. Must be able to lift to 75 lbs. although not on a daily basis. Must be able to lift 100 lbs. on a rare basis. This position requires frequent climbing, balancing, stooping/crouching, and overhead reaching. This position requires occasional pushing, pulling, kneeling, and crawling. This position will be inside approximately 90% of the time and outside approximately 10% of the time. This position will be frequently exposed to heat, cold, noise and heights.

• This is a safety sensitive position.
• *KCN

What we offer:

Salary: $22 - $48 an hour - Pay is determined based on skills, geographic location, internal equity, market/data analysis, number of years of prior relevant experience, degrees and/or certifications, technical assessment score, etc.

Company Vehicle: Our Service Technicians get a work truck and a gas card to be used for business purposes. Candidates must pass a Motor Vehicle Record (MVR) check.

Benefits: Medical Plan, Dental, Vision, 401k plan with a match from day one, identity theft protection, accident insurance, travel insurance and so much more!

Vacation: 2 weeks of vacation per year (pro-rated for the first year depending on start date). 5-12 years of service, 3 weeks. 13+ years of service, 4 weeks.

Sick Leave: 5 days of Sick Leave per year. Pro-rated the first year after 90 days of service

Holidays: 10 paid holidays per year

Konecranes moves what matters. Konecranes is a global leader in material handling solutions, serving a broad range of customers across multiple industries. We consistently set the industry benchmark, from everyday improvements to the breakthroughs at moments that matter most, because we know we can always find a safer, more productive and sustainable way. That's why, with 16 000+ professionals in over 50 countries, we are trusted every day to lift, handle and move what the world needs.

jobs.title: Associate Director, Training and Contract Operations
jobs.description:
Who We Are:

Cogent Biosciences is a publicly traded biotechnology company focused on developing novel precision therapies to treat a broad range of patients with unmet medical needs. Cogent’s lead program, bezuclastinib, is designed to selectively and potently inhibit exon 17 mutations found within the KIT receptor tyrosine kinase, including KIT D816V. KIT D816V is responsible for driving a rare and serious condition called Systemic Mastocytosis, and exon 17 mutations are also found in patients with gastrointestinal stromal tumors (GIST), a type of cancer with strong dependence on oncogenic KIT signaling. Bezuclastinib has exhibited promising initial data across all three trials: APEX in AdvSM, SUMMIT in NonAdvSM and PEAK in GIST, including an encouraging safety profile across 600+ patients in single agent and combination dosing.

The Role:

The Associate Director, Training and Contract Operations holds two core accountabilities that together drive operational excellence across the commercial organization.

The first is direct operational partnership with the Sr. Director, Training & Field Enablement — leading the tactical execution, planning, and governance of commercial training initiatives, field meetings, and enablement programs. This role serves as a critical partner across Sales, Commercial Operations, Marketing, Compliance, Finance, Legal, Procurement, and the People Team to ensure the successful delivery of commercial enablement programs and field-facing events.

The second is ownership of contract operations — facilitating commercial contracts, SOWs, and vendor agreements on behalf of the broader commercial organization as they move through the review and approval lifecycle. This role shepherds, coordinates, and facilitates our commercial contracts ensuring contracts are complete, correctly routed and moving efficiently through the review and approval process.

The balance of time and focus between these two accountabilities will flex based on business need, launch timelines, and organizational priorities. The ideal candidate is a highly organized and influential leader who excels at tactical execution, managing complex vendors and event portfolios, and driving operational excellence through effective cross-functional collaboration.

Responsibilities:

• Commercial Training & Field Operations Training & Cross-Functional Collaboration Oversee execution of commercial training initiatives, onboarding programs, field communications, the training advisory board, and operational projects from planning through implementation Build and execute live and virtual training workshops for field and cross-functional commercial partners Partner with Sales, Marketing, Medical Affairs, Market Access, Compliance, HR, and Commercial Operations to ensure alignment between training, brand strategy, and field execution Support POAs, national meetings, and commercial milestones Partner with the Sr. Director, Training & Field Enablement to define the long-term vision, priorities, and evolution of the Commercial Learning function Manage multiple high-priority training projects simultaneously while maintaining quality, timeliness, and budget adherence, and continuously evaluate processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness Meeting Planning & Event Operations Support planning and execution of national sales meetings, launch meetings, POA meetings, training workshops, and virtual events Manage meeting logistics including venue sourcing, vendor selection, contract negotiation, and budget oversight for events, attendee management, and event execution Collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to develop meeting objectives, agendas, content timelines, and success metrics Drive continuous improvement in meeting planning processes and attendee experience Contract Operations Central Coordination & Facilitation Serve as the operational point of contact facilitating commercial contracts for the broader commercial organization — triaging intake, prioritizing based on business need, and shepherding each agreement through review and approval Coordinate between the business and Legal/Procurement, facilitating timely, clear communication and maintaining an aligned signature process with proactive stakeholder heads-up and status alerts CLM, Efficiency & Enablement Own and administer the end-to-end contract workflow within the CLM system (e.g., Agiloft, DocuSign CLM, or equivalent) — intake forms, routing rules, approval workflows, and status tracking — ensuring contracts and amendments remain audit-ready Identify and flag contract language with potential business implications ("are we comfortable with this?") and surface synergies or redundancies — same vendors supporting multiple functions, contracts mirroring previously approved terms — building in pre-reviews to prevent late-stage bottlenecks Act as "Train the Trainer" on Contracting Excellence — training business submitters and contract owners on process, CLM tool usage, and best practices

Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree required; advanced degree preferred 8+ years of experience in Commercial Operations, Training, Field Enablement, Sales Operations, Meeting Planning, Contract Operations, or related functions within biotechnology, pharmaceutical, medical device, or healthcare organizations Demonstrated experience coordinating complex contracts and vendor relationships — without owning drafting, negotiation, or risk decisions Proven experience leading large-scale meetings and events, including national sales meetings and training programs Strong project management and budget management experience Experience leading cross-functional initiatives and driving results through influence Hands-on experience with a CLM platform (Agiloft, DocuSign CLM, Icertis, ContractPodAi, or similar), including workflow configuration and reporting Highly organized, able to manage two distinct accountabilities that shift in weight over time Process discipline and comfort owning a workflow end-to-end without owning its content Comfortable flagging issues upward without overstepping into Legal or risk-owner territory Excellent written and verbal communication across technical (Legal, Procurement) and non-technical (field, Sales) audiences

Salary Range:

$185,000- $220,000USD

Target Bonus: 20%

Exact compensation will vary based on skills, experience, and location.

Our Locations

Waltham, MA: Our headquarters is located in the Greater Boston life sciences community, with an open, collaborative office environment designed to support teamwork and connection. Employees benefit from convenient on-site amenities, including free on-site parking and gym facilities in the building.

Boulder, CO: Our Boulder location is home to Cogent’s discovery research organization and a key scientific hub with strong leadership based on site. Situated in the greater Denver-Boulder biopharmaceutical corridor, this office plays a central role in advancing our discovery efforts and pipeline.

Our Offer To You

At Cogent Biosciences, we offer a competitive salary, bonus, and ongoing stock awards, alongside a benefits package that sets us apart. We cover 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums for you and your family, and help reduce out-of-pocket costs by funding up to 75% of in-network deductibles. Our benefits also include a 401(k) match with immediate vesting, generous paid time off, 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave, paid family and medical leave for all employees regardless of location, and company-paid short-term disability coverage for up to 20 weeks. Additional perks like wellness programs, tuition reimbursement, and inclusive family-forming support help you thrive at work and beyond.

Payroll, Accounting, and Financial Administration

jobs.title: Senior Accountant
jobs.description:
At BBYO, we're motivated by our mission, inspiring us to reimagine work to make it fun, flexible, and fulfilling. We are looking for a passionate Senior Accountant to join our team and make a difference. As a Senior Accountant, you'll play a pivotal role in leading a timely and accurate month-end close, keeping our bank, investment, and balance sheet accounts reconciled, and producing reliable financial statements and reports that strengthen the programs and experiences we create for Jewish teens. Alongside your teammates, you'll connect in a dynamic environment and create a positive impact on teens, our community, and the world.

SHAPING THE FUTURE FOR TEENS AND YOURSELF

As a Senior Accountant, a typical day will include:

• Driving the month-end close: preparing and reviewing journal entries, accruals, and supporting schedules so the books close on time and accurately

• Completing bank, investment, and balance sheet reconciliations, then researching and resolving any variances

• Preparing and reviewing monthly financial statements, and maintaining subsidiary ledgers and schedules

• Producing standard and ad hoc reports that help Finance leadership and program teams make informed decisions

• Supporting non-finance staff with questions about expenses, coding, budgets, and systems like RAMP and Sage

• Partnering with the Controller and Finance leadership on special projects, process improvements, and audit preparation

ESSENTIAL SKILLS FOR MAKING A LASTING IMPACT

Our team has an entrepreneurial spirit and a passion for innovation to drive positive change. In addition, these skills are key to success as a Senior Accountant:

• Abilities: You work independently and connect the dots across varied work. You pay close attention to detail and can multitask in a fast-paced environment. You communicate clearly in writing and in conversation, and you're team-oriented, organized, and self-motivated.

• Technical Skills: You're proficient in Microsoft Excel and Office 365 and comfortable working with accounting databases. Experience with RAMP and Sage is preferred.

• Experience: 4–6 years of relevant accounting experience

• Education: A bachelor's degree with a major in Accounting

REQUIREMENTS

• Attend BBYO major events (2–3 times per year), including Staff Conference and International Convention (Presidents' Day Weekend).

• Ability to travel as needed, approximately 5–10%, including team meetings.

• Unrestricted authorization to work in the U.S. without holding a visa or sponsorship.

• To perform this job successfully, the individual must be able to perform each essential duty/function with or without reasonable accommodation in accordance with applicable law.

BENEFITS OF OUR DYNAMIC AND SUPPORTIVE WORKPLACE

• Own Your Balance

• Flexible work environment

• Unlimited paid time off (PTO)

• 18 paid secular and Jewish holidays

• PLUS two-week-long office shutdowns

• Medical, dental, vision, short- & long-term disability, and 2.5x salary life insurance

• Free access to WellHub, which includes access to gyms, online workouts, and wellness apps
