Compensation: Salary Range: $75,000–$85,000 annually. This position is also eligible for a bonus incentive.

We also pay for your TSA pre-check, provide a home technology allowance and have pet insurance options!

BE A PART OF A LEGACY…

• that celebrates our rich, century-long history of enhancing the Jewish experience to build a meaningful, teen-led future

• with an inclusive culture where authenticity is celebrated, respect is given, and fun is encouraged

• built on trust and empowerment, offering flexibility in where you work and autonomy in how it gets done

Embracing our past and future, we are excited about our growth and the challenges ahead. Join us and embark on an exciting journey with BBYO. INSPIRING TODAY. BUILDING TOMORROW.

jobs.title: Senior Program Analyst
jobs.description:
Who We Are (video)

At JRC, we tackle some of the toughest challenges faced by the Department of Defense (DoD) and other government agencies. Our expertise in engineering innovation and semiconductor technologies allows us to deliver mission-critical microelectronics solutions, aerospace systems engineering, and cutting-edge research and development. By joining JRC, you’ll be part of a team that supports strategic deterrence and defense missions, playing a crucial role in ensuring the safety and security of the United States and its allies.

🚀Join JRC's Missles & Space Team!

We are seeking a highly skilled Senior Program Analyst to support the Navy Strategic Systems Programs (SSP) Nuclear Weapons Surety (NWS) Policy and Compliance Branch (SP31), Nuclear Sea Launched Cruise Missile (SLCM-N) . This role requires subject matter expertise in Nuclear Weapons Technical Inspections, safety and security programs, incident response, and operational assessments. Responsibilities include providing technical and administrative support for SLCM-N mission support, developing and maintaining NWS training materials, , evaluating NWS policies and program effectiveness, and recommending improvements. The analyst will also assess hazards at weapon-related facilities and support community management for the NW Limited Duty Officer and Chief Warrant Officer communities, including task analysis, metrics, and training. Expertise in radiological emergency response and interagency coordination is essential.

💼What You'll Do

• Provide Subject Matter Expert (SME) support and assist the Government with technical analyses, inquiries, research, testing, and data validation for any matter relating to the SLCM-N weapons systems aboard submarines and support facilities.

• Support the customer by interfacing directly with SSP staff on all matters related to NWS.

• Assist the customer in identifying, planning, developing, and delivering NWS products, procedures and processes that support SLCM-N .

• Propose and execute revisions to ordnance documents (OD), Strategic Systems Programs Instructions (SSPINST), and other documentation as required in support of SSP.

• Provide administration and inspector support for nuclear weapons inspections, including pre- and post-support documentation (checklists, archiving results, report generation, trend analysis, deficiency action resolution) and on-site support.

• Support sustainment, maintenance, connectivity, training and qualification, and operation of the SSP Emergency Communication Center and related personnel to include Command Duty Officers, Emergency Response Organization, Outreach Events, and After-Action Reports. Support improvements to Information Technology infrastructure. This shall include on-site support by one person from the JRC team during normal working hours.

• Provide support for sustainment, maintenance, connectivity, training and qualification programs in support of the SLCM-N weapons system to include interactions with the Type Commanders, Groups, Squadrons and SSNs on all matters related to successful employment system and programs required to meet all higher directives, policies and program requirements.

• Regularly participate in meetings requiring close interactions with various project stakeholders (clients, SMEs, and end users).

• Support SSP in the preparation of fully coordinated program plans and required documentation to include requirements, master plans, cost estimates, testing plans, and other required documentation. Provide detailed analysis and documentation for critical planning recommendations.

• Develop and deliver executive-level presentations and program briefs, status reports, memorandums, and formal letters.

• Track work and schedules to ensure work is completed within scheduled parameters.

• Produce quality results in a fast-paced and dynamic work environment.

🧠What You Bring to the Table

• 10 years of experience in the Fleet Ballistic Missile (FBM) / Strategic Weapons Systems (SWS) and Nuclear Weapons Surety (NWS) programs or equivalent SSN TLAM strike operations .

• An active DoD security clearance at the Top-Secret level or above (or have held and active TS clearance within the last 2 years)

• Active-duty experience (former Missile Technician, Fire Control Technician, Torpedoman’s Mate , Submarine Weapons Limited Duty Officer (6260), or Weapons Officer(1120)) in submarine service.

• Familiarization of DoD Nuclear Weapons Accident Response Procedures (NARP) and National Incident Management Systems (NIMS) is a plus.

• Understanding of procedural disciplines required to operate within ordnance documents (OD), special weapons ordnance publications (SWOPs), firing craft procedures (OD44979) , Standard Operating Procedures (SOP) and other related special weapons documentation.

⭐Bonus Points

• A bachelor’s degree from an accredited university related degree preferred

• Virginia Class VPT/Strike operational experience

• SSN operational Nuclear Weapons experience

• Submarine C3 experience required to perform Authentication of Sealed Authenticator System (SAS)

• Served/Qualified as a Nuclear Weapons Inspector on USFF/PACFLT or Nuclear Weapons worker

At JRC we offer...

• A competitive compensation package

• An exceptional employee benefits program, providing support for our team members' well-being and success

• The chance to contribute to a high-profile Department of Defense programs and make a positive impact

• A collaborative work environment where teamwork, creativity, and innovation thrive

• Opportunities for professional growth and development, helping you advance your career

jobs.title: Senior T&E Engineer
jobs.description:
Who We Are (video)

At JRC, we tackle some of the toughest challenges faced by the Department of Defense (DoD) and other government agencies. Our expertise in engineering innovation and semiconductor technologies allows us to deliver mission-critical microelectronics solutions, aerospace systems engineering, and cutting-edge research and development. By joining JRC, you’ll be part of a team that supports strategic deterrence and defense missions, playing a crucial role in ensuring the safety and security of the United States and its allies.

🚀Join JRC's Missiles and Space Team!

The JRC team is looking for an enthusiastic, highly motivated Test and Evaluation Test Design to support the Navy SSP customer in a fast-paced new Acquisition development program for the Nuclear Sea-Launched Cruise Missile (SLCM-N) program. The successful candidate is a highly specialized engineer focused on the design and evaluation of strategic naval weapon systems, demanding a deep understanding of complex systems and high-stakes safety protocols for T&E Test Design, Modeling, Ground Test, Fire Control, Nuclear Surety, in support to Navy Strategic Systems Programs.

Most importantly commitment to the critical SSP mission, exhibiting unwavering accountability and driving tasks to completion. They must be proactive team players who excel in collaborative environments, fostering open communication and mutual support. Simultaneously, the ideal candidate demonstrates strong initiative, capable of leading tasks independently while consistently delivering high-quality, reliable results. Ultimately, success hinges on a blend of mission urgency, collaborative spirit, and independent leadership.

💼What You'll Do

• Test Planning & Design with the ability to develop, document, and execute comprehensive test plans, procedures, and reports for T&E. Provide expertise in creating detailed test plans that translate operational requirements into measurable test objectives. Ability to use simulations to predict system performance, reliability, and effectiveness under various conditions. Conduct Ground & Fire Control Test Component/Subsystem Testing on individual components and subsystems to verify technical specifications.

🧠What You Bring to the Table

• Bachelor’s degree in related field.

• Active DoD Secret or DoE security clearance.

• System Knowledge: Understanding of missile system architecture, including guidance, navigation, control, and communication subsystems.

• Scientific Test and Analysis Techniques (STAT): Application of statistical methods and Design of Experiments (DoE) to create efficient and effective test designs.

• Acquisition Process: Familiarity with the DoD acquisition lifecycle and the role of T&E within it.

• 10+ years’ experience in Missile design, Fire Control system integration hardware in a loop, Nuclear Surety, Navy SSP and testing with preference for experience with Cruise Missile Test and Evaluation Design.

• 5+ years’ experience with Model Based System Engineering MBSE with Cruise Missile Test and Evaluation.

• Resource Planning: Ability to identify and plan for all necessary test resources, including ranges, targets, instrumentation, and personnel.

• Modeling & Simulation (M&S) Model-Based Systems Engineering (MBSE): Experience using MBSE tools to develop and analyze system architecture and behavior.

• Verification, Validation, and Accreditation (VV&A): Knowledge of the VV&A process to ensure that models are a credible representation of the real-world system.

• Fire Control System Integration: Deep understanding of fire control systems, including sensor integration, target tracking, and weapon engagement sequencing.

• Hardware-in-the-Loop (HWIL): Experience with HWIL testing to evaluate the fire control system's software and hardware in a simulated environment.

• Nuclear Surety Safety & Security Protocols: Comprehensive knowledge of DoD and Navy policies and procedures for ensuring the safety, security, and control of nuclear weapons.

• Design Certification: Understanding of the stringent design and certification requirements for nuclear-certified systems.

• Personnel Reliability Program (PRP): Familiarity with the requirements and management of the PRP.

• Navy Strategic Systems Programs (SSP) Trident Weapon System: In-depth knowledge of the Trident II D5/D5LE missile and associated submarine systems.

• SSP Processes: Familiarity with the specific engineering, T&E, and acquisition processes and procedures of Navy SSP.

• Fleet Support: Experience providing engineering and technical support to the Fleet for strategic weapon systems.

• Experience working with multi-disciplinary teams to coordinate system design activities.

• Proven ability to prioritize and execute workload to meet requirements and deadlines and be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment conducting analysis with uncertainties or incomplete data.

• Must be capable of breaking down complex issues into simplified problem statements and laying out objective approaches to identify and compare the merits of competing solutions.

⭐Bonus Points

• Active DoD TOP SECRET security clearance.

• Master's Degree in a related field.

• Experience with weapon system acquisition programs.

At JRC we offer...

• A competitive compensation package

• An exceptional employee benefits program, providing support for our team members' well-being and success

• The chance to contribute to a high-profile Department of Defense programs and make a positive impact

• A collaborative work environment where teamwork, creativity, and innovation thrive

• Opportunities for professional growth and development, helping you advance your career

jobs.title: Systems Safety Engineer
jobs.description:

At JRC, we tackle some of the toughest challenges faced by the Department of Defense (DoD) and other government agencies. By joining JRC, you’ll be part of a team that supports strategic deterrence and defense missions, playing a crucial role in ensuring the safety and security of the United States and its allies.

🚀Join JRC's DIVISION Team!

The Conventional Safety & Certification lead (SP04732) for the Limited Operational Capability (LOC) branch (SP047) is responsible for planning and managing conventional safety requirements, overseeing implementation, ensuring verification, and supporting certification for the LOC missile.  This position is responsible for managing the implementation of DoD Instruction 5000.69, DoD Joint Services Weapon and Laser System Safety Review Processes, at the flight-system and missile level to implement system safety review procedures and process when performing weapon system safety reviews.  This position is responsible for implementing policies and procedures to achieve LOC missile safety certifications for missile processing and handling ashore and deployment afloat.

💼What You'll Do

• Serve as the principal engineer to assess system, missile, and ordnance safety policy and flow down implementable and verifiable missile requirements

• Lead oversight and approval of contractor safety feature implementation into missile and missile support equipment designs

• Represents LOC missile equities at Command-level safety meetings and forums

• Work collaboratively with external partners to assess, support, and document safety features and compliance within the baseline missile design(s)

• Advise as a safety expert and remain abreast of safety program changes and potential impacts to the LOC missile

• Support safety certification activities to proof, exercise, and assess readiness for safety certification

• Support safety certification activities that involve missile and flight-system equities

• Identify and mitigate technical risks across the system development and deployed lifecycle.

• Prepare material, support preparations, and provide technical advice during safety reviews and certification activities

• Work collaboratively with Weapon Integration Systems Engineering (WISE) team to achieve NOSSA and WSSERB safety certifications

🧠What You Bring to the Table

• Bachelor’s degree in engineering (Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Systems, or related discipline).

• Minimum 5 years of experience in defense system engineering on an MDAP.

• Extensive knowledge of DoD Manual 5000.69, DoD Joint Services Weapon System Safety Review Process

• Knowledge of MIL-STD-882E, Standard Practice for System Safety

• Knowledge of Joint Services Software Safety Authorities (JS‐SSA) Software System Safety Implementation Process and Tasks supporting MIL‐STD‐882E

• Knowledge of the DoD 5000-series acquisition policies, including DoDI 5000.88 and 5000.02.

• Demonstrated experience in missile systems design, integration, and verification.

• Strong communication skills and ability to interface with OSD, Service PEOs, and FFRDC stakeholders.

This position requires regular interaction with senior DoW, FFRDC, and industry leadership. Travel (~ 50%) to test ranges, contractor facilities, weapons facilities, and government labs is required to support technical and programmatic reviews, integration events, and milestone readiness assessments.

jobs.title: PCB/RF Design Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US 


QuantWare is building the world’s most powerful quantum processors to solve humanity's greatest challenges. We do this with our unique VIO™ technology, the only QPU architecture that breaks the hardware barriers that have held quantum computing back, unlocking the path to MegaQubit quantum processors.

With VIO, we are paving the way for the hyper-scale quantum computers that will change the world. And delivering on that vision demands people who don’t shy away from tackling the hardest challenges of our time. That’s where you come in! 



Join us as a RF/PCB Design Engineer to drive the physical realization of our next-generation 3D quantum hardware architecture - hardware that operates from room temperature down to millikelvin conditions inside a dilution refrigerator. You will own the design of critical microwave components, create high-density cryo-compatible PCB layouts, and build novel packaging solutions for large-scale QPUs. Working at the intersection of hardware and software, you'll also help streamline our development by embedding design processes into automated workflows.




WHAT YOU'LL BE DOING

 - Component & Mechanical Design: Design critical electromechanical components that form the chief interface of our QPUs and TWPAs. You will work as part of the packaging team and interface closely with the Product design team.

 - Precision Engineering: Utilise CAD to design PCBs, silicon chip layout and PCB-to-chip interconnect within the vertical VIO architecture.

 - RF/Microwave Design: Solve complex challenges related to insertion loss, impedance matching, and cross-talk at the PCB and package levels.

 - Cryogenic Integration & Testing: Design for and validate performance across the full temperature range from room temperature to millikelvin — accounting for thermal cycling, differential contraction, and material behavior at cryogenic temperatures, and running cooldown/characterization tests in dilution refrigerators.


YOUR PROFILE

 - Education: BSc or MSc in Electrical Engineering with a focus on PCB design, layout, and RF/Microwave Engineering.

 - Experience: 4+ years of hands-on PCB design experience utilizing tools such as KiCAD, Altium Designer, and Cadence to deliver high-quality board designs. Experience with diverse materials such as cofired ceramic boards (LTCC, HTCC)  is a plus.

 - Cryogenic Applications: Hands-on experience designing or testing hardware for cryogenic environments - e.g., dilution refrigerators, cryostats, or low-temperature RF/microwave systems.

 - Core EE Fundamentals: Solid understanding of developing schematics, electro-mechanical interfaces, RF layout trades, temperature dependent behavior, shielding, signal integrity, and impedance analysis.

Nice to Have:

 - Packaging & Interconnects: Background in high-density interconnects, high frequency flex interconnects, 3D packaging, or advanced integration.

 - Domain Knowledge: Familiarity with superconducting technologies is a strong plus.

 - RF Characterization: Practical experience with RF testing and measurements using VNA and related laboratory equipment.

Who We Are (video)

At JRC, we tackle some of the toughest challenges faced by the Department of Defense (DoD) and other government agencies. Our expertise in engineering innovation and semiconductor technologies allows us to deliver mission-critical microelectronics solutions, aerospace systems engineering, and cutting-edge research and development. By joining JRC, you’ll be part of a team that supports strategic deterrence and defense missions, playing a crucial role in ensuring the safety and security of the United States and its allies.

🚀Join JRC's Missiles & SpaceTeam!

Step into one of the most technically influential roles in the program: as the Deputy Branch Engineer (DBE), you’ll be the principal deputy and trusted technical right hand to the Branch Engineer for a Department of War Category 1D Major Defense Acquisition Program (MDAP) strategic missile system.

In this role, you’ll guide the engineering heart of a program that integrates complex warhead, missile, and shipboard systems—ensuring the weapon system is safe, reliable, digitally engineered, and mission-ready. You’ll shape everything from system architecture and integration to test execution, design assurance, and technical readiness for major reviews. Your work ensures compliance with DoD policies, nuclear surety requirements, and mission assurance standards, all while advising leadership on critical technical and acquisition decisions.

If you’re energized by solving hard systems problems, leading multidisciplinary teams, and safeguarding the nation’s strategic capabilities, this position puts you at the center of engineering excellence for one of the DoD’s most consequential programs.

💼What You'll Do

• Serve as principal technical advisor to the Branch Engineer and Program Manager on all systems engineering and architecture matters.

• Support system integration efforts across propulsion, guidance, control, fire control, and launch subsystems.

• Support the Command Safety Working Group (CSWG) and ensure compliance with Nuclear Weapons System Surety and Safety requirements.

• Support Configuration & Data Management Governance by implementing Configuration Management (CM) policies and ensuring traceability from high-level requirements to test results and certification artifacts.

• Ensure design integrity through requirements traceability, verification, and validation processes.

• Support Engineering Review Boards (ERB), Risk and Opportunity Management Boards (ROMB), and Configuration Control Boards (CCB).

• Assist in the review and maintenance of the Systems Engineering Plan (SEP), Mission Assurance Plan, and Test and Evaluation Master Plan (TEMP) inputs.

• Assist in the oversight of Integration and Test efforts for the LOC missile, including hardware, instrumentation, data collection, post-test analysis, and ship integration.

• Identify and mitigate technical risks across the system development and deployed lifecycle.

• Ensure technical rigor, compliance, and readiness for major technical and programmatic reviews for the LOC.

• Advise on acquisition strategy, cost, schedule, technical trade-offs, and milestone documentation.

• Mentor multidisciplinary government and contractor engineering teams to promote technical excellence and mission assurance.

🧠What You Bring to the Table

• A bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Aerospace, Electrical, Systems, or related discipline).

• 15+ years of experience in defense system engineering with 5 years in a technical leadership role on an MDAP.

• An Active Top Secret clearance (SCI eligibility required).

• Extensive knowledge of DoD 5000-series acquisition policies, including DoDI 3150.02, DoDI 5000.88, and 5000.02.

• Demonstrated experience in missile systems design, integration, and verification.

• Proficiency in MBSE, digital engineering, and model-based data environments (Cameo, DOORS, Teamcenter).

• Excellent written and oral communication skills; ability to interact effectively with OSD, Service PAEs, FFRDCs, and industry stakeholders.

• Requires frequent engagement with senior DoW, FFRDC, and industry leaders, and up to 50% travel to test ranges, contractor sites, weapons facilities, and government labs to support technical reviews, integration events, and milestone assessments.

⭐Bonus Points

• Master’s degree in Systems Engineering, Aerospace Engineering, or related field.

• DAWIA Advanced Certification in Engineering or Program Management.

• Experience supporting sea-based nuclear-capable or strategic missile programs.

• Prior SSP, NNSA, or Navy experience with nuclear weapons programs.

• Sea-Launch Platform Experience such as SSN, SSBN, and SSGN

• Familiarity with DoDI 8510.01 (RMF), MIL-STD-882E (System Safety), and mission assurance processes.

At JRC we offer...

• An exceptional employee benefits program, providing support for our team members' well-being and success

• The chance to contribute to a high-profile Department of Defense programs and make a positive impact

• A collaborative work environment where teamwork, creativity, and innovation thrive

Overview

Corti is the frontier lab for clinical-grade AI, building world-leading models and infrastructure for the realities of healthcare.


Our technology powers healthcare’s most ambitious software, from EHR vendors and virtual care platforms to the health systems that care depends on. We work with builders ranging from fast-moving startups to global healthcare enterprises, helping them bring clinical AI into real-world care.


Healthcare is full of problems where AI has to do more than simply work. Clinicians are overwhelmed by documentation. Coding errors, backlogs and denials cost health systems billions. And the specialist expertise patients need is not always available when they need it.


We build AI specifically for these environments, trained on real patient interactions, validated against real outcomes, and designed to perform where accuracy, trust and reliability matter. If you want to help define how AI is built for healthcare, you belong at Corti.



The Role

We are seeking a technically curious, execution-focused Product Marketing Manager to sit at the center of Corti’s growth engine.

This role is for someone who can read an API doc, spin up a landing page, and write a launch post that developers actually want to read. You are technical enough to understand what we build, creative enough to make people care, and pragmatic enough to ship instead of overthinking.

You will own the surfaces and campaigns that drive developer awareness, acquisition, and activation. That includes product launches, landing pages, demand generation, developer-facing content, and growth analytics. You will move fast across channels and formats, with real ownership over what ships and how it performs.

Demand generation

Product launches and landing pages

Content and SEO

 - Write technical blog posts, guides, and tutorials that position Corti as the default platform for healthcare AI development

 - Create sales enablement assets, templates, and collateral as needed



What you bring:

We don’t care about the exact title on your CV. What matters is that you are technical enough to understand what we’re building, fast enough to ship without waiting for permission, and someone your friends might describe as “one of the smartest people they know.”

jobs.title: Creative Director, Art
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Translation is an award-winning independent creative agency that aspires to be the most culturally influential company in the world.

We help ambitious brands harness the power of culture to solve their biggest challenges – at our best, we make what was once invisible unmissable.

As a unique mix of experts in culture, technology, and storytelling, we are united by a passion to grow brands in ways that advertising alone never could. What makes Translation’s work stand out is our ability to collaborate and create with individuals who don’t just consume “culture”, they’re a part of making it and living it every day.

We are an entrepreneurial business – not a traditional “ad agency.” That means we value resourcefulness and tenacity just as much as we value creativity and intelligence.

We are looking for a Creative Director, Art to join Translation in our Brooklyn headquarters!

This role will focus primarily on clients and projects that speak directly to, and by, the African American community. The ideal candidate will have an innate cultural fluency – understanding the latest trends, memes, and phrases. This person should know how cultural moves – what’s new, what’s next, and what’s not for long.

At Translation, all of our CD, Art Directors lead the development of bold visual concepts, guide, mentos, and manage creative teams on a given project. They proactively collaborate with strategy and context planning partners, as well as directly with clients, to ensure work is both creatively exceptional and strategically aligned.

Our CDs lead by example to consistently inspire creative colleagues to create world-class, pioneering ideas. They generate useful, usable ideas across all existing and emerging digital platforms – continually develop practices and processes to inspire, innovate, and harness new ways of thinking.

This role is based in Brooklyn, New York with four days in-office and one day remote.

What You'll Do

• Ensure the timely development and execution of multiple campaigns and projects that not only meet client objectives but are breakthrough ideas for the creative industry.

• Develop creative solutions that defend budget recommendations and measurement objectives to provide both profitable and quality work to our current and prospective clients.

• Stimulate creative direction and act in an advisory role throughout the duration of client team projects.

• Display an industry-leading understanding and application of the principles that make innovative and effective campaigns, designs, and interaction designs.

• Ensures the execution of high-quality work that is on time, on budget, and uses appropriate technology.

• Serve as arbiter of verbal and visual tone and craft for creative assignments for internal executive and external client review.

• Provide leadership and motivation, conveying the vision and values of the agency to staff.

• Train and supervise assigned creative teams

• Collaborate with the core leadership team on assigned accounts and projects to ensure alignment on creative recommendations and client opportunities.

• Work to resolve any internal challenges.

• Maintain external professional relationships with production partners, freelance networks, agency partners, and others to ensure we’re sharing the agency POV across the industry and recruiting the right talent and partners

• Participate in the creation and presentation of client pitches / new business efforts, as required.

Knowledge, Skills and Abilities

You are results and bottom-line-oriented, yet possess deep appreciation and sensitivity towards people, culture, and values. You are persistent,  diplomatic, passionate, and optimistic, with a proactive, hands-on mentality. You hold yourself accountable and take great pride in your work – just like us. We’re proudly diverse in our backgrounds, our accents, and our fiercely held personal passions. We are, in every sense of the word, independent and not beholden to anyone else’s agenda. So are you.

• Demonstrated experience leading multicultural or African American targeted work.

• Ability to successfully lead, motivate, and mentor teams of creative talent to create work that moves the cultural needle.

• Knowledge of the pre- and post-production process across formats and media.

• An understanding of the current landscape of creative advertising work in the market.

• Strong aptitude for providing clear creative direction, career path guidance, and timely and helpful feedback that will improve creative processes, as well as keep work on budget and schedule.

• Able to prioritize work and resources across engagements based on short- and long-term needs, timelines, and budgets.

• Possess and encourage high degrees of initiative, drive, empathy, accountability, creativity, and maturity.

• Demonstrate, evangelize, and live the core values of the agency.

• Incorporate the passion, excitement, and experience of one’s MINOR in relevant ways that inform the quality and output of agency deliverables.

• Be able to move with the ebbs and flows of pitches, brainstorming sessions, and deadlines with agility, humor, and focus.

• Possess and demonstrate impeccable interpersonal, presentation, and communication skills across all levels of both internal and client organizations.

Minimum Qualifications

• 8+ years of professional experience at an agency or similar creative organization

• Has held at least an Associate Creative Director title (or equivalent)

• A background with progressive experience in a client-facing, creative leadership role in a creative agency environment.

• Digitally savvy; MUST be proficient in Google Workspace and Microsoft Office suite as well as have knowledge of current A.I. tools and platforms.

Preferred Qualifications

• Training or degree in a directly related field, such as advertising, graphic design, commercial art, or web/digital design.

About UnitedMasters, Inc.

UnitedMasters Inc. represents the creative solutions company, Translation, and the leading software and services platform for independent creators, UnitedMasters. UnitedMasters enables ownership, exposure, and new paths for financial return for independent creators, while Translation helps brands leverage the power of contemporary culture to achieve transformational growth. Combined, UnitedMasters, Inc. is the world’s leading marketplace for cultural capital, connecting independent artists and brands to realize a future in which all creators own their future. Backed by Alphabet, Andreessen Horowitz, and Apple, UnitedMasters, Inc. is reimagining how brands and artists come together to tell their stories, build profitable growth, and push culture forward.

Salary Hiring Range: $205,000 - $240,000

Our salary ranges are based on paying competitively for our size and industry, and are one part of many compensation, benefits and other reward opportunities we provide (e.g. bonus, stock options, 401(k) match, etc.)

Individual pay rate decisions are based on a number of factors, including qualifications for the role, experience level, skillset, and balancing internal equity relative to peers at the company.  We expect the majority of the candidates who are offered roles at our company to fall healthily throughout the range based on these factors.

The range above is for the expectations as laid out in the job description, however we are often open to a wide variety of profiles, and recognize that the person we hire may be less experienced (or more senior) than this job description as posted.  If that ends up being the case, the updated salary range will be communicated with you as a candidate.

The salary range above is for the NY/CA.  As a company, we have a location based strategy, which means the salary range could be lower or higher than this if the role is hired in another location.

jobs.title: Senior Program Manager (Army)
jobs.description:
Here at Appian, our values of Intensity and Excellence define who we are. We set high standards and live up to them, ensuring that everything we do is done with care and quality. We approach every challenge with ambition and commitment, holding ourselves and each other accountable to achieve the best results. When you join Appian, you’ll be part of a passionate team dedicated to accomplishing hard things, together.

Drive high-impact technology modernization and mission success across Army programs through AI-Powered Process Automation.

Location: McLean, VA | Work Model: On-site (5 days/week or on customer site)

About the Team

The Appian Public Sector team enables US Federal agencies to modernize mission-critical operations through Enterprise-Grade Orchestration. We combine industry-leading software capabilities with deep public sector expertise to deliver agile, high-value outcomes for government leaders. By accelerating software delivery and simplifying complex workflows, our team directly drives operational readiness and digital transformation across defense and civilian platforms.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Program Manager within Appian’s Public Sector practice, you will lead a $13M+ services portfolio supporting complex technology modernization for the U.S. Army. You will serve as a strategic partner to senior military leadership and oversee a multidisciplinary team of 50+ resources, driving program growth, account strategy, and solution delivery. If you are looking to combine customer advocacy with strategic execution to help government stakeholders solve their toughest operational challenges, this is your opportunity to shape the future of enterprise automation at Appian.

What You’ll Do

• Lead Portfolio Delivery: Design, implement, and optimize a portfolio of customer success projects across onboarding, adoption, value realization, and contract renewal.

• Drive Business & Sales Strategy: Lead opportunity identification, solutioning, and capture activities—including RFI/RFP responses—for new opportunities and existing Army accounts.

• Partner with Government Leadership: Engage, influence, and negotiate with senior government stakeholders on program direction, technical requirements, and contract strategies.

• Accelerate Delivery via AI: Drive innovation into program execution, incorporating AI-Powered Process Automation and AI-enabled code generation techniques to increase delivery velocity and solution quality.

• Manage Operations & Financials: Monitor and report on key program metrics, including agile delivery velocity, customer health scores, resource utilization, and program P&L.

• Empower People: Mentor and lead a high-performing team of project managers, architects, and engineers to foster a culture of continuous improvement and delivery excellence.

Required Qualifications

• Education: Bachelor’s degree in Business, Computer Science, Engineering, Information Technology, or a related field.

• Experience: Minimum of 15+ years of experience in program management leading complex technology modernization initiatives within the Department of Defense (specifically Army) or relevant federal agencies.

• Scale & Financial Oversight: Proven track record of managing program teams of over 50 resources and overseeing over $13M in annual services revenue.

• Methodologies & AI: Hands-on leadership experience delivering software modernization programs using agile methodologies and AI-assisted application generation.

• Clearance & Citizenship: US Citizenship required, with the ability to obtain and maintain a Top Secret government clearance in the future.

• Mobility: Willingness to travel to client sites as required.

Preferred Qualifications

• Certifications: Active PMP, PgMP, or agile certifications (SAFe Agilist, Certified Scrum Master).

• Enterprise Ecosystem Experience: We value experience with enterprise platforms such as Salesforce or ServiceNow, as these skills translate exceptionally well into our Enterprise-Grade Orchestration environment.

• Strong negotiation skills with demonstrated experience managing large-scale federal fixed-price and T&M contracts.

The base salary range provided represents a good faith and reasonable estimate of the range at the time of posting. In addition to the base salary, this position is eligible for a government clearance differential. Actual compensation will be dependent on a number of factors including, but not limited to, the candidate’s relevant work experience, qualifications, internal peer equity, and market and business conditions that exist when extending an offer. A discretionary bonus may be awarded in recognition of individual and company performance.

In addition, Appian provides generous benefits offerings that include a 401(k) plan with company match, flexible time off, paid parental leave, medical, dental, and vision plans, life insurance, disability insurance, wellness programs, flexible spending accounts, health savings account contributions, an employee referral bonus program, and learning and development resources. Certain positions may be eligible for equity awards.

Pay and benefits are subject to change at any time, consistent with the terms of any applicable compensation, commission, bonus, or benefit plans.

Base Salary Range

$175,000—$350,000 USD

Tools and Resources

• Training and Development: During onboarding, we focus on equipping new hires with the skills and knowledge for success through department-specific training. Continuous learning is a central focus at Appian, with dedicated mentorship and the First-Friend program being widely utilized resources for new hires.

• Growth Opportunities: Appian provides a diverse array of growth and development opportunities, including our leadership program tailored for new and aspiring managers, a comprehensive library of specialized department training through Appian University, skills based training, and tuition reimbursement for those aiming to advance their education. This commitment ensures that employees have access to a holistic range of development opportunities.

• Community: We’ll immerse you into our community rooted in respect starting on day one. Appian fosters inclusivity through our 8 employee-led affinity groups. These groups help employees build stronger internal and external networks by planning social, educational, and outreach activities to connect with Appianites and larger initiatives throughout the company.

Benefits

Appian offers a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, wellbeing, and financial future. Benefits may include health coverage, Employee Assistance Program (EAP) with free mental health support, life and disability insurance, an Employee Stock Purchase Program (ESPP), a retirement/pension plan, wellness dollars, tuition reimbursement, family-forming benefits and more. Benefits vary by country—please ask your Talent Acquisition contact for details specific to the location you are applying to.

About Appian

Appian provides AI automation for the most important business processes at the world’s largest organizations. Our platform is known for its unique power, reliability, and scale. We’ve been automating processes for more than 25 years and have proven expertise in enterprise operations. For more information, visit appian.com.

Follow Appian: LinkedIn, YouTube, Instagram, Facebook, and X.

Appian is an equal opportunity employer that strives to attract and retain the best talent. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any characteristic protected by applicable federal, state, or local law.

Appian provides reasonable accommodations to applicants in accordance with all applicable laws. jobs.title: Water Resources Engineer III
jobs.description:
AECOM's Transportation, Greater Pennsylvania Area Water Resources group is actively seeking a creative, highly talented Water Resources Engineer III for immediate employment in the Conshohocken, Philadelphia, Pittsburgh, Mechanicsburg, or Newark (DE) office.

This role is intended for a talented engineer who is looking to expand their technical capabilities while developing leadership skills in the delivery of projects. This is a hybrid position, combining office and remote work.

The successful candidate will bring strong technical fundamentals, intellectual curiosity, and a proactive mindset, with the ability to take ownership of defined tasks and progressively grow into leading small scopes and teams.

The job responsibilities of the position will include but are not limited to:

• Assist in design activities including stormwater management, erosion and sediment control, roadway drainage, hydraulic and hydrologic analysis, utility coordination, site design and environmental permitting
• Assist with the development of preliminary to final design calculations and drawings
• Review field information and perform field inspection of existing stormwater facilities
• Perform technical writing for design reports and permitting applications
• Utilize MicroStation, AutoCAD, and a variety of Civil Engineering design software applications
• Perform specific and moderate portions of a broader assignment of an experienced engineer
• Gather and correlate basic engineering data using established and well-defined procedures
• Work on detailed or routine engineering assignments involving calculations and relatively simple tests
• Propose approach to solve new problems encountered using modifications of standard procedures or methods developed in previous assignments
• Identify discrepancies in results
• Provide guidance to entry level engineers
• Perform work in accordance with agreed upon budget and schedule with little supervision
• Independently perform all the tasks necessary to complete primary design elements for engineering works
• Performance at this level requires developmental experience in a professional position

MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:

• BA/BS in Civil Engineering or related field + 4 years of related experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education
• Registered Engineer in Training (E.I.T.)

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

• Masters Degree in Civil Engineering or related field
• Profession Engineer (P.E.) license
• Proven experience using industry standard computer software for the position (examples include software such as CADD, AutoCAD, MicroStation, GIS)
• Demonstrated experience with drainage, stormwater management, erosion and sediment control, and hydrologic and hydraulic analysis and design
• Knowledge of water resources design software (StormCAD, HydroCAD, Pondpak, HEC-RAS)

• Sponsorship for US employment authorization is not available now or in the future for this position.
• Relocation is not available for this position.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

jobs.title: Maintenance Manager (Lease-Up!)
jobs.description:
At Bozzuto, every team member shares a deep commitment to doing good for those around us. We live this each day by designing, building, managing and maintaining one-of-a-kind residences. Whether it’s the talent within our communities or the expertise across our property operations teams, we work together to make extraordinary happen for our clients, residents and fellow team members.

Our people are dedicated to delivering exceptional experiences to everyone we serve including each other. This shared purpose drives us to excel in every role and fosters a welcoming, inclusive workplace where teamwork thrives. Guided by our core values of concern, creativity, passion and the pursuit of perfection, we are inspired and empowered to reach higher, unlock our full potential and be truly extraordinary.

Primary Responsibilities

As a Maintenance Manager, your primary responsibilities include:

• Leading by example and being a role model for the standards and behaviors consistent with the core values and culture of Bozzuto

• Dedicating time to hiring, developing and providing on-the-job and classroom education opportunities to techs and community care associates

• Showing care and concern for our residents through timely follow up and meticulous completion of their apartment service tickets

• Resolving maintenance issues in the area of HVAC, electrical, plumbing and appliance repair

• Managing the make-ready and apartment turnover process with attention to detail and timeliness so apartments can be leased and new residents can move in

• Preserving the value of the building by consistently executing on preventative maintenance programs

• Preserving the beauty of the building and the safety of the community through general upkeep and cleanliness, snow removal and grounds maintenance

• Sustaining peak efficiency operation levels for all property components

• Adhering to applicable building, county and safety codes/standards, while running an accident-free operation

• Ensuring completion of annual building systems inspections required by the jurisdiction

• Leading cost-effective capital improvement and special projects

• Establishing and managing vendor relationships and projects within budget parameters

• Reinforcing monthly staffing schedules, ensuring 24/7 emergency coverage

What You Bring to Us:

• An education in the trades and 7+ years of experience in facilities and/or residential building maintenance

• 3+ years of supervisory experience and a track record of hiring, developing and retaining high performing teams

• An HVAC, EPA and/or NAPE certification

• Knowledge of risk management, OSHA and MSDS

• Advanced level of skill in HVAC, plumbing, electrical and appliance repair

• Basic carpentry, drywall and painting skills

• Exposure to complex mechanical systems such as central plant, split systems, boilers and chillers

• A safety mindset and an eye for detail

• A builder’s mentality (know it like you built it!)

• Excellent communication skills, both written and verbal

• A sharp professional appearance

• Intermediate proficiency with the Microsoft Office suite and comfort using various technology platforms, apps and computer programs

• Availability for emergency situations at the property, including an on-call rotation

• The ability to exert 25 to 50 pounds of force frequently, and/or 10 to 20 pounds of force constantly, climb stairs, use ladders and work in varying weather conditions

This position is eligible for additional bonus opportunities.

$90,000—$100,000 USD

jobs.title: Entry-Level Roadway Engineer - Networking Event with AECOM – Atlanta, GA
jobs.description:
AECOM is hosting an exclusive, invitation-only hiring event in Atlanta November 5th and 6th. This is a great opportunity to learn and connect with AECOM for career opportunities starting Spring/Summer 2027.

The event kicks off on Thursday evening with a networking mixer from 6-8 pm, where you can hear from AECOM staff about various projects, career paths, and the company itself. You’ll also have the chance to meet other students, recent graduates, and AECOM professionals from across our business lines.

On Friday, interviews will take place at our Atlanta, GA office. This is a fantastic opportunity to learn about and connect with AECOM for early career opportunities.

As an Entry-Level Roadway Engineer, you will contribute to a variety of transportation projects while working alongside experienced engineers and project managers. You will apply engineering principles, assist with the development of roadway designs, and support project delivery from planning through construction. This position offers the opportunity to build technical expertise, gain project experience, and advance your professional development within a collaborative transportation team.

Responsibilities

• Assist in the design and development of roadway projects in accordance with applicable engineering standards, guidelines, and client requirements.
• Prepare and modify roadway plan sheets, including typical sections, alignments, profiles, layouts, and cross sections.
• Utilize engineering design software, including CADD platforms, to support project development and design production.
• Perform engineering calculations, quantity estimates, and technical analyses under the guidance of senior staff.
• Assist with the preparation of reports, specifications, cost estimates, and other project documentation.

jobs.title: Medical Receptionist
jobs.description:
About Us

One Medical is a primary care solution challenging the industry status quo by making quality care more affordable, accessible and enjoyable. But this isn’t your average doctor’s office. We’re on a mission to transform healthcare, which means improving the experience for everyone involved - from patients and providers to employers and health networks. Our seamless in-office and 24/7 virtual care services, on-site labs, and programs for preventive care, chronic care management, common illnesses and mental health concerns have been delighting people for the past fifteen years.

In February 2023 we marked a milestone when One Medical joined Amazon. Together, we look to deliver exceptional health care to more consumers, employers, care team members, and health networks to achieve better health outcomes. As we continue to grow and seek to impact more lives, we’re building a diverse, driven and empathetic team, while working hard to cultivate an environment where everyone can thrive.

The Opportunity

As a Medical Receptionist, internally known as a Member Support Specialist at one of our offices presently focused on our Senior Health member population (age 65+), you will be an ambassador for patients in office, with a mastery of human connection and a strong drive for service. You will remove barriers to care, resulting in a truly exceptional in-office patient experience. You are the steward of the space and ensure the look and feel of the office lobby are on brand with the One Medical experience. You will be the first point of contact for patient feedback, as well as provide any other support as requested by the Practice Coordinator, Operations Manager, or in office providers.

You are a strong team player and use your innovative problem solving skills to tackle various tasks and challenges. You have a strong grasp of verbal and written communication. You are able to identify opportunities and deliver on customer-centric solutions while using empathy, focus, and compassion in all interactions with patients and teammates. You bring self-awareness to your daily work to utilize your strengths and develop your areas of opportunity. You thrive in cultures that focus on feedback and growth and are nimble in their approach to respond to the needs of the patients and team. You have an unwavering drive to help and serve others and create amazing moments for our members and teammates. If this sounds like you, we would love to connect.

What you'll likely work on:

• Use impeccable C-I-CARE (a framework containing the key elements of a great interaction and effective communication that we use with patients and each other) in all patient interactions and ensure a fluid and positive in-office experience through patient intake, same day schedule management, appropriate follow up scheduling, strong knowledge of billing and insurance, monitoring patient feedback and assisting with outreach as necessary

• All front of house duties including check in/check out, insurance verification, printing/paperwork tasks, prepping tests, tasking to service level expectations etc

• Contribute to team development through rounding, attending team huddles, participating in team problem solving, supporting in office providers with ad hoc asks, etc.

• Master our technology suite including but not limited to Slack, G-suite, Zoom, and our Electronic Medical Record System 1Life, in order to interact with team members and patients and complete daily work

• Perform opening and closing duties/daily office upkeep as required, including maintaining the look and feel of both patient and employee facing spaces, restocking supplies, and organization

These responsibilities are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by personnel assigned to this job classification.  They are not to be construed as an exhaustive list of job duties performed by personnel in this classification.  Other job related duties may be assigned by management.

What you’ll need:

• At least 1 year of experience in high touch customer or patient facing roles

• Strong written and verbal communication skills

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English, bilingual applicants encouraged to apply

• Experience working on collaborative, diverse and feedback-driven multi-disciplinary teams

• A proven track record of persisting through change, demonstrating a forward thinking perspective when under pressure, and consistently stepping up to take action on challenges

• Proficiency in computer technology such as typing, navigating the internet and using multiple software systems simultaneously

Competitive salary: the base pay for this position is $18.00 per hour based on a full time schedule.

This is a full-time role based in-person with our team and patients at offices in Glendale, AZ, working Monday-Friday, 8:00am-5:00pm.

Physical Demands:  Mostly sedentary work duties require exerting up to ten pounds of force occasionally and/or small amounts of force frequently. Sedentary work typically involves sitting most of the time, but may involve walking or standing for brief periods.

One Medical offers a robust benefits package designed to aid your health and wellness.  All regular team members working 24+ hours per week and their dependents are eligible for benefits starting on the team member's date of hire:

Taking care of you today

• Paid sabbatical for every five years of service

• Free One Medical memberships for yourself, your friends and family

• Employee Assistance Program - Free confidential services for team members who need help with stress, anxiety, financial planning, and legal issues

• Competitive Medical, Dental and Vision plans

• Pre-Tax commuter benefits

• PTO cash outs - Option to cash out up to 40 accrued hours per year

Protecting your future for you and your family

• 401K match

• Credit towards emergency childcare

• Company paid maternity and paternity leave

• Paid Life Insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Basic Life Insurance

• Disability insurance - One Medical pays 100% of the cost of Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance

In addition to the comprehensive benefits package outlined above, practicing clinicians also receive

• Malpractice Insurance - Malpractice fees to insure your practice at One Medical is covered 100%.

• UpToDate Subscription - An evidence-based clinical research tool

• Continuing Medical Education (CME) - Receive an annual stipend for continuing medical education

• Rounds - Providers end patient care one hour early each week to participate in this shared learning experience

• Discounted rate to attend One Medical’s Annual REAL primary care conference

One Medical is an equal opportunity employer, and we encourage qualified applicants of every background, ability, and life experience to contact us about appropriate employment opportunities.

One Medical participates in E-Verify and will provide the federal government with your Form I-9 information to confirm that you are authorized to work in the U.S.  Please refer to the E-Verification Poster and Right to Work Poster for additional information.

Your work schedule could be subject to change based on business direction at any time.

jobs.title: Sr Customer Development Manager
jobs.description:
Link Snacks, Inc. is seeking a highly motivated and experienced Sr. Customer Development Manager – Military Business to lead strategic growth, business development, and distribution execution across all military retail channels. This is a remote position with a preference for candidates based in the Dallas, Texas area. In this role, the manager will own the sales strategy for key government and military accounts, including DeCA, AAFES, NEXCOM, MCX, and CGX. This position requires a deep understanding of the unique military resale channel, strong relationship-building capabilities, and a proven track record of driving CPG brand visibility and volume growth.

JOB SUMMARY

The Sr. Customer Development Manager for the Military Business is responsible for maximizing sales volume, net revenue, and category share for the Link Snacks portfolio of products within the military channel. This individual will manage direct relationships with military/government buyers, oversee broker networks, and execute joint business plans to drive maximum distribution and promotional effectiveness.

The ideal candidate will live in the Dallas area but can manage remotely with quarterly travel to market.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

• Own and manage the customer relationship with DeCA, AAFES, NEXCOM, MCX, CGX, and broker partners to unlock new distribution placements and optimize product shelf presentation.
• Achieve top-line and bottom-line sales and profit goals.
• Build strong customer relationships.
• Develop solid DSMP (Distribution, Shelving, Merchandising, Pricing) plans that drive category growth.
• Understand customer strategy and align to annual business plans that meet growth expectations.
• Develop 1–3-year strategic customer plans by segment.
• Provide transparent and timely communication to internal team members and customers/brokers.
• Develop plans for channel-specific business opportunities focused on expanding Link Snacks’ in-store presence.
• Responsible for analyzing customer data and developing an action plan to achieve sales goals.
• Collaborate with cross-functional teams (Demand Planning, RGM, Sales Strategy) in creating both short- and long-term category and channel strategies.
• Create and present information compellingly and persuasively.
• Effectively build relationships throughout customer organizations and at various levels internally at Link Snacks, including Executive Management, Operations, Supply Planning, Accounting, and Marketing.
• Manage deduction and AR issues on all applicable accounts.
• Responsible for training and leading the broker network where applicable.
• Perform other duties as assigned.

TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS

• Approximately 30% - 40% travel depending on business needs.

• Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
• 5+ years of CPG experience within the industry.
• 3+ years of direct sales experience in military channels.
• Strong communication and presentation skills.
• Solid MS Office skills.
• Ability to keep up in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
• Ability to travel approximately 30% - 40% travel depending on business needs.

The pay range for this role is $140,000 - $170,000 (Annual). Actual wage will vary based on several factors, including but not limited to external market data, internal equity, location, and candidate skill set and experience. Base pay is just one component of Link Snacks Total Rewards package for Team Members. Other rewards may include annual incentive and program-specific awards. Link Snacks provides a variety of benefits to eligible Team Members, including medical, dental and vision benefits, life and disability insurance, 401k participation, paid holidays, and paid time off.

PHYSICAL DEMANDS

The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to be successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.

While performing the duties of this job, the Team Member is regularly required to sit, use hands and fingers, handle, or feel, and talk or hear. The Team Member is required to stand, walk, and reach with hands and arms and lift for extended periods while conducting store audits, setting up promotional displays, or attending trade shows. Must be able to regularly lift, carry, and maneuver 25 or more pounds of product cases, display materials, and sales supplies during retail visits and industry events. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision.

WORK ENVIRONMENT

Work from a dedicated home office, utilizing modern digital collaboration tools (Microsoft Teams, Slack, Zoom) to maintain seamless communication. Partner closely with remote Sales Managers overseeing other retail channels (such as Mass, Grocery, and Convenience) to share consumer insights, align pricing guardrails, and implement cohesive national brand campaigns.

EQUAL EMPLOYMENT OPPORTUNITY EMPLOYER:

Link Snacks provides equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic that is protected by federal, state or local law.

E-VERIFY:

Link Snacks is participant in the federal E-Verify program to confirm the identity and employment authorization of all newly hired employees.  For information about the E-Verify program, please visit:  http://www.uscis.gov/e-verify/employees

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

jobs.title: Moloco Ads GTM Strategy Manager
jobs.description:
About Moloco:

Moloco is an AI-native performance advertising company, bringing the power of AI advertising to the open internet. Founded in 2013 by machine learning engineers who had built AI advertising systems inside the world's largest technology companies, Moloco began from a shared mission: to build that same engine for the open internet.

Today, Moloco is one company with two businesses, built on the same compound AI system. Moloco Ads is our AI-native performance advertising platform, helping mobile app marketers acquire, retain, and re-engage high-value users across the open internet. Moloco Commerce Media is our AI-native retail media platform, enabling retailers and marketplaces to turn their platforms into thriving ad businesses. Both are powered by CARA (Compound Ad Recommendation Architecture), the AI system behind every Moloco product.

At Moloco, we bring together those who've already solved hard problems and those with the drive to. Here, we work on some of the complex problems in AI advertising, at a scale and level of sophistication very few companies can offer. Come build what's next.

The Impact You'll Be Contributing to Moloco

As part of the Ads Strategy team within Moloco's Go-To-Market organization, this person shapes strategic initiatives that drive business growth. Initial focus:

• Leading high-impact strategy projects for Moloco's Executive and C-Suite teams.

• Driving the Competitive Intelligence function for Moloco Ads.

The Opportunity

Strategy & Growth Initiatives

• Drive high-impact strategy projects to accelerate revenue growth and identify new business opportunities.

• Develop data-driven recommendations by analyzing advertiser trends, market expansion opportunities, and ecosystem dynamics.

• Partner with Product, Sales, and Finance to refine strategic proposals and make sure they get executed.

Competitive Intelligence & Market Insights

• Lead Moloco's Competitive Intelligence (CI) function: track industry trends, competitive dynamics, and product developments in mobile advertising.

• Be the company's go-to expert on the competitive landscape so leadership stays ahead of key shifts.

• Synthesize insights into executive-ready reports and actionable recommendations.

• Benchmark Moloco's ad products and monetization strategies against competitors to identify areas of differentiation.

How Do I Know if the Role is Right For Me?

• 5+ years in strategy, consulting, or a related field.

• Deep understanding of the AdTech industry; mobile app monetization experience is a plus.

• Background in Management Consulting, Investment Banking, or Corporate Strategy (highly preferred).

• Experience working directly with senior executives and C-suite stakeholders with minimal oversight.

• Exceptional analytical skills; breaks ambiguous problems into their key factors and delivers compelling recommendations.

• Has driven high-visibility strategic projects from ideation to execution, even with limited data or guidance.

• Proven cross-functional collaboration with Product, Data Science, and other teams, with outstanding written and presentation skills.

• Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills; SQL is a plus.

Compensation & Benefits

U.S.-based employees have access to medical, dental, and vision insurance, a 401(k) plan with company match, short-term and long-term disability coverage, basic life insurance, and well-being benefits and perks. U.S.-based employees also receive up to 12 scheduled paid holidays per calendar year and one Thrive Day off per quarter. Additionally, all employees have Flexible Time Off (FTO).

The successful candidate may be eligible for a bonus and equity awards. Eligibility and amounts are determined by performance and the terms of the applicable plans.

The location for this role is listed above. For base pay range purposes, location-based compensation is grouped into the following regions. Your region is determined by your assigned work location.

• Region A: Menlo Park Office, New York Office, SF Bay Area, New York Metro Area

• Region B: Seattle Office, Seattle, Los Angeles/Orange County, San Diego, Austin, Boston, Washington DC Metro Area, Miami

• Region C: All other U.S. locations

Salary Ranges:

Region A:

$152,000—$209,760 USD

Region B:

$136,800—$188,784 USD

Region C:

$129,200—$178,296 USD

Supporting Your Best Work and Your Best Life:

Our benefits are designed to support our people in doing their best work and living well, at work and beyond. Benefits vary by country, employment type, and eligibility. Connect with a recruiter to learn more about benefits in your region.

Moloco Values:

• Lead with Humility: Everyone’s voice is respected, valued, and heard. We win, lose, and learn together. Accountability and feedback are essential to our success.

• Uncapped Growth Mindset: We see all situations as opportunities to learn, grow, and improve as individuals and as an organization. We seek diverse perspectives, encourage curiosity, and promote experimentation to push the boundaries of what’s possible.

• Create Real Value: We pursue the most impactful opportunities with intensity and rigor. We take intelligent risks and make disciplined trade-offs to maintain deep focus. We help our customers win by delivering durable value.

• Go Further Together: We’re one team working towards one vision. We collaborate proactively and inclusively, involving the right people at the right time and in the right way. We strive to create a more equitable workplace. We won’t let each other fail.

Additional Resources:

• Moloco Leadership

• Moloco Newsroom
