jobs.title: Licensed Veterinary Technician
jobs.description:
Who is VetEvolve?

VetEvolve is a network of veterinary practices built to support the people delivering care and the practices they lead. We combine clinical insight with operational strength to give our teams the support, tools, and structure they need to thrive, without losing what makes each practice unique. We are intentionally focused on growth, not as an end in itself, but as a way to strengthen our practices, expand access to care, and create more opportunities for our teams.

Guided by our values: Care First. Better Together. Grow Forward. Own It. We create an environment where veterinary professionals can do their best work, build meaningful careers, and deliver exceptional care. Growth with intention. Care without compromise.

Licensed Veterinary Technician | Hollymead Veterinary Hospital | Charlottesville, Virginia

🐾 Love Animals? Love Being Part of a Team? We Want to Meet You! 🐾

Are you the person who can’t walk past a puppy without saying hello, thinks cleaning up after pets is just part of the job, and genuinely enjoys making a difference in the lives of animals and their people? Then you might be exactly who we’re looking for!

Hollymead Veterinary Hospital is looking for an enthusiastic, compassionate LVT to join our team! If you’re dependable, eager to learn, enjoy working in a fast-paced environment, and want to be part of a team that truly cares about our patients, clients, and each other, we’d love to hear from you! 🐶🐱❤️

HVH is a general practice and urgent care hospital located in Charlottesville, VA. We deliver comprehensive veterinary care while empowering pet owners with the knowledge and guidance to make informed decisions, fostering a supportive environment that promotes the health, well-being, and happiness of both pets and their families. Our core values are compassion, collaboration, respect, and support. We promote a learning environment and understand the importance of work-life balance.

Position Summary:

The Licensed Veterinary Technician (LVT) plays a vital role in assisting veterinarians and the medical support team to ensure the delivery of high-quality, compassionate care to pets and their families. This position is responsible for performing a variety of technical, clinical, and client education duties that enhance efficiency, promote a safe and collaborative hospital environment, and elevate the overall client experience. The LVT also assists in maintaining consistent, excellent medical standards and operational flow.

Compensation: $25-35/hourly, commensurate with licensure and experience

Primary Responsibilities:

• Provide high-quality nursing care to hospitalized patients, including IV catheter placement, CRI management, medication administration, feeding tube placement, and ongoing monitoring.

• Prepare, monitor, and recover patients undergoing surgical procedures, ensuring patient safety and comfort throughout all phases of care.

• Assist veterinarians during examinations, diagnostics, treatments, and surgical procedures, providing proper restraint, preparation, and patient monitoring.

• Perform laboratory diagnostics including urinalysis, hematology, fecals, and cytology; accurately document, interpret, and communicate results as appropriate.

• Operate and maintain diagnostic equipment, including radiology and ultrasound systems, in compliance with safety and regulatory standards.

• Prepare and administer medications, vaccines, and treatments as prescribed, maintaining strict compliance with DEA, OSHA, and hospital regulations.

• Maintain accurate daily controlled drug logs and ensure proper handling, storage, and documentation of controlled substances.

• Create, review, and enter treatment plans accurately in the medical record system.

• Support hospital operations through accurate medical recordkeeping, charge entry, and chart auditing.

• Provide compassionate, clear client education related to preventative care, treatment plans, medications, products, and nutritional recommendations.

• Maintain clean, organized, and well-stocked treatment and surgical areas, ensuring sterile conditions for medical and surgical procedures.

• Monitor inventory levels, rotate stock, and assist with ordering medical supplies as needed.

• Promote a positive and professional workplace culture through effective communication, teamwork, and collaboration across departments.

• Perform additional duties as assigned based on hospital needs.

• Ensure all duties are performed in accordance with state practice acts, legal requirements, and hospital policies.

Qualifications:

• High school diploma or equivalent required.

• [Licensed/Certified/Registered] Veterinary Technician credential required.

• Demonstrated proficiency in anesthesia monitoring, venipuncture, laboratory procedures, radiology, and dentistry.

• Basic computer literacy, including the ability to navigate practice management software and use Microsoft Office applications.

• Strong communication and organizational skills with the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

• Maintains professionalism, composure, and sound judgment in emotionally charged or high-stress situations.

• Capable of multitasking in a fast-paced setting while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.

• Compassionate and committed to delivering exceptional patient care and client service.

• Able to work safely around cleaning chemicals, anesthetic gases, radiation, zoonotic diseases, and animal bodily fluids.

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds and safely handle animals up to 130 pounds.

• Comfortable sitting, standing, walking, bending, and kneeling for extended periods throughout the workday.

• Professional, neat appearance consistent with hospital standards.

Hours:

• Must be able to work a flexible schedule and be available for scheduling during all hours the practice is open to support hospital operations.

Benefits:

• We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, as well as an employee discount at VetEvolve practices. In addition, employees are eligible to participate in our 401(k) retirement plan. Other benefits include paid time off, paid holidays, and access to employee assistance program.

Ready to Learn More?

We look forward to learning about your unique priorities and goals and working together with our local hospital teams to support you.

jobs.title: Warehouse & Inventory Associate
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

 - Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

 - Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands.
   
    


ROLE SCOPE

 - Operate forklifts, pallet jacks, and other warehouse equipment safely to receive, move, stage, and ship critical infrastructure at high velocity.

 - Load, unload, inspect, and organize incoming hardware, ensuring every shipment is accounted for and ready for deployment.

 - Pick, pack, and deliver parts quickly and accurately so technicians and engineers always have what they need to keep the data center moving.

 - Maintain an organized, clean, and deployment-ready warehouse, keeping inventory accessible and material flowing efficiently across the site.

 - Support inventory counts, stock replenishment, and asset tracking with precision, helping maintain accurate inventory and preventing operational delays.

 - Assist with packaging, returns, RMAs, and other warehouse operations while identifying opportunities to improve efficiency, safety, and workflow.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You've worked in a warehouse, distribution center, manufacturing environment, construction site, or other hands-on operational setting where safety, speed, and accuracy matter.

 - You're comfortable operating forklifts or are willing to become certified, and you take pride in moving material safely and efficiently.

 - You're dependable, physically active, and enjoy work that keeps you on your feet while solving real operational problems.

 - You stay organized in fast-moving environments, take ownership of your work, and don't wait to be told what needs to get done.

 - You communicate well, work effectively as part of a team, and understand that every shipment, pallet, and part plays a role in keeping critical infrastructure online.

 - Bonus: Experience with warehouse management systems, barcode scanners, shipping and receiving, inventory control, data center hardware, or high-growth operational environments.
   
    


SALARY & BENEFITS

 - Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

 - Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.
   
   - Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.
     
     
     Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.

jobs.title: Workforce Planning Analyst (Maternity Cover)
jobs.description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.

About the Role
This is an exciting opportunity to become an integral part of Motorways Workforce Planning Team. As the critical link, you will directly support Contact Centre teams across Motorway in achieving their Service Delivery Plans. Your analysis and utilisation of resources are essential to meeting critical Service Level Agreements, while simultaneously increasing overall productivity and efficiency.

You’ll proactively drive value through effective planning and detailed analysis of performance, including communicating current and future performance outlooks to stakeholders. You will create and distribute agent schedules based on demand forecasts and operational targets, ensuring optimal resource allocation across all contact channels (Voice, Live Chat, Email, and Tickets).


Key components of this role include tracking real time and historical operational performance and adherence to plans, utilising tools such as Calabrio, Zendesk Contact Centre/Amazon Connect, and Google Sheets. You'll provide deep analysis and insights into KPI performance and productivity metrics to identify critical trends and highlight performance risks. A deep understanding and application of end to end workforce planning methodologies, processes and systems, is essential for success in this fast paced contact center environment.


What You'll Do (Key Responsibilities)

 - Develop accurate demand forecasts and capacity plans across all channels (Voice, Live Chat, Email, and Tickets).

 - Create, adjust, and distribute daily and weekly agent schedules, utilizing WFM principles to optimise resource allocation and utilization.

 - Actively track and monitor the real time performance of KPIs and adherence to plans.

 - Implement dynamic intraday adjustments to staffing and skill routing to mitigate performance risks.

 - Provide deep analysis and data driven insights into operational performance (i.e. utilisation, occupancy, productivity).

 - Proactively update and engage with operational stakeholders on current and future performance outlooks, translating complex WFM data into actionable business language.

 - Maintain, build, and enhance operational reports to support data driven decision making.



What You'll Bring (Required Skills and Experience)

 - Demonstrated success and hands on experience in end to end workforce planning and real time monitoring.

 - Strong working knowledge of WFM systems (e.g. Calabrio, Genesys, NICE or similar) and contact center omnichannel platforms.

 - Exceptional skill in using analytical tools (such as Google Sheets/Excel) to manipulate large data sets and translate complex data for stakeholders.

 - Excellent ability to manage multiple, conflicting priorities effectively, particularly urgent real time needs.

 - A proactive, self motivated approach to identifying operational gaps and implementing solutions independently.

 - Experience working in a fast paced omnichannel contact centre environment.


OUR INTERVIEW PROCESS

 - Intro Call with Talent Partner - 30 minutes

 - Hiring Manager Interview - 60 minutes

 - Final Interview and Take Home Assessment - 60 minutes

You can expect to hear back from us within a week of each interview stage. You'll have the opportunity to speak with a talent partner throughout the interview process should you have any questions or need any type of accommodations.




JOB DETAILS

 - Shift pattern: Monday to Friday 8:45am to 5:30pm

 - Duration: 12 Months FTC

Benefits

We've got your back, in life's biggest moments and the everyday ones too.

 - Competitive salary

 - Equity scheme - we all share in Motorway’s success

 - 25 days holiday

 - Sea-front office with bi-weekly massages and free snacks

 - Private medical insurance via BUPA

 - Life assurance

 - Pension scheme (we contribute 5%)

 - Enhanced family leave (e.g. 26 weeks full pay for maternity or adoption)

 - 24/7 Employee Assistance Programme

 - EV leasing scheme

 - Cycle to work scheme

 - Nursery salary sacrifice scheme

 - 1 paid volunteering day a year

jobs.title: PER DIEM - School-Based Therapist (LAC/LPC, LAMFT/LMFT, LSW/LCSW)
jobs.description:
Per Diem School-Based Therapist – NuView Academy (Piscataway, NJ)

Transforming student mental health in schools.

Position Type: Per Diem
Hourly Rate: $45.00–$48.00/hour
Training Rate: $25.00/hour (combination of virtual and in-person, including CPI and Ukera )
Benefits: Available to per diem staff working 30 or more hours per week

About Effective School Solutions

Effective School Solutions (ESS) is a leading provider of school-based mental health services, serving more than 6,000 K–12 students across 12 states.

We bring the level of clinical care typically found in private practice, out-of-district placements, or higher levels of care directly into schools. We provide a full continuum of clinical programming, professional development, and district consultation.

About the Role

ESS has a large clinical team at NuView Academy, a state-run therapeutic school. As a per diem therapist at NuView, you'll provide coverage wherever the team needs you most. Depending on the day or assignment, you may step in for:

• One of our 4 mental health therapists

• One of our 5 Mental Health Technicians

• Our Clinical Director, including collaborating with the program psychiatrist and handling administrative tasks

No two assignments are exactly alike, which makes this a great opportunity for a clinician who enjoys variety and wants to make an impact across an entire program.

Who We're Looking For

We're looking for a dynamic, adaptable clinician who is comfortable moving between roles and responding to changing needs throughout the day. Experience working with students who have more acute mental health needs is required. You should be confident handling crises, stay calm under pressure, and build rapport quickly with students and staff.

Schedule and Flexibility

Per diem therapists support ESS as needed, including covering leave assignments such as medical or maternity leave. You choose your level of commitment. You can:

• Pick up occasional shifts

• Work a few days per week on an ongoing basis, when needed

• Take on a temporary full-time schedule when covering a longer-term leave

You're free to accept or decline assignments based on your availability. This role doesn't follow a consistent full-time schedule, but full-time hours may be available temporarily during extended leave assignments.

Why This Role Matters

You'll provide critical mental health support to students who may not otherwise have access to care, helping them succeed academically, build resilience, and thrive. At ESS, clinicians are trusted partners in shaping supportive school environments.

Responsibilities

Direct Clinical Care and Family Support

• Provide school-based mental health services, including individual, group, and family therapy, along with intake, diagnostic, and clinical assessments

• Partner with families and facilitate parent support programming

• Conduct risk assessments and crisis intervention, keeping students safe and coordinating referrals to the right level of care when needed

• Develop and carry out individualized, evidence-based treatment plans that support students' emotional, behavioral, and academic success

Collaboration and Professional Development

• Work with families, school staff, and interdisciplinary teams to coordinate care, and provide consultation, coaching, and training on mental health and trauma-informed practices

• Participate in team meetings, supervision, and ongoing professional development

When Covering the Clinical Director Role

• Oversee the day-to-day clinical operations of the program

• Serve as the primary clinical contact for school partners, providing expert guidance and building strong, collaborative relationships

• Collaborate with the program psychiatrist and complete administrative tasks

• Lead weekly consultation sessions to keep the team aligned on student goals and documentation standards

• Monitor program performance and keep it aligned with ESS clinical and operational standards

• Support clinician performance through feedback, coaching, and evaluations

Documentation and Professional Expectations

• Keep clinical documentation timely and accurate, in line with regulatory, ethical, and organizational standards

• Maintain active licensure, ethical practice, reliability, and a strong professional presence

Qualifications

• Master's degree in Social Work, Counseling, or a related field

• Active associate or independent clinical license in New Jersey (LAMFT/LMFT, LAC/LPC, or LSW/LCSW)

• 2+ years of experience working with children and/or adolescents with behavioral and emotional needs

• Experience working with students with acute mental health needs

• Experience working with schools, families, and community-based services (school-based experience preferred)

• Ability to build and maintain trusting relationships with students, families, and school staff

• Commitment to high-quality, evidence-based care and best practices

• Ability to make confident, sound decisions in ambiguous or changing situations

• Comfort with clinical documentation and electronic systems such as an EMR and Microsoft Office

Why Clinicians Choose ESS

✔ School-day schedule with no weekends (occasional evening hours to support family engagement)
✔ Flexible, choose-your-own commitment
✔ Ongoing clinical support and free CEUs
✔ Competitive pay
✔ Clinical leadership at the heart of our company

Make a meaningful impact on student mental health. Join Effective School Solutions!

Equal Opportunity Employer

ESS is an Equal Opportunity Employer and does not discriminate against any employee or applicant for employment on the basis of race, color, sex, age, national origin, religion, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, veteran status, disability, or any other federal, state, or local protected class.

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Lead - Healthcare
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
In healthcare, the phone is still the front door, and call volume keeps rising while the people answering it are harder to hire and keep. You'll own our North America enterprise motion across providers, payers, and life sciences, helping health organizations put agents in front of patients, members, and clinicians that are safe, fast, and fit the systems they already run. You'll have the mandate to build the playbook and the team.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the enterprise healthcare function across health systems, payers, and pharma/medtech: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution

 - Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for each segment

 - Build and lead a high-performing enterprise sales team

 - Land and expand with large health systems, health plans, and life sciences companies

 - Work through BAAs, security review, and AI governance boards (and MLR review for pharma), starting compliance conversations in week one

 - Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers to scope integrations with the EHR, claims, and telephony systems customers already run

 - Help customers pick one high-volume starting point (scheduling, reminders, after-hours coverage, benefits and claims status, HCP support) and prove it before scaling

 - Build a reference network of healthcare peers that buyers can call

 - Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations

 - Bring a sharp view of the competitive landscape, including build-vs-buy, platform bundlers, and vertical point solutions, to positioning and strategy

 - Set the bar for sales culture, integrity, and customer-first execution

Requirements:

 - Proven enterprise sales leadership in a high-growth, product-led tech company (AI/ML strongly preferred)

 - Track record selling to health systems, payers, or life sciences, with fluency in HIPAA, BAAs, and long, multi-stakeholder cycles

 - Experience building and scaling sales teams from the ground up

 - Seven-figure enterprise deals and complex sales cycles

 - Ability to be strategic and hands-on at once

 - Executive presence at C-suite and board levels

 - Collaborative, humble, and driven

 - Passion for the transformative potential of conversational AI

Remote-first in the United States, with a strong preference for New York or San Francisco, where we have office spaces.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Safety and Security Associate
jobs.description:

The Maritime Aquarium’s mission is to ignite a connection to Long Island Sound and the ocean to enrich the lives of all people and inspire action to protect our blue planet. For 38 years, the Aquarium has played a significant role in shaping the landscape of Norwalk and the region. The second largest family attraction in Connecticut, and 50 miles from New York City, the Aquarium hosts nearly 450,000 guests annually. Its primary exhibits take guests on a voyage from the shallow salt marshes and estuaries to the depths of the Long Island Sound and the ocean beyond, culminating with habitats for sharks and harbor seals.

Altogether, the Aquarium is home to more than 8,000 animals and 285 species in 75 exhibits. A new 4D Theater offers a unique sensory film experience for guests. Its education programs introduce nearly 50,000 students, campers and scouts to marine and STEM education. The Aquarium is recognized as a top aquarium in the nation and is accredited by the Association of Zoos and Aquariums. It is an active participant in the local and regional community. The strength of the Aquarium is its approximately 97 full-time and 78 part-time employees, seasonal staff, and our volunteers.

Position Overview

The Security Guard executes internal facility safety and security functions. The primary focus of this role is to ensure a secure facility for guests, staff, volunteers, and our animal collection. This role ensures the standards of security and safety per OSHA regulations as well as the Association of Zoos and Aquariums are met or exceeded. This an hourly position paying $19/hour.

Compensation

This is an hourly position paying $19.00 per hour.

Schedule Requirements

This is a full-time position working Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM. Flexibility is required to work other shifts as needed, including weekdays, weekends, holidays, and to provide coverage for vacation, sick leave, and other staffing needs.

The Security Guard schedule will vary based on operational needs to ensure 24/7 facility coverage. Open availability across all shifts and days of the week is strongly preferred. Work schedules are posted, when possible, at least four weeks in advance.

Primary Responsibilities

• Maintain facility safety and security requirements procedures for safeguarding the facility, staff, volunteers and animal collection in accordance with Post Orders

• Responds to emergency situations, conducts investigations and completes incident reports

• Administer safety audits and inspections

• Submit inspection reports and records daily and advise the Safety Manager of deficiencies

• Monitors the security camera system throughout scheduled shifts

• Assist in ensuring 24/7 security coverage of the facility

• Responsible for receiving and delivery of packages

• Assist with TMA lost and found program, and acts as the point of contact for guest retrieval of items

Qualifications

• High School diploma and a minimum of 3 years of security experience.

• CPR/AED/First Aid Certification required

• Demonstrates knowledge of security operations, safety practices, and incident investigation in a public institution.

• Able to lift and/or move items of at least 50 pounds

jobs.title: Sr. Director, Learning & Development
jobs.description:
The Sr. Director, Learning & Development, builds the training engine behind our revenue. Reporting to the SVP of Talent, this leader's primary mandate is to make our field revenue teams (in-home sales consultants, retail and event marketers, canvassers, and the appointment-setting teams that support them) ramp faster, sell better, and stay longer.

This is a business role first and a learning role second. Success is measured in close rates, revenue per lead, ramp time, and early-tenure retention, not course completions. The role also owns leadership development for field managers and leaders and the company's compliance training program.



What You'll Do:

1. Field Team Training

 - Build and own the training curriculum for our revenue-generating roles: in-home sales consultants, retail and event marketers, canvassers, and our call center roles.

 - Design new hire onboarding and certification for each revenue role that shortens time to first sale and time to full productivity.

 - Partner with Sales and Marketing leaders to codify what top performers do, and turn it into repeatable training on the sales process, product knowledge, objection handling, pricing and financing conversations, and lead generation.

 - Build ongoing skill development, not just onboarding: refresher programs, new product and promotion launches, and targeted coaching for underperforming reps and markets.

 - Equip field sales and marketing managers to reinforce training through ride-alongs, role plays, and coaching in the field.

 - Spend regular time in the field (ride-alongs, retail events, canvassing shifts) to keep training grounded in how the work actually happens.

 - Onboard and train sales and marketing teams at acquired businesses, aligning them to our sales process and standards.

2. Measurement & Business Impact

 - Tie every major revenue program to business metrics such as close rate, revenue per lead, appointment set and issue rates, average ticket, cancellation rate, ramp time, and 90-day retention.

 - Partner with Sales, Marketing, and Finance to use performance data to find skill gaps by role, market, and rep, and prioritize training where it will move EBITDA most.

 - Report program results and recommendations to executive leadership in business terms.

3. Leadership Development

 - Design and deliver practical development programs for frontline field managers and mid-level leaders, with priority on sales and marketing managers.

 - Build manager capability in coaching, performance management, and running effective teams.

 - Provide support to HRBPs as needed on manager and leader development.

4. Compliance Training & Learning Operations

 - Manage required compliance training in partnership with Legal, Safety, and HR, ensuring completion and documentation across the organization.

 - Own the LMS and learning technology stack, including content administration, reporting, and vendor management.

 - Manage the L&D budget and external content and vendor relationships.

 - Maintain and run Docebo, our L&D platform.

5. Team Leadership

 - Lead and grow a team of field trainers, instructional designers, and LMS administrators.



What You'll Bring:

Required

 - 10+ years in learning and development

 - Direct experience building training for field-based, direct-to-consumer sales teams (in-home sales, retail or event marketing, door-to-door, or similar) in a multi-site organization.

 - A track record of training programs that measurably improved sales results such as close rate, revenue per rep, or ramp time. Be ready to share the numbers.

 - Credibility with sales leaders and frontline reps. You understand lead flow, the sales process, and how field reps are paid and motivated.

 - Strong instructional design and facilitation skills across in-person, virtual, and on-demand formats.

 - Comfort with data. You can pull performance metrics, find the skill gap, and show the before and after.

Preferred

 - Experience in home services, home improvement, or similar in-home sales industries.

 - Experience onboarding teams from acquired businesses.

 - Experience designing leadership development for frontline managers and senior leaders.

 - Hands-on LMS administration and learning vendor management.



Travel & Working Conditions

Travel of approximately 30 to 40% to markets, branches, retail locations, and acquired businesses to observe field teams, deliver training, and partner with local leadership. Some evening and weekend work to observe retail events and canvassing shifts.



About Renuity 
Renuity, headquartered in Charlotte, NC, is a leading home improvement services business with a rapidly expanding national footprint. Renuity currently operates across 36 states and has created hundreds of thousands of happier homeowners across the United States who have chosen Renuity for their home improvement needs. Renuity is redefining the home improvement experience with a focus on trust, innovation and customer-first service.



Renuity and its affiliates are committed to equal opportunity. jobs.title: TS QPL48 Management Lead
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking an ITS QPL48 Management Lead to support the Georgia Department of Transportation (GDOT) Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS) program.

This position will lead the evaluation, approval, testing, integration, and lifecycle management of ITS devices within GDOT’s Qualified Products List (QPL48).

The role will serve as a key liaison between GDOT, technology vendors, system integrators, and AECOM teams to ensure ITS technologies meet technical requirements and support reliable operation of Georgia’s transportation management system.

The job responsibilities of this position will include but are not limited to:

• Lead the end-to-end QPL48 product application, technical review, testing, approval, and lifecycle management process.
• Serve as the primary point of contact for vendors and provide guidance on QPL48 submission requirements, technical specifications, testing, and approval processes.
• Coordinate New Product Evaluations (NPEs) with GDOT’s Office of Materials and Testing (OMAT).
• Review vendor submittals, technical specifications, compliance matrices, test results, certifications, and supporting documentation for compliance with GDOT requirements.
• Evaluate emerging ITS technologies, including LiDAR, radar, video detection, and other transportation technology systems.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:

jobs.title: B2B Sales Specialist
jobs.description:
ABOUT MOTORWAY

Motorway is the UK's largest online car-selling platform. We connect private sellers directly with over 8,000 dealers nationwide. Our online platform helps sellers achieve great prices for their cars while giving dealers fast, reliable access to the stock they want for their dealerships. Founded in 2017, our award-winning, technology-led approach has redefined the experience of selling a car. Motorway is backed by some of the world’s leading technology investors, having raised £143 million in Series C funding.

This is a unique opportunity to join a fast-growing scale-up at a crucial phase of growth and help change an industry for the better.


ABOUT THE ROLE

This is a consultative B2B sales role focused on driving platform adoption across UK car dealerships and encouraging active daily auction participation.

You’ll manage a varied portfolio of dealer partners across the UK, ranging from onboarding brand-new businesses and winning back lapsed accounts, to optimizing performance for established, regular buyers. Rather than hard-selling from a rigid script, your goal is to ask great questions, understand each dealership’s unique business goals and position the value of Motorway to demonstrate a clear ROI. You will ultimately build high-value, collaborative and long-term relationships.

Whether you’re delivering a powerful first impression to a new account or embedding repeatable, profitable processes into an existing or lapsed partner's daily routine, you'll act as a trusted advisor to help them win. We don't expect you to know everything on day one, but we do look for solid sales foundations, curiosity, and a drive to learn. We’ll back you with structured coaching, dedicated mentorship, and all the tools you need to succeed.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Consult & Position: Conduct high-level business conversations to uncover dealership needs, positioning Motorway as an essential, long-term inventory solution.

 - Drive Network Activity: Onboard new dealership partners, re-engage cold or lapsed accounts, and nurture regular users to drive daily auction participation.

 - Demonstrate Value Fast: Clearly articulate ROI to new or hesitant dealers while building repeatable, sustainable buying habits for mature accounts.

 - Pipeline Ownership: Maintain exceptional CRM hygiene using HubSpot to log activity, manage your pipeline, and report accurately.

 - Overcome Friction: Confidently navigate objections, address dealer pain points, and follow up consistently to keep conversations moving forward.

 - Collaborate for Impact: Work closely with cross-functional teams to resolve dealer challenges and feed market insights back to our product team.

 - Hit Targets: Take ownership of your numbers, proactively seeking coaching and feedback whenever you spot room to grow.


WHO YOU ARE

 - Sales Foundations: You have background experience in B2B or outbound sales, working comfortably against key performance targets.

 - Consultative Mindset: You ask smart questions before pitching, listening intently to tailor your value proposition to each business.

 - Adaptable Communicator: Exceptional telephone manner with the confidence to speak to business owners and decision-makers at all levels.

 - CRM Competent: Comfortable managing a pipeline and staying organised across a busy, diverse portfolio using HubSpot (or a similar CRM).

 - Resilient & Driven: Rejection doesn't derail you; it motivates you to follow up. You’re genuinely energised by hitting and exceeding targets.

 - Relationship Builder: You're motivated by true customer success and prefer doing things right over closing a bad deal fast.

 - Continuous Learner: You’re coachable and take ownership of your development.


LIFE IN THE TEAM

The B2B Sales team at Motorway is a tight-knit, collaborative group who work hard, celebrate wins together, and genuinely look out for one another. You’ll be encouraged to test new approaches, ask questions, and share ideas.

You'll be based in our multi-story, sea-fronted Brighton office located in the heart of the city next to Churchill Square, where vibrant culture and professional growth go hand in hand.


WE OFFER A FANTASTIC RANGE OF BENEFITS TO HELP YOU THRIVE

 - £26,000 starting salary (OTE £48,000)

 - Great work-life balance with standard shifts from 9am to 5:30pm

 - Sea fronted office location with regular social events, office drinks, weekly massages and free snacks to keep you going!

 - Flexibility to work from home 1 day per week to help nail that work life balance

 - Stock options so you can share in Motorway’s growth and future success

 - Pension scheme to plan for your future with our provider NEST

 - Strong commitment to your personal development including budget for books, courses, conferences, etc!

 - Opt-in comprehensive health insurance through BUPA including fitness discounts

 - Cycle to work scheme - save big ££ on a new bike and accessories

 - One paid volunteering day a year for you to use as you wish

 - Generous parental benefits including 6 months full paid maternity leave, 4 weeks paternity leave and and workplace nursery scheme

 - ... and much more!

jobs.location: Various GA sites (Hazlehurst, Jesup, Vidalia, Waycross, and Douglas)
jobs.description:
Silicon Ranch is a fully integrated provider of customized renewable energy, carbon, and battery storage solutions for a diverse set of partners across North America.

• We are known for putting community partnerships first, and are the only renewable energy company in the U.S. that owns and operates all of its solar ranches and has a 100% track record for successful delivery.

• We have the largest utility scale agrivoltaics portfolio in the country under Regenerative Energy®, our nationally recognized holistic approach to project design, construction, and land management. Our model incorporates regenerative ranching and other regenerative land management practices to restore livelihoods and soil health, biodiversity, and water quality.

• Through our subsidiary, Clearloop, we are able to help businesses of all sizes reclaim their carbon footprint with a direct investment in building new solar projects while also helping bring renewable energy and economic development to distressed communities.

By joining Silicon Ranch, you will be joining a team of experienced and dedicated individuals who have proven time and again that it is indeed possible to not only “make solar do more”, but to make the promise of carbon-free, renewable energy that benefits people right where it comes from a tangible, measurable, and replicable reality.

Silicon Ranch is committed to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace that is reflective of the communities in which we work and serve. We are an equal opportunity employer and will consider all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics.

Job Description

Position: Solar PV Operations and Maintenance Area Lead III - Field Operations (Georgia sites)

Location: Various GA sites (Hazlehurst, Jesup, Vidalia, Waycross, and Douglas)

Overview:

This position is responsible for the performance and leading of corrective and preventative maintenance tasks within a defined set of facilities. These tasks include the inspection, troubleshooting, diagnosis, and remedy of issues impacting the production of the solar PV facility. This includes repair and/or replacement of electrical and mechanical components and subcomponents such as contactors, breakers, motors, bearings, PV modules, PLCs, transformers, etc, as well as the troubleshooting of complex electrical systems.

The ideal candidate is a self-starter with a strong mechanical inclination and verifiable experience performing in a utility scale operations and maintenance role. Experience performing and leading maintenance tasks on DC, AC, and MV systems, communications equipment, and mechanical systems will translate well to this position.

PV solar operations and maintenance experience is required to be considered for this role. Candidates must have direct on-site management experience at NERC-regulated facilities with a capacity of 100 MW or greater.

Main Responsibilities

● Perform and lead scheduled preventive maintenance tasks at each facility, including the full PV system, UPS, SCADA, substation, and MV/HV/OHE systems.

● Perform and lead corrective maintenance tasks, both scheduled and unscheduled, at each facility, including the full PV system, UPS, SCADA, substation, and MV/HV/OHE systems.

● Respond to directives for emergency dispatches for critical systems as directed.

● Log all work performed via the Silicon Ranch CMMS platform.

● Perform electrical testing using IV Curve Tracers, Power Quality Meters, Insulation Resistance Testers, Multimeters, and other testing equipment as needed.

● Assist management with field investigations to support predictive analytics, root cause analysis, and serial defect reports.

● Assist in creating and reviewing preventative and corrective maintenance SOP’s, schedules, and checklists.

● Provide site access to third party contractors and as directed.

● Attend internal and external training sessions as directed.

● Perform other tasks as directed.

● Provide daily leadership, mentoring, and training to direct reports in the defined area of operations.

● Schedule preventative and corrective maintenance work in the defined area of operations.

● Participate in regular update meetings with management, providing information and recommended actions for facilities inside the defined area of operations.

● Must be able to communicate effectively, collaboratively, and responsibly with team members and management.

● Must be able to work alone as a self-starter and work within a team driving towards a common goal.

● Must be able to stand for long periods of time.

● Must be able to work outside in most weather conditions.

● Must be able to lift 50 pounds.

Qualifications:

· Advanced skills with computers and electronic equipment required.

· Intermediate Microsoft Office and Adobe Acrobat required.

· Working knowledge of NEC, NFPA70E, and OSHA standards.

· Valid Driver’s License Required

· OSHA 30 (must be obtained within 4 weeks of employment)

· CPR/BLS (must be obtained within 4 weeks of employment)

· State electrical license or NABCEP certification desired

Education:

· High School Diploma or GED

Experience:

· Required experience includes PV solar operations and maintenance. Candidates must also have direct on-site management experience supporting NERC-regulated solar facilities of 100 MW or greater.

· 4+ years of experience in the electrical trade, electrical maintenance, multicraft maintenance, or the completion of a recognized apprenticeship program required.

· 1+ years of experience in utility scale solar PV operations and maintenance required.

· Experience with MV/HV systems, IT systems, inverters, T&D systems, substations, or other specialized electrical systems highly desired.

Our interview process:

A typical interview process at Silicon Ranch might include the below stages. Please note that we may make changes to these steps as needed, and details will be provided to you early on in the process.

• Introductory Interview with our recruiter

• Hiring Manager Interview to dive into technical skills and behavioral questions

• Panel Interview to assess cross-functional skills and dive deeper into technical skills

• Executive Interview to answer high-level questions about SRC and the team

jobs.title: Enterprise Sales Lead, Financial Services
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role
Banks, insurers, lenders, and wealth firms are all asking the same question: how do we move from chat-only to voice and AI agents without regulatory, brand, or operational blowback? You'll own our North America enterprise motion in financial services and be the person who answers it, with customers, partners, and the C-suite. This is a rare chance to join while the vertical is moving from pilots to production, with the mandate to build the playbook and the team.

In this role, you will:

 - Own the enterprise FinServ function across banking, insurance, lending/payments, and wealth: strategy, pipeline, forecast, process, execution

 - Define the enterprise ICP, sales methodology, and a repeatable motion for regulated buyers

 - Build and lead a high-performing enterprise sales team

 - Land anchor logos in legacy banks and insurers, then expand across business lines (this is an industry where one named logo opens doors with its peers)

 - Guide buyers through model-risk review, architecture review, and vendor security, bringing Risk, Compliance, and InfoSec in early

 - Help customers pick a narrow, high-volume first use case (servicing, caller verification, collections, claims, onboarding) and scale from there

 - Partner with our Forward Deployed Engineers, Product, Marketing, and Customer Success to co-build and share what the field teaches us

 - Lead executive briefings, events, and high-stakes negotiations

 - Bring a sharp view of the competitive landscape, including build-vs-buy and platform bundlers, to positioning and strategy

 - Set the bar for sales culture, integrity, and customer-first execution

Requirements:

 - Proven enterprise sales leadership in a high-growth, product-led tech company (AI/ML strongly preferred)

 - Track record selling to banks, insurers, or fintechs, and navigating Risk, Compliance, and InfoSec gatekeepers

 - Experience building and scaling sales teams from the ground up

 - Seven-figure enterprise deals and complex, multi-stakeholder cycles

 - Working knowledge of financial regulation and model-risk expectations (a plus)

 - Ability to be strategic and hands-on at once

 - Executive presence at C-suite and board levels

 - Collaborative, humble, and driven

 - Passion for the transformative potential of conversational AI

Location

This role is remote-first, so it can be executed from anywhere in the United States, however the ability to operate in EST, CST, or PST timezones is required. There is a preference for candidates to be based in New York or San Francisco, with the option to work out of our office.

jobs.title: Vice President of Medical Affairs
jobs.description:
Position Summary

The Vice President, Medical Affairs (VPMA) serves as the senior physician leader responsible for medical staff governance, physician professional practice standards, and regulatory oversight across Luminis Health. Reporting to the Executive Vice President & Chief Physician Executive (CPE), the VPMA provides leadership for credentialing, peer review, physician accountability, medical staff policy development, and accreditation readiness.

The VPMA partners closely with medical staff leadership, physician leaders, hospital administration, and legal/compliance teams to ensure fair, evidence-based, and consistent physician governance structures across the system. This role champions professional accountability, physician self-governance, clinical integrity, and compliance with regulatory and accreditation standards.

Operating within a highly collaborative environment, the VPMA strengthens medical staff alignment and consistency across employed and independent physicians while supporting uniform medical staff governance and care standards across Luminis Health.

The VPMA serves as a trusted physician leader who promotes professionalism, fairness, transparency, and physician engagement while preserving the integrity of medical staff governance processes.

Essential Functions & Responsibilities

1. Medical Staff Governance & Professional Standards

• Provide executive leadership for medical staff governance structures across the system.

• Oversee credentialing, privileging, peer review, physician conduct, and professional practice evaluation processes.

• Ensure consistency and integrity of medical staff bylaws, rules, regulations, and policies.

• Support medical staff leadership in advancing physician accountability and professional standards.

• Promote a culture of patient safety, quality improvement, evidence-based practice, and a uniform clinical approach across the medical staff.

• Promote and support efforts to advance IT into clinical care workflows in a standard fashion.

• Represent the organization and medical affairs function in key internal and external forums.

2. Regulatory & Accreditation Oversight

• Lead physician-related regulatory readiness and accreditation activities.

• Partner with Quality, Compliance, and Legal leadership to ensure adherence to CMS, Joint Commission, state, and specialty accreditation standards.

• Support organizational readiness for audits, surveys, and regulatory reviews.

• Monitor evolving regulatory requirements impacting physician practice and governance.

3. Peer Review & Physician Accountability

• Oversee fair, transparent, and effective peer review processes.

• Promote a culture of professionalism, accountability, and continuous improvement.

• Support physician performance management in collaboration with Department Chairs and medical staff leadership.

• Collaborate with quality, legal, risk, and human resources to ensure adherence to applicable laws, regulations, bylaws, and professional standards.

• Ensure appropriate follow-up and resolution of physician quality or conduct concerns.

4. Physician Leadership & Medical Staff Engagement

• Lead physician engagement efforts, including communication, conflict resolution, change management, and partnership-building across employed and independent members of the medical staff.

• Strengthen alignment and engagement across employed and independent physicians.

• Serve as a liaison between administration and organized medical staff leadership.

• Support physician leadership development and succession planning initiatives.

• Foster trust, collaboration, and physician engagement across the enterprise.

5. Enterprise Collaboration & Clinical Consistency

• Partner with the Chief Clinical Officer and Medical Group leadership to ensure alignment between governance structures and operational priorities.

• Support enterprise initiatives related to quality, patient safety, and clinical standardization.

• Advance system-wide consistency in physician governance and professional practice expectations.

Key Relationships

• Executive Vice President & Chief Physician Executive

• Chief Clinical Officer

• President, Luminis Health Medical Group

• Chief Legal Officer

• Chief Compliance Officer

• Department Chairs & Executive Medical Directors

• Vice President, Quality & Patient Safety

• Human Resources Leadership

Qualifications

Education & Certification

• MD or DO required.

• Completion of ACGME-accredited residency required.

• Current Board Certification required.

• Eligible for medical licensure in Maryland.

• Advanced degree such as MBA, MPH, MHA, or equivalent is strongly preferred.

Experience

• Minimum of 7–10 years of progressive physician leadership experience.

• Demonstrated experience in medical staff governance, credentialing, peer review, and physician leadership.

• Strong understanding of accreditation, regulatory, and compliance requirements.

• Experience working collaboratively with organized medical staff structures.

• Demonstrated ability to navigate sensitive physician relations and governance matters.

$325,000—$495,000 USD

•    Retirement Plan (with employer match for employees who work more than 1000 hours in a calendar year)
•    Paid Time Off

•    Paid Holidays, Disability, and Life/AD&D for full-time employees
•    Wellness Programs
•    Employee Assistance Programs and more
*Benefit offerings based on employment status

To enable this feature, select "yes" when asked to "opt-in to receive text messages" and to "Receive updates from a recruiter about this job via SMS" when completing your application. Once you are opted in, you can easily opt-out at any time.

jobs.title: Customer Service Specialist I – Order Entry
jobs.description:
Job Summary

The Customer Service Specialist I – Order Entry is an entry-level individual contributor responsible for accurately processing, validating, and maintaining customer orders while providing responsive support to customers, distributors, sales teams, and internal business partners. Working under general supervision and within established procedures, the role reviews orders received through electronic and manual channels, identifies discrepancies, coordinates routine resolutions, maintains complete records in ERP and CRM systems, and communicates order status and required actions. The role applies foundational customer service and order-management knowledge to resolve routine issues, escalates non-routine matters appropriately, develops proficiency in relevant systems and processes, and contributes to service quality, operational efficiency, and customer satisfaction. This position does not include formal people-management responsibility.

Responsibilities

• Receive, review, proofread, enter, and acknowledge customer purchase orders received through EDI, DCS, email, and manual-entry channels in accordance with established procedures and customer requirements.

• Validate customer, product, pricing, quantity, delivery, shipping, and account information to support accurate and timely order processing.

• Review system-generated reports and electronic order queues to identify errors, exceptions, duplicate orders, incomplete information, and other discrepancies requiring follow-up.

• Communicate order discrepancies, status updates, required actions, and routine process information clearly to customers, distributors, sales teams, and internal stakeholders.

• Coordinate with Product Management, Sales, Quotes, Accounting, Information Technology, Customer Service, Warehouse, and Logistics to resolve routine order-entry issues and meet customer commitments.

• Perform routine order maintenance, including schedule and quantity changes, cancellations, pricing requests, expedite requests, shipping updates, and order or inventory status inquiries.

• Document customer inquiries, order activity, decisions, and resolutions accurately in ERP, CRM, and related systems to maintain complete and reliable records.

• Maintain customer-specific order-processing requirements, item cross-reference data, and other assigned account information within established controls.

• Respond to routine customer and sales inquiries through phone, email, chat, and other approved channels, providing accurate information and timely follow-through.

• Support customer onboarding by gathering requirements, updating account information, coordinating assigned activities, and participating in customer discussions as requested.

• Resolve routine issues by applying established policies, procedures, and job knowledge; identify root causes when practical and escalate non-standard, high-risk, or complex matters to the appropriate resource.

• Meet established accuracy, service, productivity, quality, and training expectations while managing assigned priorities and deadlines.

• Develop working knowledge of products, customer requirements, business processes, policies, and systems through training, feedback, and on-the-job experience.

• Identify recurring issues and practical opportunities to improve order accuracy, customer experience, documentation, or workflow efficiency, and share recommendations with the appropriate stakeholder.

• Support team objectives, special projects, knowledge sharing, and other related duties as assigned.

Qualifications

• Associate degree in Business, Logistics, Supply Chain, or a related field and up to two years of customer service, order processing, administrative support, or related experience; an equivalent combination of education and relevant experience may be considered.

• Foundational understanding of customer service and order-processing practices, with the ability to learn company products, policies, customer requirements, and business processes.

• Strong attention to detail and business-math skills, with the ability to review data, identify discrepancies, and maintain accurate records.

• Effective written and verbal communication skills and the ability to interact professionally with customers and cross-functional partners.

• Organizational, time-management, and problem-solving skills, including the ability to prioritize routine work, meet deadlines, and adapt to changing business needs.

• Ability to follow established procedures, use sound judgment within defined parameters, accept feedback, and escalate matters requiring additional guidance.

• Ability to work independently on assigned activities and collaborate effectively as part of a team.

• Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, and Outlook, with the ability to learn and use ERP, CRM, EDI, and related order-management applications.

• Experience in a business-to-business customer service, order-entry, distribution, or manufacturing environment preferred.d

Essential Job Functions

• Must be able to work overtime.

• Must be able to sit for up to four hours at a time and up to eight hours in a workday.

• Must be able to use a computer keyboard and mouse to perform data entry and related order-processing activities.

• Must comply with company dress code guidelines.

• Punctuality and attendance must be maintained in accordance with company policies.

Perks & Benefits

Phoenix Contact offers a generous benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, 401k matching, and a generous time off package. There are also a wide variety of additional benefits available including 14 weeks fully paid maternity leave & 6 weeks fully paid paternity leave, life insurance, short & long-term disability, assistance, and more!

jobs.title: Executive Director, System Software Development
jobs.description:
Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is seeking an Executive Director, Systems Software Development to lead the strategy, development, delivery, quality, productivity, and lifecycle support of the systems software technologies that enable Toshiba's global retail hardware platforms. This executive leader will direct a global, multi-level engineering organization responsible for Linux, SKY, and Android operating system solutions; Open Systems drivers; device drivers and utilities; diagnostics; hardware SDKs; system images and preloads; and supporting technologies required across Toshiba's retail hardware portfolio.

The Executive Director will establish the technical and organizational strategy for Systems Software Development while ensuring predictable execution across new product development, software releases, customer deployments, and lifecycle support. A key expectation is to transform engineering productivity through automation, CI/CD, modern software development practices, and the full implementation and adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities throughout the software development lifecycle.

Qualifications:

• 15+ years of progressive software, systems software, embedded software, or related product development experience.

• 10+ years of technical and organizational leadership experience with increasing levels of responsibility.

• Minimum of 5 years of experience in an executive or senior executive engineering leadership role, including responsibility for managers, senior technical leaders, and complex development organizations.

• Significant experience leading geographically distributed engineering teams and organizations.

• Demonstrated experience delivering complex commercial software products through the complete development lifecycle.

• Strong technical understanding of operating systems, device drivers, hardware/software interfaces, diagnostics, SDKs, and system-level software.

• Experience leading software development requiring close integration between hardware and software.

• Demonstrated ability to establish technology strategy and translate strategy into executable product and engineering roadmaps.

• Proven experience driving measurable improvements in engineering productivity, development cycle time, quality, and speed of execution.

• Demonstrated experience implementing and scaling development automation, automated testing, DevOps, and CI/CD practices across a software engineering organization.

• Demonstrated experience leading implementation and organizational adoption of AI-enabled engineering capabilities beyond experimentation and into production engineering workflows.

• Proven ability to establish measurable AI adoption, productivity, quality, and execution objectives and drive results.

• Experience leading critical customer and field issue resolution across multiple technical and business organizations.

• Experience managing complex development portfolios involving competing priorities, resource constraints, and customer commitments.

• Proven ability to build, develop, and lead high-performing engineering organizations.

• Strong executive communication skills with experience presenting technical strategy, business tradeoffs, risks, investments, and recommendations to senior leadership.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline, or a Master of Business Administration (MBA).

• Executive leadership experience within a global technology, software, hardware, or product development organization.

• Experience developing commercial systems software for retail, Point-of-Sale, embedded, or edge-computing environments.

• Deep knowledge of Linux and Android operating system environments.

• Experience with proprietary or specialized operating system platforms.

• Experience developing and supporting device drivers, diagnostics, SDKs, utilities, and system images.

• Experience managing software across multiple hardware generations and extended product lifecycles.

• Knowledge of software security, vulnerability management, and secure development practices.

• Experience leading large-scale engineering transformation involving AI, automation, DevOps, CI/CD, test automation, and engineering productivity.

• Experience with Agile development, modern software engineering toolchains, configuration management, and automated build, test, and release environments.

• Experience managing global engineering organizations and external development partners.

• Experience supporting software platforms used by large enterprise customers operating business-critical systems.

Lead the Systems Software Development Organization

Provide executive leadership for a global engineering organization responsible for the development, integration, validation, release, and lifecycle support of:

• Linux, SKY, and Android operating system solutions

• Open Systems drivers and device drivers/utilities

• Hardware diagnostics

• Hardware Software Development Kits (SDKs)

• System images and preloads

• Supporting system software technologies required to enable Toshiba retail hardware platforms

Lead through multiple levels of management and technical leadership while establishing accountability for product delivery, software quality, engineering productivity, automation, technical excellence, and customer support.

Build organizational capability through workforce planning, talent development, succession planning, performance management, and strategic skills development.

Define Systems Software Strategy and Technical Direction

Establish and execute the long-term strategy and technology roadmap for Toshiba's Systems Software portfolio.

Partner with Hardware Architecture, Software Architecture, Product Management, and Development leaders to:

• Define future software platform strategies and roadmaps

• Establish operating system and platform direction

• Align hardware and software architectures

• Evaluate emerging technologies and industry trends

• Increase software reuse and common capabilities

• Reduce platform complexity and technical debt

• Establish lifecycle and migration strategies

• Ensure future hardware platforms can be efficiently enabled and supported across operating environments

Balance customer requirements, innovation, security, maintainability, productivity, development cost, and long-term support requirements when making platform decisions.

Drive Product Development and Predictable Execution

Provide executive oversight across the complete Systems Software development lifecycle, including:

• New product enablement

• Operating system releases

• Drivers and utilities development

• Diagnostics solutions

• SDK delivery

• System preloads

• Lifecycle releases

• Customer-specific software requirements

Establish planning, prioritization, resource management, and execution processes that deliver commitments with high levels of predictability, quality, productivity, and transparency.

Partner across Hardware and Software Development organizations to identify and mitigate technical and execution risks early.

Transform Engineering Productivity Through AI, Automation, and CI/CD

Provide executive ownership for the implementation, adoption, execution, and ongoing expansion of AI, automation, and CI/CD capabilities throughout Systems Software Development.

Drive practical AI implementation across:

• Software design and development

• Code generation and review

• Automated testing and test case generation

• Defect identification and root cause analysis

• Requirements management and documentation

• Knowledge management and engineering search

• CI/CD and DevOps workflows

• Engineering planning and estimation

• Customer and field issue resolution

• Repetitive engineering and administrative activities

Advance automation capabilities through:

• Automated build and integration processes

• Automated regression testing

• Validation and quality gate automation

• Configuration management automation

• Release process automation

Establish governance, security, intellectual property protection, development standards, and measurement practices for AI-enabled engineering.

Develop measurable objectives for AI adoption, automation, engineering productivity, software quality, development cycle time, throughput, and speed of execution.

Champion Software Quality and Customer Experience

Establish a strong engineering culture that emphasizes quality throughout the software development lifecycle.

Drive continuous improvement in:

• Software design and development practices

• Automated testing and defect prevention

• Release readiness

• Root cause analysis and corrective actions

• Software reliability and maintainability

• Field issue resolution

• Engineering quality and productivity metrics

Provide executive leadership for significant customer and field issues, ensuring rapid resolution, clear accountability, and permanent corrective action.

Leverage lessons learned from customer deployments and field issues to improve architecture, development, validation, automation, and release processes.

Drive Operational Excellence and Develop a High-Performing Global Organization

Establish a culture where engineering productivity, quality, and speed of execution are continuously measured and improved.

Utilize engineering metrics and KPIs to identify bottlenecks and improve:

• Development cycle time

• Automation coverage

• Test effectiveness

• Software quality

• Release performance

• Technical debt reduction

• Organizational throughput

Lead initiatives focused on:

• Leadership development and succession planning

• Technical, AI, and automation skills development

• Organizational design and workforce planning

• Global resource optimization

• Recruitment and retention of critical talent

• Development of managers and senior technical leaders

• Clear ownership and accountability

Promote collaboration across global engineering locations, encouraging innovation, technical excellence, accountability, knowledge sharing, and continuous learning.

Leads a highly complex global engineering organization responsible for systems software platforms supporting Toshiba's retail hardware portfolio. Balances product delivery, technology strategy, engineering transformation, AI adoption, workforce development, customer commitments, and operational excellence across multiple technologies, products, teams, and geographic regions.

Drives business value through improvements in engineering productivity, software quality, delivery efficiency, workforce optimization, technology investment effectiveness, reduced development costs, accelerated time-to-market, scalable revenue growth, and enhanced customer satisfaction.

Toshiba Global Commerce Solutions is a dynamic billion-dollar global company based in Research Triangle Park, NC, providing retail store solutions to your favorite brands.  Have you ever been in a hurry and made use of the self-checkout at Lowe’s Foods, earned fuel rewards at Kroger, or just paid for purchases at retailers such as Walmart, Michaels, Carrefour, The Gap, Calvin Klein, Boots, Cencosud, BJ’s, or Costco?  These are just a few examples of our in-store solutions and impressive customer base that made us the world's installed market share leader.

DIVERSITY, EQUITY & INCLUSION
