jobs.title: Future Special Education Teacher Opportunities
jobs.description:
Future Special Education Teacher Opportunities

Location: Philadelphia, PA

Compensation:  $55,000 - $88,000 (more details below)

Contact: jobs@hebrewpublic.org

About Hebrew Public

Hebrew Public is a small and growing network of schools operated by Hebrew Public: Charter Schools for Global Citizens. Hebrew Public is a secular organization that welcomes candidates of all backgrounds into a supportive and inclusive community.

Across the network, Hebrew Public schools serve children from all backgrounds and help students become global citizens who are strong problem solvers, aware communicators, and lifelong learners committed to making a positive difference in the world around them. Our schools are models of racial and economic integration, academic excellence, and world language learning.

Why PHP?

As part of Hebrew Public, Philadelphia Hebrew Public teachers and staff bring our mission to life with students from more than 40 zip codes across Philadelphia, primarily Black and Brown students whose brilliance, curiosity, and potential drive our work every day.

PHP is rooted in the belief that every student deserves excellent teachers and an outstanding education. Through rigorous academics, strong relationships, and a globally minded education, we help students expand what they see as possible for themselves.

We also invest in educators. Teachers receive coaching, collaborative planning, professional development, certification support, and opportunities to grow into leadership roles. Our compensation model recognizes teacher skill, growth, and classroom impact, not simply years of experience. After their first year, eligible teachers may qualify for 5% up to 10% annual salary increases based on their impact in the classroom, without needing additional graduate coursework.

For educators who want to make a meaningful difference while growing their own careers, PHP offers the opportunity to do both.

You don’t need to speak Hebrew to apply, and we strongly encourage candidates from traditionally underrepresented groups to join our community.

The Opportunity

We are always open to meeting skilled, student-centered educators who may be a strong fit for future Special Education Teacher opportunities. Philadelphia’s education community is a small world, and we value building relationships with excellent teachers, even when we do not have an immediate opening.

This evergreen talent-pipeline posting may not represent a current vacancy. Applications will be reviewed as staffing needs arise, and our Talent Team may contact candidates whose experience aligns with an available opportunity.

Special Education roles at PHP vary based on student needs. Teachers may provide push-in or pull-out services or lead a classroom serving students with moderate support needs. Across settings, Special Education Teachers deliver highly individualized instruction, implement IEPs, monitor student progress, and collaborate closely with families, general education teachers, service providers, and school leaders.

Teachers who lead classrooms for students with moderate support needs are also responsible for leading and supporting paraprofessionals, establishing clear roles and routines, providing ongoing guidance and feedback, and ensuring that instructional, behavioral, and individualized supports are implemented consistently.

What You’ll Do

• Deliver highly individualized, standards-aligned instruction based on each student’s strengths, needs, and IEP goals

• Provide push-in, pull-out, small-group, and/or specialized classroom instruction depending on the role

• Lead a classroom serving students with moderate support needs, when applicable

• Develop, implement, and monitor high-quality Individualized Education Programs (IEPs)

• Use assessment and progress-monitoring data to adjust instruction and accelerate student growth

• For moderate-needs classroom roles, lead and support paraprofessionals by setting clear expectations, coordinating student supports, and providing ongoing guidance and feedback

• Partner with general education teachers to adapt curriculum, instruction, accommodations, and classroom supports

• Maintain high expectations while creating a structured, inclusive, and supportive learning environment

• Support students’ academic, social-emotional, behavioral, and functional development

• Collaborate with families, related-service providers, teachers, and school leaders

• Maintain accurate documentation and meet special education timelines and compliance requirements

• Advocate for students and ensure they have meaningful access to rigorous learning experiences

• Participate in coaching, collaborative planning, professional development, and feedback

• Model our OLAM values: outstanding problem-solving, lifelong learning, aware communication, and making a difference

Who You Are

• You believe in the limitless potential of every student and that all children deserve excellent teachers and an outstanding education

• You are committed to urban education and closing opportunity and achievement gaps

• You hold a bachelor’s degree from an accredited institution

• You believe students with disabilities deserve rigorous, individualized, and inclusive learning experiences

• You understand differentiated instruction, accommodations, modifications, and evidence-based interventions

• You can design and deliver highly individualized instruction responsive to a wide range of student needs

• You use assessment and progress-monitoring data to make informed instructional decisions

• You can develop and implement meaningful, measurable IEP goals

• If leading a moderate-needs classroom, you are comfortable directing, coaching, and supporting paraprofessionals as part of a coordinated classroom team

• You build strong relationships with students and families while maintaining high expectations

• You welcome feedback and demonstrate the OLAM values in your work

Pennsylvania teacher certification in an applicable middle-level or subject area, or active progress toward certification, is preferred. Experience working with middle school students in urban school communities and familiarity with high-quality, standards-aligned instructional practices are also preferred.

Benefits

Potential benefits* include:

• Medical and dental coverage with 85% of premiums covered by the employer

• Employer-paid vision coverage

• A 5% employer retirement match with no vesting period

• Paid time off, school holidays, and 6 weeks paid parental leave

• Mental-health and employee-assistance resources

• Professional development and certification partnerships

• Additional stipends, performance-based compensation, and global travel opportunities

*Benefits packages vary depending on the role.

Our Commitment

We are committed to building a team that reflects the communities we serve. Candidates of color and those from backgrounds that are underrepresented in school leadership roles are strongly encouraged to apply.

If you need accommodations or assistance due to a disability, please reach out to us at jobs@hebrewpublic.org. This information will be treated as confidential and used only for the purpose of determining an appropriate accommodation for the interview process.

For more information please visit our websites below.

• CMO Website: www.hebrewpublic.org

• School Website: https://philadelphiahebrewpublic.org/

Apply today at jobs@hebrewpublic.org and join PHP, where you can make a lasting impact on students while growing your practice and your career.

jobs.title: Design Release Engineer, Range Extender Generator & Inverter
jobs.description:

But Scout is more than just a brand, it’s a legacy steeped in a culture of exploration, caretaking, and hard work.

The Scout brand is all about respect. Respect for the past and the future by taking an iconic American brand that hasn’t been around for a while, electrifying it, digitizing it, and loading it with American innovation. Respect for communities by creating a company that stands for its people and its customers. Respect for both work and play, with vehicles that are equally at home at a camp site, a job site, or on a Tuesday commute. And respect for our customers by developing two powertrains that meet their requirements — an all-electric powertrain as well as the Harvester™ range extender powertrain which includes a built-in gas-powered generator with an estimated 500 miles of combined range.

At Scout Motors, we empower our talented, inclusive, and entrepreneurial teams to innovate. What makes a Scout employee? Someone who is a visionary and a leader, who seeks new paths and shares lessons learned. A knowledgeable doer who collaborates across the company to build better. A go-getter with unrivaled passion.

Join us at Scout Motors and be part of shaping the future of transportation. If you're ready to drive change and make history, apply now!

What you’ll do

Become part of an iconic brand that is set to revolutionize the electric pick-up truck & rugged SUV marketplace by achieving the following:

• Own the range extender generator and inverter subsystem and ensure it meets program targets for packaging, cost, mass, and timing for the skateboard platform underpinning the Scout pick-up and SUV.

• Represent Scout Powertrain Engineering as the technical lead and liaison between engineering services contractors and Tier 1 suppliers of the range extender generator and inverter subsystem.

• Release 3D CAD and 2D drawings for the range extender generator and inverter assembly into Scout PLM systems.

• Collaborate with Powertrain Development & Validation colleagues to ensure that the range extender generator and inverter subsystem achieves technical requirements.

• Manage implementation of engineering changes as needed throughout development, and post-launch.

• Manage delivery of prototype hardware builds with Tier 1 suppliers to support on-time prototype testing and vehicle builds.

• Develop documentation necessary to scope work products for external engineering partners as needed.

• Lead and coordinate technical efforts between Scout and the component supply base.

Location & Travel Expectations:

• This role will be based out of the Scout Motors location in Novi, Michigan.

• This role requires 4-5 days per week in the office, with regular in-person meetings and events.

• Applicants should expect that the role will require the ability to convene with Scout colleagues in person and travel to participate in events on behalf of the company from time to time.

What you’ll bring

We expect all Scout employees to have integrity, curiosity, resourcefulness, and strive to exhibit a positive attitude, as well as a growth mindset. You’ll be comfortable with change and flexible in a fast-paced, high-growth environment. You’ll take a collaborative approach to achieve ambitious goals. Here's what else you'll bring:

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Engineering or Engineering Technology. (required)

• Strong Powertrain technical fundamentals, particularly for trucks and SUVs (required)

jobs.title: Multi-Site Data Center Operations Manager
jobs.description:
LightEdge Solutions is developing the IT solutions that will propel businesses forward over the next 10 years. Using a combination of shared and private/dedicated platforms, LightEdge has been successful in offering businesses alternatives that streamline operations, improve reliability and reduce costs.
If you are passionate about creating real solutions that help businesses with cutting-edge technology, want to be challenged to think out of the box and be in a position where you can impact change on a daily basis, then LightEdge can offer you a dynamic corporate environment built on teamwork and personal responsibility.

Position Summary
The Multi-Site Data Center Operations Manager leads Lightedge’s DCOPS technicians and daily operations across assigned third-party colocation sites. Based in Lewisville, Texas or St. Louis, MO this working manager combines direct, hands-on operational support with remote leadership of small teams or individual technicians in remote locations. The role travels regularly to provide onsite oversight, coaching, project support, and operational consistency.
The manager is accountable for Lightedge’s rack-level operations, customer deployment support, staffing, service quality, and incident response. The third-party colocation providers own and maintain facility infrastructure, including building electrical distribution, UPS systems, generators, cooling, and fire/life safety systems. This role coordinates with those providers regarding service delivery, planned maintenance, access, and incidents affecting Lightedge operations.
Key Responsibilities
Multi-Site Team Leadership
Manage DCOPS technicians across assigned sites, including locations staffed by a single technician; establish clear responsibilities, priorities, and performance expectations.
Coach and develop employees through regular individual meetings, onsite visits, skills assessments, cross-training, and performance reviews; support recruiting and onboarding.
Build staffing, scheduling, and coverage plans for normal operations, vacations, absences, projects, and incidents; coordinate backup support and provider remote-hands services where needed.
Plan regular site visits based on operational needs, staffing, risk, and project activity; maintain effective communication and accountability between visits.
Capacity planning, power/space utilization, and coordination across multiple teams.
Rack-Level Operations and Customer Support
Oversee and perform authorized installation, maintenance, troubleshooting, and removal of servers, network devices, storage equipment, rack PDUs, and associated cabling.
Coordinate rack layouts, equipment placement, cable management, labeling, asset inventory, and rack power and airflow practices within provider requirements and approved capacity limits.
Work with project managers, systems engineers, network teams, and customers to deliver deployments, migrations, upgrades, and decommissions accurately and on schedule.
Prioritize tickets and work orders; verify completion, documentation, and service quality, including work performed by provider remote-hands personnel.
Incident Response, On-Call, and Change Management
Participate as an active member of technician on-call rotation, including after-hours, weekend, and holiday response as scheduled; provide hands-on onsite support when required.
Coordinate operational incident response across assigned sites, including escalation, troubleshooting, provider engagement, stakeholder updates, and service restoration.
Review and approve operational changes within assigned authority; ensure clear methods of procedure, risk assessments, rollback plans, and compliance with change management requirements.
Document incidents, support root-cause reviews, and track corrective actions to completion; maintain current runbooks and escalation contacts.
Colocation Provider Coordination and Operational Controls
Serve as Lightedge’s primary operational contact for assigned colocation providers; coordinate access, deliveries, remote hands, maintenance notifications, and service escalations.
Review provider maintenance notices and assess potential effects on Lightedge services; coordinate internal readiness and follow up on provider incidents or service concerns.
Conduct site and rack inspections for organization, cabling, asset accuracy, access compliance, and adherence to procedures; maintain records supporting audits and customer requirements.
Maintain consistent operating procedures across sites; monitor ticket performance, deployment quality, incident trends, staffing coverage, and corrective actions.
Manage assigned operational budgets and expenses, including travel, supplies, and remote-hands services; identify practical cost and efficiency improvements.
Perform other duties consistent with the scope of the role.
Required Qualifications
6–8 years of relevant data center operations, colocation, or IT infrastructure experience, including experience leading technicians or operational teams.
Demonstrated ability to manage distributed staff, prioritize work across multiple locations, and support sites with limited local staffing.
Hands-on experience with server and network hardware, rack PDUs, structured cabling, equipment installations, inventory controls, and hardware troubleshooting.
Working knowledge of A/B rack power, rack capacity, airflow, physical access controls, and colocation operations sufficient to recognize issues and coordinate provider response.
Experience with ticketing systems, operational documentation, change management, incident response, and customer-facing service delivery.
Strong communication, organization, and judgment; ability to work independently and lead teams through time-sensitive operational issues.
Ability to work onsite in Lewisville, travel regularly to assigned locations, and fulfill scheduled on-call and after-hours responsibilities.
Preferred Qualifications
Experience managing multiple colocation sites and third-party providers; experience with remote-hands services, customer deployments, and compliance audits. An associate’s or bachelor’s degree in information technology, computer systems, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is preferred. Relevant technical or IT service management certifications are a plus.

jobs.title: Technical Lead - Laser Amplification (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
About Focused Energy

Focused Energy is an international deep-tech company based in Germany and the US, working to commercialize laser-driven nuclear fusion. Our mission is to provide clean, safe, and virtually unlimited energy to the world. We are rapidly scaling and looking for talented individuals who thrive in building clarity and structure within fast-growing environments.

Your Role

The laser amplification chain scales the beam energy needed by our fusion system. Developing it involves complex technical decisions, interdependent teams and requirements that evolve as the programme advances.

We are looking for a Technical Lead - Laser Amplification (f/m/d) to give this function clear direction and accountability. Your mission is to lead the amplification team, critically evaluate technical information and turn stakeholder input into decisions, priorities and a credible development roadmap. You will guide the function towards delivery of a subsystem that meets agreed requirements and can integrate with the wider laser system.

You do not need to be an expert in every amplifier technology. You do need strong engineering judgement, extensive technical leadership experience and enough laser understanding to ask the right questions, challenge assumptions and work effectively with domain specialists.



WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Lead and develop the function. Provide line management for technical teams, set clear expectations, give feedback and develop their capabilities. Build a view of the skills and capacity needed as the programme evolves, and contribute to hiring and team development.

 - Provide technical decisions and steering. Listen to different stakeholders, critically review their input and challenge assumptions. Work with specialists to assess options and make reasoned decisions, identifying where further evidence or expertise is needed.

 - Own the development roadmap. Translate system requirements and programme priorities into a function-level plan that goes beyond individual task lists. Establish milestones, identify dependencies and capability gaps, and adapt the plan as requirements and evidence change.

 - Guide complex project delivery. Lead larger technical projects through uncertainty. Keep priorities, resources, risks and trade-offs visible, coordinate with programme management and lab operations, and escalate issues early.

 - Connect amplification to the wider system. Take accountability for the amplification architecture, requirements and interfaces, drawing on the team's specialist expertise. Coordinate with adjacent laser functions and system integration so technical decisions support agreed performance and integration needs.
   


WHO YOU ARE

 - You have some laser exposure and a general understanding of amplification. You have enough relevant background to understand the function, engage with specialists and assess how its decisions affect the wider system. Direct hands-on amplifier development is an advantage, not a prerequisite.

 - Extensive technical leadership experience. You have led technical teams and larger, complex engineering projects, with responsibility for people, priorities and delivery. You can develop specialists and provide direction across disciplines.

 - Strong engineering judgement. You can evaluate technical arguments, distinguish assumptions from evidence, identify risks and challenge recommendations constructively. You do not need to know every answer yourself, but you know how to reach a sound decision with the right experts.

 - Experience leading through uncertainty. You have worked on development programmes with incomplete information, evolving requirements or changing technical priorities. You can maintain direction while adapting plans as new evidence emerges.

 - People and stakeholder leadership. You listen carefully, reconcile different perspectives, communicate decisions clearly and remain close to the team. Your leadership experience includes line management and developing technical colleagues, not only coordinating schedules.

 - Your background may be in laser systems, photonics, optical systems or a broader complex-engineering programme that includes relevant laser work. Your current title is less important than the scope of technical and people leadership you have exercised.
   
   
   
   NICE TO HAVE

 - Direct experience developing laser amplifiers or high-energy/high-power laser systems.

 - Familiarity with solid-state, fibre or diode-pumped amplification, CPA/OPCPA, or relevant pulsed and ultrafast systems.

 - Systems engineering, requirements traceability, technology-maturity planning and subsystem integration.

 - Industrialisation, supplier coordination, budget and resource planning, or design for cost and manufacture.

 - Experience in fusion, a high-power laser facility or a defence laser programme.

 - A PhD or equivalent depth of experience in physics, photonics or a related engineering discipline.
   



WHY WORK WITH US?

 - Innovative Technology & Mission: Be part of a cutting-edge company working on groundbreaking research in clean energy and scientific discovery.

 - Career Development: We invest in our people. This is an opportunity to join an early, growing company at the forefront of new technology, where you’ll have the opportunity to develop and grow your career.

 - Collaborative Culture: Work with great people in a dynamic, international environment with top-tier scientists, engineers, and professionals passionate about solving global challenges.

 - Ownership: Take ownership from day 1 and drive impact by making decisions, solving challenges, and shaping the future of our company.

 - Your Success is our Success: We offer a competitive salary and company ownership in the form of stock options, giving you a direct stake in our success and ownership in what we build together.

 - Vacation Days: We support your work-life balance by granting you 30 days of vacation per year.

 - Flexibility: Work should fit around your life, not the other way around. We offer the ability to work from our office, but some flexibility to work from home as well.

 - Snacks and Drinks: Our office fridges are never empty. Enjoy our healthy snacks and drinks. Our Darmstadt office even offers a canteen with delicious lunch options daily.

 - Retirement Plan: If you decide on a private pension plan, we will finance 20% on top of your monthly contributions, plus loyalty incentives.

 - Events: We organize regular events to foster team bonding, encourage collaboration, and build a strong, supportive company culture. Connect with colleagues across departments, share ideas, and have fun together, both in and outside of the workplace.

 


Focused Energy is an equal opportunity employer committed to creating an inclusive environment. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status.

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer, Agentic Discovery
jobs.description:
About Us

At Cloudflare, we are on a mission to help build a better Internet. Today the company runs one of the world’s largest networks that powers millions of websites and other Internet properties for customers ranging from individual bloggers to SMBs to Fortune 500 companies. Cloudflare protects and accelerates any Internet application online without adding hardware, installing software, or changing a line of code. Internet properties powered by Cloudflare all have web traffic routed through its intelligent global network, which gets smarter with every request. As a result, they see significant improvement in performance and a decrease in spam and other attacks. Cloudflare was named to Entrepreneur Magazine’s Top Company Cultures list and ranked among the World’s Most Innovative Companies by Fast Company.

At Cloudflare, we’re not looking for people who wait for a polished roadmap; we’re looking for the builders who see the cracks in the Internet that everyone else has simply learned to live with. We value candidates who have the instinct to spot a "normalized" problem and the AI-native curiosity to create a solution using the latest tools. Our culture is built on iteration, leveraging AI to ship faster today to make it better tomorrow, while ensuring that every improvement, no matter how small, is shared across the team to lift everyone up. If you’re the type of person who values curiosity over bureaucracy, and that AI is a partner in solving tough problems to keep the Internet moving forward, you’ll fit right in.

Available Locations: Lisbon, or London (Hybrid)

About the Department

Emerging Technologies & Incubation (ETI) is where new and bold products are built and released within Cloudflare. Rather than being constrained by the structures which make Cloudflare a hugely successful business, we are able to leverage them to deliver entirely new tools and products to our customers. Cloudflare’s edge and network make it possible to solve problems at massive scale and efficiency which would be impossible for almost any other organization.

About the Team

We build the products that enable the next era of the Internet: making domains Readable, Discoverable, and Callable for autonomous AI agents.

Here at Cloudflare, agentic discovery is a core part of our vision for the Agentic Internet. As AI agents change how humans and machines find, evaluate, and act on information, businesses need tools to control how they are represented and reached. We build capabilities that enable website owners to prepare their sites for agent interaction, test and observe how agents read their content, establish open interaction standards (like WebMCP and MCP), and create entirely new channels to reach agentic audiences.

We are a cross functional group that communicates and collaborates regularly. We celebrate our achievements, support each other when we make mistakes, and hold each other and our work to a high standard.

About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer to serve as a technical anchor and become a subject matter expert on our Agentic Discovery team. In this role, you will define the architecture, core protocols, and multi-team standards powering the next generation of agent-web interactions.

As a senior technical leader, you will shape product roadmaps, mentor engineers across Cloudflare, and write technical specifications that drive execution across multiple teams. You will drive engineering excellence across edge infrastructure, data pipelines, protocol layers, and developer tooling, ensuring systems are resilient and complexity is reduced for your peers.

What You'll Do

• Architect and ship high-throughput, resilient production services that make web properties Readable (structured content transformation), Discoverable (indexing and AEO), and Callable (WebMCP, tool-calling APIs, Generative UI) for autonomous agents.

• Define emerging agent protocols and integrations (MCP, MCP Apps, UCP, MPP, WebMCP). Author architectural specifications and technical designs that guide engineering work both within and outside the ETI team.

• Partner directly with Product Management, customers and stakeholders to translate customer needs into technical requirements, clarify KPIs, and shape engineering roadmaps.

• Drive improvements in system health and observability. Lead complex incident responses, conduct post-incident retrospectives, and rearchitect systems to eliminate failure modes and minimize customer-escalation issues.

• Elevate the engineering process across Cloudflare through code reviews, technical mentorship, architectural governance, and candidate evaluation for engineering hiring.

Desirable Skills, Knowledge, and Experience

• Experience designing scalable system architecture and setting performance metrics in a distributed environment.

• Experience writing technical specifications and leading cross-functional technical initiatives to completion.

• Deep understanding of HTTP, APIs, proxies, caching, web security, and performance bottlenecks spanning multi-service architectures.

• Hands-on experience and deep conceptual understanding of AI agents, tool calling, Model Context Protocol (MCP), or agent harnesses.

• Ability to partner with product managers and customers to navigate ambiguous problem spaces and iteratively deliver large-scale architecture.

• Experience mentoring junior and mid-level engineers, contributing to hiring, and driving improvements to engineering processes and incident response workflows.

Bonus Points

• Fluency in async Rust or TypeScript/JavaScript edge runtimes (e.g., Cloudflare Workers) at scale.

• Active contributions to or leadership in open-source agent frameworks, protocols (e.g., MCP), web standards bodies, browser engines, or network proxies.

• Track record of resolving complex, multi-team production incidents and driving post-mortem recommendations to completion.

• Background in search engines, Answer Engine Optimization (AEO), web crawling at scale, or RAG platform engineering.

• Expertise in cryptographic protocols (public-key encryption, digital signatures) or privacy-preserving web architectures.

Compensation

Compensation may be adjusted depending on work location.

● For Portugal based hires: Estimated annual salary is between €66,000 - €91,000.

• The final offer will be inclusive of time exemption, in alignment with the applicable law and collective bargaining agreements.

Equity

This role is eligible to participate in Cloudflare’s equity plan.

What Makes Cloudflare Special?

We’re not just a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company. We’re a highly ambitious, large-scale technology company with a soul. Fundamental to our mission to help build a better Internet is protecting the free and open Internet.

Project Galileo: Since 2014, we've equipped more than 2,400 journalism and civil society organizations in 111 countries with powerful tools to defend themselves against attacks that would otherwise censor their work, technology already used by Cloudflare’s enterprise customers--at no cost.

Athenian Project: In 2017, we created the Athenian Project to ensure that state and local governments have the highest level of protection and reliability for free, so that their constituents have access to election information and voter registration. Since the project, we've provided services to more than 425 local government election websites in 33 states.

1.1.1.1: We released 1.1.1.1 to help fix the foundation of the Internet by building a faster, more secure and privacy-centric public DNS resolver. This is available publicly for everyone to use - it is the first consumer-focused service Cloudflare has ever released. Here’s the deal - we don’t store client IP addresses never, ever. jobs.title: Trade Surveillance Analyst
jobs.description:
About the Company

Sei Labs is a unicorn startup based in NYC building Sei, the fastest EVM blockchain in the world designed for trading. We're building a decentralized Wall Street. We're a lean, remote-first team that ships fast, takes full ownership of outcomes and builds from first principles.

Sei Labs is incubating a new US regulated exchange from zero to one. You'd be one of the first hires in your function, with the speed and ownership of a startup and the backing of an established company and an S-tier team (Robinhood, Coinbase, Google, etc.)

About the role

As our first trading Surveillance Analyst, you will be a founding member of the DCM's market regulation function. You will monitor trading activity on the exchange, investigate alerts, and help build the surveillance program, procedures and tooling we launch with. This role starts hands-on and detail-heavy. As the exchange goes live and the team grows, there is a clear path to more complex investigations and team leadership.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Monitor real-time and post-trade activity for potential manipulation, fraud and disruptive trading practices (spoofing, layering, wash trading, pre-arranged trading, position-limit breaches and similar).

 - Triage and investigate alerts in our surveillance platform: reconstruct orders and trades, decide whether an alert is an error, a false positive or a potential violation, and document the reasoning clearly.

 - Run participant inquiry workflows, including broker explanation requests, and work directly with FCMs and clearing members to gather information and resolve cases.

 - Escalate potential rule violations and prepare well-documented case files for review, enforcement and regulatory inquiries, under the direction of the head of trade surveillance and/or market regulation.

 - Help design our case-management flow, alert tuning and automation so the program scales as volume grows.

 - Contribute to written surveillance procedures and DCM Core Principle readiness ahead of launch.

 - Ownhigh-volume first-line alert review, and earn broader investigative ownership as the function grows.

 - Participate in coverage for a 24/7 market, which may include scheduled weekend or off-hours rotations.


WHAT YOU BRING

 - 2–5+ years in trade or market surveillance at an exchange or regulator (e.g., DCM, national securities exchage, CFTC, SEC, NFA, or FINRA) strongly preferred; trading compliance experience at an FCM, broker-dealer, or trading firm strongly considered.

 - Hands-on experience investigating surveillance alerts, ideally in Nasdaq SMARTS or a comparable platform (Eventus Validus, TT Score, NICE Actimize, Solidus, b-next).

 - Working knowledge of manipulative and disruptive trading patterns and how to evidence them.

 - Experience with digital assets and digital assets investigations, as well as traditional financial instruments and futures or other derivatives, including on-chain analysis and forensic tracing of wallets and fund flows using tools such as Chainalysis, TRM Labs, or Elliptic..

 - Clear, professional written and verbal communication. You will deal directly with external FCMs and clearing members.

 - Strong attention to detail and disciplined documentation habits.

 - Comfort with ambiguity, shifting priorities and building process where none exists yet.

 - Ability to work from approved security devices and environments, and to comply with information barrier, conflict-of-interest, and personal trading policies, including restrictions on trading in markets we surveil.


NICE TO HAVE

 - SQL, Python or other data tooling for analysis and automating repetitive surveillance work.

 - Experience with 24/7 markets, or crypto derivatives.

 - Exposure to CFTC/NFA regulation, DCM Core Principles or rule-enforcement reviews.

 - Interest in growing into a team lead or manager role as the function scales.

jobs.title: Customer Experience Coordinator (Part-Time) - Brookfield, WI
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say YES and put pets and customers experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online

• Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly

• Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs

• Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate

• Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience.

• Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions

• Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information.

• Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships

• Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

WHAT YOU NEED

• 2+ years of experience in a customer service role

• Advanced proficiency in computer programs and practice management software

• Highly organized, with strong attention to detail

• Strong communication skills; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone

• The ability to multitask and thrive amid chaos

• High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly

• Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments

• Problem solving skills and a focus on innovation

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• A BIG focus on learning and growth from VEG-created clinical and leadership programs to Unlimited ER CE + travel stipend (No really!). Part-time credentialed VEGgies receive a $1,000/year travel stipend. Part-time uncredentialed VEGgies receive a $400/year travel stipend.

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, and food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Quality Improvement Lead
jobs.description:
Join Riverside Natural Foods Ltd., a Canadian-based, family-owned, and globally operating business, committed to leaving the world better than we found it. As a B-Corp certified, Triple-Bottom Line company, we proudly manufacture nutritious, 'better-for-you' snacks such as MadeGood and GOOD TO GO. We value teamwork, humility, respect, ownership, adaptability, grit, and fun.

We’re on an ambitious mission to double our business by 2030, and we need talented individuals like you to help us reach new heights. At Riverside, you’ll have the opportunity to chart your own path to success while contributing to ours. We believe anything worth doing is worth doing right, and our values will guide us through the rugged terrain – and yes, it will get rough. But that’s what makes the journey worthwhile.

So, lace up your boots and let’s tackle the climb together.

You can learn more about us at www.riversidenaturalfoods.com.

Position Summary/Objective:

The position ensures successful continues improvement of Riverside’s Food Safety and Quality Assurance System by providing leadership through strong knowledge and experience of managing food safety and quality incidents, conducting root cause analysis, risk assessment, CAPA program and meeting the food safety and quality targets. You will be responsible for initiatives to enhance the food safety and quality performance of products and processes within Riverside Natural Food Ltd. They are passionate about Riverside’s values and purpose, solving problems, food safety, quality (delighting our consumers) and always lead with a continuous improvement mindset.

Primary Responsibilities:

• Demonstrate and uphold Riverside Natural Food’s core values

• Manage (lead investigations, root cause analysis -RCA, collect or identify data that needs to be collected, etc.) food safety and Quality Incidents including consumer and customer complaints, product holds, internal non-conformances to ensure product safety and quality

• Take the OWNERSHIP on leading investigation and root cause analysis to identify possible issues affecting food safety and quality of the products and processes, place necessary products on hold in SAP systems

• Review and analyze data from food safety records and quality verification checks to identify trends and areas for improvement and implement corrective action

• Lead cross-functional teams in identifying opportunities for food safety and quality improvement by addressing root cause of issues, writing incident reports, and ensuring comprehensive action plans are implemented and completed to prevent future issues

• TEAMWORK and work closely with Production, Sanitation, Maintenance, Engineering, Facility, R&D and other relevant departments to implement and sustain food safety and quality improvement initiatives

• Ensure consistent execution of current Food Safety and Quality Management Programs, internal procedures and compliance with BRC requirements

• Establish, develop, implement and monitor food safety and quality improvement strategies, plans and KPIs aligned with organizational goals. Communicate and report improvement, progress and results to stakeholders to measure success

• Use statistical methods, data analysis and sampling plans to track and monitor product and process performances and capabilities affecting safety and quality and reduce defects and minimize inconsistencies. Identify upper and lower specifications limits to build run charts to monitor CTQs and CTPs. Understand the process to create and implement control charts for existing and new products working with R&D and production team.

• Develop, update, and implement improvement policies and procedures and Food safety and quality plan

• Identify training opportunities, train the trainer and ensure employees are trained in food safety and quality improvement methodologies and tools such as root cause and hazard analysis, risk assessment, corrective and preventive action development.

• Promote a culture of excellence and improvement awareness across the organization

• Develop innovative solutions to food safety and quality related issues and provide improvement reports on the status improvement projects to senior leadership.

• Keeps the work atmosphere FUN by keeping it light and welcoming

• Other duties, as assigned to support the execution of FSQA programs.

Reporting Relationship:

Reports directly to the plant FSQA Leader. Plant FSQA leaders report to corporate. There are no direct reports.

Education & Qualifications:

• or Diploma in Engineering, Food Science and technology, Chemistry, Microbiology, pharmaceutical and other related disciplines

• A minimum of 3 years of FSQA experience in food manufacturing and relevant food safety and quality programs in similar roles (Quality improvement, continues improvement, process improvement).

• Experience with highly automated food manufacturing lines for continues and batch processes.

• Strong understanding of hazards analysis, HACCP, GMPs, FM prevention, microbiology, pest control and other food safety related programs

• A minimum Lean Six Sigma- Green belt certification and experience in QI (quality improvement) focused environment. Demonstrated application on actual projects on production sites.

• Strong understanding of statistics, product sampling standards/programs and SPC and experience in SPC technologies such as Minitab

• Understanding and knowledge of commercialization processes, food safety and quality attributes and its impact

• Experience in investigation process, root cause analysis methodologies and corrective action plans (CAPA)

Skills & Abilities:

• Ability to be persuasive, assertive while also being collaborative with diverse TEAMS.

• Exceptional time management, organizational and implementation skills.

• Self-starter with a high level of initiative and ADAPTABILITY

• Strong interpersonal and communication skills with follow-through

• Analytical, with problem-identification and problem-solving capabilities, detail oriented.

• PASSIONATE and curious individuals with a positive attitude and desire to learn and

• Aptitude to exhibit, RESPECT and protect Riverside’s Core Values in a rapidly changing

Job Scorecard FSQA Improvement Leader

Purpose of the role:

The position ensures successful continues improvement of Riverside’s Food Safety and Quality Assurance System by providing leadership through strong knowledge and experience of managing food safety and quality incidents, investigation, conducting root cause analysis, risk assessment, CAPA program and meeting the food safety and quality targets. Lead initiatives to enhance the food safety and quality performance of products and processes and solve problems always with a continuous improvement mindset to meet and exceed consumer expectations and food safety requirements.

Key Accountabilities

Responsibility

Drive Continuous Improvement

·        CAPA effectiveness rate: by measuring CAPA closure and recurrence rate

·        % Reduction in NCRs (Cases or Kg on hold)

·        Develop process mapping for one line per year and map out CTP- centerlines and CTQs

Competencies for Success in the Role:

5.      Drives Results

Consistently achieving results, even under tough circumstances.

6.      Balances Stakeholders

Talented Definition:

7.      Directs Work

4.      Provides appropriate guidance and direction based on people’s capabilities.

Key Riverside Functional Competencies needed to be successful in this role:

Functional Competencies

Definition

Food Safety and Quality compliance

Demonstrated knowledge and hands-on experience in Food Safety and Quality specifically in continues improvement and process improvement. In-depth knowledge of Non-conformance and CAPA processes. Strong understanding of HACCP principles, GFSI standards- BRC, GMPs, FM prevention, microbiology, pest control and SPC

·        Perform risk assessment and analyze its impact

Food manufacturing knowledge with highly automated food manufacturing lines for continues and batch processes

·        Establish, develop, implement and monitor food safety and quality improvement strategies, plans and KPIs aligned with organizational goals.  Report improvement, progress and results to stakeholders to measure success

Training Delivery

·        Identify training opportunities

·        Train the trainer and ensure employees are trained in food safety and quality improvement methodologies and tools such as root cause and hazard analysis, risk assessment, corrective and preventive action development.

·        Share learning and best practices

Please note this role is an existing vacancy.

Salary Range

$70,000—$85,000 CAD

At Riverside, we are committed to transparency and fairness in our compensation and job posting practices. The range above reflects the target compensation for the position at the time of posting. Exact compensation will be determined based on experience, skill set, education, and training, as well as other organizational needs, while balancing internal equity.

What we expect:

• Values-led: You’ll be a member of a thoughtful and compassionate team that prioritizes respect, teamwork and resourcefulness along with a good dash of fun. Sometimes, even making granola bars is hard, and life’s too short to take ourselves so seriously that we don’t enjoy the journey.

• Unparalleled experiences and opportunities: We’re still determining who we are and what we can be. Help us shape what this organization will look like and what we’ll offer the world, into the future. This means rolling up your sleeves and sometimes building the process – fast! – while employing it. At Riverside, progress occasionally means proceeding imperfectly, and we’re okay with that, as long as we’re staying true to our values and learning and improving along the way.

• Access to everyone: We’re a flat organization with few silos which means you’ll have full access to everyone from our founders to our production staff. Even when employees dress up, they wear steel-toed shoes. So don’t be shy. Speak up, share your ideas and go places you normally wouldn’t – like the plant, or the boardroom.

• Personal development: We’ll support and empower you to chart your own path and reach any heights you set for yourself. Career paths at Riverside are carved by the people walking on them, not dictated by leaders. Count on us to give you the training and tools to grow and progress.

• Gratitude: As a growing business, we can’t always offer formal recognition like awards programs, but we do show our true gratitude and appreciation. At Riverside, we’re all in this together and we value you.

• Be a Riverside Brand Ambassador: Stay relentlessly close to our consumers and represent the brand in every interaction, decision, and deliverable. Bring the consumer voice into your work by protecting product quality, availability, and experience, acting early when standards slip, and delivering consistent value that earns trust, advocacy, and long-term brand love.

What We Offer:

• Values-led: We don’t cut corners or step on anyone or anything on our way to our summit. There is no winning at all costs here. Every step you take must align with our values, no compromises.

• Courageous determination: As a family-run, rapidly growing business, we are often challenged to find ways to deliver that aren’t obvious or easy. You must be willing to try, ask and answer challenging questions, test and learn, turn over every stone, keep moving forward and help us find a way through. Resourcefulness and grit will be your constant companions at Riverside and will serve you well.

• Humility: We’re a small (but growing) fish in a sea of whales and sharks. We know the products we offer are some of the healthiest and most sustainable, but we don’t brag about it, and know we have a steep path ahead. We pride ourselves in being respectful and supportive of others while shining brightly through our innovative, high-quality products. There isn’t one superstar at Riverside. We take turns leading the way as we climb to the summit.

• Continuous improvement: As a learn-as-we-go organization, we rely on each other to continuously improve everything we touch to make it better, more efficient, more sustainable, and more endearing to customers, consumers, employees, vendors, partners and the community. We own our mistakes and learn from them as we wind our way to the top.

Wait! There’s more!

• Immerse yourself in our comprehensive benefits program, with Riverside taking care of the costs!

• RRSP matching or 401k matching for an empowered financial journey

• Eligibility to participate in Riverside's Profit Sharing Plan

• Join Employee-Led Resource Groups (ERGs) championing mental health, sustainability, diversity, women, and LGBTQ+ rights

• Develop your career further through our Riverside University program and with our Tuition Reimbursement Program

• An open concept work environment that embodies our Values

How to Apply:

If you have the commitment to excellence, the energy, the attitude and experience we need, then please submit your resume to careers(AT)riversidenaturals.com with the job title you are applying for in the subject line or click the apply button!

Westside Surgical Center is an ambulatory surgery center located in Cincinnati, Ohio. With two operating rooms, and four procedure rooms, the center provides high-quality, cost-effective outpatient procedural care primarily for GI, Endoscopies, and Ophthalmologic care.

Owned and operated in partnership with BSMH, Gastro Health, and Compass Surgical Partners, the Westside Center combines advanced technology with compassionate, patient-centered care in a convenient setting.

jobs.title: Director, Statistical Programming
jobs.description:
About Summit:

Summit Therapeutics Inc. is a biopharmaceutical oncology company with a mission focused on improving quality of life, increasing potential duration of life, and resolving serious unmet medical needs. At Summit, we believe in building a team of world class professionals who are passionate about this mission, and it is our people who drive this mission to reality. Summit’s core values include integrity, passion for excellence, purposeful urgency, collaboration, and our commitment to people. Our employees are truly the heart and soul of our culture, and they are invaluable in shaping our journey toward excellence.

Summit’s team is inspired to touch and help change lives through Summit’s clinical studies in the field of oncology. Summit has multiple global Phase 3 clinical studies, including:

Non-small Cell Lung Cancer (NSCLC)

• HARMONi: Phase 3 clinical study which was intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to placebo plus chemotherapy in patients with EGFR-mutated, locally advanced or metastatic non-squamous NSCLC who were previously treated with a 3rd generation EGFR TKI.

• HARMONi-3: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab combined with chemotherapy compared to pembrolizumab combined with chemotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

• HARMONi-7: Phase 3 clinical study which is intended to evaluate ivonescimab monotherapy compared to pembrolizumab monotherapy in patients with first-line metastatic NSCLC.

Colorectal Cancer (CRC)

• HARMONi-GI3: Phase 3 clinical study intended to evaluate ivonescimab in combination with chemotherapy compared with bevacizumab plus chemotherapy.

Ivonescimab is an investigational therapy not presently approved by any regulatory authority other than China’s National Medical Products Administration (NMPA). Summit is headquartered in Miami, Florida, and has additional offices in California, New Jersey, the UK, and Ireland.

Overview of Role:

The Director of Statistical Programming oversees managing statistical programming projects and creating strategic plans related to clinical trials and medical affairs publications. They lead the team in developing, maintaining, validating and running SAS programs that analyze and report clinical trial data, following statistical analysis plans, ICH guidelines and regulatory requirements. They are responsible for the structure of the statistical programming function and representing the function in cross-functional activities, particularly in regard to data collection, analysis, and integration of clinical trial data and real-world evidence.

​Role and Responsibilities:

• Provides technical and/or operational leadership in the delivery of high quality and timely statistical programming for clinical studies, drug programs, and/or in support of NDA submissions.

• Works closely with Biostatistics to implement statistical analysis of clinical trial data, working closely on the development and validation of ADaM specifications and datasets, and TLFs for analyses to support regulatory, medical affairs, and market access needs.

• Works closely with Data Management on cross-functional data review and the development and validation of CDISC SDTM specifications and datasets and define packages, may also support Drug Safety to support safety data review and reporting needs, and/or Clinical Pharmacology to support their dataset creation and analytic needs.

• Manages internal and vendor statistical programming support; Maintains strong collaboration and governance with preferred vendors.

• Writes SAS programs that produce or validate tables, listings, figures, and analysis datasets, in support of clinical studies or complex integrated analyses for submission.

• Performs, plans, and coordinates project work to ensure timely, quality delivery across multiple projects, or across a drug program.

• Writes specifications to describe programming needs, including development and maintenance of complex / ADaM specifications and reviewer guides.

• May lead the creation and validation of global macros or systems that streamline repetitive operations to increase programming efficiency.

• Provides input into, or leads general standardization efforts (e.g., CRFs, query checks, standard statistical programs, data presentations).

• Leads efforts to develop programming processes consistent with industry best practices.

• Reviews and provides expert input to DMP, eCRF specs, and other clinical data management documents; Reviews and provides expert input to statistical analysis plans and other related documents.

• Partners with or oversees CROs or Programming vendors to perform any of the above tasks.

Experience, Education and Specialized Knowledge and Skills:

• PhD with 8+ years of experience or MS with 11+ years of experience in statistics or biostatistics or related disciplines with clinical trials, pharmaceutical/biotech industry, or healthcare experience

• Experience in supporting oncology phase II/III clinical studies

• Experience in organizing and driving regulatory submissions (e.g. NDA, sNDA, BLA)

• In-depth knowledge of CDISC standards

• Technical expertise and knowledge of experimental design and analyses using SAS, R, or EAST, and etc.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Good working knowledge of ICH, FDA and GCP regulations and guidelines

• Proficient user of standard MS Office suite (e.g., Word, Excel), experience using electronic document management systems, and document review tools desirable

• Strong computer and database skills

• Attention to detail, accuracy and confidentiality

• Clear and concise oral and written communication skills

• Excellent organizational skills

• Critical thinking, problem solving, ability to work independently.

• Must be able to effectively multi-task and manage time-sensitive and highly confidential documents.

• Communicate effectively and articulate complex ideas in an easily understandable way

• Prioritize conflicting demands.

• Work in a fast-paced, demanding and collaborative environment

This is the pay for this position

Pay Transparency

$203,000—$253,000 USD

Actual compensation packages are based on several factors that are unique to each candidate, including but not limited to skill set, depth of experience, certifications, and specific work location. This may be different in other locations due to differences in the cost of labor. jobs.description:
Who we are

DigiCert is a global leader in intelligent trust. We protect the digital world by ensuring the security, privacy, and authenticity of every interaction. Our AI-powered DigiCert ONE platform unifies PKI, DNS, and certificate lifecycle management, to secure infrastructure, software, devices, messages, AI content and agents. Job summary

DigiCert is seeking a Senior Manager, Revenue and Billing Assurance to lead the operational governance, accuracy, and control of our global revenue and billing processes.

Reporting to the Corporate Controller, you will help ensure that customer contracts are translated accurately into billing and financial systems, invoices are complete and timely, revenue-related transactions are properly supported, and potential revenue leakage is identified and resolved. You will work closely with Revenue Accounting, Sales, Deal Desk, Order Management, Accounts Receivable, Customer Success, Legal, Finance Systems, and other cross-functional teams. The successful candidate will combine strong quote-to-cash experience with financial discipline, operational leadership, and a continuous-improvement mindset.

What you will do

• Lead DigiCert's global revenue and billing assurance function, establishing clear ownership, controls, service levels, and performance expectations.

• Develop and maintain an end-to-end assurance framework covering contract setup, order booking, billing, credits, rebates, renewals, amendments, cancellations, and other revenue-impacting transactions.

• Partner with Finance Systems and IT to improve the integration of CRM, CPQ, contract-management, billing, marketplace, and ERP platforms.

• Lead user-acceptance testing and operational-readiness activities for system implementations, product launches, pricing changes, and new commercial models.

• Support acquisitions and business integrations by standardizing revenue and billing processes, controls, data, and reporting.

• Review complex and nonstandard customer arrangements to identify billing, operational, and financial-reporting implications before transactions are booked.

• Ensure invoices are accurate, complete, timely, and consistent with contractual terms and approved commercial arrangements.

• Partner with Revenue Accounting to ensure billing activity, contract data, and supporting documentation facilitate accurate revenue recognition and financial reporting.

• Support the monthly and quarterly close through reconciliations, variance analysis, exception resolution, and review of billing-related adjustments.

• Identify revenue leakage, billing errors, system gaps, and control weaknesses; lead root-cause analysis and corrective-action plans.

• Establish and monitor key performance indicators, including billing accuracy, billing timeliness, unbilled amounts, credit activity, exception volumes, and issue-resolution times.

• Maintain effective internal controls and supporting documentation for billing and revenue-related processes, including controls relevant to audits and SOX readiness.

• Drive accuracy, accountability, customer service, and continuous improvement through collaboration and mentorship, laying the foundation for future team development and leadership.

• Provide clear reporting and insights to the Corporate Controller and other senior leaders regarding risks, trends, and improvement opportunities.

What you will have

• Bachelor's degree in Accounting, Finance, Business, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

• 8 or more years of progressive experience in billing, revenue operations, quote-to-cash, accounts receivable, accounting operations, or a related discipline.

• 3 or more years of people-management experience, preferably leading geographically distributed teams.

• Experience supporting a global technology, SaaS, subscription, or recurring-revenue business.

• Strong understanding of end-to-end quote-to-cash processes and the relationship between customer contracts, order management, billing, collections, and revenue reporting.

• Experience reviewing complex commercial arrangements, including subscriptions, multi-year agreements, amendments, rebates, credits, partner transactions, and cloud marketplace offers.

• Demonstrated ability to design and improve scalable processes, controls, reconciliations, and operating procedures.

• Experience supporting month-end and quarter-end close activities and responding to internal and external audit requests.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify root causes and translate findings into sustainable operational improvements.

• Experience working with ERP, CRM, CPQ, billing, and reporting platforms.

• Advanced spreadsheet and data-analysis skills.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to influence senior stakeholders across Finance, Sales, Legal, Operations, and Technology.

Nice to have

• Experience with Salesforce, NetSuite, Zuora, or similar enterprise finance and billing platforms.

• Direct experience managing transactions through AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud Marketplace.

• Experience in a public-company, SOX-compliant, IPO-readiness, or private-equity-backed environment.

jobs.description:
At Curaleaf, we’re redefining the cannabis industry with a strong commitment to quality, expertise, and innovation. As a leading global cannabis provider, our brands—including Curaleaf, Select, and Grassroots—offer premium products and services in both medical and adult-use markets.

Join us at Curaleaf to be part of a high-growth, purpose-driven company that champions corporate social responsibility through our Rooted in Good initiative, supporting community outreach and positive change. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful impact, drive innovation, and help shape the future of cannabis.

Cultivation Associate

Job Type: Full-Time; Non-Exempt
Shift: Monday - Friday, 7:00 am - 3:30 pm.
Hourly Pay Rate: $17.00/hr.
Location: Hammonton - NJ

Who You Are:

As our Cultivation Associate, you will be responsible for the day-to-day assignments and tasks that keep our plants healthy to meet our production goals and quality targets on track. These responsibilities include but are not limited to trimming, pruning, debulking, transplanting, canopy manipulation, harvesting, data entry, and overall plant care at our cannabis cultivation facility. This position is also responsible for many of the cleaning, sanitation, and organization tasks of our grow rooms. Our cleaning instruments and chemicals will be required to ensure a sterile and pest-free environment for our plants.

What You’ll Do:

• Work with cultivation leadership to plan for growing activities that are consistent with planned production schedules

• Prepare space required for planned production

• Cloning: cutting, rooting, and transplanting; clone care, watering, and feeding.

• Monitor growing conditions and review changes in humidity, moisture, and temperature and cultivation procedures to ensure conformance with quality control standards

• Inspect crop to ascertain conditions such as leaf texture, bloom size, and the existence of pests or disease, removing substandard or diseased plants to maintain quality standards

• Monitor and care for plants during vegetative and flowering phase

• Harvesting: cutting plants; trimming cut plants; removing flowering tops.

• Curing: hanging and dry-racking flowers; monitoring curing process and climate control.

• Operating and maintaining cultivation systems/equipment

• Ensure daily compliance with policies and procedures including but not limited to state compliance, security protocols, and access protocols

• Other duties as assigned related to the overall health and efficiency of our cultivation efforts

What You’ll Bring:

• A green thumb, a passion for working with plants, and experience with harvesting plants in a work or home setting (gardening, etc.)

• Ability to work well with other employees in a fast paced, team environment while contributing to a positive and professional atmosphere

• Possess great attention to detail

• Ability to learn and execute techniques consistent with company best practices

Even Better If:

• You have previous landscaping, horticulture, or agriculture experience

jobs.title: Customer Experience Coordinator (Per Diem) - Brookfield, WI
jobs.description:
ABOUT VEG

In 2014, VEG was born with a mission to help people and their pets when they need it most. This meant challenging the status quo and fixing everything that was wrong with the ER experience. Since then, we’ve expanded rapidly, with hospitals nationwide open 24/7, 365 days a year, and created a better emergency experience—not only for people and their pets, but also for everyone who works here—our VEGgies!

At VEG we find a way to say yes to the career you want in veterinary emergency medicine. This means transforming how ER works, from our open-concept hospitals, where you can handle emergency cases of every kind (even exotics!) to our immersive, customer-focused experience, which helps us give people and their pets the care they deserve.

This also means saying yes to creating the greatest experience possible for our VEGgies. Yes to working in an environment where you can find your place and feel valued for the amazing work you do. Yes to having unparalleled opportunities for learning and mentorship so you can grow where you want to go in your career. And yes to making an impact here in ways you never thought possible.

VEG is a 2025 and 2026 certified Great Place to Work®.

THE JOB

As a Customer Experience Coordinator, your job is to define the customer’s experience through service, focus, and participation—so you are passionate about perfecting the experience before, during, and after their time at VEG. Outgoing and personable, with each customer, you conduct yourself professionally in both demeanor and presence. You find ways to say YES and put pets and customers experience above all else. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to grow where you want to go, building valuable experience and paving the way for your career to take unexpected and rewarding directions.

WHAT YOU’LL DO

• Greet every customer with warmth and urgency, whether in person, over the phone, or online

• Oversee all customer communications (calls, emails, texts), record details accurately, and route urgent medical calls to a doctor quickly

• Deliver personalized, memorable experiences—always looking for creative ways to say “yes” to customer needs

• Listen with empathy, resolve concerns quickly, and anticipate issues before they escalate

• Keep nursing team and doctors updated on customer needs for a seamless care experience

• Provide confidential, compassionate guidance on financial options and end-of-life decisions

• Process payments accurately while protecting personal and financial information

• Follow up with customers after visits to check on their pet’s care and strengthen relationships

• Celebrate and capture special moments (with permission), creating lasting connections between customers, their pets, and the hospital

WHAT YOU NEED

• 2+ years of experience in a customer service role

• Advanced proficiency in computer programs and practice management software

• Highly organized, with strong attention to detail

• Strong communication skills; able to interact positively with anyone and everyone

• The ability to multitask and thrive amid chaos

• High emotional intelligence, able to read a room and plan and act accordingly

• Adaptable and amenable in high stakes environments

• Problem solving skills and a focus on innovation

• Must be willing to work in a noisy environment with strong or unpleasant odors

• Availability to work nights, weekends, and holidays on a rotating or as needed basis based on hospital needs

• Work well in a fast-paced environment with people from all backgrounds and different personality types

WHO YOU ARE

• Empathetic, instinctively taking a people-centric approach, whether supporting your colleagues or making an effort to understand different perspectives

• Have a sense of humility; acknowledging mistakes, sharing credit with others, and lifting up your team’s’ accomplishments

• Feel a strong sense of ownership over your work, taking responsibility for outcomes and staying committed to achieving long-term, impactful results

• Curious by nature; you ask insightful questions and continuously seek out opportunities to learn and grow your skills and knowledge

HOW WE INVEST IN YOU

• Competitive compensation

• Flexible work schedules to support your life outside of work

• Generous employee referral program, so our awesome people can bring in more awesome people

• And the little (big) things, like comfy scrubs, cool VEG swag, food in the fridge for when you’re hungry

DEI

At VEG, diversity is not just a word—it's a strength that fuels innovation and kindness. Our mission is “Helping people and their pets when they need it most.” And we do that better when our VEGgies (employees) feel valued, respected, and empowered to bring their authentic selves to work. That's why we're devoted to creating an environment that reflects the diverse communities we serve—where different perspectives are not only welcomed but celebrated.

We are focused on providing equitable opportunities for growth, promoting inclusive decision-making, and ensuring that everyone's perspective is considered. Saying yes to VEG means helping us build a culture where your unique experiences and background contribute to a shared vision: being the world’s veterinary emergency company.

jobs.title: Maintenance Technician (Electrician) - Weekend Shift
jobs.description:
An experienced pharmaceutical/medical device Electrician is required to carry out planned/unplanned maintenance across, aseptic manufacturing, filling and or packaging. You will work as part of a strong multi-disciplined team of Fitters, Electricians, Process and Mechatronic Engineers. We have a strong emphasis on identifying opportunities for improvements and efficiency. Our primary objective is the consistent supply of safe, first class product to our customers.

Responsibilities:

• Carry out planned/unplanned maintenance on manufacturing, filling and packaging equipment, using a Reliability-Centred Maintenance (RCM) approach.

• Support continuous improvement and process efficiency programs, i.e., MEP,OEE, OPEX, RCA, and productivity output for the BU.
• Provide information to the tracking and monitoring of the relevant KPIs for the Technical Team.
• Help support the BU during regulatory and compliance audits.
• Ensures all maintenance activities within the department are performed to the appropriate health and safety standards.
• Ability to trouble-shoot and correct technical issues, in an effective and timely manner, with a sense of urgency to minimize equipment downtime.
• Ability to determine the root cause of technical issues using proven problem-solving techniques.
• Flexible and willing to carry out overtime and Shift Work as necessary.

• National Craft Senior Trades Electrical qualification is essential to be considered for this job.
• A minimum of 4 years’ maintenance and troubleshooting experience in a highly automated pharmaceutical or similar regulated environment.
• Automation/Mechatronic qualification desirable.
• Clear understanding and experience of maintenance and troubleshooting of electrical or mechanical, instrumentation and automation systems. This includes PLCs and HMI, pick-and-place robotics, control pneumatics, IPCs and PC-based tools, Vision systems, VSDs and Servo-drives, SCADA .
• Proficient on SAP to manage maintenance requisitions and spare parts control.
• Willingness to work on set shift pattern and to travel to equipment vendors as required.
• Excellent communication and Interpersonal skills are essential for this job.
• Ability to work under pressure and to tight deadlines.
• Team player and a good problem solver.
• Be flexible in this position and be prepared to undertake other work that may be assigned to you from time to time, which may be outside the area of your normal duties.
