jobs.title: Referral Relations Specialist, SUD
jobs.description:
Why Charlie Health?

Millions of people across the country are navigating mental health conditions, substance use disorders, and eating disorders, but too often, they’re met with barriers to care. From limited local options and long wait times to treatment that lacks personalization, behavioral healthcare can leave people feeling unseen and unsupported.

Charlie Health exists to change that. Our mission is to connect the world to life-saving behavioral health treatment. We deliver personalized, virtual care rooted in connection—between clients and clinicians, care teams, loved ones, and the communities that support them. By focusing on people with complex needs, we’re expanding access to meaningful care and driving better outcomes from the comfort of home.

As a rapidly growing organization, we're reaching more communities every day and building a team that’s redefining what behavioral health treatment can look like. If you're ready to use your skills to drive lasting change and help more people access the care they deserve, we’d love to meet you.

About the Role

Charlie Health is one of the fastest-growing startups in the healthcare industry, working tirelessly to connect people everywhere to life-saving mental health and substance use treatment.

As a SUD Referral Relations Specialist, you will join a founding go-to-market team responsible for scaling Charlie Health's Substance Use Disorder (SUD) program nationally. SUD represents our next major growth vertical, and this team is charged with building the playbook. Where our Outreach team builds the relationships that point people toward care, you will make sure they get there.

Connecting someone with a substance use concern to treatment takes more than a warm handoff. Clients often come to us in crisis, in unstable circumstances, and at the hardest possible moment to keep an appointment. You will own the daily work of making sure no one is lost in that gap — identifying clients whose care has stalled, reaching out directly to get them rescheduled, coordinating with our Admissions team, and keeping referral partners informed on every client they send us.

You will work shoulder to shoulder with our SUD-focused Outreach Team and Admissions team.

This role is best suited for someone who thrives in high-accountability environments and wants to help build something meaningful from the ground up. In your role, you'll have unparalleled responsibility while collaborating with sharp, spirited, and ambitious coworkers. You'll also receive competitive benefits, ensuring you have the resources to thrive both personally and professionally.

We’re a team of passionate, forward-thinking professionals eager to take on the challenge of the mental health crisis and play a formative role in providing life-saving solutions. If you’re inspired by our mission and energized by the opportunity to increase access to mental healthcare and impact millions of lives in a profound way, apply today.

Responsibilities

• Own the client journey from first contact through the start of care, making sure no one falls out of the process along the way

• Serve as the connective tissue between referral partners, clients, and our Admissions team

• Keep referral partners closely informed on the people they entrust to us, building confidence in Charlie Health as a long-term care partner

• Partner with our Outreach team to keep every client moving toward treatment, and coach on pipeline strategy so their time stays focused in the field

• Identify barriers to care as they surface and escalate the patterns behind them

Requirements

• Experience in direct client-facing role (e.g. Admissions Team), particularly in the mental health field, preferred.

• Support pipeline management activities during key Central Time and West Coast time hours (11am to 7pm ET).

• Work authorized in the United States and native or bilingual English proficiency

• Familiarity with and willingness to use cloud-based communication software—Google Suite, Slack, Zoom, Dropbox, Salesforce–in addition to EMR and survey software on a daily basis.

Benefits

Charlie Health is pleased to offer comprehensive benefits to all full-time, exempt employees. Read more about our benefits here.

Additional Information

The total target base compensation for this role will be between $55,000 and $65,000 per year at the commencement of employment. In addition to base compensation, this role also offers a performance bonus. The expected total cash compensation range, including potential bonus, will be between $71,500 and $84,000 per year. Please note, pay will be determined on an individualized basis and will be impacted by location, experience, expertise, internal pay equity, and other relevant business considerations. Further, cash compensation is only part of the total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may include stock options and other Charlie Health-sponsored benefits.

HYBRI

Our Values

• Connection: Care deeply & inspire hope.

• Congruence: Stay curious & heed the evidence.

• Commitment: Act with urgency & don’t give up.

Please do not call our public clinical admissions line in regard to this or any other job posting.

Please be cautious of potential recruitment fraud. If you are interested in exploring opportunities at Charlie Health, please go directly to our Careers Page: https://www.charliehealth.com/careers/current-openings. Charlie Health will never ask you to pay a fee or download software as part of the interview process with our company. In addition, Charlie Health will not ask for your personal banking information until you have signed an offer of employment and completed onboarding paperwork that is provided by our People Operations team. All communications with Charlie Health Talent and People Operations professionals will only be sent from @charliehealth.com email addresses. Legitimate emails will never originate from gmail.com, yahoo.com, or other commercial email services.

Recruiting agencies, please do not submit unsolicited referrals for this or any open role. We have a roster of agencies with whom we partner, and we will not pay any fee associated with unsolicited referrals.

At Charlie Health, we value being an Equal Opportunity Employer. We strive to cultivate an environment where individuals can be their authentic selves. Being an Equal Opportunity Employer means every member of our team feels as though they are supported and belong. We value diverse perspectives to help us provide essential mental health and substance use disorder treatments to all young people.

jobs.title: Senior Product Marketing Manager, Commercial Operations
jobs.location: Oslo, NO / Trondheim, NO / Gdańsk, PL / Madrid, ES / Berlin, DE / Aachen, DE / München, DE / Stockholm, SE / Aarhus, DK / Porvoo, FI / Wien, AT / London, GB / Kadıköy, TR / Tampere, FI
jobs.description:
Our mission is to provide innovative services critical to society, unlocking a cleaner, better and more profitable future. Working towards this goal, Volue has become a leading technology supplier and enabler of the green transition, helping energy companies simplify and optimize everyday operations.

Volue’s Commercial Operations business covers our product portfolio within energy trading and asset optimization, providing software that traders, asset owners, and utilities use to optimize their assets and participate in European power markets.

It is one of our fastest-growing areas, driven by the rapid battery buildout, new entrants into energy markets, and expansion beyond our traditional core markets.

We are now looking for a Senior Product Marketing Manager to shape how we bring this portfolio to market, serving customers ranging from first-time traders to some of Europe’s largest utilities and asset owners.

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant ownership of positioning, messaging, and go-to-market strategy.

What you will be doing to make a difference:

You will own product marketing for Volue’s Commercial Operations portfolio and turn market, customer, and product insights into compelling stories that resonate with different customer segments.

Your key responsibilities will include:

• Positioning & messaging: Own value propositions, personas, and messaging frameworks across the Commercial Operations portfolio.
• Go-to-market: Develop segmented GTM strategies for customers ranging from new market entrants and proprietary traders to multinational utilities and asset owners.
• Launches & demand: Lead product launches and work with Growth Marketing to build an always-on demand engine, continuously testing and improving what converts.
• Sales enablement: Create high-impact sales materials including pitches, decks, one-pagers, case studies, and battlecards based on real customer use cases.
• Product partnership: Work closely with Product Management to translate complex product capabilities and roadmap developments into clear customer value.
• Market & competitive intelligence: Build a strong view of European energy markets, customer segments, regulation, regional dynamics, and competitors, bringing insights back into both GTM and product decisions.
• Customer advocacy: Develop customer references, success stories, thought leadership, and content for campaigns, events, and white papers.
• AI-enabled marketing: Use AI across research, content development, and competitive monitoring to increase the quality and scale of your work.
• Performance: Own launch and campaign performance, pipeline influence, and adoption KPIs, using data to continuously reprioritize.

What you need to succeed:

We are looking for an experienced product marketer who combines strong commercial thinking with curiosity and the ability to understand complex products and markets.

You bring:

• Senior-level experience owning product marketing for a product family or portfolio, ideally within technical B2B software.
• Experience positioning solutions for specialist audiences such as traders, asset owners, operations teams, or IT leaders.
• Strong experience with market segmentation, positioning, messaging, launches, and sales enablement across different customer sizes and buying processes.
• A commercial and data-driven mindset, with experience owning GTM metrics and using insights to determine priorities.
• An AI-native approach to marketing, with AI tools already integrated into your daily workflow.
• A proactive mindset, connecting market insight, Product, Sales, messaging, and demand rather than waiting for requests.
• Curiosity about European energy markets and the motivation to understand our products and customers in depth.
• Professional fluency in English.

Experience within energy, power trading, commodities, asset optimization, or industrial software is an advantage.

You will work closely with teams across Volue, including:

• Product Management: Positioning, use cases, roadmap and customer value.
• Sales & SDR: Market insight, field feedback and sales enablement.
• Customer Success: Adoption and expansion.
• Growth, Brand & Events: Campaigns, content and go-to-market execution.

Reasons to join Volue team and what we offer:

• Large degree of influence in shaping & developing the role further
• Great colleagues in one of Europe’s most exciting green tech companies with innovative and international work environment
• Flexible working hours & competitive compensation package

We are looking to hire for Volue office in Norway but will be ready to consider other locations for the right candidate.

All Volue offices in Europe: Norway, Sweden, Denmark, Finland, UK, Germany, Poland, Switzerland, Austria, Spain, Turkey.

In Volue, we cherish each employee’s competence, ideas and personality. Let your skills and talent be a part of our team – and let us leave our mark on the world together!

Company Culture

In Volue, we believe that in order to be a successful company, we need to bring everyone to the table.

We look at diversity as a competitive advantage. A diverse workforce enables better decision-making and creates more value. By inclusion, we refer to the sense of belonging and being part of a community at work. We want the people of Volue to feel welcome, valued and not least encouraged to bring their whole, unique selves to work.

Volue is about people. From staff to client, people are at the center of all our operations, and we always strive for a flat structure where everyone feels included, appreciated and recognized for their individual efforts. Or as we call it "ONE Volue". We hire talented individuals, regardless of gender, race, ethnicity, ancestry, age, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, cultural background or religious beliefs.

jobs.title: Care Coordinator, MA (Bilingual)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Evergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care. We believe patients living with kidney disease deserve the best care. We are committed to improving patient outcomes and improving quality of life by delaying disease progression, shifting care to the home, and accelerating kidney transplants.

We help nephrologists focus on the right patients at the right time across the full care spectrum. We do this by providing them with the best-in-class interdisciplinary clinical resources, analytical insight and tools, and services to patients. We listen to the needs of our patients, our employees, and our client partners, continually working to push beyond the status quo in which the care system manages patients today.

Who You Are

You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

Your Role

The Evergreen Chronic Care Management (CCM) Care Coordinator supports proactive care coordination services for patients with complex chronic conditions, including chronic kidney disease (CKD), hypertension, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and related comorbidities. Working under Evergreen’s clinical supervision, the Care Coordinator conducts patient outreach, creates, maintains, and reinforces established care plans, supports documentation compliance, and coordinates communication between patients, providers, and healthcare partners.

This role is outreach-driven and operationally focused, requiring strong organization, patient communication skills, and the ability to manage a high-volume patient panel. Experience supporting nephrology or CKD patient populations is strongly preferred.

The program uses SMS as the first-line channel for patient engagement, with phone outreach used when appropriate.

While this position is fully remote, you must be able to work 8:00am – 5:00pm in the pacific time zone.

Role Responsibilities

Some responsibilities may vary based on specific patient programs, but this role's primary duties include the following:

• Patient Enrollment & Eligibility Support CCM patient enrollment and onboarding activities. Verify eligibility based on Evergreen and payer program guidelines. Ensure patient consent documentation is completed prior to outreach. Proactively maintain patient engagement regularly. Identify inactive or non-engaged patients and escalate appropriately.

• Patient Outreach & Engagement Conduct text & telephonic outreach to enrolled CCM patients weekly. Achieve required engagement time standards aligned with Medicare CCM billing requirements. Support achievement of required engagement time for billing compliance. Reinforce provider-directed care plans during patient interactions. Identify barriers to adherence including medication access, transportation, or social needs.

• Expected activities include: High-volume outbound patient calling and texting. Follow-up outreach attempts.

• Documentation & Billing Compliance Document patient interactions accurately within the CCM patient management platform and EHR systems. Track engagement time consistent with Medicare CCM billing requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation standards. Ensure HIPAA and PHI compliance.

• Patient Care Coordination & Clinical Workflow Facilitate patient access to their referring provider and clinical staff. Support care transitions following hospitalizations or ED visits. Coordinate referrals and follow-up appointments. Escalate symptom concerns or medication issues to licensed clinical staff.

• Preferred experience includes: Chronic kidney disease patient populations. Dialysis patient coordination. Medication adherence monitoring. Kidney transplant or specialty referrals.

• Technology & Communication Utilize CCM platform and EHR systems daily. Manage patient messaging workflows. Collaborate with remote clinical and operational teams.

Required Qualifications

• Certified Medical Assistant

• Bilingual (Spanish/English)

• 1–3 years healthcare experience

• Chronic disease or nephrology experience is preferred.

• Strong clinical assessment, communication, and documentation skills.

• Comfortable working in two systems (EHR + CCM platform) simultaneously.

• Ability to manage a structured, metric-driven workflow with reliability.

• Intermediate skills with MS Office Suite of products including Outlook and Teams

• Able to work effectively in a primarily remote environment: Home internet must support a minimum download speed of 25 Mbps and upload speed of 10 Mbps. Cable, Fiber, or DSL connections hardwired to the internet device are recommended Evergreen will provide remote employees with telephony applications and equipment to meet the business requirements for their role Employees must work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in chronic disease management

• Prior work in virtual care, remote nursing, or telehealth programs.

• Familiarity with CCM regulatory requirements.

• Strong patient education and motivational interviewing skills.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $45,000 to $52,000 annually. Exact pay is determined based on experience, education, demand for the role, and other role-specific factors.

This role is also eligible for a bonus.

Benefits

Evergreen Nephrology’s total rewards program is designed to support you in and outside of work. You can expect:

• Paid time off starting at 4 weeks for full-time employees

• 12 paid holidays per year

• Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including an HSA with employer match

• Reimbursement for continuing medical education for eligible roles

• A 401(k) program where Evergreen matches up to 4% of contributions after six months of tenure

• Paid parental leave

• A robust training and development program that starts with onboarding and continues throughout your career with Evergreen Nephrology

Evergreen Nephrology is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any other protected category under local, state or federal laws.

If you are an applicant with a disability who requires reasonable accommodation for any part of the hiring process, please contact us for assistance at recruiting@evergreennephrology.com.

jobs.title: Senior Account Executive - Utilities
jobs.description:
A Toku nasceu para ajudar empresas a arrecadar mais, em menos tempo, com o uso da tecnologia.

Estamos crescendo no Brasil e queremos trazer para o time alguém que conheça o mercado de utilities e nos ajude a construir nossa presença nesse setor.

Nosso foco inclui distribuidoras e comercializadoras de energia, empresas de energia por assinatura e geração compartilhada, distribuidoras de gás e concessionárias de água e esgoto. São negócios com cobrança recorrente, grandes volumes de pagamentos e desafios que afetam diretamente seus resultados e a experiência dos clientes.

Buscamos uma pessoa com experiência comercial, conhecimento do setor e disposição para abrir mercado. Você terá autonomia para definir prioridades, desenvolver relacionamentos e conquistar grandes contas, trabalhando próximo da liderança e dos times de Produto e Implementação.

O DESAFIO
Construir e desenvolver a atuação comercial da Toku em utilities no Brasil.
Queremos alguém que saiba entrar nas contas certas, entender a operação do cliente e construir uma proposta que faça sentido para o negócio. Isso exige conhecer o mercado, conduzir conversas com diferentes áreas e mostrar, com números, o impacto que podemos gerar.

O QUE VOCÊ VAI FAZER

 - Definir as contas prioritárias e a estratégia para desenvolver o segmento no Brasil.

 - Conduzir o ciclo completo de vendas: prospecção, diagnóstico, apresentação da plataforma, proposta, negociação e fechamento.

 - Entender os processos de faturamento, arrecadação, cobrança e conciliação dos clientes, identificando onde a Toku pode contribuir.

 - Construir análises de retorno financeiro que mostrem o potencial de redução da inadimplência, dos custos operacionais e do trabalho manual.

 - Desenvolver relacionamentos com CFOs e lideranças de financeiro, arrecadação, cobrança, comercial, tecnologia e operações.

 - Envolver as diferentes áreas que participam da decisão e conduzir os processos de contratação com organização e clareza.

 - Trabalhar com os BDRs e o Marketing para gerar oportunidades e manter uma carteira comercial consistente.

 - Acompanhar a passagem da venda para a implementação, garantindo que o contexto e os compromissos acordados com o cliente cheguem aos times responsáveis.

 - Trazer para Produto e liderança o que você está ouvindo no mercado, ajudando a orientar melhorias na plataforma e na nossa abordagem comercial.



QUEM BUSCAMOS

 - Uma pessoa com experiência sólida em vendas consultivas B2B — como referência, entre 7 e 10 anos — e histórico de conquista de grandes contas.

 - Experiência vendendo para utilities a partir de empresas de tecnologia, software, pagamentos ou consultoria, ou atuando em posições comerciais dentro do setor.

 - Conhecimento de um ou mais desses mercados: distribuição e comercialização de energia, energia por assinatura e geração compartilhada, distribuição de gás, água e saneamento.

 - Entendimento de como essas empresas operam: grandes volumes de faturas, cobrança recorrente, exigências regulatórias e decisões que envolvem várias áreas.

 - Capacidade de analisar a operação do cliente, identificar oportunidades e construir uma proposta com retorno financeiro claro.

 - Familiaridade com metodologias de vendas consultivas, como MEDDIC, SPIN ou Challenger, e experiência em aplicá-las.

 - Autonomia para definir prioridades, disciplina para acompanhar as oportunidades e responsabilidade pelos resultados.

 - Disposição para participar da construção: testar abordagens, ajustar a estratégia e trabalhar com outras áreas para fazer as oportunidades avançarem.

 - Inglês e/ou espanhol avançado para conversar e trabalhar com os times de outros países.



Também queremos conhecer profissionais que tenham construído sua carreira em arrecadação, cobrança ou faturamento dentro de utilities e tenham experiência em negociação e perfil comercial.

O QUE CONTA COMO DIFERENCIAL

 - Conhecimento de Pix, boleto, débito automático, cartão e outros meios de pagamento.

 - Familiaridade com integrações via API e sistemas de faturamento e gestão de clientes, como SAP IS-U.

 - Experiência em fintechs ou empresas de pagamentos.



COMO SERÁ SUA ROTINA
Você vai dividir seu tempo entre desenvolver novas contas, avançar nas negociações e trabalhar com o time para construir boas propostas.
Reuniões e visitas presenciais serão parte importante dessa rotina. Queremos estar próximos dos clientes, conhecer suas operações e entender o que precisa melhorar.
Internamente, você terá contato frequente com BDRs, Marketing, Produto, Implementação e Customer Success. Sua experiência no setor vai ajudar tanto a conquistar clientes quanto a preparar a Toku para atendê-los melhor.

É uma posição para quem gosta de vender, conhece utilities e quer participar da construção de um mercado com espaço para crescer no Brasil.

jobs.description:
Principal Consultant – Data Transformation & Technical Program Delivery

Location: McLean, VA | Practice Area: Technology & Engineering | Type: Permanent

Bring together data, technology, and transformation leadership to deliver complex programs that create meaningful outcomes for financial services clients.

The Role

As a Principal Consultant in Capco’s Technology & Engineering practice, you’ll lead complex data and technology transformation initiatives for financial services clients, taking programs from planning through implementation.

You’ll combine a strong technical foundation with transformation delivery leadership, working across data engineering, data platforms, governance, analytics, cloud, and related technology initiatives. You’ll partner with engineers, architects, product owners, and senior business and technology stakeholders to turn strategic objectives into executable plans and drive programs through to successful delivery.

This is a role for someone who can engage credibly with technical teams, understand what is being built, challenge assumptions, and identify dependencies while remaining focused on leading transformation and getting complex programs delivered, rather than acting as the hands-on engineer or solution architect.

What You’ll Do

• Lead complex data and technology transformation programs, coordinating multiple workstreams across data engineering, platforms, governance, analytics, cloud, and related initiatives from planning through implementation.

• Partner with engineers, architects, product owners, and business and technology stakeholders to translate strategic objectives into executable plans, resolve blockers, and maintain alignment across teams.

• Establish effective program governance and maintain visibility across scope, milestones, resources, dependencies, risks, decisions, and business outcomes, providing clear executive-level reporting.

• Apply your technical understanding of modern data environments to challenge delivery assumptions, identify root causes, evaluate technical dependencies, and translate complex technology considerations into clear business implications.

• Serve as a trusted client advisor, leading workstreams and teams while contributing to transformation strategies, roadmaps, proposals, business development, and the development of Capco colleagues.

What We’re Looking For

• 8+ years of experience across data, technology, and transformation initiatives, preferably within financial services and/or consulting, with experience leading complex programs involving cross-functional coordination, risk management, and senior stakeholder communication.

• A technical foundation developed through earlier hands-on experience in data engineering, data analytics, BI, data management, software engineering, or a related discipline, combined with practical knowledge of modern data ecosystems and the data lifecycle.

• Experience engaging effectively with engineers and architects, understanding technical designs and dependencies, and translating them into program and business implications for technical and non-technical stakeholders.

• Proven experience delivering data modernization, data platforms, data governance, analytics, cloud, or similar transformation initiatives, supported by strong program management capabilities across planning, dependencies, RAID management, governance, and executive reporting.

• Strong client-facing, communication, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence across organizational boundaries and actively drive resolution of complex delivery challenges.

Bonus Points For

• Experience within banking, capital markets, wealth management, payments, or another financial services domain.

• Knowledge of data engineering and ETL/ELT pipelines, data modeling, cloud data platforms, data warehouses, SQL, APIs, systems integration, governance, lineage, metadata, data quality, and analytics/BI platforms.

• Experience with AWS, Microsoft Azure, or Google Cloud environments.

• Familiarity with AI, GenAI, machine learning, or advanced analytics initiatives, particularly where these capabilities depend on broader data modernization efforts.

• An advanced degree and/or experience mentoring colleagues and strengthening data transformation or program delivery capabilities.

Why Join Capco

• Deliver high-impact technology solutions for Tier 1 financial institutions.

• Work in a collaborative, flat, and entrepreneurial consulting culture.

• Access continuous learning, training, and industry certifications.

• Be part of a team shaping the future of digital financial services.

• Help shape the future of digital transformation across FS & Energy.

Benefits

• Medical, dental, and vision coverage.

• 401(k) match and HSA/FSA options.

• Maternity and paternity leave and dependent care benefits.

• Tuition reimbursement and wellness reimbursement.

• Commuter benefits and access to Working Advantage, a discounted marketplace.

Inclusion at Capco

We’re committed to making our recruitment process accessible and straightforward for everyone. If you need any adjustments at any stage, just let us know – we’ll be happy to help. We value each person’s unique perspective and contribution. At Capco, we believe that being yourself is your greatest strength. Our #BeYourselfAtWork culture encourages individuality and collaboration – a mindset that shapes how we work with clients and each other every day.

Use of Artificial Intelligence in Talent Acquisition

At Capco, we use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support and enhance several parts of talent acquisition. This includes using AI-enabled features within LinkedIn to help source potential candidates, speeding up routine recruitment communications such as emails and creating compelling and brand-aligned job postings that accurately reflect role requirements, and AI-scheduling applications to improve the efficiency of interview coordination.

AI is used as a support tool only. All hiring decisions are made by talent acquisition and hiring teams.

Work Location

This role requires working from our Northern Virginia office 5 days per week.

We have been informed of several recruitment scams targeting the public. We strongly advise you to verify identities before engaging in recruitment related communication. All official Capco communication will be conducted via a Capco recruiter.

jobs.title: Senior Engineering Manager, Platform
jobs.description:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

Location: You must be based in one of the countries on this list and must overlap with East Africa Time and US Eastern Time (8am-6pm) by at least 3 hours. As an example, 6PM East Africa Time is 11AM US Eastern time in the summer and 10AM in the winter. In practice, if you are in the Eastern US timezone, that means being regularly available for 8AM meetings and some 7AM ones. We know people have commitments like school drop-offs, so you’re encouraged to set a schedule that works for you—as long as there’s sufficient overlap with the team. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment Visas in the U.S. or U.K. at this time.

About this role

We’re hiring three Senior Engineering Managers to own domains of our cash delivery platform at a moment of rapid growth: we’re doubling our engineering team over the coming year and expect to hit $1B in revenue in 2026, with significant growth forecast for 2027.

You'll own one domain of our cash delivery platform — payments, core platform, or data collection (see team charters below) — the software product that is at the heart of delivering cash to recipients. We recently launched a platform rebuild as a greenfield project, and the work ahead is scaling it from initial launch to delivering $5B/year. This is a management role close to the work: you'll directly manage a team of 5–7 senior engineers, partner with product counterparts on roadmap and delivery, own the operational details (on-call, incident response), and stay close enough to the code to pressure-test designs and represent tradeoffs in roadmap decisions.

You will own maintaining and scaling a strong engineering culture on your team through rapid growth: recruiting and retaining a high talent density team, and building strong operating processes that encourage open debate in search of the best outcomes for recipients rather than attachment to being right or looking good; continuous learning, improvement, and adoption of new tools; deep product ownership in service of impact for recipients; and strong judgment about tradeoffs. You'll set a high technical quality bar, pressure-testing designs and tradeoffs while still giving a very senior team high autonomy.

You optimize for recipient impact, not the most interesting technical problem. We're not driven by hot new technical trends; we're building the hard tech that matters to recipients — integrations with mobile money rails and delivery in low-connectivity contexts.

You'll own the interface between engineering and team members who haven't worked heavily with a product development organization before. That means learning our programs and the realities of our field teams, and working with partner teams to build our development practices, whether building trust that an MVP is a starting point rather than a final answer, or helping teams see why it’s worth taking time out of their urgent delivery goals to give feedback on a demo or try something new.

As GiveDirectly scales, technology is what allows us to reach more people without breaking. Your leadership means getting more cash to the people who need it most.

Reports to: VP of Technology

Level: Senior Manager

Travel Requirement: Must be able to travel ~3-4 times per year to one of our countries of operation for team retreats or field visits

Team charters:

We're hiring one Senior Engineering Manager for each of three teams. During the process we'll match candidates to charters based on experience and interest — you don't need to pick one to apply.

• Payments: owns integrations with mobile money and banking rails, payments orchestration, and financial tracking and reconciliation. A key mission of this domain is to build reliable systems that can move billions of dollars, on top of financial payment rails of varying maturity.

• Core platform: owns the heart of the cash delivery platform: the recipient and program data model, the web app our call center agents and field managers use every day, and the migration cutover from our legacy and Salesforce systems.

• Data collection: owns how we identify and enroll recipients: survey and enrollment tooling built for low-connectivity, offline-first field contexts, and, in time, increasingly direct-to-recipient communications. This team’s work shapes how recipients experience our programs – and ultimately the operational mechanics of delivering at scale.

What you’ll do:

• Directly manage a team growing to 5–7 senior engineers — 1:1s, goal setting, feedback, career development, performance management — and build the team itself: you'll drive recruiting for several of your own hires in your first year and own their onboarding

• Own your domain’s technical outcomes: delivery, reliability, and the consequences of its big technical bets – in close partnership with senior and staff engineers and your product counterpart

• Partner with product to balance feature development with tech debt drawdown, infrastructure investments, and other efforts to improve velocity and drive compounding progress

• Drive operational excellence, including on-call, incident response, code quality, testing, AI, and deployment practices

• Protect and scale the culture as we grow: open debate, product ownership, continuous improvement, and strong engineering foundations

• Represent your team with stakeholders and leadership: translate technical realities into business decisions and vice versa, and partner with diverse stakeholders to create the enabling environment for product development

• Set the technical quality bar: stay close enough to the technical work to weigh in on architecture, review designs, and help the team make sound trade-offs, without becoming the bottleneck

What you’ll bring:

• Exceptional alignment with GiveDirectly Values and active demonstration of our core competencies: emotional intelligence, problem solving, project management, follow-through, and fostering inclusivity. We welcome and strongly encourage applications from candidates who have personal or professional experience in the low-income and/or historically marginalized communities that we serve.

• Language Requirement: English

• 3+ years managing software engineers through full delivery cycles

• 8+ years of overall industry experience building production software, with a strong backend foundation (databases, cloud services, APIs)

• Demonstrated ability to recruit, coach, develop, and retain engineers, building and retaining a talent-dense and inclusive team during periods of high growth

• Track record of building a strong engineering culture including candid, ego-free debate, deep product ownership, and continuously raising the bar on craft and tooling (including agentic engineering)

• You enable speed through focus and create clarity in ambiguity: cutting through complexity to the strategic kernel and shielding the team from distraction, so a senior team can move fast and autonomously

• Strong technical judgment driven by the mission, not ego: you can pressure-test architecture decisions with very senior engineers, have made consequential calls and lived with the results, and weigh technical and non-technical tradeoffs by recipient impact

• Energized to build product-development fluency in an organization that's relatively new to it: you've successfully partnered with non-technical stakeholders and leaders, and you’re excited by this, rather than daunted by it

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

United States

Octave is a modern behavioral health practice creating a new standard for care delivery that’s both high-quality and accessible. About the Role:

Octave is hiring Licensed Clinicians to work within an organizational structure to provide high-quality behavioral health care to our clients. Octave Clinicians demonstrate strong clinical service thinking, informed by evidence-informed therapies. You create an inclusive culture that promotes collaboration and entrepreneurial spirit and are responsible & aware of the store’s strengths, opportunities, and competitors. Customer Sales & Profit

• Responsible for the total OMNI customer experience in your store, ensuring visual and commercial curation according to your store format environment, global guidelines and regional strategies

• Establish, analyze, and follow up on sales & budget goals, and create plans to optimize results

• Ensure all admin routines for both people and operations are handled in a correct way

• Keep up to date with fashion scene, trends, tendencies, styles, brands, products, competitors, and relevant influencers, etc

jobs.title: Senior Specialist I, EHS
jobs.description:
Step into a career with ASM, where cutting edge technology meets collaborative culture. ​

For over 55 years ASM has been ahead of what’s next, at the forefront of innovation and what’s technologically possible. With more than 4,500 ASMers representing 70 nationalities, our people and our advanced semiconductor devices are playing a crucial role in trends such as 5G, cloud computing, AI, and autonomous driving.  But we’re more than just a tech company. We value diversity, inclusion and sustainability as we strive to make a positive impact on the world.  Our development programs help support your growth, shaping your future and pushing the boundaries of innovation to unleash potential.

As a Senior Specialist I, EHS you will report to the US Region EHS Lead and support the implementation and continuous improvement of Environmental, Health & Safety (EHS) programs for ASM's Service organization at an assigned site and associated customer locations. You will work closely with Field Service Engineers (FSEs), site leadership, customers, and EHS professionals to ensure service activities are conducted safely, compliantly, and in accordance with ASM requirements.

This role serves as the local EHS resource for service operations, helping to implement corporate and regional safety programs, support regulatory compliance, conduct field safety activities, facilitate training, investigate incidents, and drive continuous improvement. The position requires a strong field presence and regular interaction with employees and customers to promote a proactive safety culture.

The Senior EHS Specialist is an individual contributor role focused on execution, implementation, and operational support, focusing on effective site-level leadership, implementation and continuous improvement of established EHS programs.

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Chemistry, or related field preferred.

• 5 years of experience in occupational health and safety within manufacturing, semiconductor, high-technology, field service, facilities, or related industries.

• Working knowledge of applicable occupational health and safety regulations.

• Experience working in semiconductor fabs, cleanroom environments, laboratories, or other high-tech manufacturing facilities preferred.

• Experience supporting field service personnel, contractors, or customer-facing operations preferred.

• OSHA 511, ASP, CSP or other EHS certification preferred.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

Leadership Partnership & Safety Culture

• Develop and maintain strong working relationships with site leadership to support the integration of EHS expectations into daily service operations.

• Partner with Service Managers and site leadership to identify safety risks, review performance trends, and develop practical risk reduction strategies.

• Participate in site operational reviews, staff meetings, and leadership discussions to provide EHS guidance and support informed decision-making.

• Regularly communicate EHS performance, emerging risks, regulatory changes, and improvement opportunities to site leadership.

• Support site leaders in fostering a positive safety culture through employee engagement, visible leadership activities, and proactive safety conversations.

• Collaborate with site management to establish and track site-specific EHS objectives, action plans, and continuous improvement initiatives.

• Provide coaching and consultation to supervisors and managers on EHS responsibilities, incident prevention, hazard recognition, and regulatory compliance.

• Support leadership teams during incident investigations by identifying root causes, recommending corrective actions, and verifying implementation of improvements.

• Facilitate leadership participation in safety observations, Safety Management by Walking Around (SMBWA) activities, and site safety committee meetings.

• Serve as a trusted advisor to site leadership on EHS matters while promoting alignment with ASM policies, customer requirements, and industry best practices.

Safety Program Implementation

• Implement ASM EHS policies, standards, programs, and initiatives at assigned sites and customer locations.

• Support deployment of corporate and regional safety initiatives.

• Assist local management in maintaining compliance with ASM EHS requirements and customer safety expectations.

• Promote safe work practices and support continuous improvement initiatives.

• Participate in implementation of safety, industrial hygiene, ergonomics, and risk reduction programs.

Regulatory and Customer Compliance

• Maintain awareness of applicable regulatory requirements and customer EHS standards.

• Assist employees and managers in understanding and complying with ASM and customer safety requirements.

• Participate in customer safety meetings, audits, and assessments.

• Support compliance inspections and corrective action programs.

• Assist with maintaining site compliance documentation and records.

Field Safety Leadership

• Conduct regular field observations, safety walks, inspections, and behavioral safety engagements.

• Coach employees and contractors on hazard recognition and safe work practices.

• Act as a visible safety resource in customer facilities and ASM workplaces.

• Support Safety Management by Walking Around (SMBWA) activities and safety observation programs.

• Identify hazards and recommend corrective actions to minimize operational risk.

Incident Management

• Support reporting, investigation, and documentation of incidents, near misses, and occupational health concerns.

• Participate in root cause investigations and corrective action development.

• Track corrective actions to closure and verify effectiveness.

• Support lessons learned communications and sharing across service teams.

Training and Awareness

• Deliver safety training, toolbox talks, and EHS communications.

• Support onboarding and qualification activities for Field Service Engineers.

• Maintain training records and verify completion of required safety training.

• Reinforce safety requirements through routine engagement with employees and managers.

Emergency Preparedness

• Support maintenance of local emergency response plans.

• Participate in emergency drills and preparedness exercises.

• Coordinate with customer emergency response personnel and local management as needed.

Metrics, Audits, and Continuous Improvement

• Collect and analyze EHS performance data.

• Support internal audits, customer assessments, and compliance reviews.

• Monitor corrective action completion and audit findings.

• Assist with identifying trends and opportunities to improve safety performance.

Knowledge, Skills & Abilities

• Knowledge of occupational health and safety principles and practices.

• Understanding of hazard recognition, risk assessment, and incident investigation methodologies.

• Familiarity with semiconductor manufacturing, equipment servicing, cleanroom environments, and customer facilities.

• Experience with chemical, gas, industrial hygiene, ergonomic, and electrical safety hazards preferred.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

• Strong organizational and follow-up capabilities.

• Demonstrated analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Ability to influence safe behaviors through collaboration and engagement.

• Ability to work independently while supporting broader organizational objectives.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Office and EHS data management tools.

Travel

• Ability to travel between ASM facilities and customer facilities

• Other travel 10-25%

Physical Demands

The employee must be able to work within office, warehouse, laboratory, manufacturing, cleanroom, and customer environments. Responsibilities include:

• Standing and walking for extended periods.

• Accessing semiconductor fabrication facilities and working around semiconductor equipment.

• Working around hazardous gases, chemicals, process equipment, and supporting facility infrastructure.

• Wearing required personal protective equipment.

Work Environment

The work environment includes ASM offices, customer semiconductor manufacturing facilities, cleanrooms, warehouses, laboratories, and other operational environments where service personnel work. Compliance with customer and ASM EHS requirements is required at all times.

Success Profile

A successful Senior Specialist I, EHS is highly visible in the field, technically knowledgeable, collaborative, customer-focused, and skilled at influencing safe behaviors. They translate ASM's EHS requirements into daily operational practices, helping ensure employees go home safely every day while supporting world-class service operations in the semiconductor industry.

Apply today to be part of what’s next.

We make the tech that enables the chips in devices which improve lives around the world. We do this with an eye to the future, pushing the boundaries of what’s possible through cutting-edge innovation, and driving the next wave of technological breakthroughs that shape how we live, work, and connect.

To learn more about ASM, find us at asm.com and on LinkedIn, Facebook, Instagram, X and YouTube.

jobs.description:
US Conec, Ltd.

Engineering Innovation. Precision Plastics. Powering AI.

US Conec, Ltd. is a trusted, global company that prides itself on engineering excellence—creating innovative connectivity solutions that support today’s most important technologies. We foster a friendly, inclusive culture that values teamwork, creativity, and mutual respect. At US Conec, you’ll find real opportunities to grow and make a meaningful impact in a company that genuinely cares about its people and its customers. With competitive compensation, excellent benefits, and a supportive environment, this is a place where you can build your future—whether your interests lie in manufacturing, engineering, operations, or beyond.

Automation Technician - Weekend Shift (Fri-Sun/6pm-6am)

Overview

We’re seeking a hands‑on Automation Technician to install, optimize, and support automated manufacturing systems across injection molding and ferrule posting areas. In this role you’ll use mechanical and electrical troubleshooting skills to keep automation running, drive continuous improvement, and collaborate with engineering and operations to deliver reliable, efficient production.

Responsibilities

• Support installation, commissioning, and optimization of automation in black and clear injection molding areas.

• Support installation and optimization of automation for ferrule posting processes.

• Monitor automated processes, inspect output, and adjust systems to maintain product quality and process consistency.

• Provide first‑line technical support and troubleshooting to minimize downtime; escalate complex repairs as needed.

• Perform preventative maintenance and basic repairs on automation equipment; coordinate vendor/engineering repairs.

• Read and update technical documentation, including work instructions, schematics, and process flow for manual and automated tasks.

• Assist with PLC/HMI program testing, loading, and diagnostics in coordination with controls engineers.

• Use 2D/3D CAD drawings to identify components, fixtures, and assemblies during installation and troubleshooting.

• Support and occasionally lead training for operators, technicians, or engineers on new or modified automation systems.

• Collaborate across business units to support additional automation projects from concept through implementation.

• Occasionally operate automation equipment to support training, validation, or production needs.

Must Haves

• Associate’s degree in Mechatronics, Mechanical, or Electrical Engineering Technology preferred; other technical fields acceptable.

• 2–4 years hands‑on experience in a medium‑volume manufacturing environment (injection molding, die casting, machining, assembly).

• Strong mechanical aptitude and experience maintaining automated equipment, jigs, and fixturing.

• Familiarity with PLCs and HMIs and ability to assist with program loading, basic testing, and diagnostics.

• Working knowledge of 2D/3D CAD to read schematics and assembly drawings.

• Proactive problem‑solver with strong analytical and communication skills.

• Proficient with Microsoft Office (Excel, Outlook) and basic PC skills.

• Ability to lift/move up to 25 lbs regularly and up to 50 lbs occasionally; good visual acuity and manual dexterity.

• Willingness to work in a manufacturing environment with regular exposure to machining fluids, adhesives, and particulate.

Nice to Haves

• Experience specifically with injection molding automation and ferrule/posting process equipment.

• Hands‑on troubleshooting experience with servo drives, motion systems, sensors, and vision inspection equipment.

• Previous experience authoring or improving work instructions, SOPs, and technical documentation.

• Familiarity with root‑cause analysis, corrective actions, and continuous improvement methodologies (5S, Kaizen, Lean).

• Experience coordinating vendor repairs and upgrades for automation systems.

What We Offer

• Competitive base salary with performance‑based bonus potential.

• 4 weeks of PTO to relax and recharge.

• Health, dental, and vision plans to support you and your family.

• 401(k) retirement savings plan with employer match and planning resources.

• Collaborative, team‑based culture that fuels innovation.

• Paid holidays and employee recognition programs to celebrate achievements.

• Community engagement and STEM outreach opportunities to give back locally.

jobs.title: Strategic Delivery Lead, Federal Civilian & State and Local Government
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The OpenAI for Government team brings frontier AI to public institutions to help them achieve their missions. We partner with government leaders, mission owners, and technical teams to deploy AI tools responsibly, with the reliability, security, and support needed for meaningful use.

Our Federal Civilian and State & Local Government business supports public institutions across a broad range of missions. We help these customers apply frontier AI to public services, knowledge work, research, and mission operations through hands-on delivery, tailored enablement, and collaboration with their teams.




ABOUT THE ROLE

The Strategic Delivery Lead (SDL), Federal Civilian & State and Local Government, will shape and deliver high-impact AI engagements across federal civilian agencies and state and local governments. You will turn customer priorities into practical deployments and sustained use, helping government leaders and mission teams apply OpenAI technology to public services, knowledge discovery, and operational workflows.

This individual contributor role reports to the leader of Federal Civilian and State & Local Government. You will work alongside Account Directors and Applied AI Architects across assigned engagements, coordinating Research, Product, Engineering, Policy, Security, and Enablement resources. Account Directors own commercial strategy, contracts, and quota; you own delivery coordination, adoption, and customer outcomes, without an individual sales quota.

You will lead execution across customer and OpenAI workstreams: define scope, milestones, acceptance criteria, dependencies, and success measures; surface risks; resolve blockers; and communicate progress to agency executives, program leaders, and working teams. You are accountable for agreed delivery commitments and customer acceptance. Engineering and Product teams remain responsible for technical implementation and operation of the systems they own.

This is a high-trust, high-autonomy role combining senior relationship leadership with hands-on execution. Success requires sound judgment, technical fluency, strong program management, and the ability to turn executive alignment into useful technology in government teams’ hands.

This role is based in Washington, DC, with domestic travel for high-value customer engagements, workshops, and delivery milestones.




IN THIS ROLE, YOU WILL:

 - Build trusted relationships with senior government leaders, program owners, and technical and mission teams to identify priorities and turn senior alignment into actionable engagements.

 - Own delivery plans for assigned federal civilian and state and local government engagements, with clear milestones, accountable owners, customer acceptance criteria, and measurable mission or operational outcomes.

 - Translate customer and mission needs into requirements and decisions that engineers, domain experts, and senior leaders can act on; communicate progress, limitations, risks, and dependencies clearly.

 - Connect customer mission and technical teams with OpenAI Research, Product, and Engineering teams to assess promising applications and move feasible opportunities into scoped, supported projects.

 - Coordinate the Applied AI Architect, specialist engineers, and customer technical teams on architecture, data access, evaluation, integration, and deployment requirements.

 - Build sustained adoption through practical enablement, user feedback, workflow support, and repeatable playbooks that can be applied across agencies and government customers.

 - Lead executive reviews and focused workshops in Washington and at customer sites, bringing the right decision-makers and technical experts together to resolve issues and advance delivery.

 - Identify security, data, infrastructure, contractual, and resourcing risks early; work with the accountable teams to resolve them and escalate decisions promptly.

 - Prioritize across a small, matrixed team, make clear trade-offs, and maintain momentum as customer needs and model capabilities evolve.

 - Coordinate with Account Directors, policy colleagues, and partners on broader government engagement, while keeping delivery commitments aligned with available resources and approved capabilities.
   
   


YOU’LL THRIVE IN THIS ROLE IF YOU:

 - Have 10+ years of experience leading complex technical programs, customer delivery, or transformation initiatives, including substantial work with federal civilian agencies, state or local governments, or comparable public institutions.

 - Can meet customer-specific access requirements. An active DOE Q and/or U.S. Government TS/SCI clearance is preferred for engagements involving national security missions.

 - Are willing to travel domestically when an in-person engagement materially advances customer priorities, relationships, or delivery; use Washington-based engagement and remote collaboration effectively.

 - Understand how government executives, program owners, acquisition stakeholders, and technical teams make decisions and deliver work; navigate organizational boundaries to turn priorities into execution.

 - Have led complex AI/ML, enterprise software, API, cloud, scientific computing, or digital transformation engagements through implementation and sustained adoption.

 - Bring executive presence and a record of influencing senior government leaders, while remaining personally accountable for follow-through with working teams.

 - Translate mission goals into practical execution plans, acceptance criteria, and measures such as workflow adoption, staff productivity, output quality, and time to a validated outcome.

 - Have enough technical fluency to evaluate AI use cases, challenge assumptions, and work credibly with architects and domain experts on data integration, model evaluation, and deployment trade-offs.

 - Are curious about frontier AI and actively experiment with the technology to understand its capabilities, limitations, and applications to government work.

 - Build durable partnerships across mission teams, engineers, security teams, program owners, and executives; thrive in ambiguity and take initiative in a fast-moving environment.

 - See yourself as a bridge between frontier AI research and practical mission impact, with the judgment to distinguish a promising demonstration from a validated outcome.

 - Help customers use AI responsibly, with appropriate data protection, human review, provenance, reproducibility, and validation suited to the mission and use case.

 - Existing relationships across federal civilian agencies or state and local governments are valuable. Experience with DOE, national labs, NASA, or NSF is one relevant area of expertise.



About OpenAI

OpenAI is an AI research and deployment company dedicated to ensuring that general-purpose artificial intelligence benefits all of humanity. We push the boundaries of the capabilities of AI systems and seek to safely deploy them to the world through our products. AI is an extremely powerful tool that must be created with safety and human needs at its core, and to achieve our mission, we must encompass and value the many different perspectives, voices, and experiences that form the full spectrum of humanity. 

We are an equal opportunity employer, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability, genetic information, or other applicable legally protected characteristic.

jobs.title: Social Worker – Hospital Social Work
jobs.description:
Liquid Personnel is recruiting an Adult’s Social Worker to join its client’s Hospital team, based in Bournemouth. This is an excellent opportunity for a dedicated practitioner to work within a busy acute hospital setting, supporting adults with complex care and support needs through safe, timely, and person-centred discharge planning.

The successful candidate will work closely with health professionals, carers, families, community services, and partner agencies to facilitate effective hospital discharge and promote positive outcomes. You will undertake strengths-based assessments, coordinate support arrangements, and help individuals maximise their independence and wellbeing following hospital admission.

This role is ideally suited to a Social Worker with recent hospital social work experience and a strong understanding of Discharge to Assess pathways, Adult Social Care legislation, and multidisciplinary working.

What will your responsibilities be?

• Managing a caseload of adults requiring social care intervention within an acute hospital setting.

• Undertaking strengths-based assessments to identify needs, risks, strengths, and desired outcomes.

• Completing Care Act 2014 assessments, reviews, and support planning to facilitate safe and effective discharge arrangements.

• Supporting complex discharge planning and ensuring appropriate services and support are in place following discharge from hospital.

• Working within Discharge to Assess pathways to promote independence and reduce reliance on long-term support where appropriate.

• Undertaking Mental Capacity Assessments and facilitating Best Interest decision-making in accordance with the Mental Capacity Act 2005.

• Leading and contributing to safeguarding enquiries in line with Adult Safeguarding legislation and local procedures.

• Assessing and managing risks effectively, balancing safety, choice, independence, and positive risk-taking.

• Working collaboratively with health professionals, therapists, discharge coordinators, community services, carers, families, and partner agencies.

• Arranging and coordinating care packages, reablement services, community support, and placements where required.

• Participating in multidisciplinary meetings, discharge planning meetings, safeguarding discussions, and case reviews.

• Preparing high-quality assessments, reports, support plans, and professional documentation.

• Maintaining accurate, timely, and legally compliant case records in accordance with statutory and organisational requirements.

Qualifications and Experience:

To be successful in this role you must have;

• Professional Qualification: MA, BA, BSc in Social Work, Diploma in Social Work, CQSW, CSS, or equivalent recognised Social Work qualification.

• Registration: Must be registered with Social Work England.

• Experience: Significant post-qualified experience within Adult Social Care services.

• Hospital Experience: Recent experience working within a Hospital Social Work Team, Hospital Discharge Team, or Discharge to Assess service is highly desirable.

• Legislation Knowledge: Strong understanding of the Care Act 2014, Mental Capacity Act 2005, Adult Safeguarding legislation, and associated statutory guidance.

• Discharge Planning Experience: Experience supporting complex discharge planning and hospital discharge pathways.

• Assessment Skills: Proven ability to undertake complex assessments, support planning, risk management, and safeguarding interventions.

• Safeguarding Experience: Experience undertaking safeguarding enquiries and managing safeguarding concerns involving vulnerable adults.

• Multi-Agency Working: Strong experience working collaboratively with health professionals, community teams, care providers, carers, families, and partner agencies.

• Communication Skills: Excellent communication, report-writing, analytical, negotiation, and decision-making skills.

• Professional Practice: Commitment to strengths-based, person-centred practice and continuous professional development.

Why Liquid Personnel?

• Free DBS and compliance service

• Twice weekly payroll and ‘Faster Pay’ service, getting you paid more quickly

• Access to exclusive roles that aren’t available from other agencies

• Free access to Liquid’s exclusive social work training and CPD portal

• Your own dedicated consultant with extensive social work knowledge

• Access to a wide selection of social work positions across the UK

• “Refer a Friend” bonus – get £500 for each social worker you refer who we successfully place*

• “Find your own job” bonus – get £250 for bringing your own position to us *

Liquid Personnel is an equal opportunities employer. Liquid Personnel Ltd is acting as an Employment Business in relation to this vacancy. * Terms and conditions apply to our bonus schemes.

jobs.title: Lead Device Software Engineer
jobs.description:
ConnectDER (www.ConnectDER.com) represents the next generation in US-based resource technology product development. Our signature product, the ConnectDER Meter Socket Adapter, dramatically cuts down the cost and interconnection time for solar energy, EV charging, and home battery storage, putting clean, resilient power within reach of millions of homeowners. With a pipeline of exciting innovations, we’re only just getting started on our journey to transform how the world makes and consumes its energy.

We are a dynamic, venture-backed company based in Philadelphia, PA, near Center City, with a team of over 50 dedicated professionals working in remote, hybrid, and on-site roles across the United States. As we continue to grow, we are committed to developing cutting-edge products that empower technology partners, installers, electricians, and their customers. We seek talented individuals who can deliver high-quality service and drive the value of clean energy resources forward.

Our culture is collaborative, transparent, and team-oriented. We value open communication and people who bring thoughtful perspectives to the table. If you're looking for an opportunity to stretch your skills, get creative, and be a part of something new and meaningful, ConnectDER is the place for you!

All full-time employees receive access to comprehensive benefits including:

• Health insurance plan - we cover 75% for employees, spouses, and children.

• Flexible paid time off – take the time off that you need.

• 401K with company match – we want to help you meet your future financial goals.

• Equity stock options - your opportunity to share in the success of the company.

This is a hands-on technical lead role as part of a team of 3 firmware engineers, reporting to the Director of Electrical Engineering. In this role, you will own the device software system end to end, defining the architecture, breaking it into well-scoped workstreams, and driving fast, iterative delivery. You will both write production code, and delegate tasks to the team.

You will be responsible for the IslandDER digital interface, built to comply with a new device-to-device communication standard we are co-developing with the leading battery and inverter companies for secure integration with home batteries (e.g., Tesla Powerwall) and Vehicle-to-Home (V2H) solutions. The software monitors voltage and current, drives relays, performs safety checks, and communicates securely with third-party devices and the ConnectDER cloud.

The device software breaks into four subsystems you'll own: Data Acquisition (grid/microgrid metering), Control (real-time, safety-critical), Communication (Ethernet, WireGuard, multi-core interfaces), and Integration (fault tolerance, firmware updates, security, logging).

In your first year, you might:

• Write the design diagrams and safety case for the IslandDER's safety-critical software, and sit across the table from the NRTL to defend it.

• Bring up firmware on a new board with the EE team, debugging across the hardware/software boundary with a logic analyzer.

• Stand up the code-signing pipeline so a production firmware build can be signed and shipped as a verified OTA update.

• Hand a teammate a well-scoped metering or comms workstream with a clean interface, then review their PRs.

• Tighten a line-frequency control loop that's missing its timing budget.

Responsibilities will include:

• Systems Architecture & Leadership: Own the overall device software architecture. Break complex requirements into well-scoped workstreams, delegate with clean interfaces, and guide the team while staying hands-on where it matters.

• Device Software Safety Architecture: Architect and implement the safety-critical software, scoping the safety boundary tightly and owning the FMEA, safety case, and NRTL certification.

• Metering: Design and implement revenue-grade metering systems, including data acquisition, signal processing, and calibration.

• Hardware-Software Co-Design: Partner with electrical engineering — co-defining requirements, driving board bring-up, debugging across the boundary, and influencing hardware design for testability and safety.

• Firmware Integrity & Updates: Own the secure firmware-update path, including secure boot, code signing, and the key-management system behind it.

• Build, Test & Scale: Keep a modern CI/CD pipeline and testable code and take systems from prototype to mass production.

Minimum Qualifications:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science, with 7+ years in firmware engineering and a track record of shipping new products at scale.

• Rigorous system design and documentation: you bring an exacting commitment to clear, thorough technical documentation and design diagrams, and the discipline to drive a complex safety certification (e.g., IEC 61508 / IEC 60730 / UL 1998) to completion.

• Technical leadership: you've led the technical direction of a project. You architect the approach, partition it into workstreams for others, and still ship code yourself.

• Embedded mastery: expert in C, C++, and/or Rust, with deep experience debugging embedded systems via oscilloscopes, logic analyzers, and JTAG/SWD.

• Deep bare-metal/RTOS firmware experience on modern 32-bit microcontrollers, including low-level architecture and multi-core memory optimization. (ARM Cortex-M or similar.)

• AI-assisted development with ownership: sophisticated use of AI coding agents paired with full ownership; you can explain every significant decision you ship.

• A bias for fast iteration and judgment to size effort to business value, with the communication skills to explain complex requirements to diverse stakeholders.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Master's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, or Computer Science

• Prior experience taking safety-critical software through NRTL certification.

• Matter/Thread device commissioning (SPAKE2+/PASE, setup-code or QR pairing).

• Protocols & build: I2C, UART, SPI, CAN/CAN-FD, and Ethernet; build systems (Make, CMake); test automation and CI/CD.

• Embedded TCP/IP networking (e.g., lwIP); experience implementing WireGuard or similar secure tunnels on a real-time embedded platform

• Reverse-engineering CAN protocols or developing custom evaluation tools.

• Experience configuring and using an RTOS for multi-threaded, timing-critical applications across metrology, safety, and communications.

• Experience with PX5 or ThreadX.

• Experience designing or operating a code-signing / PKI system for firmware (key custody, signing pipeline, secure boot verification, key rotation and revocation).

• Familiarity with relevant standards, e.g., UL 1741/IEEE 1547, UL 3141, UL 2900 (cybersecurity), and ANSI C12.1 (metering).

US Salary Range

$155,000—$175,000 USD

To apply, please submit your resume. Applications without a resume will not be considered.

jobs.description:
Company Overview

Maven AGI sits at the center of the hottest intersection in tech right now: AI and customer experience. While most "AI support" tools still focus on FAQs and deflection, Maven's agents actually do the work — autonomously interacting with customers, personalizing the conversation, and resolving complex issues, not just providing information.

That's not a soft ROI story. It's the most direct cost-displacement case in enterprise software today: real human work, replaced, at a fraction of the cost — not "savings if you use it well," but savings because the agent did the ticket instead of a person. 

Founded in 2023 by executives from HubSpot, Google, and Stripe, Maven builds conversational AI agents that don't just answer customers — they act: going into a customer's account, finding the actual problem, and fixing it, with no human required. Customers like Dell, ServPro, HardRock, Tripadvisor, Clio, and Thumbtack rely on Maven, with independently verified results — customers report resolving 70–93% of interactions autonomously — and G2 has named Maven a High Performer and Best Meets Requirements across multiple categories this spring.

Position Overview

We're hiring a senior individual contributor to own demand generation at Maven. You'll set the strategy and own the number, and you'll also do the building yourself: configuring the platforms, launching the campaigns, writing the workflows, and pulling the data. We're looking for someone who enjoys hands-on work and doesn't see it as a step on the way to managing people.

Our GTM motion runs on tight collaboration between marketing, SDRs, and AEs, and this role sits at the center of it. Day to day, you'll work closely with SDRs and AEs to make sure demand turns into real pipeline, not leads that sit in a queue. Inbound is a major part of the job, and you'll also drive outbound programs and ABM against our enterprise accounts.

Given our stage, this role also leans toward growth. You should be comfortable going beyond traditional demand gen channels into experiment-driven tactics when they'll move the number, and comfortable building the systems that make those experiments cheap to run.

What You'll Do

 - Own the demand generation strategy and number: build and run multi-channel campaigns across inbound (paid ads, website conversion) and outbound (technographic targeting, sequences run with SDRs), with inbound as a primary driver of pipeline volume
