jobs.title: Center-Based Registered Behavior Technician
jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds.

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

Pay Range: $19 - $20

Requirements:

• Passionate about helping children with autism.

• Patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team.

• 18+ years of age

• High school diploma or GED

• Ability to obtain a CPR, First Aid Certification and Tuberculosis test (if you haven’t had one in the last year)

• Ability to pass a pre employment background check

• Ability to move in various positions (sit, squat, bend, etc.)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds

Perks of Working at Centria:

• Structured career path in the field of Behavioral Analysis

• Discounts to hundreds of retail partners via our Benefit Hub

• Access to Centria’s Employee Assistance Plan with benefits around mental health and counseling

• Unlimited opportunities to make an impact in the life of a special needs child

• Early wage access to employees- Work today, get paid tomorrow with Rain!

We are an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, Veteran status, or disability status. jobs.title: Facility Operator
jobs.description:
ABOUT FLUIDSTACK

We exist to make humanity more free. For most of human history, you farmed or you starved. Technology gave people more time for the things they wanted to do, instead of things they had to do. Powerful AI will be the biggest lever for human choice we've ever built - but only if models are aligned with what humanity actually wants. There are groups building AI who don't share these goals. Whoever deploys frontier compute infrastructure fastest will decide whether AI expands human freedom or shrinks it. 


We're singularly focused on delivering 10 to 100s of GWs of compute faster than anyone else, rethinking every layer of the stack. We acquire power, design and build data centers, and operate them - with teams spanning hardware and software. Speed and scale are our key differentiators. Come be a part of building civilization-scale infrastructure for AI.


We hire people who care deeply about this problem space. If that is you, please apply!




HOW WE OPERATE

 - Be a barrel. Full autonomy. Own things end to end, take on scope without being asked, no permission required to operate outside your core role.

 - Insane urgency. We drive everything forward as fast as possible.

 - Reason from first principles. Challenge every assumption. Zero analogy thinking, no egos, the best idea wins.

 - Love of the game. The frontier of AI is the most interesting problem of our time. We put in long hours at high intensity to push the frontier forward.

 - Build something that actually matters. If you're going to spend your time, spend it on something that matters to the world.




THE DATA CENTER OPERATIONS TEAM

Examples of key problems the team is working on

 - Operate at the scale of a nation, not a building. Accelerating toward 10s to 100s of GWs by the end of the decade, more than the entire electricity consumption of many countries. You won't just run a data center; you'll run infrastructure the size of a G7.

 - Fly the plane while it's being built. Running flawless operations inside a live construction zone, adapting in real time and turning the pace of build-out into our advantage. You will redefine operational excellence.

 - Write the playbook, don't inherit it. Most operators step into someone else's system. Here you build one, leaving your fingerprints on how the whole company runs. As we scale 100x, you'll set the standards, shape the operating model, and grow the team by the thousands
   
   .


ROLE SCOPE

 - Serve as the on-site SME for data center critical infrastructure, handling escalations across the white space and the supporting facilities.

 - Understand and manage the design limitations and risks of the site, and audit colocation partners and service providers on their maintenance programs and effectiveness.

 - Own the change management process for high-risk maintenance activities in the data center.

 - Act as first responder on-site for incidents, driving resolution with support from engineering and infrastructure SMEs.

 - Partner with colo partners, vendors, and internal teams to keep the site reliable, and feed operational learnings back into design and process.
   
    


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

The below is a starting point. We always make space for exceptional people, so if you don't fit this role exactly, tell us where you would. https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/fluidstack/05c2e69c-42f9-4fcb-9cf0-a467aaf98f1c

 - You've operated or led critical-facilities operations in a live data center, owning the physical infrastructure that keeps a site running.

 - You know the critical-infrastructure stack (power and cooling) well enough to be the on-site authority and handle escalations.

 - You run change management for high-risk work and hold partners to a real maintenance standard.

 - You're a calm, capable first responder when something fails at 3am.

 - You audit, document, and improve, leaving the site's operating posture stronger than you found it.

 - Bonus: Hyperscale or colocation operations. Uptime Institute or NFPA familiarity. Critical environment and MOP/EOP experience. Vendor and colo management.
   
    


SALARY & BENEFITS

 - Competitive total compensation package (salary + equity).

 - Retirement or pension plan, in line with local norms.

 - Health, dental, and vision insurance.

 - Generous PTO policy, in line with local norms.

Total compensation may also include equity in the form of restricted stock units.

 



We are committed to pay equity and transparency.

Fluidstack is an Equal Employment Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability and protected veterans’ status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Fluidstack will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records pursuant to applicable law.



You will receive a confirmation email once your application has successfully been accepted. If there is an error with your submission and you did not receive a confirmation email, please email careers@fluidstack.io with your resume/CV, the role you've applied for, and the date you submitted your application--  someone from our recruiting team will be in touch.

jobs.title: Site Surveyor - Hampton, Georgia
jobs.description:
Introduction to XYZ

XYZ Reality are the creators of the world's first and only engineering-grade Augmented Reality solution, purpose built for the construction industry. Not only have we created this holographic technology, that sits within The Atom – a smart, site-safe headset/hardhat - but we implement it on projects, utilising the power of AR to ensure that all schemes are completed in line with the delivery timescales and budgets.

 

XYZ has grown to over 100 staff across the UK, US & Europe and is working with Mission Critical organisations & construction companies to successfully deliver major projects.

 

Role Summary

As a Site Surveyor at XYZ Reality, you will be responsible for establishing and maintaining both primary and secondary control on-site using a Robotic Total Station to enable the usage of the Atom. Once established, part of your daily tasks will be to wear the Atom, using it to eliminate construction and design errors on-site, which would otherwise lead to costly and time-consuming rework.

 

Key Responsibilities

 - Using a Robotic Total Station to establish primary and secondary control via traversing / resection.

 - Conducting daily site inspections using the Atom (Augmented Reality headset) to ensure works are installed/being installed correctly, as per the BIM Model.

 - Client communication and reporting

 - Producing reports based on the inspections from that day.

 - Attending meetings to coordinate with contractors to plan daily activities.

 - Processing and reviewing all acquired data to ensure it is accurate and reliable.

 - Reporting to the Field Operations Manager, maintaining an efficient workflow and ensuring all requested inspections are conducted within the specified time frame.

 - Working with the Contractor to devise a weekly lookahead of inspections in line with the master construction programme to de-risk incorrect installation from taking place in the field.

 - Obtaining and preparing the latest approved Revit models to export into HoloSite

 

Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

 - Experience in construction surveying or engineering surveying.

 - Strong experience using Robotic Total Stations for construction layout and control.

 - Experience working on large-scale construction or infrastructure projects is preferred

 - Knowledge related to 3D software (Revit, Navisworks etc) or BIM / BIM360 is desirable but not essential and can be taught

 - Must be confident in using Microsoft Office

 

Benefits & Good to Knows

· Competitive salary based on 40-hour week

· 15 days paid time off + public holidays

· Healthcare 

· Working on-site on MAJOR multimillion/billion-dollar construction projects

· Travel and relocation opportunities across the US

· Push boundaries and deliver cutting-edge technology that is going to change the construction industry forever

· Professional development opportunities

 

If you'd like to see the products and technology we have created so far on our journey you can view it in action through our YouTube https://www.youtube.com/@XYZReality/videos and Website http://www.xyzreality.com/

 

Essential: You must have a clean criminal record and be willing to undergo background checks and drugs tests due to security requirements of the projects we work on.

 

This is a permanent role. Ongoing assignments will be subject to project availability and the candidate’s flexibility to travel or relocate.

jobs.title: Workplace Experience Manager
jobs.description:
About the role

Sei Development Foundation is seeking an experienced, proactive, and detail-oriented Workplace Experience Manager to oversee our physical office space in the NoHo neighborhood of New York City. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in dynamic environments, loves solving problems independently, and wants to contribute to a fast-moving blockchain company that’s building at the frontier of web3.

We are a hybrid company with one home: our office in NoHo. We believe the best ideas, strongest relationships, and real sense of belonging come from time spent together. So when our team comes in, we want the office to feel like the center of our community. Our office is a beautiful space in one of New York's best neighborhoods. It's where we do our best work together, host offsites and team gatherings, and celebrate wins.

We're looking for someone to make it feel alive. You'll create the experiences that make people want to walk through the door: thoughtful details, great events, and a space that runs so smoothly no one has to think about it. You'll balance operational excellence with real hospitality, and culture and community will always be your north star.

You'll be a part of the Operations team, but this role is yours to run. You're our sole owner of workplace experience, with no facilities team behind you, so you'll bring a builder's mindset and the drive to get things done yourself. As a 5 days/week on-site role, you'll be the steady presence in the office, welcoming people on the days they come in and making each one count.

What you'll do

Office operations & vendors

 - Run daily office operations: front-of-house, mail and packages, supplies, and general upkeep

 - Own vendor and landlord relationships, including sourcing, contracts, renewals, and service quality

 - Be the first point of contact for employee requests and office issues, and resolve them yourself or find who can

Facilities, supplies & budget

 - Manage facilities needs such as space planning, repairs, equipment, and safety compliance

 - Own the office budget: track spend, negotiate pricing, and flag cost-saving opportunities

 - Manage snacks, supplies, and inventory

Events & culture

 - Plan and run team events, including offsites and office happy hours and gatherings

 - Coordinate company-wide moments such as all-hands and milestone celebrations

 - Gather employee feedback and keep improving the workplace experience

What we're looking for

 - 3–6 years in office management, workplace experience, facilities, or a similar operations role

 - Track record of working independently as the sole owner of an area

 - Strong vendor management and budgeting skills

 - Experience planning events from start to finish

 - Highly organized and proactive: you spot problems before they're reported

 - Clear, warm communicator who treats colleagues as customers

 - Comfortable in a small company where you'll wear many hats

 - Able to work on-site at our Manhattan office 5 days a week

 - Experience with workplace tools (e.g., Google Workspace, Envoy, Slack, expense/procurement platforms)

Nice to have

 - Passion for web3 and interest in blockchain ecosystems

 - Experience at a startup or high-growth company

jobs.title: Vice President, Transportation Business Development Lead
jobs.description:
AECOM is seeking a dynamic and experienced Vice President, Business Development Lead to drive business growth for Texas Department of Transportation (TxDOT). This external facing leader will represent AECOM with TxDOT and be responsible for statewide business development, strategy, and relationship across TxDOT’s Central Office and districts and divisions. The key goal is expanding our presence and winning new and repeat business for all of AECOM’s service offerings. This role requires a deep understanding of TxDOT as well as Texas transportation policies, procedures, and regulations.

This position is expected to begin immediately.

Job Summary/Responsibilities

With a 75-year legacy in Texas, AECOM maintains a strong TxDOT presence with offices in major markets across the state, including Dallas, Fort Worth, Houston, Austin, San Antonio, El Paso, and other key locations. AECOM’s 480 transportation professionals in Texas have supported TxDOT and municipal clients for many decades. Our talented teams combine local knowledge with the resources of a global infrastructure consulting firm, enabling us to deliver planning, environmental, engineering, program management, and construction-phase services throughout the state. Our intent with this role is to build on this depth of experience to grow and expand our support to TxDOT.

The Business Development lead will need to be a growth minded leader who can work collaboratively with other senior leaders in Transportation and other Business Lines to drive strategic planning, business development, sales & marketing, opportunity identification, capture management, and relationship building.  The candidate should be able to demonstrate knowledge of the engineering and construction industry, develop knowledge of the company, and help recruit as we expand our presence.

The responsibilities of this position may include, but are not limited to:

• Fully accountable for business development activities with TxDOT in collaboration with leaders across the AECOM Texas business.
• Represent AECOM and serve a point of contact with TxDOT Leadership.
• Manage the successful delivery of projects by aligning AECOM’s local and global resources and ensuring resources adhere to local transportation regulations, safety standards, and contractual obligations.
• Serve as a Principal-in-Charge on larger projects to provide executive oversight on the project's overall success, client relationship, financial performance and high-level risk management.
• Monitor the Department's needs and trends within the transportation industry, providing insights and recommendations for strategic initiatives.
• Identify opportunities for expanding the scope of services offered to the Department and collaborate with pursuit teams to develop proposals.
• Coordinate with technical teams to ensure that solutions align with the Department's goals and regulatory requirements.
• Prepare comprehensive reports and presentations for AECOM leadership highlighting project status, key account performance metrics, and areas for improvement.
• Maintain a high profile with TxDOT and transportation industry. Attend conferences and workshops to strengthen existing TxDOT relationships and establish new TxDOT relationships.
• Has a keen understanding of industry trends and market drivers.
• Provides leadership in recruiting, training, and retaining top talent for TxDOT opportunities and projects.

Benefits:

• Competitive salary and performance-based incentives.
• Comprehensive benefits package, including health insurance, retirement plans, and more.
• Opportunity to make a meaningful impact on transportation projects that enhance public infrastructure and safety.
• Professional development opportunities to stay updated on changing government regulations and industry trends.
• Collaborative and dynamic work environment that values innovation and teamwork.

Minimum Requirements

• BA/BS + 12 years of relevant experience or demonstrated equivalency of experience and/or education, including 4 years of leadership.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with and knowledge of TxDOT standards, policies, regulations, and procedures within a government context.
• Experience in business development and strong existing relationships with TxDOT.
• Existing relationships within the transportation community in Texas, and active involvement in relevant professional organizations
• Team-oriented and able to work in a fast-paced environment with minimal supervision.
• Strong understanding of best practices in capture process for professional services

• This role does not provide Visa Sponsorship.

At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.

About AECOM

AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.

AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.

What makes AECOM a great place to work

You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. jobs.title: Behavior Technician- Work with Kids - Training Provided
jobs.description:
We are looking for enthusiastic individuals to join our team as Behavior Technicians. As a Behavior Technician, you will have the opportunity to make a real difference in the lives of children with autism.

In this role, you will work one-on-one with children, implementing individualized behavior intervention plans under the guidance of a Board Certified Behavior Analyst (BCBA). You will use evidence-based techniques to teach communication, social, and daily living skills while reducing interfering behaviors.

We are looking for candidates who are passionate about helping children with autism reach their full potential. You will need to be patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team environment. We will provide comprehensive training so that you are equipped and empowered to help each child, even if you don’t currently have experience. Children can be unpredictable and potentially confrontational, so this role is not for the weak of spirit, mind, or body. Part of the joy of working with kids is exercise! Our clients move, so you need to be comfortable standing, walking, sitting, grasping, reaching, bending, kneeling, crouching, squatting, lifting, and at times carrying children or objects that weigh up to 50 pounds

At the end of each day, you will go home knowing that you have made a meaningful impact on the life of a child and their family. Join us and become a part of a dedicated team that is changing lives for the better. Apply now to start your journey as a Behavior Technician with us!

Pay Range: $19 - $24

Requirements:

• Passionate about helping children with autism.

• Patient, compassionate, and able to work well in a team.

• 18+ years of age

• High school diploma or GED

• Ability to obtain a CPR, First Aid Certification and Tuberculosis test (if you haven’t had one in the last year)

• Ability to pass a pre employment background check

• Ability to move in various positions (sit, squat, bend, etc.)

• Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds.

• Unlimited opportunities to make an impact in the life of a special needs child

jobs.title: Care Coordinator
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Evergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care. We believe patients living with kidney disease deserve the best care. We are committed to improving patient outcomes and improving quality of life by delaying disease progression, shifting care to the home, and accelerating kidney transplants.

We help nephrologists focus on the right patients at the right time across the full care spectrum. We do this by providing them with the best-in-class interdisciplinary clinical resources, analytical insight and tools, and services to patients. We listen to the needs of our patients, our employees, and our client partners, continually working to push beyond the status quo in which the care system manages patients today.

Who You Are

You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

Your Role

The Evergreen Chronic Care Management (CCM) Medical Assistant (Care Coordinator) supports proactive care coordination services for patients with complex chronic conditions, including chronic kidney disease (CKD), hypertension, diabetes, cardiovascular disease, and related comorbidities. Working under Evergreen’s clinical supervision, the Care Coordinator conducts patient outreach, creates, maintains, and reinforces established care plans, supports documentation compliance, and coordinates communication between patients, providers, and healthcare partners.

This role is outreach-driven and operationally focused, requiring strong organization, patient communication skills, and the ability to manage a high-volume patient panel. Experience supporting nephrology or CKD patient populations is strongly preferred.

The program uses SMS as the first-line channel for patient engagement, with phone outreach used when appropriate.

While this position is fully remote, you must be able to work 8:00am – 5:00pm in the central time zone.

Role Responsibilities

Some responsibilities may vary based on specific patient programs, but this role's primary duties include the following:

• Patient Enrollment & Eligibility Support CCM patient enrollment and onboarding activities. Verify eligibility based on Evergreen and payer program guidelines. Ensure patient consent documentation is completed prior to outreach. Proactively maintain patient engagement regularly. Identify inactive or non-engaged patients and escalate appropriately.

• Patient Outreach & Engagement Conduct text & telephonic outreach to enrolled CCM patients weekly. Achieve required engagement time standards aligned with Medicare CCM billing requirements. Support achievement of required engagement time for billing compliance. Reinforce provider-directed care plans during patient interactions. Identify barriers to adherence including medication access, transportation, or social needs.

• Expected activities include: High-volume outbound patient calling and texting. Follow-up outreach attempts.

• Documentation & Billing Compliance Document patient interactions accurately within the CCM patient management platform and EHR systems. Track engagement time consistent with Medicare CCM billing requirements. Maintain audit-ready documentation standards. Ensure HIPAA and PHI compliance.

• Patient Care Coordination & Clinical Workflow Facilitate patient access to their referring provider and clinical staff. Support care transitions following hospitalizations or ED visits. Coordinate referrals and follow-up appointments. Escalate symptom concerns or medication issues to licensed clinical staff.

• Preferred experience includes: Chronic kidney disease patient populations. Dialysis patient coordination. Medication adherence monitoring. Kidney transplant or specialty referrals.

• Technology & Communication Utilize CCM platform and EHR systems daily. Manage patient messaging workflows. Collaborate with remote clinical and operational teams.

Required Qualifications

• Certified Medical Assistant

• 1–3 years healthcare experience

• Chronic disease or nephrology experience is preferred.

• Strong clinical assessment, communication, and documentation skills.

• Comfortable working in two systems (EHR + CCM platform) simultaneously.

• Ability to manage a structured, metric-driven workflow with reliability.

• Intermediate skills with MS Office Suite of products including Outlook and Teams

• Able to work effectively in a primarily remote environment: Home internet must support a minimum download speed of 25 Mbps and upload speed of 10 Mbps. Cable, Fiber, or DSL connections hardwired to the internet device are recommended Evergreen will provide remote employees with telephony applications and equipment to meet the business requirements for their role Employees must work from a dedicated space lacking ongoing interruptions to protect member PHI / HIPAA information

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in chronic disease management

• Prior work in virtual care, remote nursing, or telehealth programs.

• Bilingual (Spanish/English)

• Familiarity with CCM regulatory requirements.

• Strong patient education and motivational interviewing skills.

Compensation

The pay range for this role is $45,000 to $52,000 annually. Exact pay is determined based on experience, education, demand for the role, and other role-specific factors.

This role is also eligible for a bonus.

Benefits

Evergreen Nephrology’s total rewards program is designed to support you in and outside of work. You can expect:

• Paid time off starting at 4 weeks for full-time employees

• 12 paid holidays per year

• Medical, dental, vision and life insurance, including an HSA with employer match

• Reimbursement for continuing medical education for eligible roles

• A 401(k) program where Evergreen matches up to 4% of contributions after six months of tenure

• Paid parental leave

• A robust training and development program that starts with onboarding and continues throughout your career with Evergreen Nephrology

Evergreen Nephrology is an equal opportunity employer. Applicants will not be discriminated against because of race, color, creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, religion, national origin, citizenship status, disability, ancestry, marital status, veteran status, medical condition or any other protected category under local, state or federal laws.

If you are an applicant with a disability who requires reasonable accommodation for any part of the hiring process, please contact us for assistance at recruiting@evergreennephrology.com.

jobs.title: Senior Technical Application and Onboarding Specialist
jobs.description:
Help make the world more hospitable

The hospitality industry is uniquely human, and it deserves technology that’s just as inspiring as the people behind it. At Mews, we’re transforming the industry with a platform that helps hotels run smarter, move faster and create better guest experiences.

You’ll work with smart, curious people who care deeply about what they do. You’ll have autonomy and the trust to make good decisions and move quickly. And you’ll enjoy a real sense of purpose as you see the impact of what we’re building.

If you’re motivated by ownership, curiosity and meaningful impact, and are driven to deliver consistent high performance, you’ll feel at home here.

About the role

Let's get into the specifics. It’s impossible to capture every nuance of a role – especially at a rapidly growing company like Mews – but if we had to distil it into a job description (which we do because this is a job description), it would be this:

You'd own one Mews product area end to end from the Specialist Hub: the hardest technical implementations in it, the escalations that Onboarding Managers and Support can't resolve from the knowledge base, and the operational health of the whole thing, from onboarding performance and SLAs to the documentation the rest of Customer Success relies on. When a customer's setup involves non-standard configuration, API work or integrations nobody has wired up before, it comes to you, and so does the question of how to stop that case recurring.

Hotels increasingly run on Mews as the hub for payments, distribution, POS and dozens of connected systems, which makes implementations more technical and more consequential every year. This role exists to make sure that complexity gets resolved properly, documented once, and fed back into the product. You sit between Onboarding, Customer Success, Product and R&D, with a direct line into testing, blitz testing and product feedback, so what you learn from customers shapes what gets built.

What you would do

• Support complex implementations for your product area, including configuration, integrations, APIs and non-standard requirements, and act as the technical escalation point when something is blocking a go-live

• Act as third-tier support to Onboarding Managers and Customer Success on configuration, troubleshooting and edge cases, and advise CSMs on what is and isn't feasible for new leads

• Own the performance metrics for your area (CSAT, time to resolution, repeat question rate, deflection rate) and act when timelines, SLAs or onboarding health are at risk, before they become blockers

• Own and maintain the knowledge base content for your product area, and use AI to redesign how it gets written, kept current and checked, building approaches the wider Specialist Hub can follow

• Work with Product and R&D on technical escalations, recurring onboarding problems and product feedback, and contribute to product testing, hackathons and strategic projects

AI Fluency Level 3: in this role that means AI is part of how you run your product area, not just how you draft faster. You rethink how knowledge base content for your area gets created, maintained and verified, how escalations get triaged and how you spot patterns in your queue; you turn what works into approaches the rest of the Specialist Hub can adopt; and you check AI output against real product behaviour before it reaches a customer or a colleague.

For more information on AI fluency at Mews, please refer to "AI Fluency at Mews: A Comprehensive Guide for Candidates".

What you would bring

• 3+ years in technical applications, implementation, onboarding or technical support in a SaaS environment, with proven experience supporting complex implementations and managing multiple priorities independently

• Hands-on troubleshooting across software configuration, integrations and APIs, and the ability to translate a customer's technical requirements into the right implementation approach

• An analytical, metrics-led approach to spotting risk early and taking action on it, with the project management skills to keep several implementations moving at once

• Experience building or improving processes, not just following them, and clear communication with both technical and non-technical audiences, from engineers to hotel general managers

• AI Fluency Level 3 or the equivalent hands-on experience: you've already redesigned how you or your team works using AI, and you check what it produces rather than taking it at face value

Nice to have

• Working knowledge of Salesforce, Jira and Confluence

• Experience in hospitality technology or with PMS, payments or distribution systems

• A bachelor's degree in a relevant field, or equivalent practical experience

United States

$105,500—$136,500 USD

Pay Transparency at Mews

Salary ranges are provided in good faith and reflect current market conditions and internal pay structures. Final compensation may be adjusted based on funding, budget constraints, or exceptional candidate qualifications, but will remain within reasonable proximity to the stated range.

This salary disclosure is provided in compliance with applicable pay transparency legislation. We are committed to equal pay practices and prohibit salary history inquiries during our recruitment process.

If the location you're applying from wasn't originally advertised for this role, salary range information is available upon request at any point during the application/interview process - your recruiter will be able to help.

What’s in it for you?

Our success is powered by our incredible people, supported by benefits that help them thrive.

Global benefits

No matter where you’re based, you’ll enjoy:

• Unlimited paid holiday (yes, really)

• Participation in our company share program

• Paid parental leave (6 months fully paid for primary caregivers, 2 months for secondary, available after one year of service)

• An annual Learning budget of €300 (and more for high performers) to support your development

• Monthly "EDGE" time to Explore, Develop, Grow, and Elevate yourself

• A work from anywhere policy with flexibility to work abroad for a few weeks each year

• Relocation options, available after one year

• Flexible, hybrid working options

• A home office setup budget to make your workspace your own and a monthly work-from-home allowance

• Claude tokens, so you can automate workflows and build smarter, more efficient ways of working

Local benefits

You'll receive additional benefits that vary by location, from healthcare and retirement plans to team events, socials and other perks. Ask us about it during your interview process.

Life at Mews

We’re an equal opportunities employer. We value teams that reflect the diversity of the customers and communities we serve. Different perspectives make better ideas, stronger products and a more welcoming company.

We also believe transparency is important when deciding if you're the right fit. Mews is an ambitious, high-pressure environment of continuous learning and high standards. Success here requires resilience, adaptability and a willingness to solve difficult problems.

A few things that define how we work:

• High autonomy means high responsibility. People are expected to take ownership and drive outcomes. There isn’t a detailed playbook for everything, and that’s part of what makes the work challenging – and rewarding.

• Change is constant. We’re growing quickly and adapting as we scale. Teams, processes and priorities continue to evolve, and only people who stay curious and agile will thrive.

• We’re remote-first, not relationship-free. Flexibility is core to how we work, but strong relationships still matter. Our teams are global, so we need expert collaborators and communicators to help us move forward together.

• AI is an integral part of our processes. It’s not here to steal people’s jobs, but to amplify efficiency and productivity. We’re motivated to proactively use the technology to seek out better ways of working and share our findings with the rest of the company.

If there's anything we can do to support you during the application process, let us know.

We don't discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, nationality, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, disability or any other protected characteristic.

One final thing: don't hold back. If you don't meet 100% of the criteria in this job description but you're certain you could make a big impact, apply. Everyone should have equal access to opportunities, and we're committed to providing an inclusive experience.

If Mews sounds like the kind of environment where you'd thrive, we'd love to hear from you.

We are looking for a Warehouse Associate/Back up Driver to join our Warshauer Electric Supply team in Lakewood, NJ!

Shift: 7 am - 4 pm

Summary:

Employee’s level and pay will be dependent on their level of experience, knowledge, and capabilities. The Warehouse Associate/Truck Driver I is responsible for efficiently and accurately filling customer orders, receiving, stocking, staging, and shipping material in a manner that meets company standards for safety, security, accuracy, and productivity. Responsible for all warehouse transactions, as well as the upkeep and maintenance of the branch warehouse environment and equipment. This role also has an essential driving component and may be assigned to operate a delivery vehicle for up to 50% of its time delivering products to/from customers, company branch/warehouse locations, and company suppliers in a delivery van or box truck (No CDL required). Responsible for ensuring that deliveries are prepared to meet customer requirements in the most efficient manner and materials are correct and free of damage.

• Follow established Standard Operating Procedures, Environmental Health and Safety Rules, and immediately address safety concerns
• Receive material coming into the building by vendors, customers, or other warehouses and verify the quantity and description of materials received by checking merchandise against the packing list
• Keep incoming orders stocked on shelves orderly and in designated area and report freight damage claims

• Inspect and perform minor maintenance on equipment
• Perform inventory counts and reconcile any discrepancies
• Operate delivery vehicles to make deliveries to and from customers, company branch/warehouse locations, and company suppliers

• Must follow Department of Transportation (DOT), local and state driving laws and regulations

jobs.title: Senior Safety Engineer - Power Tools and Accessories
jobs.description:
This role is hybrid remote with 60% monthly in-office presence in Mount Prospect, Illinois. (3 days in office per week).

The Senior Product Safety Engineer plays a critical role to ensure the safety of new power tools and safeguard end-users This involves analyzing new product designs for power tools to identify hazards and risks in order to devise hazard-mitigation measures.  The Senior Product Safety Engineer creates and maintains Product Safety Review for products, communicates product safety requirements to product development teams, and provides safety input to user instruction manuals and product warning labels.  The Senior Product Safety Engineer also mentor and train other safety engineers and project teams, create safety design guidelines and procedures and support investigations of field returns.

Responsibilities:

• Analyze new product designs and prototypes for user hazards, assess the risk, and develop the hazard mitigation requirements for innovative power tools.
• Document safety requirements in Product Safety Review and maintain throughout the development phase of the product.
• Communicate Product Safety requirements to project teams through meetings, calls, and emails.
• Read and critically review test reports to confirm product safety qualification requirements are met.
• Provide safety input, warnings, and instructions for user instruction manual, and review content provided by others for safety concerns.
• Create and mentor others for on-product warning label content per ANSI Z535
• Review product photography, videography, and marketing artwork for accurate representation of reasonably safe use and compliance with operating instructions and warnings.
• Mentor and train other Product Safety Engineers.
• Train product development teams on Product Safety requirements and workflow.
• Create and update Product Safety procedures and design guidelines.
• Support product investigations for testing and field returns.
• Challenge product development team on appropriate hazard mitigation methods.

• Bachelor of Science in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering or equivalent experience in technical-related discipline.
• Minimum 6-8 years of experience working in North American agency approvals (UL, CSA), regulatory compliance (CFR, OSHA), new product development for consumer products, or quality engineering for new product development. Experience analyzing and using power tools is required.
• Excellent written and oral communication skills in English, with ability to describe technical information to project teams.
• Strong understanding of North American product safety requirements for product design to ensure correct analysis for safety and compliance requirements.
• Culturally sophisticated awareness of how North Americans will use power tools on job sites, homes, and yards.
• Patient, and detail oriented with ability to proofread written instructions for logical errors, contradictions, or safety hazards.
• Familiarity with hazard identification and methods to document countermeasures.

jobs.title: Care Coordinator, LPN (Bilingual)
jobs.description:
Who We Are

Evergreen Nephrology partners with nephrologists to transform kidney care through a value-based, person-centered, holistic, and comprehensive approach to kidney care. We believe patients living with kidney disease deserve the best care. We are committed to improving patient outcomes and improving quality of life by delaying disease progression, shifting care to the home, and accelerating kidney transplants.

We help nephrologists focus on the right patients at the right time across the full care spectrum. We do this by providing them with the best-in-class interdisciplinary clinical resources, analytical insight and tools, and services to patients. We listen to the needs of our patients, our employees, and our client partners, continually working to push beyond the status quo in which the care system manages patients today.

Who You Are

You are devoted, compassionate, and enjoy being on the front lines of healthcare, changing the lives of patients by supporting them and the team by focusing on customers. You’re excited about being part of a team that is building a healthcare delivery model that ensures the highest possible quality of life and best outcomes for those in our care. You believe people living with kidney disease deserve the best person-centered, holistic, comprehensive care and want to influence the healthcare system to drive towards that. You thrive in innovative and evolving environments with high rates of change.

Your Role

As a Licensed Practical Nurse (LPN) with Evergreen Nephrology, you are responsible for conducting monthly clinical check-ins, identifying and addressing clinical concerns, reinforcing care plans, escalating issues appropriately, and ensuring clinical documentation accuracy across both the EHR and partner technology platform. This position requires clinical judgment, licensed expertise, and the ability to support patients between office visits while collaborating closely with Evergreen’s providers, care teams, and leadership. LPNs are essential to delivering a safe, compliant, clinically credible Connected Care Program.

The program uses SMS as the first-line channel for patient engagement, with phone outreach used when appropriate.

While this position is fully remote, you must be able to work from 8:30am – 5pm in the pacific time zone.

Role Responsibilities

Some responsibilities may vary based on specific patient programs, but this role's primary duties include the following:

• Patient Engagement & Outreach Perform monthly CCM touchpoints for assigned patient panels. Build strong, ongoing relationships with patients and caregivers through regular outreach. Review patient chart data (diagnoses, kidney disease history, medications, labs, imaging, treatment cycles) before calls. Explain CCM participation and reinforce program benefits.

• Clinical Assessments & Judgment Conduct structured symptom assessments (pain, fatigue, neuropathy, SOB, nausea, etc.). Evaluate changes in condition using licensed clinical judgment. Assess medication adherence issues, side effects, or confusion about regimen. Identify clinical red flags requiring escalation (e.g., worsening symptoms, new SOB, uncontrolled pain, concerning vitals).

• Escalation, Coordination & Provider Communication Escalate urgent issues based on defined triage pathways (same-business-day or immediate).

• Collaborate with the provider team on symptom changes, new concerns, or medication-related issues. Route EHR messages with clinically relevant documentation. Assist in coordinating care: scheduling follow-up, arranging labs, ensuring nephrology appointments are kept, and reducing missed care.

jobs.title: Sr. Financial Analyst - Business Partner Sales Controlling
jobs.description:

The Sales Business Partner will work closely with Sales leadership and cross-functional stakeholders to drive forecast accuracy, provide transparency into business performance, and translate complex sales and financial data into actionable insights. The ideal candidate combines strong analytical capabilities with commercial acumen, operates with a high degree of autonomy, and is comfortable challenging assumptions and influencing senior stakeholders.

Sales Forecasting, Reporting & Analysis

• Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Economics, or a related field.

• Strong experience in sales forecasting, Month-End reporting, variance analysis, Net Sales analysis, pricing, and commercial performance reporting.

jobs.title: Software Engineering Manager/Tech Lead, Maven Voice
jobs.description:
Maven AGI sits at the center of the hottest intersection in tech right now: AI and customer experience. While most "AI support" tools still focus on FAQs and deflection, Maven's agents actually do the work, autonomously interacting with customers, personalizing the conversation, and resolving complex issues, not just providing information.

Founded in 2023 by executives from HubSpot, Google, and Stripe, Maven builds conversational AI agents that don't just answer customers, they act: going into a customer's account, finding the actual problem, and fixing it, with no human required. Customers like Dell, ServPro, HardRock, Tripadvisor, Clio, and Thumbtack rely on Maven, with independently verified results — customers report resolving 70–93% of interactions autonomously — and G2 has named Maven a High Performer and Best Meets Requirements across multiple categories.




THE POSITION

We’re looking for an Engineering Manager/Technical Lead to help build Maven AGI’s Voice Agent platform.

Maven Voice enables enterprise customers to automate real customer conversations through AI agents that can understand intent in real time, respond naturally, handle interruptions, execute workflows, and seamlessly hand conversations off to human agents when needed.

This is a technical leadership role that combines people mentorship, product execution, and strong engineering judgment. You will support managing our team of engineers working across real-time voice infrastructure, conversational AI, agent orchestration, integrations, and customer-facing product experiences.

You will partner closely with Product, AI/ML, Design, Customer Success, and other engineering teams to turn complex customer needs into reliable, scalable product capabilities. You’ll also work directly with enterprise customers and internal stakeholders to understand voice workflows, contact-center environments, and technical constraints, then help the team deliver solutions that work in production at scale.



WHAT YOU’LL DO:

 - Manage and co-develop with a team of software engineers building Maven’s Voice Agent platform

 - Partner with Product and Design to define scope, sequencing, and technical approaches for new Voice capabilities

 - Partner closely with other technical leads to align architecture, engineering priorities, and execution

 - Help onboard engineers as the Voice team grows

 - Balance customer commitments, product velocity, platform reliability, and longer-term technical investments

 - Communicate technical risks, trade-offs, dependencies, and progress across the organization

 - Build strong partnerships across Engineering, Product, AI/ML, Customer Success, and Go-to-Market teams

 - Improve engineering processes while keeping the team fast, pragmatic, and focused on shipping high-quality products

 - Build a culture of technical ownership, experimentation, and continuous improvement


TECHNICAL AND PRODUCT RESPONSIBILITIES:

 - Guide the design, development, and operation of real-time voice and conversational AI systems

 - Lead engineering efforts across voice agents, conversation orchestration, telephony integrations, and customer workflows

 - Help the team build responsive, natural conversational experiences that handle interruptions, changing context, accents, languages, and unpredictable user behavior

 - Partner with AI/ML teams to integrate speech recognition, text-to-speech, LLMs, and other AI models into production voice experiences

 - Drive improvements in latency, reliability, call quality, scalability, and overall user experience

 - Guide integrations with telephony and contact-center infrastructure, including SIP, PSTN, WebRTC, Twilio, Genesys, Cisco, RingCentral, Zendesk Talk, and similar platforms

 - Build systems that allow AI agents to execute real-world workflows such as account updates, transactions, scheduling, refunds, and other customer actions

 - Ensure voice conversations can transition smoothly to human agents with the appropriate context, transcripts, summaries, and interaction history

 - Establish strong observability and debugging practices for distributed, real-time systems

 - Partner with customer-facing teams to investigate production issues and turn customer feedback into durable product improvements

 - Help define technical architecture and engineering standards as the Voice platform scales across customers and use cases

 - Evaluate and adopt technologies that improve voice quality, developer velocity, reliability, and product performance



WHO YOU ARE:

 - 7+ years of software engineering experience

 - 3+ years of experience managing engineering teams

 - Strong technical background building and operating production software systems

 - Experience leading teams working on distributed, real-time, or high-concurrency applications

 - Strong understanding of APIs, backend systems, service-oriented architectures, and cloud infrastructure

 - Experience working with asynchronous systems, streaming data, event-driven architectures, or similar real-time workloads

 - Strong product judgment and experience partnering closely with Product and Design

 - Comfortable working across both technical architecture and day-to-day execution

 - Experience operating customer-facing systems where reliability and responsiveness are critical

 - Ability to communicate complex technical trade-offs clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders

 - Strong cross-functional collaboration skills

 - Comfortable working directly with customers to understand technical requirements and production issues

 - Comfortable operating in a fast-paced startup environment




HOW YOU SHOW UP

 - We are customer champions. You put users at the center of your thinking, advocate for their needs, and design solutions that make their lives measurably better.

 - We are bold in action. You move with urgency and courage, unafraid to challenge convention and take smart risks in pursuit of meaningful outcomes.

 - We are data-driven and insight guided. You make thoughtful decisions grounded in evidence, combining data with intuition to guide strategy and execution.

 - We are stronger together. You bring others along, value diverse perspectives, and contribute to a culture of trust and shared ownership.



WHAT WE OFFER

 - 100% of medical, dental, and vision premiums covered for you, 80% for family

 - HSA and FSA plans available

 - Unlimited vacation and 100% paid parental leave

 - Free lunches, onsite gym, and commuter benefits for in-office employees

 - $1,000 home office stipend and $5,000/year for continuing education

 - Competitive salary, comprehensive benefits, and meaningful equity

 - ~130 people, built from zero in under three years — small enough that your work is visible, big enough to already be running at Dell- and Tripadvisor-scale

jobs.description:
This role is hybrid remote with 60% monthly in-office presence in Mount Prospect, Illinois. (3 days in office per week).

Bosch Power Tools North America is seeking a highly organized and results-oriented Channel Operations Manager to support the execution of commercial and digital shelf strategies across our key distribution partners, including HomeDepot.com, Lowes.com, Walmart.com and professional trade distributors. Reporting to the eCommerce Channel Management Lead, this role plays a key supporting function in enabling the e-commerce sales team by driving the execution of digital shelf optimizations, automated data reporting, and operational readiness for peak retail events and promotions.

This role will collaborate closely across sales, brand marketing, and operations teams to ensure Bosch and Dremel’s digital shelf presence is effectively executed and flawlessly represented across each retailer’s website, in alignment with in-store assortment and availability.

It’s an excellent opportunity for someone who thrives in a fast-paced, cross-functional environment, enjoys technical and tactical execution, and is able to juggle multiple catalog and retailer priorities.

This role requires minimum 3 days per week on-site at the Mount Prospect, Illinois location, 2 work days may be remote.  We are not offering relocation for this role.

What You Will Do:

• Own digital shelf execution for the HomeDepot.com, Lowes.com, and Walmart.com catalogs, driving continuous improvement across traffic, discoverability, and item-level conversion metrics.
• Drive organic discoverability by deploying targeted keyword strategies, optimizing on-site search rank, and maintaining accurate category placement and the attribute data that powers each retailer’s filters and faceted navigation.
• Maximize product page conversion by auditing and ensuring content completeness, asset quality (imagery/video), enhanced and rich media content deployment, and brand page updates across each retailer.
• Execute listing health protocols, proactively resolving supplier portal tickets, content syndication errors, product page and variation issues, and discrepancies between online and in-store availability and fulfillment options (e.g., ship-to-home, buy online pick up in store).
• Deploy promotional and review tactics by executing retailer review and sampling programs (e.g., The Home Depot Seeds, Walmart Spark Reviewer) and review syndication, tracking rating/review sentiment, and ensuring accurate pricing, badging, and promotional display across the catalog.
• Manage operational traffic alignment by reviewing organic versus paid search share, ensuring product listings are completely retail-ready to support retail media campaigns across Orange Apron Media, Lowe’s One Roof Media Network, and Walmart Connect.
• Track competitive digital shelf metrics – including share of search, content quality scores, and competitor review positions, along with Walmart.com marketplace seller activity – to identify immediate operational optimization opportunities.

• 3+ years of experience in e-commerce operations, digital shelf management, or online merchandising with a primary focus on home improvement or mass retail websites such as HomeDepot.com, Lowes.com, or Walmart.com.
• Supported account management teams by executing retailer.com listing optimizations, promotional setups or new product launch deployments through retailer supplier portals.
• Hands-on experience managing a retailer.com catalog, including a strong understanding of retailer content and attribute requirements, item setup processes, and supplier support ticketing.
• Experience utilizing digital shelf tools and syndication platforms (e.g., Salsify, Syndigo, Profitero, Stackline, Walmart Retail Link) to publish content and monitor share of search, content quality scores, and competitor listings.
• Proficient with Microsoft Excel for auditing massive catalog files (e.g., utilizing VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP and pivot tables) and tracking digital shelf performance data.

jobs.title: Health and Safety Responsible
jobs.description:
WHAT YOU’LL DO

As a Health & Safety Responsible, you will play a key role in driving Health & Safety initiatives across the market, ensuring safe workplaces, legal compliance, and strong preventive practices across all stores, offices, and operations. You oversee risk assessments, incident management, training, audits, and travel‑risk processes while partnering cross‑functionally to embed a strong safety culture.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Lead and oversee all aspects of workplace safety and compliance across our locations.
• Ensure compliance with country specific Health & Safety laws & regulations, as well as global guidelines and routines.
• Fosters a culture of safety and contribute to a secure environment for both employees and customers.
• Develop, implement, and maintain Health & Safety Policies, procedures, and manuals in compliance with legal and regulatory requirements.
• Conduct risk assessments and controls, identify potential hazards, recommend corrective actions, and follow up to ensure implementation.
• Lead incident investigations and prepare detailed reports, including root-cause analysis and preventive measures.
• Organize and deliver health and safety training to employees (e.g. fire safety, manual handling, first aid, etc).
• Act as the main contact for regulatory bodies, labour inspections, insurance representatives, emergency services and external healthy and safety partners.
• Provide safety & security support for travelers & execute Travel tracker protocols, including emergency travel response plans.
• Maintain direct contact with Prevention Delegates and Health & Safety Committees.

WHO YOU’LL WORK WITH

You will work closely with the Health & Safety team, Store Teams, the Construction & Facilities team, People teams, and Operations to integrate safety standards into daily operations.

WHO YOU ARE

We are looking for people with...

• Bachelor’s degree in occupational and/or Environmental H&S or relevant related fields.
• Certification as an Occupational Risk Prevention Specialist (Técnico Superior en Prevención de Riesgos Laborales - PRL) is required.
• Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a Health & Safety role, preferably within retail, logistics, or warehouse operations.
• Experience in conducting inspections, audits, and investigations.
• In-depth knowledge of H&S regulations, compliance standards & best practices.
• Proficiency in incident management (reporting, data analysis for trend identification, and corrective action planning).
• Strong understanding of occupational safety principles, accident investigation, and stakeholder engagement.
• Fluency in Spanish and English both written and spoken.
• Portugues is considered an advantage.

And people who are...

• Strong analytical thinkers and problem-solvers.
• Excellent communicators with strong interpersonal skills, able to train, engage and create commitment with others.
• Strong negotiators, capable of building constructive relationships and driving alignment among multiple stakeholders.
• Highly organized, with strong communication skills and a proactive, hands-on approach.

WHO WE ARE​

H&M Group is a global company of strong fashion brands and ventures. Our goal is to prove that there is no compromise between exceptional design, affordable prices, and sustainable solutions. We want to liberate fashion for the many, and our customers are at the heart of every decision we make.​

​We are made up of thousands of passionate and talented colleagues united by our shared culture and values. Together, we want to use our power, our scale, and our knowledge to push the fashion industry towards a more inclusive and sustainable future. ​

At H&M Group, we are proud to be a vibrant and welcoming company. We offer our employees attractive benefits with extensive development opportunities around the globe. ​

• Access to our Flexible Remuneration Plans.
• Enjoy access to Benefits at Work, the online shopping benefits club with special discounts for all H&M people.
• Access to GoFluent, a language learning platform for comprehensive language training catered to your professional needs.

JOIN US​

Our uniqueness comes from a combination of many things – our inclusive and collaborative culture, our strong values, and opportunities for growth. But most of all, it’s our people who make us who we are.​

Take the next step in your career together with us. The journey starts here.​

jobs.title: Impact Producer
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

We're looking for a Producer to own the external storytelling and event presence for Impact, a role that coordinates PR, agency management, social launches, documentary-style case studies, and event production. This is a hands-on, in-house role: you're the person who makes sure every launch, film, and activation meets (or, ideally raises) the bar of the rest of the company's output, working closely with our internal Design, Comms, and Events teams, and, when applicable, with the external agencies and production teams supporting PR, film, and creative execution. As Impact's first dedicated producer, you'll build the production and launch engine for a team whose external footprint is scaling fast, this quarter alone includes 5+ events, six documentaries in production, two live ElevenLabs Summit sessions, a partner launch every month, and several more case studies in flight.

jobs.title: Data Scientist
jobs.description:
You are passionate about transforming complex data into actionable insights and tools that make people more efficient. You thrive on the challenge of gathering, cleaning, and analyzing diverse data sources to find the "hidden truth" that drives real customer value. Your ideal role involves using a blend of computer science, statistics, and machine learning to translate information security data into organizational knowledge. While you enjoy research, you get the most energy from seeing your work—from predictive models to Gen AI applications—directly impact cybersecurity outcomes.

Does this sound like you? Great!

We’re looking for a Data Scientist who wants to automate routine decisions and empower our humans to be more efficient. You’ll work alongside our Detection and Response (D&R) Engineering and Security Operations Center (SOC) teams to deliver quick, iterative wins that improve how we detect and investigate cybersecurity incidents.

Our team values collaboration and a team-focused mindset. If you are an adaptable problem-solver who enjoys working with others to turn noisy data into clear capabilities, we should talk!

What Expel can do for you

• Provide opportunities where the decisions you make have a direct impact on our company and our customers

• Grow through collaborative mentorship and hands-on stretch assignments

• Challenge you to push the boundaries of our data science, security, and technology vision

• Provide an entertaining, small and highly transparent startup environment

What you can do for Expel

• Support our security analysts by continuously improving alert quality, workflow efficiency, and detection capabilities through advanced analytics, machine learning, and Gen AI.

• Work across our operations, engineering and service delivery teams, ensuring Expel can easily deploy, monitor, and manage all of our machine learning capabilities.

• Drive business decisions by translating data insights into clear, actionable knowledge for the organization.

• Foster an atmosphere of experimentation, continuous learning, and improvement.

• Maintain and enhance our existing models while supporting new data science initiatives.

• Contribute to Expel’s external voice through blog posts and conference speaking.

What you should bring with you

• Ability and desire to collaborate and work with teams throughout the organization to foster research and innovation

• Ability to communicate technical data science concepts to various audiences, especially non data science experts

• Passion for finding order and meaning in large, chaotic data sets an amorphous problem domains

• Deep proficiency with Python (pandas, numpy, sklearn) and SQL for model development.

• Knowledge of statistics (distributions, hypothesis testing, probability, etc.)

• Proficiency of a few popular data science and visualization frameworks such at scikit-learn, plotly, pandas, and numpy, and the underlying statistics that drive them

• Understanding of data engineering and proven experience with cloud deployment best practices

• Prefers 3+ years of data science experience creating models, analyzing data and drawing conclusions, recommending next steps, and summarizing key results to stakeholders

• A Bachelor’s degree in Math, Statistics, or Computer Science (or equivalent experience in AI/ML).

Additional information

The base salary range for this role is between $118,400 USD and $171,700 USD + bonus eligibility and equity. While the full salary band reflects our long-term compensation framework, we're primarily targeting candidates between $135,000 and $160,000 based on experience, skills, and market data.

At Expel, our employee benefits reflect our commitment to our crew. Unlimited PTO, equity for everyone, work location flexibility, up to 24 weeks of parental leave, and excellent health benefits are some of the ways we care for our Expletives.

We’re only hiring those authorized to work in the United States. We do not currently sponsor immigration visas.
