De stagevergoeding is €600 bruto per maand, gebaseerd op een 38-urige werkweek. Daarnaast is er ook een mogelijkheid om reiskostenvergoeding te ontvangen. Elke dag kun je genieten van een gratis maaltijd in onze personeelskantine.

Ga je graag uit eten? Goed nieuws! Je krijgt tot 50% korting op eten en drinken in restaurants in 4- en 5 sterren hotels in Amsterdam.

Dit ga je doen

Je zult werken in een uitdagende werkomgeving, waar ruimte is voor eigen ideeën en initiatieven. Wij zoeken een teamplayer, die proactief is en zelfstandig kan werken. Naast het opdoen van praktijk werkervaring, krijg je de gelegenheid om je te ontwikkelen op het gebied van communicatie én bieden wij je een uitgebreide blik in de keuken van marketing en communicatie bij een vijfsterren hotel.

Als Marketing Intern ben je, samen met jouw Marketing collega’s, medeverantwoordelijk voor de offline en online marketing en communicatie van Sofitel Legend The Grand Amsterdam en de diverse outlets, waaronder ons fine dining restaurant Bridges en Garden Bistro Oriole.

De dagelijkse werkzaamheden bestaan onder andere uit het schrijven van (commerciële) teksten voor brochures, websites en nieuwsbrieven, het ontwerpen van promotiemateriaal en het up-to-date houden van de diverse websites. Daarnaast houdt jij je bezig met het beheer van en de content creatie voor de diverse social media accounts en beoordeel en begeleid je influencer verzoeken/ bezoeken. Affiniteit met social media en fotografie is daarom een pré.

Dit neem je mee

• Je volgt een opleiding in Hospitality management, Marketing of een vergelijkbare studie.
• Zeer goede sociale en communicatieve vaardigheden in woord en geschrift, in zowel het Nederlands en het Engels.
• Je bent beschikbaar voor minimaal 6 maanden.
• Je bent ambitieus, leergierig en hebt een hands-on mentaliteit.
• Je bent creatief en houdt van het bedenken en schrijven van teksten.

jobs.title: Senior Enterprise Support Engineer (Remote)
jobs.location: New York, New York, United States
jobs.description:
About Unframe

Unframe is an AI-first startup helping the world’s largest enterprises bring LLM-powered applications to life in days - not months. We combine the speed of a product company with the flexibility of a consultancy, helping customers move from idea to deployed AI systems faster than anyone else in the market.

Backed by Bessemer, Craft, and TLV Partners with $100M in Series B funding, we’re building a fast-growing, revenue-generating company working with Fortune 500 customers globally.

About the role

We are seeking an energetic, high-proactivity Senior Enterprise Support Engineer to serve as the primary technical advisor and face of Unframe for our enterprise clients. This is not a back-office, ticket-routing support role; you will be a core member of our customer-facing technical team, executing across cloud/API forensics, executive client advisory, and AI agent orchestration.

This role is for someone technical, curious, and service-oriented, who wants to be close to customers, product, and AI implementation at enterprise scale. You will own client technical issues end-to-end, drive live strategy and de-escalation video calls with Fortune 500 C-suite and engineering leaders, and independently perform log and code forensics to free up our core engineering team. As our US anchor hire, you will also help establish our technical support playbooks, SLAs, and customer feedback loops.

Please note this role is focused on candidates located on the East Coast.

What you'll do

• Proactively lead enterprise client engagements. Bringing high energy, technical authority, and consultative presence to live video calls with bank executives, enterprise sponsors, and client engineering leads. Actively uncover workflow pain points, translate business requirements into technical solutions, and handle high-stakes account de-escalations with professional poise.

• Independently investigate, reproduce, and resolve production incidents across web applications, REST APIs, webhooks, microservices, and databases. Query SQL databases, parse CloudWatch/Datadog/Splunk logs, trace JSON payloads, and inspect source code in GitHub to isolate root causes before involving core engineering.

• Act as an "AI Support Orchestrator." Configuring, testing, and deploying autonomous AI agents (using Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, and LLM APIs) to analyze logs, automate triage workflows, and build self-service knowledge bases.

• Own the technical relationship for enterprise accounts, helping build Unframe’s support infrastructure, SLAs, incident escalation paths, and diagnostic runbooks.

• Partner closely with Product and Engineering leadership to turn recurring customer friction into actionable product specs, bug fixes, and feature enhancements.

What we're looking for

• 4+ years of experience in technical support, support engineering, QA, solutions engineering, or a similar hands-on technical role.

• Proven experience presenting to and advising enterprise stakeholders on live video calls with clear verbal and written communication skills.

• High energy, proactive communication, and zero hesitation to jump into ambiguous situations. You take personal accountability for client outcomes rather than waiting for direction or escalating to engineering.

• Diagnostic Tech Stack: Hands-on proficiency writing SQL queries to inspect relational and cloud databases. Practical experience conducting cloud log analysis in CloudWatch, Datadog, Splunk, Grafana, or Loki. Clear understanding of REST APIs, JSON payloads, webhooks, HTTP status codes, and browser DevTools. Familiarity with enterprise authentication protocols (SSO, SAML 2.0, OAuth 2.0, Okta).

• Active daily practitioner of generative AI and agentic coding tools (Claude Code, Cursor, ChatGPT, Copilot) for log parsing, code navigation, and workflow automation.

Why join us?

This role is a great fit for someone who enjoys solving real technical problems while working closely with customers, product, and engineering teams. You’ll be exposed to complex enterprise environments, cutting-edge AI products, and fast product cycles with real ownership and direct impact from day one. It’s an opportunity to grow quickly, learn how large-scale AI systems are deployed in the real world, and help shape the experience of some of the world’s biggest companies using Unframe.

jobs.title: Director of Risk Management
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Rootstock Capital is building a BTC capital markets business, and we're hiring a small, senior team of two to three people to shape, grow and deliver it. Its first product is an institutional-grade, BTC-denominated investment fund that lets institutional and private Bitcoin holders earn yield and manage credit risk through a mixed portfolio of strategies, bridging traditional institutional demand and Bitcoin-native yield.

As Director of Risk Management, you'll build and lead Rootstock Capital's risk function. You'll own the risk framework across market, credit, counterparty, liquidity, operational and protocol risk, spanning BTC, digital assets and traditional finance, and covering OTC, bilateral and exchange-traded activity. You'll be a founding member of the team, working alongside the VP Fund Management.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Risk framework and governance

• Design and own Rootstock Capital's risk framework: risk appetite; exposure, concentration and leverage limits; liquidity buckets; collateral haircuts; margin and drawdown triggers; and escalation procedures.

• Take risk policies and limits through board approval, and report regularly to the board and investment committee.

• Give independent risk sign-off on new strategies, products, venues and counterparties before launch.

Risk modelling and analysis

• Build the models and analytics that measure market, credit, counterparty, liquidity and protocol risk across traditional and digital positions, including VaR, scenario analysis and stress testing.

• Stress-test the portfolio against BTC price shocks, liquidity crises, venue or counterparty failure, depeg events, protocol exploits and liquidation cascades.

• Model and evaluate complex transactions (secured lending, repo, basis and derivatives, structured products) and assess how risks interact and compound across on-chain and off-chain components.

• Monitor positions and exposures daily, and flag early when outcomes drift from limits or assumptions.

Counterparty and credit risk

• Lead counterparty, venue and protocol due diligence: creditworthiness, custody arrangements, and smart-contract, bridge, oracle and governance risk.

• Set and monitor counterparty limits, collateral eligibility and margin terms.

Legal and transaction documentation

• Review and negotiate the risk terms in fund, OTC and bilateral documents (ISDA/CSA, lending and repo agreements, collateral and margin terms, termination events and close-out provisions) with the Fund Asset Manager and legal counsel.

Operational risk, controls and compliance

• Design operational risk controls across the trade lifecycle, settlement, reconciliation, custody and treasury that scale with both traditional and digital asset activity.

• Shape the processes that connect risk, execution and finance across digital and traditional OTC, bilateral and exchange-traded transactions.

• Work with compliance, legal, the fund administrator and auditors on regulatory obligations, audits and reporting.

Product delivery

• Work with the Fund Asset Manager and commercial, technology, legal and compliance teams to take new products from idea to launch, making sure they are investable and structurally sound.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Postgraduate degree in Finance, Computer Science or Mathematical Finance, plus a professional qualification in finance or risk (CFA, FRM, PRM or equivalent).

• 10+ years in risk management at asset managers, funds, banks, trading firms or digital asset businesses, including several years leading a risk function.

• Deep capital, asset and risk management experience across BTC, digital assets and traditional finance, including DeFi protocol risk.

• Strong financial modelling and risk analysis skills (stress testing, scenario analysis, VaR) across traditional and digital instruments, with hands-on Python, R or SQL.

• Hands-on experience designing operational risk controls across the trade lifecycle, custody and treasury for OTC, bilateral and exchange-traded activity.

• Experience reviewing and negotiating risk terms in fund, OTC and bilateral documents, and working within fund regulatory and compliance requirements.

• Proven leadership of high-performing teams, and the ability to explain complex risk clearly to boards, investors and regulators.

ROOTIES BENEFITS

At RootstockLabs, we don’t just offer a job, we offer a community. Here’s what you can expect when you join us:

• Competitive compensation package and unique benefits designed to support your growth and well-being.

• 100% Remote Work from Europe & Latin America, with access to global CoWorking spaces.

• Work-Life Balance: Paid vacation and sick leave days

• Continuous Learning: Access to training programs, language courses, and learning sponsorship annually.

• Unique Projects: Work with cutting-edge blockchain technology in a global, diverse team.

ABOUT ROOTSTOCKLABS

RootstockLabs is a key contributor to Rootstock, Bitcoin's Financial Infrastructure for lending, yield, and onchain capital markets. We build and commercialize the institutional infrastructure that turns Bitcoin into productive capital.

• What we do: Develop and commercialize Bitcoin-backed lending, tokenized real-world assets, and onchain financial strategies

• Who we work with: Leading custodians, asset managers, and financial institutions

• Why it matters: Rootstock is secured by 80%+ of Bitcoin's hash power and has run with 100% uptime since 2018 (bringing Ethereum-style programmability to the world's hardest money).

• Proof it works: 200+ dApps live on Rootstock, from BTCFi protocols like Sushiswap and Oku to institutional names like Mercado Bitcoin, Animoca Brands, and Paystand

jobs.title: Accounting Automation Engineer
jobs.description:
ABOUT US

Ruby Labs is a leading tech company that creates and operates innovative consumer products. We offer a diverse range of opportunities across the health, education, and entertainment industries. Our innovative teams are driving the future of consumer-led products, and we're always looking for passionate individuals to join us. Learn more about our story at: https://rubylabs.com/about-us/




ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring an Accounting Automation Engineer to replace manual accounting work across a multi-entity, multi-country enterprise, using Claude Code and agentic AI. 

You will use Claude Code and agentic AI, plus Python or JavaScript/TypeScript, to automate accounts payable, accounts receivable, reconciliations, month-end close and the wider day-to-day accounting operation. You need strong IFRS or US GAAP knowledge to get the numbers right, because an automation that posts wrong entries is worse than no automation.

We build agentic AI systems and AI agents, not fixed step-by-step workflows. Experience with rule-based workflow builders such as n8n or Zapier is not relevant to this role.

Titles we will consider: Accounting Automation Engineer, Finance Engineer, Financial Systems Engineer, Technical Accountant (with engineering background), Accounting Systems Manager (with engineering background).




KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

The goal is to automate the repeatable core of enterprise accounting, with human review kept only where judgment is needed.

Accounts payable

 - Invoice capture and data extraction from PDFs and email, using AI where useful

 - Vendor matching, coding suggestions, and 2-way/3-way PO matching

 - Duplicate invoice detection and approval routing

 - Payment run preparation and vendor statement reconciliation

Accounts receivable

 - Invoice generation and delivery

 - Cash application and bank receipt matching

 - Aging reports, dunning and collections reminders

 - Credit note handling and bad debt/ECL provision support

Reconciliations

 - Bank and card reconciliations across all accounts and currencies

 - Balance sheet account reconciliations (prepayments, accruals, deferred revenue, fixed assets)

 - Intercompany and subledger-to-GL reconciliations

 - Exception reports that flag only the items a human needs to review

Month-end close

 - Close checklist tracking and scheduled reminders

 - Recurring, accrual, prepayment and amortization journals

 - Depreciation runs and FX revaluation

 - Trial balance checks, flux/variance analysis, and draft commentary

 - Management reporting packs

General accounting operations

 - Expense report and employee reimbursement checks

 - Chart of accounts and master data hygiene

 - Audit support: evidence collection, PBC lists, sample extraction

 - Data pipelines between ERP, banks, payment platforms and spreadsheets


QUALIFICATIONS

Two things matter most, and we weigh them above everything else:

 1. Strong knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP

 2. Real experience with AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, backed by solid engineering basics

We accept two paths: an accountant who learned to code, or an engineer who learned accounting. Both are judged on the same practical test.

 - Hands-on experience building automations with Python or JavaScript/TypeScript (either is fine)

 - Daily, hands-on use of AI coding tools, ideally Claude Code, with solid engineering basics, shipping working scripts and agents

 - Ability to run local scripts and schedule jobs (cron, task schedulers or CI pipelines)

 - Strong knowledge of IFRS or US GAAP, shown by ACCA, ACA, CPA or equivalent, or by several years of hands-on accounting experience

 - Experience with core processes: AP, AR, bank reconciliation, month-end close

 - Comfort working with APIs and MCP servers, CSV/Excel data and basic SQL

 - Care for accuracy, controls and audit trails


NICE TO HAVE

 - Experience in multi-entity or multi-currency environments, including intercompany and consolidation

 - Experience reconciling payment processor statements across multiple jurisdictions and currencies

 - Experience with shared cost services that invoice group companies, including complex expense splits and automated invoice generation

 - Experience with an ERP and its API (which ERP does not matter)

 - Experience building AI agents and agentic workflows, including tool use and MCP servers

 - Knowledge of VAT/GST and e-invoicing rules in several jurisdictions

 - Experience with Git, testing and basic cloud deployment

 - Prior experience in a finance transformation or accounting operations team

 - Additional languages, where our entities operate in non-English markets


LOCATION

Ruby Labs operates within the CET (Central European Time) zone. Applicants from any country are welcome to apply for the position as long as they are located within approximately ± 4 hours of CET. This ensures optimal collaboration and communication during working hours.




BENEFITS

Discover the perks of being part of our vibrant team! We offer:

 - Remote Work Environment: Embrace the freedom to work from anywhere, anytime, promoting a healthy work-life balance. 

 - Unlimited PTO: Enjoy unlimited paid time off to recharge and prioritize your well-being, without counting days. 

 - Paid National Holidays: Celebrate and relax on national holidays with paid time off to unwind and recharge. 

 - Company-provided MacBook: Experience seamless productivity with top-notch Apple MacBooks provided to all employees who need them. 

 - Flexible Independent Contractor Agreement: Unlock the benefits of flexibility, autonomy, and entrepreneurial opportunities. Benefit from tax advantages, networking opportunities, reduced employment obligations, and the freedom to work from anywhere. Read more about it here: https://docs.google.com/document/d/1nkrN76JlZkbKj9WSOhlT1_mni_CZeDkHdwfIjPXVwvk/preview?tab=t.0#heading=h.ndsdl4wapxtt

Be part of our fast-growing team and seize this excellent opportunity for personal and professional growth!




INTERVIEW PROCESS

After submitting your application, we conduct a thorough review which typically takes 3 to 5 days, but may occasionally take longer due to the volume of applications received. If we see a potential fit, we proceed with the following steps:

 - Recruiter Screening (40 minutes)

 - Technical Interview (90 minutes)

 - Final Interview (60 minutes)




LIFE AT RUBY LABS

At Ruby Labs, we move fast, aim high, and expect the same from our team. We’re not here to play small—we’re here to build, grow, and win. That means we look for people who are ambitious, driven, and ready to give their best every single day.

This is a place for individuals who thrive under pressure, embrace challenges, and see opportunity in every obstacle. If you’re hungry to achieve, motivated by impact, and want to grow at the speed of your own ambition, Ruby Labs offers the platform to make it happen.

Here, effort is matched with reward. We recognize those who go all in and deliver results, and we create space for people who want more—more responsibility, more growth, and more success.

jobs.title: Front Office Management Intern

A career that lets your passion shine

During your internship, you will become an essential part of our Front Office team and gain exposure to both operational and management-oriented responsibilities. While developing a strong foundation in Front Office operations, you will also work closely with the Front Office leadership team, gaining valuable insight into the operational and managerial aspects of running a luxury hotel.

You will perform all Front Desk Agent tasks, including completing daily checklists, handling check-ins and check-outs, working with the Opera Property Management System, and assisting guests with a wide variety of requests. At the same time, you will be involved in departmental projects, quality initiatives, and management meetings, allowing you to develop a broader understanding of hotel operations beyond the front desk and preparing you for a future leadership role within hospitality. By collaborating closely with our Guest Relations, Butler, Concierge, and Night teams, you will develop a comprehensive understanding of the Rooms Division and the guest journey within a luxury hospitality environment.

In addition to daily Front Office operations, you will take ownership of several quality and coordination responsibilities, including:

• Participating in daily Operations meetings and gaining insight into hotel-wide operational discussions
• Representing the Front Office department during Quality Committee meetings
• Contributing to discussions on service excellence and operational improvements
• Identifying and addressing operational challenges together with the team
• Sharing insights and feedback with colleagues based on LQA self-assessments and quality reviews
• Supporting consistency in service delivery and brand standards across the department
• Assisting with purchasing requests and ensuring operational materials are available when needed

What you will bring to the role

• You are currently enrolled in a hospitality-related study program
• You have a strong interest in luxury hospitality, guest experience, and hotel operations
• You are fluent in English; Dutch is considered a plus
• You are proactive, organized, and eager to take ownership of responsibilities
• You possess strong communication and teamwork skills
• You are flexible, motivated, and able to perform well in a fast-paced environment
• You have an eye for detail and a passion for delivering exceptional guest experiences

What we offer

Our team is young, dynamic, and passionate about hospitality. The Grand highly values personal and professional development, which is why we have a dedicated Training Manager who actively supports your growth throughout your internship journey.

In addition to your operational learning experience, you will have the opportunity to:

• Participate in various cross-trainings across different hotel departments
• Gain exposure to quality management and operational coordination projects
• Take part in an operational management shift once per month, providing valuable insight into daily hotel operations and decision-making
• Explore future career opportunities within Sofitel Legend The Grand Amsterdam and the wider Accor network

The internship allowance is €600 gross per month based on 38 hours per week. In addition, you may be eligible for a travel allowance.

Every day, you can enjoy a complimentary meal in our staff canteen.

Love dining out? As part of the Accor family, you can enjoy discounts of up to 50% at selected restaurants and bars within participating 4- and 5-star hotels in Amsterdam.

Please note that only candidates who already have the legal right to work in the Netherlands will be considered. Sofitel Legend The Grand Amsterdam does not provide visa or work permit sponsorship.

jobs.title: ML Engineer
jobs.description:
MACHINE LEARNING ENGINEER




ABOUT PROXIMA

Proxima (formerly VantAI) is advancing an AI-native approach to drug discovery by making protein interactions programmable. Our platform brings together foundation-model machine learning, a scalable data generation engine, and a partnership track record exceeding $5B in collaborations across the world’s leading biopharma and tech organizations. We’ve recently closed an oversubscribed seed round partnering us with an elite group of sophisticated and dedicated VCs including DCVC, Nvidia’s Nventures, AIX, and Yosemite among others.

 

Neo-1 is our all-atom foundation model that combines state-of-the-art structure prediction and molecular generation in a single system. Neo-1 enables rapid exploration of chemical and structural space for high-value, previously intractable targets, and in particular unlocks small molecule proximity therapeutics like molecular glues with AI for the first time.

 

In parallel, we are developing an advanced structural interactomics platform (NeoLink https://www.vant.ai/neo-1#neolink) built on proprietary XLMS technology and a lab equipped with next-generation mass spectrometry instrumentation. This platform produces proteome-scale maps of protein interactions and helps identify small molecules that modulate proximity. Together with Neo-1, it creates an integrated system capable of co-folding protein complexes while generating candidate small molecules to influence those interactions. Proximity-based therapeutics represent one of the most promising frontiers in modern drug discovery with the potential to treat previously intractable diseases and target ‘undruggable’ proteins. Our technology combines proteome-scale structural data with state-of-the-art generative AI foundation models and, coupled with our talented team of scientists and engineers, we are uniquely well-positioned to discover and develop a new class of medicines. Come join us!

 


ABOUT YOU:

We are looking for a versatile software engineer to build the tools and systems behind our drug discovery research. You will work across automation, infrastructure, data, and ML, helping scientists develop models, run experiments, and use the results.

 

You enjoy taking a problem from investigation through deployment. Your work might involve integrating a dataset into training, diagnosing a stalled inference job, building an API for scientific results, or automating a manual workflow. You can find your way around an unfamiliar codebase, understand the constraints, and deliver a focused, well-tested improvement.

 

Our environment centers on Python and PyTorch, with containerized workloads, Kubernetes, cloud storage, and shared GPU compute. You will work closely with researchers and infrastructure engineers.

 

Relevant areas of expertise might include high-performance cloud computing, systems engineering, and machine learning, but specific knowledge of any of these areas is less critical than versatility and a willingness to learn and work anywhere in the tech stack. We value individuals who want to make an impact, have a deep intellectual curiosity, enjoy solving challenging problems, and have a track record of achievement.

 


OUTCOMES FOR THIS ROLE:

 - Build reliable scientific workflows that colleagues can run, reproduce, and troubleshoot with less manual intervention.

 - Integrate new models, datasets, and evaluation methods while preserving data correctness and compatibility with existing experiments.

 - Improve compute workflows through better job submission, monitoring, failure recovery, and artifact tracking.

 - Identify and remove bottlenecks in data preparation, execution, and evaluation so researchers can iterate faster.

 - Deliver libraries, services, and developer tools that are easy to use and maintain, with appropriate tests, documentation, and monitoring.

 - Contributing to the culture of a rapidly growing company

 - Being challenged by your colleagues and learning something new every day

 


SPECIFIC SKILLS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

 - Strong Python and software engineering fundamentals, including data structures, interface design, testing, concurrency, and systematic debugging.

 - A track record of delivering software that other people use and depend on, including maintaining and troubleshooting it after release.

 - Experience building or supporting ML or scientific computing workflows, with an understanding of how data, model execution, and evaluation fit together. PyTorch experience is a must.

 - Experience running software on Linux, working with containers, and shipping changes through automated tests and CI/CD.

 - Ability to break down ambiguous problems, make progress independently, and explain technical tradeoffs with evidence.

 - Willingness to work across automation, infrastructure, data, and ML, with a strong sense of ownership and clear communication with scientists and engineers.

 - Ability to use AI development tools effectively and take responsibility for the correctness and maintainability of the resulting code.

 

Experience with Kubernetes, cloud platforms, workflow orchestration, databases, or computational biology and chemistry is valuable. We welcome strong engineers from other technical domains; a biology or chemistry background is not required.

jobs.title: Head of Revenue Operations
jobs.description:
ABOUT ELEVENLABS

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

 - ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

 - ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

 - ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.




HOW WE WORK

 - High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

 - Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

 - AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

 - Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

 - Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.




WHAT WE OFFER

 - Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

 - Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

 - Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

 - Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

 - Annual company offsite: Each year, we bring the entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia and Italy.

 - Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.


ABOUT THE ROLE

As the Head of Revenue Operations, you will be the architect of ElevenLabs' commercial operating system - the planning, data, processes, systems, and AI-powered workflows that enable our GTM organization to scale revenue predictably and efficiently.

You’ll own the operational foundation across our entire revenue organization, spanning Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success. You’ll work directly with GTM leadership to shape how we plan, measure, and execute our commercial strategy.

This is a high ownership role for someone who thrives at the intersection of strategy, data, systems, AI, and execution. You’ll have significant influence over how ElevenLabs scales its revenue organization and will build the infrastructure, operating model, and team required for the next stage of growth.




IN THIS ROLE YOU WILL

 - Own the commercial operating model across Sales, Marketing, Partnerships, and Customer Success, ensuring the organization can scale revenue predictably and efficiently.

 - Partner with the CEO, CFO, and GTM leadership team on revenue strategy, annual planning, forecasting, organizational design, investment decisions, and long-range growth planning.

 - Lead territory design, segmentation, quota setting, capacity planning, headcount planning, and GTM productivity across Corporate, Mid-Market, Enterprise, Strategic, and Partnerships.

 - Establish the operating cadence for the GTM organization, including forecasting, pipeline reviews, business reviews, performance management, and executive reporting.

 - Build the data, analytics, and systems foundation that gives leadership a trusted view of pipeline, conversion, productivity, attainment, retention, expansion, and revenue efficiency.

 - Own the evolution of the GTM technology stack, including Salesforce, ensuring systems, data, processes, and workflows scale with the business.

 - Lead the AI transformation of Revenue Operations, using AI and automation to increase productivity, improve decision-making, eliminate manual work, and fundamentally rethink how GTM teams operate.

 - Partner across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Legal, Product, and Customer Success to create consistent processes, shared definitions, and strong commercial execution.

 - Drive continuous improvement across the revenue funnel, from pipeline generation and acquisition through expansion and renewal.

 - Build and lead a world-class RevOps organization, developing the talent, structure, and capabilities required for ElevenLabs’ next stage of growth.




REQUIREMENTS

 - 10+ years of Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, or related GTM experience, including significant leadership experience in a high-growth SaaS or technology company.

 - Proven track record of scaling revenue organizations across multiple GTM motions and segments, including Enterprise, Strategic, Mid-Market, and Partnerships.

 - Deep expertise in revenue planning, forecasting, territory and capacity planning, sales processes, compensation, and GTM performance management.

 - Strong understanding of usage-based business models and the metrics that drive efficient growth, including pipeline generation, acquisition, expansion, retention, and revenue productivity.

 - Experience building scalable GTM systems, data infrastructure, and operating processes, with deep familiarity with Salesforce and modern GTM technology.

 - Demonstrated ability to use AI and automation to increase GTM productivity, improve decision-making, and fundamentally rethink how Revenue Operations operates.

 - Exceptional analytical and strategic thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear insights and decisions for executive leadership.

 - Proven ability to partner with and influence senior executives across Sales, Marketing, Finance, Product, Legal, and Customer Success.

 - Exceptional leadership and organizational skills, with a track record of building and developing high-performing RevOps teams.

 - Strong business judgment, bias for action, and comfort operating in a fast-moving, ambiguous environment.




LOCATION

This role is remote across the US, with the option to work from our San Francisco or New York offices if preferred.

We are an equal opportunity employer and do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, veteran status, disability or other legally protected statuses.

jobs.title: Renewals Specialist - Remote (US East Coast)
jobs.description:
The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination.

n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact.



Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve:



 - Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders

 - Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects

 - Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation


That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register http://app.n8n.cloud/register.



We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us.

🎯 Your main goal will be to own and help build a scalable renewal motion for our Scaled Customer Success segment: protecting revenue and ensuring contracts reach a signed outcome ahead of expiry.

As our first dedicated Renewals Specialist, you’ll manage the end-to-end commercial renewal process for a high-volume portfolio of Enterprise customers, typically €20k–50k ARR, with around 60 renewals per quarter. You’ll work closely with our Scaled CSMs while helping us build the processes, operating rhythms, and automation that will allow renewals to scale as n8n grows. You'll usually work with billing/procurement contacts and the n8n champion on the account (often a technical user or engineer). 




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own renewals end-to-end. Prepare and send renewal quotes, negotiate pricing and commercial terms, manage procurement and contractual back-and-forth, create order forms, coordinate signatures, and ensure completed contracts are accurately processed in our CRM and billing systems.

 - Manage a high-volume renewal pipeline. Keep around 60 renewals per quarter progressing with clear next steps, accurate renewal dates, and enough lead time to avoid preventable last-minute slippage.

 - Partner with CSMs on renewal risk. Work closely with Scaled CSMs to understand customer health, identify potential churn or commercial risk early, and determine the right path to renewal.

 - Keep the forecast accurate. Maintain reliable renewal forecasts, close-plan notes, and CRM hygiene so we have a clear view of upcoming renewals and revenue retention.

 - Build a more scalable renewal motion. Identify where processes break down or create unnecessary manual work, and improve the workflows, templates, operating rhythms, and automation behind them.

 - Navigate the business independently. Partner with Finance, Legal, Sales, and Customer Success to resolve commercial or contractual blockers and keep renewals moving.




REQUIREMENTS


MUST-HAVES

 - 🔄 B2B SaaS renewals experience: You’ve owned commercial renewals, account management, or a commercially focused Customer Success portfolio in B2B SaaS, including negotiating contracts and renewals with business customers.

 - 📚 High-volume portfolio management: You’ve managed a sizeable book of customers and are comfortable keeping dozens of commercial conversations moving simultaneously. Experience with smaller Enterprise accounts and roughly €20k–50k ARR contracts is particularly relevant.

 - 🤝 Commercial & contractual confidence: You’re comfortable negotiating pricing and terms and navigating the practical mechanics of SaaS renewals — quotes, order forms, procurement, legal review, approvals, and signatures.

 - 📈 Operational rigor: You manage your renewal pipeline with discipline. Forecasts, dates, next steps, and CRM data stay accurate, and you take ownership of getting contracts closed on time.

 - 🚀 High-growth startup experience: You’ve worked in a fast-growing environment where processes change quickly, ownership is high, and the answer isn't always already documented.

 - 🛠️ Builder mindset: You don't just execute a process — you notice where it isn't working and help improve it. You’re comfortable creating structure while doing the work at the same time.

 - 🤖 Automation mindset: You’re interested in using automation and AI to eliminate repetitive work and make high-volume processes more scalable.




NICE-TO-HAVES
